    (assert (wf (view wg)))
    (assert (<= n 100000))
    (assert (ctx (view wg) n s))))

(ghost-fn nodup ((s (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len s))) (!= (idx s i) (idx s j))))))
(ghost-fn all_below ((s (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((i int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (< (idx s i) n))))))
(ghost-fn swap_out ((s (seq int)) (k int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))))
  (body (seq-build (- (len s) 1) (fn (q) (if (== q k) (idx s (- (len s) 1)) (idx s q))))))
(lemma swap_out_at (params (s (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))))
  (ensures (== (len (swap_out s k)) (- (len s) 1))
           (forall ((q int)) (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q (- (len s) 1)))
             (== (idx (swap_out s k) q) (if (== q k) (idx s (- (len s) 1)) (idx s q))))))
  (body))
(lemma nodup_ne (params (s (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (nodup s) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s))) (!= i j))
  (ensures (!= (idx s i) (idx s j)))
  (body
    (if (< i j)
      (assert (!= (idx s i) (idx s j)))
      (assert (!= (idx s j) (idx s i))))))
(lemma below_at (params (s (seq int)) (n int) (i int))
  (requires (all_below s n) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (< (idx s i) n)))
  (body))
(lemma swap_out_ne_at (params (s (seq int)) (k int) (q int) (r int))
  (requires (nodup s) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q r)) (< r (- (len s) 1))))
  (ensures (!= (idx (swap_out s k) q) (idx (swap_out s k) r)))
  (body
    (call swap_out_at s k)
    (ghost-let l int (- (len s) 1))
    (if (== q k)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (swap_out s k) q) (idx s l)))
        (assert (== (idx (swap_out s k) r) (idx s r)))
        (call nodup_ne s l r))
      (if (== r k)
        (block
          (assert (== (idx (swap_out s k) r) (idx s l)))
          (assert (== (idx (swap_out s k) q) (idx s q)))
          (call nodup_ne s q l))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx (swap_out s k) q) (idx s q)))
          (assert (== (idx (swap_out s k) r) (idx s r)))
          (call nodup_ne s q r))))))
(lemma swap_out_below_at (params (s (seq int)) (n int) (k int) (q int))
  (requires (nodup s) (all_below s n) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (== (idx s k) (- n 1))
            (and (<= 0 q) (< q (- (len s) 1))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx (swap_out s k) q)) (< (idx (swap_out s k) q) (- n 1))))
  (body
    (call swap_out_at s k)
    (ghost-let l int (- (len s) 1))
    (if (== q k)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (swap_out s k) q) (idx s l)))
        (call nodup_ne s k l)
        (call below_at s n l))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (swap_out s k) q) (idx s q)))
        (call nodup_ne s k q)
        (call below_at s n q)))))
(lemma pigeon (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (nodup s) (all_below s n))
  (ensures (<= (len s) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call below_at s n 0)
        (if (exists ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (== (idx s k) (- n 1))))
          (block
            (obtain ((k0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 k0) (< k0 (len s))) (== (idx s k0) (- n 1))))
            (ghost-let t (seq int) (swap_out s k0))
            (call swap_out_at s k0)
            (forall ((q int) (r int)) (call swap_out_ne_at s k0 q r))
            (forall ((q int)) (call swap_out_below_at s n k0 q))
            (assert (nodup t))
            (assert (all_below t (- n 1)))
            (call pigeon t (- n 1))
            (assert (== (len t) (- (len s) 1))))
          (block
            (assert (all_below s (- n 1)))
            (call pigeon s (- n 1))))))))
(lemma pigeon_dup (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (all_below s n) (> (len s) n))
  (ensures (exists ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len s))) (== (idx s i) (idx s j)))))
  (body
    (if (nodup s)
      (call pigeon s n)
      (block (assert (not (nodup s)))))))

(lemma weight_from_at (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (i int) (a int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 a) (<= a i)) (< i (len row)) (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
            (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))) (!= j i)) (!= (get (idx row j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v a) (get (idx row i) 1)))
  (decreases (- (len row) a))
  (body
    (if (== a i)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v a) (get (idx row i) 1)))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row a) 0) v))
        (call weight_from_at row v i (+ a 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v a) (weight_from row v (+ a 1))))))))
(lemma edge_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
           (connected g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (assert (connected g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
(lemma edge_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (connected g u v))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (connected g u v))
    (assert (wf g))
    (obtain ((w0 int)) (has_edge g u v w0))
    (assert (has_edge g u v w0))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u)))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 1) w0))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) (len g))))))
(lemma edge_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (wf g))
    (call weight_from_at (idx g u) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) i 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                (weight_from (idx g u) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) 0)))))
(lemma connected_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (connected g u v))
  (ensures (exists ((i int))
    (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
         (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) (get_edge_weight g u v))))))
  (body
    (assert (connected g u v))
    (obtain ((w0 int)) (has_edge g u v w0))
    (assert (has_edge g u v w0))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u)))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 1) w0))))
    (call edge_weight g u i0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w0))))
(lemma edge_info (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) n))
           (and (<= -100000 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body
    (assert (ctx g n s))
    (assert (wf g))
    (assert (weights_and_size_bounded g))
    (call edge_has g u i)))

(lemma path_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx p t) (idx p (+ t 1))))
  (body (assert (is_path g p))))
(lemma path_take_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- k 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take p k) t) (idx (take p k) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (call path_step g p t)
    (assert (== (idx (take p k) t) (idx p t)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p k) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ t 1))))))
(lemma path_take (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures (is_path g (take p k)) (== (len (take p k)) k) (== (idx (take p k) 0) (idx p 0)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (take p k)) k))
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_take_step g p k t))
    (assert (== (idx (take p k) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (is_path g (take p k)))))
(lemma path_drop_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (- (len p) k) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (drop p k) t) (idx (drop p k) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (call path_step g p (+ t k))
    (assert (== (idx (drop p k) t) (idx p (+ t k))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop p k) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ (+ t k) 1))))))
(lemma path_drop (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (is_path g (drop p k)) (== (len (drop p k)) (- (len p) k)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (drop p k)) (- (len p) k)))
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_drop_step g p k t))
    (assert (is_path g (drop p k)))))
(lemma path_below_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p t)) (< (idx p t) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (< t (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call path_step g p t)
        (call edge_range g (idx p t) (idx p (+ t 1))))
      (block
        (call path_step g p (- t 1))
        (assert (== (idx p (+ (- t 1) 1)) (idx p t)))
        (call edge_range g (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p (+ (- t 1) 1)))))))
(lemma path_below (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures (all_below p (len g)))
  (body
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_below_step g p t))
    (assert (all_below p (len g)))))
(lemma extend_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) t) (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (if (< t (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call path_step g p t)
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) t) (idx p t)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ t 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) t) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ t 1)) v))))))
(lemma path_extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
           (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) v)
           (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
               (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (forall ((t int)) (call extend_step g p v t))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (== (idx q (len p)) v))
    (call law_seq_ext (take q (- (len q) 1)) p)
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q)
                (+ (path_weight g (take q (- (len q) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))))

(lemma split_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) (path_weight g (drop p m)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== m (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert (== (+ m 1) (len p)))
        (assert (== (take p (+ m 1)) p))
        (assert (== (len (drop p m)) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (drop p m)) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let pp (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let dm (seq int) (drop p m))
        (assert (== (len pp) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (len dm) (- (len p) m)))
        (call split_weight g pp m)
        (call law_take_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ m 1))
        (call law_seq_ext (take dm (- (len dm) 1)) (drop pp m))
        (assert (== (idx dm (- (len dm) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
        (assert (== (idx dm (- (len dm) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g dm)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take dm (- (len dm) 1)))
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx dm (- (len dm) 2)) (idx dm (- (len dm) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g pp)
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn cut ((p (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (body (seq-build (- (len p) (- j i)) (fn (t) (if (<= t i) (idx p t) (idx p (+ t (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_facts (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (ensures (== (len (cut p i j)) (- (len p) (- j i)))
           (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= 0 t) (<= t i)) (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p t))))
           (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (< i t) (< t (- (len p) (- j i))))
                                 (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p (+ t (- j i)))))))
  (body))
(lemma path_cut_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (if (< t i)
      (block
        (call path_step g p t)
        (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p t)))
        (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ t 1)))))
      (if (== t i)
        (block
          (call path_step g p j)
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
        (block
          (call path_step g p (+ t (- j i)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p (+ t (- j i)))))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ (+ t (- j i)) 1)))))))))
(lemma path_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (is_path g (cut p i j))
           (== (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_cut_step g p i j t))
    (assert (is_path g (cut p i j)))
    (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (if (== j (- (len p) 1))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) i) (idx p j)))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))
                  (idx p (+ (- (len (cut p i j)) 1) (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_drop_step (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- (len p) j))))
  (ensures (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ x i)) (idx p (+ x j))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (if (== x 0)
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) i) (idx p i)))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ x i)) (idx p (+ (+ x i) (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p)
               (+ (path_weight g (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i)) (path_weight g (cut p i j)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let tk (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (cut p i j))
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (assert (== (len tk) (+ j 1)))
    (call split_weight g p j)
    (call split_weight g tk i)
    (call law_take_take p (+ j 1) (+ i 1))
    (call split_weight g r i)
    (call law_seq_ext (take r (+ i 1)) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (forall ((x int)) (call cut_drop_step p i j x))
    (call law_seq_ext (drop r i) (drop p j))))
(lemma cycle_nonneg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (not (has_negative_cycle g)) (is_path g c) (> (len c) 1)
            (== (idx c 0) (idx c (- (len c) 1))))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g c) 0))
  (body (assert (not (has_negative_cycle g)))))

(ghost-fn short_path ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int)) bool
  (body (exists ((q (seq int)))
    (and (and (is_path g q) (<= (len q) (len g)))
         (and (and (== (idx q 0) s) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) e))
              (<= (path_weight g q) x))))))
(lemma reduce (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (> (len g) 0) (not (has_negative_cycle g)) (is_path g p))
  (ensures (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (assert (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
      (block
        (call path_below g p)
        (call pigeon_dup p (len g))
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (ghost-let c (seq int) (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i))
        (call path_take g p (+ j 1))
        (call path_drop g (take p (+ j 1)) i)
        (assert (== (len c) (+ (- j i) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx p i)))
        (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p j)))
        (call cycle_nonneg g c)
        (call cut_weight g p i j)
        (call path_cut g p i j)
        (call cut_facts p i j)
        (call reduce g (cut p i j))
        (assert (short_path g (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1)) (path_weight g (cut p i j))))
        (obtain ((q (seq int)))
          (and (and (is_path g q) (<= (len q) (len g)))
               (and (and (== (idx q 0) (idx (cut p i j) 0))
                         (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))))
                    (<= (path_weight g q) (path_weight g (cut p i j))))))
        (assert (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))))))

(ghost-fn walks ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int)) bool
  (body (exists ((p (seq int)))
    (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) e)))
         (== (path_weight g p) x)))))
(lemma walk_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) e) (== (path_weight g p) x))
  (ensures (walks g s e x))
  (body))
(lemma relax_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (u int) (i int) (du int))
  (requires (wf g) (walks g s u du) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (walks g s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let tv int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (ghost-let wt int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (assert (walks g s u du))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
           (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call edge_has g u i)
    (call edge_weight g u i)
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) tv))
    (call path_extend g p tv)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) tv) wt))
    (call walk_intro g s tv (+ du wt) (concat p (seq-lit tv)))))

(ghost-fn dist_le ((d (seq (option int))) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d)))
             (and (is some (idx d v)) (<= (field (idx d v) value) x)))))
(ghost-fn sound ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (walks g s v (field (idx d v) value))))))
(ghost-fn bounded ((d (seq (option int))) (b int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (and (<= (- 0 b) (field (idx d v) value)) (<= (field (idx d v) value) b))))))
(ghost-fn mono ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (dist_le nx v (field (idx d v) value))))))
(ghost-fn same_dist ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (== (idx nx v) (idx d v))))))
(ghost-fn lb ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((p (seq int)))
    (=> (and (and (is_path g p) (<= (len p) (+ k 1))) (== (idx p 0) s))
        (dist_le d (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p))))))
(ghost-fn all_relaxed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (and (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i ci)))
                  (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u)))))
        (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn outer_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len d) (len g)) (sound g s d))
             (and (bounded d (* k 100000)) (lb g s k d)))))
(ghost-fn round_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len nx) (len g)) (mono d nx))
             (and (and (sound g s nx) (bounded nx (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
                  (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci)))))
(ghost-fn updated ((nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len nx2) (len nx)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len nx))))
             (and (== (idx nx2 v) (some c))
                  (and (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len nx))) (!= x v)) (== (idx nx2 x) (idx nx x))))
                       (or (is none (idx nx v)) (< c (field (idx nx v) value))))))))
(ghost-fn improved ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (w int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 w) (and (< w (len nx)) (< w (len d))))
             (and (is some (idx nx w))
                  (or (is none (idx d w)) (< (field (idx nx w) value) (field (idx d w) value)))))))
(ghost-fn final_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (ds (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (< v (len ds)))
        (match (idx ds v)
          (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                         (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
          (case (some dv) (is_shortest_dist g s v dv)))))))

(lemma le_mono (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (t int) (y int))
  (requires (mono a b) (dist_le a t y))
  (ensures (dist_le b t y))
  (body (assert (dist_le b t (field (idx a t) value)))))
(lemma mono_refl (params (a (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (mono a a))
  (body (assert (mono a a))))
(lemma mono_trans_at (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (v int))
  (requires (mono a b) (mono b c) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len a))) (is some (idx a v))))
  (ensures (dist_le c v (field (idx a v) value)))
  (body
    (assert (dist_le b v (field (idx a v) value)))
    (call le_mono b c v (field (idx a v) value))))
(lemma mono_trans (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))))
  (requires (mono a b) (mono b c))
  (ensures (mono a c))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call mono_trans_at a b c v))
    (assert (mono a c))))
(lemma updated_mono (params (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (tv int) (c int))
  (requires (updated nx nx2 tv c))
  (ensures (mono nx nx2))
  (body
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (assert (mono nx nx2))))
(lemma sound_update (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (tv int) (c int))
  (requires (sound g s nx) (updated nx nx2 tv c) (walks g s tv c))
  (ensures (sound g s nx2))
  (body
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (assert (sound g s nx2))))
(lemma bounded_update (params (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (tv int) (c int) (b int))
  (requires (bounded nx b) (updated nx nx2 tv c) (and (<= (- 0 b) c) (<= c b)))
  (ensures (bounded nx2 b))
  (body
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (assert (bounded nx2 b))))
(lemma dist_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (u int) (x int))
  (requires (outer_inv g s k d) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d))) (== (idx d u) (some x)))
  (ensures (<= (- 0 (* k 100000)) x) (<= x (* k 100000)))
  (body
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (bounded d (* k 100000)))
    (assert (== (field (idx d u) value) x))))

(lemma relaxed_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i ci)))
            (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (body (assert (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci))))
(lemma relaxed_empty (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (all_relaxed g d nx 0 0))
  (body (assert (all_relaxed g d nx 0 0))))
(lemma relaxed_advance_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int) (u2 int) (i2 int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u i) (mono nx nx2)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u)))
            (dist_le nx2 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
            (and (<= 0 u2) (< u2 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u2))))
            (or (< u2 u) (and (== u2 u) (< i2 (+ i 1))))
            (and (< u2 (len d)) (is some (idx d u2))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx2 (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1))))
  (body
    (if (and (== u2 u) (== i2 i))
      (block)
      (block
        (call relaxed_at g d nx u i u2 i2)
        (call le_mono nx nx2 (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1)))))))
(lemma relaxed_advance (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u i) (mono nx nx2)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u)))
            (dist_le nx2 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (all_relaxed g d nx2 u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((u2 int) (i2 int)) (call relaxed_advance_at g d nx nx2 u i u2 i2))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d nx2 u (+ i 1)))))
(lemma row_done_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (ci int) (u2 int) (i2 int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u ci) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (== ci (len (idx g u)))
            (and (<= 0 u2) (< u2 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u2))))
            (or (< u2 (+ u 1)) (and (== u2 (+ u 1)) (< i2 0)))
            (and (< u2 (len d)) (is some (idx d u2))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1))))
  (body (call relaxed_at g d nx u ci u2 i2)))
(lemma skip_none_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (u2 int) (i2 int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u 0) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d))) (is none (idx d u))
            (and (<= 0 u2) (< u2 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u2))))
            (or (< u2 (+ u 1)) (and (== u2 (+ u 1)) (< i2 0)))
            (and (< u2 (len d)) (is some (idx d u2))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (!= u2 u))
    (call relaxed_at g d nx u 0 u2 i2)))

(lemma round_begin (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))))
  (requires (>= k 0) (outer_inv g s k d) (== (len nx) (len d)) (same_dist d nx))
  (ensures (round_inv g s k d nx 0 0))
  (body
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (same_dist d nx))
    (assert (mono d nx))
    (assert (sound g s nx))
    (assert (bounded nx (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
    (call relaxed_empty g d nx)
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx 0 0))))
(lemma round_update (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (n int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int) (du int) (tv int) (wt int) (c int))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (outer_inv g s k d) (round_inv g s k d nx u i)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (idx d u) (some du))
            (== tv (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (== wt (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (== c (+ du wt))
            (updated nx nx2 tv c))
  (ensures (round_inv g s k d nx2 u (+ i 1)) (improved d nx2 tv))
  (body
    (assert (ctx g n s))
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx u i))
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (call updated_mono nx nx2 tv c)
    (call mono_trans d nx nx2)
    (assert (walks g s u (field (idx d u) value)))
    (assert (== (field (idx d u) value) du))
    (call relax_walk g s u i du)
    (call sound_update g s nx nx2 tv c)
    (call dist_bound g s k d u du)
    (call edge_info g n s u i)
    (call bounded_update nx nx2 tv c (* (+ k 1) 100000))
    (assert (dist_le nx2 tv c))
    (call relaxed_advance g d nx nx2 u i)
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx2 u (+ i 1)))
    (if (is some (idx d tv))
      (assert (dist_le nx tv (field (idx d tv) value)))
      (block))
    (assert (improved d nx2 tv))))
(lemma round_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (n int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int) (du int) (tv int) (wt int) (c int))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (outer_inv g s k d) (round_inv g s k d nx u i)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (idx d u) (some du))
            (== tv (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (== wt (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (== c (+ du wt))
            (dist_le nx tv c))
  (ensures (round_inv g s k d nx u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (assert (ctx g n s))
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx u i))
    (call mono_refl nx)
    (assert (== (field (idx d u) value) du))
    (call relaxed_advance g d nx nx u i)
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx u (+ i 1)))))
(lemma round_row_done (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (ci int))
  (requires (round_inv g s k d nx u ci) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (== ci (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (round_inv g s k d nx (+ u 1) 0))
  (body
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx u ci))
    (forall ((u2 int) (i2 int)) (call row_done_at g d nx u ci u2 i2))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d nx (+ u 1) 0))
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx (+ u 1) 0))))
(lemma round_skip_none (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int))
  (requires (round_inv g s k d nx u 0) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d))) (is none (idx d u)))
  (ensures (round_inv g s k d nx (+ u 1) 0))
  (body
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx u 0))
    (forall ((u2 int) (i2 int)) (call skip_none_at g d nx u u2 i2))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d nx (+ u 1) 0))
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx (+ u 1) 0))))

(lemma lb_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (lb g s k d) (and (and (is_path g p) (<= (len p) (+ k 1))) (== (idx p 0) s)))
  (ensures (dist_le d (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
  (body (assert (lb g s k d))))
(lemma lb_start (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))))
  (requires (>= k 0) (lb g s k d))
  (ensures (dist_le d s 0))
  (body
    (ghost-let p0 (seq int) (seq-lit s))
    (assert (== (len p0) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p0 0) s))
    (assert (is_path g p0))
    (call lb_at g s k d p0)
    (assert (== (path_weight g p0) 0))
    (assert (== (idx p0 (- (len p0) 1)) s))))
(lemma edge_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (== (len d) (len g)) (all_relaxed g d nx n 0) (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2)
            (dist_le d (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (ctx g n s))
    (ghost-let u0 int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (ghost-let v0 int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (call path_step g p (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (connected g u0 v0))
    (call connected_edge g u0 v0)
    (obtain ((i0 int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u0) (< u0 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u0)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u0) i0) 0) v0) (== (get (idx (idx g u0) i0) 1) (get_edge_weight g u0 v0)))))
    (assert (dist_le d u0 (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (call relaxed_at g d nx n 0 u0 i0)
    (assert (== (path_weight g p)
                (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
    (assert (dist_le nx v0 (path_weight g p)))))
(lemma lb_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (>= k 0) (outer_inv g s k d) (round_inv g s k d nx n 0)
            (and (and (is_path g p) (<= (len p) (+ k 2))) (== (idx p 0) s)))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx n 0))
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (block
        (call lb_at g s k d p)
        (call le_mono d nx (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
      (block
        (call path_take g p (- (len p) 1))
        (assert (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) s))
        (call lb_at g s k d (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
        (call edge_step g n s d nx p)))))
(lemma round_finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (>= k 0) (outer_inv g s k d) (round_inv g s k d nx n 0))
  (ensures (outer_inv g s (+ k 1) nx))
  (body
    (assert (ctx g n s))
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx n 0))
    (forall ((p (seq int))) (call lb_path g n s k d nx p))
    (assert (lb g s (+ k 1) nx))
    (assert (outer_inv g s (+ k 1) nx))))

(lemma init_lb (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (dist_le d s 0) (and (and (is_path g p) (<= (len p) 1)) (== (idx p 0) s)))
  (ensures (dist_le d (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) s))))
(lemma init_inv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (idx d s) (some 0))
            (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (!= v s)) (is none (idx d v)))))
  (ensures (outer_inv g s 0 d))
  (body
    (ghost-let p0 (seq int) (seq-lit s))
    (assert (== (len p0) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p0 0) s))
    (assert (is_path g p0))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p0) 0))
    (call walk_intro g s s 0 p0)
    (assert (dist_le d s 0))
    (assert (sound g s d))
    (assert (bounded d (* 0 100000)))
    (forall ((p (seq int))) (call init_lb g s d p))
    (assert (lb g s 0 d))
    (assert (outer_inv g s 0 d))))

(lemma same_le (params (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (t int) (y int))
  (requires (same_dist d nx) (== (len nx) (len d)) (dist_le nx t y))
  (ensures (dist_le d t y))
  (body
    (assert (same_dist d nx))
    (assert (dist_le nx t y))
    (assert (== (idx nx t) (idx d t)))))
(lemma same_relaxed_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci) (same_dist d nx) (== (len nx) (len d))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i ci)))
            (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u))))
  (ensures (dist_le d (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (body
    (call relaxed_at g d nx cu ci u i)
    (call same_le d nx (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma same_relaxed (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci) (same_dist d nx) (== (len nx) (len d)))
  (ensures (all_relaxed g d d cu ci))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (i int)) (call same_relaxed_at g d nx cu ci u i))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d d cu ci))))
(lemma fixed_lower (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (== (len d) (len g)) (dist_le d s 0) (all_relaxed g d d n 0)
            (and (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s)))
  (ensures (dist_le d (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (len p) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) s)))
      (block
        (call path_take g p (- (len p) 1))

    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (forall ((t int)) (call extend_step g p v t))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (== (idx q (len p)) v))
    (call law_seq_ext (take q (- (len q) 1)) p)
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q)
                (+ (path_weight g (take q (- (len q) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))))

(lemma split_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) (path_weight g (drop p m)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== m (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert (== (+ m 1) (len p)))
        (assert (== (take p (+ m 1)) p))
        (assert (== (len (drop p m)) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (drop p m)) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let pp (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let dm (seq int) (drop p m))
        (assert (== (len pp) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (len dm) (- (len p) m)))
        (call split_weight g pp m)
        (call law_take_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ m 1))
        (call law_seq_ext (take dm (- (len dm) 1)) (drop pp m))
        (assert (== (idx dm (- (len dm) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
        (assert (== (idx dm (- (len dm) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g dm)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take dm (- (len dm) 1)))
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx dm (- (len dm) 2)) (idx dm (- (len dm) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g pp)
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn cut ((p (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (body (seq-build (- (len p) (- j i)) (fn (t) (if (<= t i) (idx p t) (idx p (+ t (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_facts (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (ensures (== (len (cut p i j)) (- (len p) (- j i)))
           (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= 0 t) (<= t i)) (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p t))))
           (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (< i t) (< t (- (len p) (- j i))))
                                 (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p (+ t (- j i)))))))
  (body))
(lemma path_cut_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (if (< t i)
      (block
        (call path_step g p t)
        (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p t)))
        (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ t 1)))))
      (if (== t i)
        (block
          (call path_step g p j)
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
        (block
          (call path_step g p (+ t (- j i)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p (+ t (- j i)))))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ (+ t (- j i)) 1)))))))))
(lemma path_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (is_path g (cut p i j))
           (== (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_cut_step g p i j t))
    (assert (is_path g (cut p i j)))
    (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (if (== j (- (len p) 1))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) i) (idx p j)))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))
                  (idx p (+ (- (len (cut p i j)) 1) (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_drop_step (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- (len p) j))))
  (ensures (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ x i)) (idx p (+ x j))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (if (== x 0)
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) i) (idx p i)))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ x i)) (idx p (+ (+ x i) (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p)
               (+ (path_weight g (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i)) (path_weight g (cut p i j)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let tk (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (cut p i j))
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (assert (== (len tk) (+ j 1)))
    (call split_weight g p j)
    (call split_weight g tk i)
    (call law_take_take p (+ j 1) (+ i 1))
    (call split_weight g r i)
    (call law_seq_ext (take r (+ i 1)) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (forall ((x int)) (call cut_drop_step p i j x))
    (call law_seq_ext (drop r i) (drop p j))))
(lemma cycle_nonneg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (not (has_negative_cycle g)) (is_path g c) (> (len c) 1)
            (== (idx c 0) (idx c (- (len c) 1))))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g c) 0))
  (body (assert (not (has_negative_cycle g)))))

(ghost-fn short_path ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int)) bool
  (body (exists ((q (seq int)))
    (and (and (is_path g q) (<= (len q) (len g)))
         (and (and (== (idx q 0) s) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) e))
              (<= (path_weight g q) x))))))
(lemma reduce (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (> (len g) 0) (not (has_negative_cycle g)) (is_path g p))
  (ensures (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (assert (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
      (block
        (call path_below g p)
        (call pigeon_dup p (len g))
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (ghost-let c (seq int) (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i))
        (call path_take g p (+ j 1))
        (call path_drop g (take p (+ j 1)) i)
        (assert (== (len c) (+ (- j i) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx p i)))
        (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p j)))
        (call cycle_nonneg g c)
        (call cut_weight g p i j)
        (call path_cut g p i j)
        (call cut_facts p i j)
        (call reduce g (cut p i j))
        (assert (short_path g (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1)) (path_weight g (cut p i j))))
        (obtain ((q (seq int)))
          (and (and (is_path g q) (<= (len q) (len g)))
               (and (and (== (idx q 0) (idx (cut p i j) 0))
                         (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))))
                    (<= (path_weight g q) (path_weight g (cut p i j))))))
        (assert (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))))))

(ghost-fn walks ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int)) bool
  (body (exists ((p (seq int)))
    (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) e)))
         (== (path_weight g p) x)))))
(lemma walk_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) e) (== (path_weight g p) x))
  (ensures (walks g s e x))
  (body))
(lemma relax_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (u int) (i int) (du int))
  (requires (wf g) (walks g s u du) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (walks g s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let tv int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (ghost-let wt int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (assert (walks g s u du))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
           (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call edge_has g u i)
    (call edge_weight g u i)
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) tv))
    (call path_extend g p tv)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) tv) wt))
    (call walk_intro g s tv (+ du wt) (concat p (seq-lit tv)))))

(ghost-fn dist_le ((d (seq (option int))) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d)))
             (and (is some (idx d v)) (<= (field (idx d v) value) x)))))
(ghost-fn sound ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (walks g s v (field (idx d v) value))))))
(ghost-fn bounded ((d (seq (option int))) (b int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (and (<= (- 0 b) (field (idx d v) value)) (<= (field (idx d v) value) b))))))
(ghost-fn mono ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (dist_le nx v (field (idx d v) value))))))
(ghost-fn same_dist ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (== (idx nx v) (idx d v))))))
(ghost-fn lb ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((p (seq int)))
    (=> (and (and (is_path g p) (<= (len p) (+ k 1))) (== (idx p 0) s))
        (dist_le d (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p))))))
(ghost-fn all_relaxed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (and (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i ci)))
                  (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u)))))
        (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn outer_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len d) (len g)) (sound g s d))
             (and (bounded d (* k 100000)) (lb g s k d)))))
(ghost-fn round_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len nx) (len g)) (mono d nx))
             (and (and (sound g s nx) (bounded nx (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
                  (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci)))))
(ghost-fn updated ((nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len nx2) (len nx)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len nx))))
             (and (== (idx nx2 v) (some c))
                  (and (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len nx))) (!= x v)) (== (idx nx2 x) (idx nx x))))
                       (or (is none (idx nx v)) (< c (field (idx nx v) value))))))))
(ghost-fn improved ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (w int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 w) (and (< w (len nx)) (< w (len d))))
             (and (is some (idx nx w))
                  (or (is none (idx d w)) (< (field (idx nx w) value) (field (idx d w) value)))))))
(ghost-fn final_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (ds (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (< v (len ds)))
        (match (idx ds v)
          (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                         (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
          (case (some dv) (is_shortest_dist g s v dv)))))))

(lemma le_mono (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (t int) (y int))
  (requires (mono a b) (dist_le a t y))
  (ensures (dist_le b t y))
  (body (assert (dist_le b t (field (idx a t) value)))))
(lemma mono_refl (params (a (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (mono a a))
  (body (assert (mono a a))))
(lemma mono_trans_at (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (v int))
  (requires (mono a b) (mono b c) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len a))) (is some (idx a v))))
  (ensures (dist_le c v (field (idx a v) value)))
  (body
    (assert (dist_le b v (field (idx a v) value)))
    (call le_mono b c v (field (idx a v) value))))
(lemma mono_trans (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))))
  (requires (mono a b) (mono b c))
  (ensures (mono a c))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call mono_trans_at a b c v))
    (assert (mono a c))))
(lemma updated_mono (params (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (tv int) (c int))
  (requires (updated nx nx2 tv c))
  (ensures (mono nx nx2))
  (body
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (assert (mono nx nx2))))
(lemma sound_update (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (tv int) (c int))
  (requires (sound g s nx) (updated nx nx2 tv c) (walks g s tv c))
  (ensures (sound g s nx2))
  (body
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (assert (sound g s nx2))))
(lemma bounded_update (params (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (tv int) (c int) (b int))
  (requires (bounded nx b) (updated nx nx2 tv c) (and (<= (- 0 b) c) (<= c b)))
  (ensures (bounded nx2 b))
  (body
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (assert (bounded nx2 b))))
(lemma dist_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (u int) (x int))
  (requires (outer_inv g s k d) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d))) (== (idx d u) (some x)))
  (ensures (<= (- 0 (* k 100000)) x) (<= x (* k 100000)))
  (body
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (bounded d (* k 100000)))
    (assert (== (field (idx d u) value) x))))

(lemma relaxed_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i ci)))
            (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (body (assert (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci))))
(lemma relaxed_empty (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (all_relaxed g d nx 0 0))
  (body (assert (all_relaxed g d nx 0 0))))
(lemma relaxed_advance_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int) (u2 int) (i2 int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u i) (mono nx nx2)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u)))
            (dist_le nx2 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
            (and (<= 0 u2) (< u2 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u2))))
            (or (< u2 u) (and (== u2 u) (< i2 (+ i 1))))
            (and (< u2 (len d)) (is some (idx d u2))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx2 (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1))))
  (body
    (if (and (== u2 u) (== i2 i))
      (block)
      (block
        (call relaxed_at g d nx u i u2 i2)
        (call le_mono nx nx2 (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1)))))))
(lemma relaxed_advance (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u i) (mono nx nx2)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u)))
            (dist_le nx2 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (all_relaxed g d nx2 u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((u2 int) (i2 int)) (call relaxed_advance_at g d nx nx2 u i u2 i2))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d nx2 u (+ i 1)))))
(lemma row_done_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (ci int) (u2 int) (i2 int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u ci) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (== ci (len (idx g u)))
            (and (<= 0 u2) (< u2 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u2))))
            (or (< u2 (+ u 1)) (and (== u2 (+ u 1)) (< i2 0)))
            (and (< u2 (len d)) (is some (idx d u2))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1))))
  (body (call relaxed_at g d nx u ci u2 i2)))
(lemma skip_none_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (u2 int) (i2 int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u 0) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d))) (is none (idx d u))
            (and (<= 0 u2) (< u2 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u2))))
            (or (< u2 (+ u 1)) (and (== u2 (+ u 1)) (< i2 0)))
            (and (< u2 (len d)) (is some (idx d u2))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (!= u2 u))
    (call relaxed_at g d nx u 0 u2 i2)))

(lemma round_begin (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))))
  (requires (>= k 0) (outer_inv g s k d) (== (len nx) (len d)) (same_dist d nx))
  (ensures (round_inv g s k d nx 0 0))
  (body
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (same_dist d nx))
    (assert (mono d nx))
    (assert (sound g s nx))
    (assert (bounded nx (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
    (call relaxed_empty g d nx)
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx 0 0))))
(lemma round_update (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (n int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int) (du int) (tv int) (wt int) (c int))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (outer_inv g s k d) (round_inv g s k d nx u i)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (idx d u) (some du))
            (== tv (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (== wt (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (== c (+ du wt))
            (updated nx nx2 tv c))
  (ensures (round_inv g s k d nx2 u (+ i 1)) (improved d nx2 tv))
  (body
    (assert (ctx g n s))
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx u i))
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (call updated_mono nx nx2 tv c)
    (call mono_trans d nx nx2)
    (assert (walks g s u (field (idx d u) value)))
    (assert (== (field (idx d u) value) du))
    (call relax_walk g s u i du)
    (call sound_update g s nx nx2 tv c)
    (call dist_bound g s k d u du)
    (call edge_info g n s u i)
    (call bounded_update nx nx2 tv c (* (+ k 1) 100000))
    (assert (dist_le nx2 tv c))
    (call relaxed_advance g d nx nx2 u i)
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx2 u (+ i 1)))
    (if (is some (idx d tv))
      (assert (dist_le nx tv (field (idx d tv) value)))
      (block))

    (assert (wit g start d1 (concat p (seq-lit v)) (idx s1 v) v))))
(lemma reach_new (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (le_dist d0 d1) (reached g start d0 s0 u))
  (ensures (reached g start d1 s1 v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (wit g start d0 p (idx s0 u) u) (== (path_weight g p) (field (idx d0 u) value))))
    (call relax_new g start d0 d1 s0 s1 p u i v w nd)
    (assert (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v))) (field (idx d1 v) value)))))
(lemma reach_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int) (x int))
  (requires (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (le_dist d0 d1) (reached g start d0 s0 x) (!= x v))
  (ensures (reached g start d1 s1 x))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d1))) (< x (len s1))) (is some (idx d1 x)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx d1 x) (idx d0 x)))
        (assert (== (idx s1 x) (idx s0 x)))
        (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (wit g start d0 q (idx s0 x) x) (== (path_weight g q) (field (idx d0 x) value))))
        (call pre_mono g d0 d1 q)
        (assert (wit g start d1 q (idx s1 x) x))
        (assert (== (path_weight g q) (field (idx d1 x) value))))
      (block))))
(lemma reach_keep_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int) (x int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (le_dist d0 d1) (reach_all g start d0 s0))
  (ensures (reached g start d1 s1 x))
  (body
    (assert (reached g start d0 s0 u))
    (assert (reached g start d0 s0 x))
    (if (== x v)
      (call reach_new g start d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd)
      (call reach_other g start d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd x))))
(lemma reach_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (le_dist d0 d1) (reach_all g start d0 s0))
  (ensures (reach_all g start d1 s1))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call reach_keep_at g start d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd x))))

(lemma esat_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (v int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (esat g d0 x j) (d_upd d0 d1 v) (le_dist d0 d1) (!= x v))
  (ensures (esat g d1 x j))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (< x (len d1))) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))) (is some (idx d1 x))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx d1 x) (idx d0 x)))
        (assert (le_at d0 d1 (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0))))
      (block))))
(lemma round_keep_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (r int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (round_ok g d0 s0 r u i) (d_upd d0 d1 v) (s_upd s0 s1 v) (le_dist d0 d1)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))) (== (idx s1 v) (+ r 1)))
  (ensures (round_at g d1 s1 r u i x j))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s0))) (!= x v))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s1 x) (idx s0 x)))
        (assert (round_at g d0 s0 r u i x j))
        (if (or (< (idx s0 x) r) (and (== (idx s0 x) r) (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i)))))
          (call esat_mono g d0 d1 v x j)
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma round_adv_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (r int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (round_ok g dist stamp r u i) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len stamp))) (or (!= (idx stamp u) r) (esat g dist u i)))
  (ensures (round_at g dist stamp r u (+ i 1) x j))
  (body (assert (round_at g dist stamp r u i x j))))
(lemma round_next_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (r int) (u int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (round_ok g dist stamp r u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (round_at g dist stamp r (+ u 1) 0 x j))
  (body (assert (round_at g dist stamp r u (len (idx g u)) x j))))
(lemma round_close_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (r int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (round_ok g dist stamp r (len g) 0) (== (len stamp) (len g)))
  (ensures (round_at g dist stamp (+ r 1) 0 0 x j))
  (body (assert (round_at g dist stamp r (len g) 0 x j))))
(lemma round_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (bound_ok dist stamp 0) (== (len stamp) (len dist)))
  (ensures (round_at g dist stamp 0 0 0 x j))
  (body (assert (bound_at dist stamp 0 x))))

(lemma bound_weak_at (params (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (bound_ok dist stamp a) (<= a b))
  (ensures (bound_at dist stamp b x))
  (body (assert (bound_at dist stamp a x))))
(lemma bound_weak (params (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (bound_ok dist stamp a) (<= a b))
  (ensures (bound_ok dist stamp b))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call bound_weak_at dist stamp a b x))))
(lemma bound_keep_at (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (nd int) (h int) (lim int) (x int))
  (requires (bound_ok d0 s0 lim) (d_upd d0 d1 v) (s_upd s0 s1 v) (== (len s0) (len d0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d0)))
            (== (idx d1 v) (some nd)) (== (idx s1 v) h) (and (<= 0 h) (<= h lim))
            (<= (* -100000 h) nd) (<= nd (* 100000 h)))
  (ensures (bound_at d1 s1 lim x))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d0))) (!= x v))
      (block
        (assert (bound_at d0 s0 lim x))
        (assert (== (idx d1 x) (idx d0 x)))
        (assert (== (idx s1 x) (idx s0 x))))
      (block))))
(lemma bound_keep (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (nd int) (h int) (lim int))
  (requires (bound_ok d0 s0 lim) (d_upd d0 d1 v) (s_upd s0 s1 v) (== (len s0) (len d0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d0)))
            (== (idx d1 v) (some nd)) (== (idx s1 v) h) (and (<= 0 h) (<= h lim))
            (<= (* -100000 h) nd) (<= nd (* 100000 h)))
  (ensures (bound_ok d1 s1 lim))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call bound_keep_at d0 d1 s0 s1 v nd h lim x))))

(lemma relax_inv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (r int) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (inv g start d0 s0 (+ r 1) r u i) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd)
            (== (idx s0 u) r) (>= r 0) (< (+ r 1) (len g))
            (<= -100000 w) (<= w 100000))
  (ensures (inv g start d1 s1 (+ r 1) r u i)
           (or (!= (idx s1 u) r) (esat g d1 u i)))
  (body
    (call le_upd d0 d1 v nd)
    (call reach_keep g start d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd)
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call round_keep_at g d0 d1 s0 s1 v r u i x j))
    (assert (round_ok g d1 s1 r u i))
    (assert (bound_at d0 s0 (+ r 1) u))
    (assert (<= (* -100000 (+ r 1)) nd))
    (assert (<= nd (* 100000 (+ r 1))))
    (call bound_keep d0 d1 s0 s1 v nd (+ r 1) (+ r 1))
    (call bound_keep d0 d1 s0 s1 v nd (+ r 1) (- (len g) 1))
    (assert (le_at d0 d1 start))
    (assert (start_ok d1 start))
    (if (== (idx s1 u) r)
      (block
        (assert (!= u v))
        (assert (== (idx d1 u) (idx d0 u)))
        (assert (esat g d1 u i)))
      (block))))
(lemma adv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (lim int) (r int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (inv g start dist stamp lim r u i) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (or (!= (idx stamp u) r) (esat g dist u i)))
  (ensures (inv g start dist stamp lim r u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call round_adv_at g dist stamp r u i x j))
    (assert (round_ok g dist stamp r u (+ i 1)))))
(lemma next_u (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (lim int) (r int) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (inv g start dist stamp lim r u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (inv g start dist stamp lim r (+ u 1) 0))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call round_next_at g dist stamp r u x j))
    (assert (round_ok g dist stamp r (+ u 1) 0))))
(lemma next_r (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (r int))
  (requires (inv g start dist stamp (+ r 1) r (len g) 0))
  (ensures (inv g start dist stamp (+ r 1) (+ r 1) 0 0))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call round_close_at g dist stamp r x j))
    (assert (round_ok g dist stamp (+ r 1) 0 0))))
(lemma widen (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (r int))
  (requires (inv g start dist stamp r r 0 0))
  (ensures (inv g start dist stamp (+ r 1) r 0 0))
  (body (call bound_weak dist stamp r (+ r 1))))

(lemma init_pre_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (a int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist))) (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
  (ensures (pre_at g dist (seq-lit start) a))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (if (== a 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
        (assert (== (take (seq-lit start) 1) (seq-lit start)))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma init_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist))) (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
  (ensures (wit g start dist (seq-lit start) 0 start) (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (strict_walk g (seq-lit start)))
    (forall ((a int)) (call init_pre_at g start dist a))
    (assert (pre_ok g dist (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) (- (len (seq-lit start)) 1)) start))))
(lemma init_bound_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (init_ok g start dist stamp))
  (ensures (bound_at dist stamp 0 x))
  (body))
(lemma init_reach_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (init_ok g start dist stamp))
  (ensures (reached g start dist stamp x))
  (body
    (if (== x start)
      (block
        (call init_walk g start dist)
        (assert (== (idx stamp start) 0))
        (assert (wit g start dist (seq-lit start) (idx stamp x) x)))
      (block))))
(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)))
  (requires (init_ok g start dist stamp))
  (ensures (inv g start dist stamp 0 0 0 0))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call init_bound_at g start dist stamp x))
    (assert (bound_ok dist stamp 0))
    (call bound_weak dist stamp 0 (- (len g) 1))
    (forall ((x int)) (call init_reach_at g start dist stamp x))
    (assert (reach_all g start dist stamp))
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call round_init_at g dist stamp x j))
    (assert (round_ok g dist stamp 0 0 0))
    (assert (start_ok dist start))))

(lemma pre_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (a int))
  (requires (pre_ok g dist p) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p a)) (< (idx p a) (len dist))))
  (body (assert (pre_at g dist p a))))
(lemma long_walk_neg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (h int) (v int))
  (requires (wit g start dist p h v) (>= h (len dist)))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (forall ((a int)) (call pre_range g dist p a))
    (assert (seq_below p (len dist)))
    (call pigeon p (len dist))
    (obtain ((pi int)) (exists ((pz int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 pi) (< pi pz)) (< pz (len p))) (== (idx p pi) (idx p pz)))))
    (obtain ((pj int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 pi) (< pi pj)) (< pj (len p))) (== (idx p pi) (idx p pj))))
    (assert (strict_at g p pi pj))
    (call neg_from_dup g p pi pj)))
(lemma neg_found (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (reach_all g start d0 s0) (== (idx s1 v) (len g)))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call le_upd d0 d1 v nd)
    (call reach_keep g start d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd)
    (assert (reached g start d1 s1 v))
    (assert (is some (idx d1 v)))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (wit g start d1 p (idx s1 v) v) (== (path_weight g p) (field (idx d1 v) value))))
    (call long_walk_neg g start d1 p (idx s1 v) v)))

(lemma all_esat_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (round_ok g dist stamp (len g) 0 0) (bound_ok dist stamp (- (len g) 1))
            (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len stamp) (len g)))
  (ensures (esat g dist x j))
  (body
    (assert (round_at g dist stamp (len g) 0 0 x j))
    (assert (bound_at dist stamp (- (len g) 1) x))))
(lemma lower_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf_g g) (feasible g dist) (start_ok dist start) (== (len dist) (len g)) (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len dist)))
           (is some (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
           (<= (field (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (len p) 1))
        (assert (== (- (len p) 1) 0))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let pr (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call take_path g p (- (len p) 1))
        (assert (== (len pr) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx pr 0) start))
        (call lower_bound g start dist pr)
        (ghost-let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let b int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx pr (- (len pr) 1)) a))
        (call path_step g p (- (len p) 2))
        (assert (connected g a b))
        (call connected_index g a b)
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g a)))) (== (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0) b)))
        (call edge_weight_at g a e)
        (assert (== (get_edge_weight g a b) (get (idx (idx g a) e) 1)))
        (assert (esat g dist a e))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g pr) (get_edge_weight g a b))))))))
(lemma lower_none (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (v int) (q (seq int)))
  (requires (wf_g g) (feasible g dist) (start_ok dist start) (== (len dist) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (is none (idx dist v))
            (is_path g q) (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))
  (ensures false)
  (body (call lower_bound g start dist q)))
(lemma lower_some (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (v int) (q (seq int)))
  (requires (wf_g g) (feasible g dist) (start_ok dist start) (== (len dist) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (is some (idx dist v))
            (is_path g q) (== (idx q 0) start) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g q) (field (idx dist v) value)))
  (body (call lower_bound g start dist q)))
(lemma final_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (feasible g dist) (start_ok dist start) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len stamp) (len g))
            (reach_all g start dist stamp) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (match (idx dist v)
             (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                            (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
             (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (if (is none (idx dist v))
      (forall ((q (seq int))) (call lower_none g start dist v q))
      (block
        (assert (reached g start dist stamp v))
        (obtain ((w0 (seq int))) (and (wit g start dist w0 (idx stamp v) v) (== (path_weight g w0) (field (idx dist v) value))))
        (assert (and (and (is_path g w0) (and (== (idx w0 0) start) (== (idx w0 (- (len w0) 1)) v))) (== (path_weight g w0) (field (idx dist v) value))))
        (forall ((q (seq int))) (call lower_some g start dist v q))
        (assert (is_shortest_dist g start v (field (idx dist v) value)))))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)))
  (requires (wf_g g) (inv g start dist stamp (len g) (len g) 0 0))
  (ensures (forall ((v int))
             (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
                 (match (idx dist v)
                   (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                                  (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
                   (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call all_esat_at g dist stamp x j))
    (assert (feasible g dist))
    (forall ((v int)) (call final_at g start dist stamp v))))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call wf_bridge graph)
    (assert (wf_g g))
    (assert (== n (len g)))
    (assert (<= n 100000))
    (assert (and (<= 0 start) (< start n)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64)) (seq-build n (fn (ix) (none))))
    (let-mut stamp (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (iy) 0)))
    (set-idx dist start (some 0))
    (assert (init_ok g start dist stamp))
    (call init_state g start dist stamp)
    (let-mut r i64 0)
    (while (< r n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 r) (<= r n)))
      (invariant (and (== n (len g)) (<= n 100000)))
      (invariant (wf_g g))
      (invariant (inv g start dist stamp r r 0 0))
      (decreases (- n r))
      (call widen g start dist stamp r)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (and (== n (len g)) (<= n 100000)))
        (invariant (wf_g g))
        (invariant (inv g start dist stamp (+ r 1) r u 0))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (call row_short g u)
        (let rl i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
        (let-mut i i64 0)
        (while (< i rl)
          (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i rl)))
          (invariant (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (== rl (len (idx g u)))))
          (invariant (<= rl n))
          (invariant (and (== n (len g)) (<= n 100000)))
          (invariant (wf_g g))
          (invariant (inv g start dist stamp (+ r 1) r u i))
          (decreases (- rl i))
          (let edge (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
          (let vx i64 (get edge 0))
          (let wt i64 (get edge 1))
          (call edge_facts g u i)
          (assert (== vx (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
          (assert (== wt (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
          (let du_opt (option i64) (idx dist u))
          (match du_opt
            (case (none) (assert (esat g dist u i)))
            (case (some du)
              (if (== (idx stamp u) r)
                (block
                  (assert (bound_at dist stamp (+ r 1) u))
                  (let nd i64 (+ du wt))
                  (let better bool (match (idx dist vx) (case (none) true) (case (some prev_d) (< nd prev_d))))
                  (if better
                    (block
                      (ghost-let d0 (seq (option int)) dist)
                      (ghost-let s0 (seq int) stamp)
                      (set-idx dist vx (some nd))
                      (set-idx stamp vx (+ r 1))
                      (assert (step_ok g d0 dist s0 stamp u i vx wt nd))
                      (if (== (+ r 1) n)
                        (block
                          (call neg_found g start d0 dist s0 stamp u i vx wt nd)
