(ghost-fn bound_at ((dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (lim int) (x int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (<= 0 x) (and (< x (len dist)) (< x (len stamp))))
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx stamp x)) (<= (idx stamp x) lim))
         (=> (is some (idx dist x))
             (and (<= (* -100000 (idx stamp x)) (field (idx dist x) value))
                  (<= (field (idx dist x) value) (* 100000 (idx stamp x)))))))))
(ghost-fn bound_ok ((dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (bound_at dist stamp lim x))))
(ghost-fn start_ok ((dist (seq (option int))) (start int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
             (and (is some (idx dist start)) (<= (field (idx dist start) value) 0)))))
(ghost-fn inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (lim int) (r int) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len stamp) (len g)))
        (and (and (reach_all g start dist stamp) (round_ok g dist stamp r u i))
        (and (and (bound_ok dist stamp lim) (bound_ok dist stamp (- (len g) 1)))
             (start_ok dist start))))))
(ghost-fn init_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
        (and (and (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len stamp) (len g)))
        (and (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
        (and (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (!= x start)) (is none (idx dist x))))
             (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (== (idx stamp x) 0)))))))))

(lemma le_upd_at (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (v int) (nd int) (x int))
  (requires (d_upd d0 d1 v) (improves d0 v nd) (== (idx d1 v) (some nd)))
  (ensures (le_at d0 d1 x))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d0))) (!= x v))
      (assert (== (idx d1 x) (idx d0 x)))
      (block))))
(lemma le_upd (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (v int) (nd int))
  (requires (d_upd d0 d1 v) (improves d0 v nd) (== (idx d1 v) (some nd)))
  (ensures (le_dist d0 d1))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call le_upd_at d0 d1 v nd x))))
(lemma pre_mono_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (pre_ok g d0 p) (le_dist d0 d1) (== (len d1) (len d0)))
  (ensures (pre_at g d1 p i))
  (body
    (assert (pre_at g d0 p i))
    (if (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
      (assert (le_at d0 d1 (idx p i)))
      (block))))
(lemma pre_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (pre_ok g d0 p) (le_dist d0 d1) (== (len d1) (len d0)))
  (ensures (pre_ok g d1 p))
  (body (forall ((i int)) (call pre_mono_at g d0 d1 p i))))
(lemma low_from_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (nd int) (a int))
  (requires (pre_ok g d0 p) (improves d0 v nd))
  (ensures (low_at g p v nd a))
  (body (assert (pre_at g d0 p a))))
(lemma ext_strict_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (strict_walk g p) (low_all g p v (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))))
  (ensures (strict_at g (concat p (seq-lit v)) i j))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (<= j (len p)))
      (block
        (call ext_at p v i)
        (call ext_at p v j)
        (call ext_take p v i)
        (if (< j (len p))
          (block
            (call ext_take p v j)
            (assert (strict_at g p i j)))
          (block
            (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ j 1)) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
            (assert (low_at g p v (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v))) i)))))
      (block))))
(lemma ext_strict (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (strict_walk g p) (low_all g p v (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))))
  (ensures (strict_walk g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
  (body (forall ((i int) (j int)) (call ext_strict_at g p v i j))))
(lemma ext_pre_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (a int))
  (requires (pre_ok g d1 p) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d1))) (is some (idx d1 v))
            (<= (field (idx d1 v) value) (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))))
  (ensures (pre_at g d1 (concat p (seq-lit v)) a))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 a) (<= a (len p)))
      (block
        (call ext_at p v a)
        (if (< a (len p))
          (block
            (call ext_take p v a)
            (assert (pre_at g d1 p a)))
          (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ a 1)) (concat p (seq-lit v))))))
      (block))))

(lemma relax_new (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (le_dist d0 d1)
            (wit g start d0 p (idx s0 u) u) (== (path_weight g p) (field (idx d0 u) value)))
  (ensures (wit g start d1 (concat p (seq-lit v)) (idx s1 v) v)
           (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v))) nd))
  (body
    (call edge_intro g u i)
    (call edge_weight_at g u i)
    (call ext_weight g p v)
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v))) nd))
    (call ext_path g p v)
    (call pre_mono g d0 d1 p)
    (forall ((a int)) (call low_from_at g d0 p v nd a))
    (assert (low_all g p v nd))
    (call ext_strict g p v)
    (forall ((a int)) (call ext_pre_at g d1 p v a))
    (assert (pre_ok g d1 (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (call ext_at p v 0)
    (call ext_at p v (len p))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v))
    (assert (wit g start d1 (concat p (seq-lit v)) (idx s1 v) v))))
(lemma reach_new (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (le_dist d0 d1) (reached g start d0 s0 u))
  (ensures (reached g start d1 s1 v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (wit g start d0 p (idx s0 u) u) (== (path_weight g p) (field (idx d0 u) value))))
    (call relax_new g start d0 d1 s0 s1 p u i v w nd)
    (assert (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v))) (field (idx d1 v) value)))))
(lemma reach_other (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int) (x int))
  (requires (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (le_dist d0 d1) (reached g start d0 s0 x) (!= x v))
  (ensures (reached g start d1 s1 x))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d1))) (< x (len s1))) (is some (idx d1 x)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx d1 x) (idx d0 x)))
        (assert (== (idx s1 x) (idx s0 x)))
        (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (wit g start d0 q (idx s0 x) x) (== (path_weight g q) (field (idx d0 x) value))))
        (call pre_mono g d0 d1 q)
        (assert (wit g start d1 q (idx s1 x) x))
        (assert (== (path_weight g q) (field (idx d1 x) value))))
      (block))))
(lemma reach_keep_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int) (x int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (le_dist d0 d1) (reach_all g start d0 s0))
  (ensures (reached g start d1 s1 x))
  (body
    (assert (reached g start d0 s0 u))
    (assert (reached g start d0 s0 x))
    (if (== x v)
      (call reach_new g start d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd)
      (call reach_other g start d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd x))))
(lemma reach_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (le_dist d0 d1) (reach_all g start d0 s0))
  (ensures (reach_all g start d1 s1))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call reach_keep_at g start d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd x))))

(lemma esat_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (v int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (esat g d0 x j) (d_upd d0 d1 v) (le_dist d0 d1) (!= x v))
  (ensures (esat g d1 x j))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (< x (len d1))) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))) (is some (idx d1 x))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx d1 x) (idx d0 x)))
        (assert (le_at d0 d1 (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0))))
      (block))))
(lemma round_keep_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (r int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (round_ok g d0 s0 r u i) (d_upd d0 d1 v) (s_upd s0 s1 v) (le_dist d0 d1)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))) (== (idx s1 v) (+ r 1)))
  (ensures (round_at g d1 s1 r u i x j))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s0))) (!= x v))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s1 x) (idx s0 x)))
        (assert (round_at g d0 s0 r u i x j))
        (if (or (< (idx s0 x) r) (and (== (idx s0 x) r) (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i)))))
          (call esat_mono g d0 d1 v x j)
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma round_adv_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (r int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (round_ok g dist stamp r u i) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len stamp))) (or (!= (idx stamp u) r) (esat g dist u i)))
  (ensures (round_at g dist stamp r u (+ i 1) x j))
  (body (assert (round_at g dist stamp r u i x j))))
(lemma round_next_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (r int) (u int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (round_ok g dist stamp r u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (round_at g dist stamp r (+ u 1) 0 x j))
  (body (assert (round_at g dist stamp r u (len (idx g u)) x j))))
(lemma round_close_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (r int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (round_ok g dist stamp r (len g) 0) (== (len stamp) (len g)))
  (ensures (round_at g dist stamp (+ r 1) 0 0 x j))
  (body (assert (round_at g dist stamp r (len g) 0 x j))))
(lemma round_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (bound_ok dist stamp 0) (== (len stamp) (len dist)))
  (ensures (round_at g dist stamp 0 0 0 x j))
  (body (assert (bound_at dist stamp 0 x))))

(lemma bound_weak_at (params (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (bound_ok dist stamp a) (<= a b))
  (ensures (bound_at dist stamp b x))
  (body (assert (bound_at dist stamp a x))))
(lemma bound_weak (params (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (bound_ok dist stamp a) (<= a b))
  (ensures (bound_ok dist stamp b))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call bound_weak_at dist stamp a b x))))
(lemma bound_keep_at (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (nd int) (h int) (lim int) (x int))
  (requires (bound_ok d0 s0 lim) (d_upd d0 d1 v) (s_upd s0 s1 v) (== (len s0) (len d0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d0)))
            (== (idx d1 v) (some nd)) (== (idx s1 v) h) (and (<= 0 h) (<= h lim))
            (<= (* -100000 h) nd) (<= nd (* 100000 h)))
  (ensures (bound_at d1 s1 lim x))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d0))) (!= x v))
      (block
        (assert (bound_at d0 s0 lim x))
        (assert (== (idx d1 x) (idx d0 x)))
        (assert (== (idx s1 x) (idx s0 x))))
      (block))))
(lemma bound_keep (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (nd int) (h int) (lim int))
  (requires (bound_ok d0 s0 lim) (d_upd d0 d1 v) (s_upd s0 s1 v) (== (len s0) (len d0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d0)))
            (== (idx d1 v) (some nd)) (== (idx s1 v) h) (and (<= 0 h) (<= h lim))
            (<= (* -100000 h) nd) (<= nd (* 100000 h)))
  (ensures (bound_ok d1 s1 lim))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call bound_keep_at d0 d1 s0 s1 v nd h lim x))))

(lemma relax_inv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (r int) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (inv g start d0 s0 (+ r 1) r u i) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd)
            (== (idx s0 u) r) (>= r 0) (< (+ r 1) (len g))
            (<= -100000 w) (<= w 100000))
  (ensures (inv g start d1 s1 (+ r 1) r u i)
           (or (!= (idx s1 u) r) (esat g d1 u i)))
  (body
    (call le_upd d0 d1 v nd)
    (call reach_keep g start d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd)
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call round_keep_at g d0 d1 s0 s1 v r u i x j))
    (assert (round_ok g d1 s1 r u i))
    (assert (bound_at d0 s0 (+ r 1) u))
    (assert (<= (* -100000 (+ r 1)) nd))
    (assert (<= nd (* 100000 (+ r 1))))
    (call bound_keep d0 d1 s0 s1 v nd (+ r 1) (+ r 1))
    (call bound_keep d0 d1 s0 s1 v nd (+ r 1) (- (len g) 1))
    (assert (le_at d0 d1 start))
    (assert (start_ok d1 start))
    (if (== (idx s1 u) r)
      (block
        (assert (!= u v))
        (assert (== (idx d1 u) (idx d0 u)))
        (assert (esat g d1 u i)))
      (block))))
(lemma adv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (lim int) (r int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (inv g start dist stamp lim r u i) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (or (!= (idx stamp u) r) (esat g dist u i)))
  (ensures (inv g start dist stamp lim r u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call round_adv_at g dist stamp r u i x j))
    (assert (round_ok g dist stamp r u (+ i 1)))))
(lemma next_u (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (lim int) (r int) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (inv g start dist stamp lim r u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (inv g start dist stamp lim r (+ u 1) 0))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call round_next_at g dist stamp r u x j))
    (assert (round_ok g dist stamp r (+ u 1) 0))))
(lemma next_r (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (r int))
  (requires (inv g start dist stamp (+ r 1) r (len g) 0))
  (ensures (inv g start dist stamp (+ r 1) (+ r 1) 0 0))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call round_close_at g dist stamp r x j))
    (assert (round_ok g dist stamp (+ r 1) 0 0))))
(lemma widen (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (r int))
  (requires (inv g start dist stamp r r 0 0))
  (ensures (inv g start dist stamp (+ r 1) r 0 0))
  (body (call bound_weak dist stamp r (+ r 1))))

(lemma init_pre_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (a int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist))) (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
  (ensures (pre_at g dist (seq-lit start) a))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (if (== a 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
        (assert (== (take (seq-lit start) 1) (seq-lit start)))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma init_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist))) (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
  (ensures (wit g start dist (seq-lit start) 0 start) (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (strict_walk g (seq-lit start)))
    (forall ((a int)) (call init_pre_at g start dist a))
    (assert (pre_ok g dist (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) (- (len (seq-lit start)) 1)) start))))
(lemma init_bound_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (init_ok g start dist stamp))
  (ensures (bound_at dist stamp 0 x))
  (body))
(lemma init_reach_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (init_ok g start dist stamp))
  (ensures (reached g start dist stamp x))
  (body
    (if (== x start)
      (block
        (call init_walk g start dist)
        (assert (== (idx stamp start) 0))
        (assert (wit g start dist (seq-lit start) (idx stamp x) x)))
      (block))))
(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)))
  (requires (init_ok g start dist stamp))
  (ensures (inv g start dist stamp 0 0 0 0))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call init_bound_at g start dist stamp x))
    (assert (bound_ok dist stamp 0))
    (call bound_weak dist stamp 0 (- (len g) 1))
    (forall ((x int)) (call init_reach_at g start dist stamp x))
    (assert (reach_all g start dist stamp))
    (forall ((x int) (j int)) (call round_init_at g dist stamp x j))
    (assert (round_ok g dist stamp 0 0 0))
    (assert (start_ok dist start))))

(lemma pre_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (a int))
  (requires (pre_ok g dist p) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p a)) (< (idx p a) (len dist))))
  (body (assert (pre_at g dist p a))))
(lemma long_walk_neg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)) (h int) (v int))
  (requires (wit g start dist p h v) (>= h (len dist)))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (forall ((a int)) (call pre_range g dist p a))
    (assert (seq_below p (len dist)))
    (call pigeon p (len dist))
    (obtain ((pi int)) (exists ((pz int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 pi) (< pi pz)) (< pz (len p))) (== (idx p pi) (idx p pz)))))
    (obtain ((pj int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 pi) (< pi pj)) (< pj (len p))) (== (idx p pi) (idx p pj))))
    (assert (strict_at g p pi pj))
    (call neg_from_dup g p pi pj)))
(lemma neg_found (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (nd int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (step_ok g d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd) (reach_all g start d0 s0) (== (idx s1 v) (len g)))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call le_upd d0 d1 v nd)
    (call reach_keep g start d0 d1 s0 s1 u i v w nd)
    (assert (reached g start d1 s1 v))
    (assert (is some (idx d1 v)))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (wit g start d1 p (idx s1 v) v) (== (path_weight g p) (field (idx d1 v) value))))
    (call long_walk_neg g start d1 p (idx s1 v) v)))

(lemma all_esat_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (stamp (seq int)) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (round_ok g dist stamp (len g) 0 0) (bound_ok dist stamp (- (len g) 1))
            (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len stamp) (len g)))
  (ensures (esat g dist x j))
  (body
    (assert (round_at g dist stamp (len g) 0 0 x j))
    (assert (bound_at dist stamp (- (len g) 1) x))))
(lemma lower_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))

(lemma join_take_last (params (a (seq int)) (b (seq int)))

    (call law_len_drop b 1)
    (call law_len_concat a (drop b 1))
    (call law_len_take b (- (len b) 1))
    (call law_len_drop (take b (- (len b) 1)) 1)
    (call law_len_concat a (drop (take b (- (len b) 1)) 1))
    (call law_len_take (concat a (drop b 1)) (- (+ (len a) (len b)) 2))
    (forall ((t int)) (call join_take_last_at a b t))
    (call law_seq_ext (take (concat a (drop b 1)) (- (+ (len a) (len b)) 2)) (concat a (drop (take b (- (len b) 1)) 1)))))

    (call law_len_drop b 1)
    (call law_len_concat a (drop b 1))

        (forall ((t int)) (call join_one_at a b t))

      (block
        (ghost-let m int (- (len b) 1))

        (call law_idx_take b m 0)
        (assert (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b1 0)))
        (call join_weight g a b1)
        (call join_take_last a b)
        (call join_step_idx a b)

        (assert (== (- (len q) 1) (- (+ (len a) (len b)) 2)))

(lemma eq_take_at (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (t int))

  (ensures (== (idx (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i) 1)) t) (idx (take p (+ j 1)) t)))

    (ghost-let a (seq int) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (ghost-let tt (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let c (seq int) (drop tt i))
    (call law_len_take p (+ i 1))
    (call law_len_take p (+ j 1))
    (call law_len_drop tt i)
    (call join_idx a c t)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ j 1) t)
    (if (< t (len a))
      (call law_idx_take p (+ i 1) t)
      (block
        (call law_idx_drop tt i (+ (- t (len a)) 1))

(lemma eq_take (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (ensures (== (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i) 1)) (take p (+ j 1))))

    (call law_len_take p (+ i 1))
    (call law_len_take p (+ j 1))
    (call law_len_drop (take p (+ j 1)) i)
    (call law_len_drop (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i) 1)
    (call law_len_concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i) 1))

    (call law_seq_ext (concat (take p (+ i 1)) (drop (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i) 1)) (take p (+ j 1)))))

    (call law_len_drop p j)
    (call join_idx tt bb t)

(lemma eq_drop (params (p (seq int)) (j int))

    (call law_len_take p (+ j 1))
    (call law_len_drop p j)
    (call law_len_drop (drop p j) 1)
    (call law_len_concat (take p (+ j 1)) (drop (drop p j) 1))

(ghost-fn loop_of ((p (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)

(lemma cut_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (x int) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (walk g s x p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (walk g s x (cut_of p i j))
    (< (len (cut_of p i j)) (len p))
    (is_path g (loop_of p i j))
    (> (len (loop_of p i j)) 1)
    (== (idx (loop_of p i j) 0) (idx (loop_of p i j) (- (len (loop_of p i j)) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (cut_of p i j)) (path_weight g (loop_of p i j)))))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) s))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))
    (ghost-let a (seq int) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (ghost-let tt (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let c (seq int) (drop tt i))
    (ghost-let bb (seq int) (drop p j))
    (call law_len_take p (+ i 1))
    (call law_len_take p (+ j 1))
    (call law_len_drop tt i)
    (call law_len_drop p j)
    (assert (== (- (len a) 1) i))
    (assert (== (- (len tt) 1) j))
    (assert (== (- (len c) 1) (- j i)))
    (assert (== (- (len bb) 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ i 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ i 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ j 1) j)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ j 1) i)
    (call law_idx_drop tt i 0)
    (call law_idx_drop tt i (- j i))
    (call law_idx_drop p j 0)
    (call law_idx_drop p j (- (len p) (+ j 1)))
    (assert (== (+ (- j i) i) j))
    (assert (== (+ (- (len p) (+ j 1)) j) (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx p i)))
    (assert (== (idx tt (- (len tt) 1)) (idx p j)))
    (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx p i)))
    (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p j)))
    (assert (== (idx bb 0) (idx p j)))
    (assert (== (idx bb (- (len bb) 1)) x))
    (assert (== (idx a 0) s))
    (call take_path g p (+ i 1))
    (call take_path g p (+ j 1))
    (call drop_path g tt i)
    (call drop_path g p j)
    (call join_path g a bb)
    (call join_ends a bb)
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat a (drop bb 1)))
    (assert (== (cut_of p i j) r))
    (assert (== (loop_of p i j) c))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) s))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) x))
    (assert (walk g s x r))
    (assert (< (len r) (len p)))
    (call eq_take p i j)
    (call join_weight g a c)
    (assert (== (path_weight g tt) (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g c))))
    (call eq_drop p j)
    (call join_weight g tt bb)
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g tt) (path_weight g bb))))
    (call join_weight g a bb)
    (assert (== (path_weight g r) (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g bb))))))
(lemma pigeon (params (p (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (> (len p) n)
    (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))) (and (<= 0 (idx p t)) (< (idx p t) n)))))
  (ensures (exists ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (and (< j (len p)) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 0)
      (block
        (assert (> (len p) 0))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) n))))
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (- (len p) 1))
        (ghost-let x int (idx p m))
        (assert (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
        (if (exists ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k m)) (== (idx p k) x)))
          (block
            (obtain ((k0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 k0) (< k0 m)) (== (idx p k0) x)))
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 k0) (< k0 m)) (and (< m (len p)) (== (idx p k0) (idx p m))))))
          (block
            (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build m (fn (h) (if (== (idx p h) (- n 1)) x (idx p h)))))
            (assert (== (len q) m))
            (assert (forall ((h2 int)) (=> (and (<= 0 h2) (< h2 m)) (== (idx q h2) (if (== (idx p h2) (- n 1)) x (idx p h2))))))
            (assert (forall ((h3 int)) (=> (and (<= 0 h3) (< h3 m)) (and (<= 0 (idx q h3)) (< (idx q h3) (- n 1))))))
            (call pigeon q (- n 1))
            (obtain ((i0 int) (j0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 j0)) (and (< j0 (len q)) (== (idx q i0) (idx q j0)))))
            (assert (== (idx p i0) (idx p j0)))
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 j0)) (and (< j0 (len p)) (== (idx p i0) (idx p j0)))))))))))
(lemma path_vertex (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (x int) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (walk g s x p) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p t)) (< (idx p t) (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (if (== t 0)
      (assert (== (idx p 0) s))
      (block
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- t 1)))
        (ghost-let v int (idx p t))
        (call path_step g p (- t 1))
        (assert (connected g u v))
        (call connected_idx g u v)
        (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u))))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) v)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) (len g))))))))

(ghost-fn relaxes ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (e (tuple int int))) bool

(ghost-fn closed_upto ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int)) bool

(ghost-fn copy_of ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int)))) bool

(lemma updated_at (params (s (seq (option int))) (t (seq (option int))) (v int) (c (option int)) (x int))

(lemma eq_take (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))

(lemma cut_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (x int) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (walk g s x p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (walk g s x (cut_of p i j))
    (< (len (cut_of p i j)) (len p))
    (is_path g (loop_of p i j))
    (> (len (loop_of p i j)) 1)
    (== (idx (loop_of p i j) 0) (idx (loop_of p i j) (- (len (loop_of p i j)) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (cut_of p i j)) (path_weight g (loop_of p i j)))))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) s))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))
    (ghost-let a (seq int) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (ghost-let tt (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let c (seq int) (drop tt i))
    (ghost-let bb (seq int) (drop p j))
    (call law_len_take p (+ i 1))
    (call law_len_take p (+ j 1))
    (call law_len_drop tt i)
    (call law_len_drop p j)
    (assert (== (- (len a) 1) i))
    (assert (== (- (len tt) 1) j))
    (assert (== (- (len c) 1) (- j i)))
    (assert (== (- (len bb) 1) (- (len p) (+ j 1))))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ i 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ i 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ j 1) j)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ j 1) i)
    (call law_idx_drop tt i 0)
    (call law_idx_drop tt i (- j i))
    (call law_idx_drop p j 0)
    (call law_idx_drop p j (- (len p) (+ j 1)))
    (assert (== (+ (- j i) i) j))
    (assert (== (+ (- (len p) (+ j 1)) j) (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx p i)))
    (assert (== (idx tt (- (len tt) 1)) (idx p j)))
    (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx p i)))
    (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p j)))
    (assert (== (idx bb 0) (idx p j)))
    (assert (== (idx bb (- (len bb) 1)) x))
    (assert (== (idx a 0) s))
    (call take_path g p (+ i 1))
    (call take_path g p (+ j 1))
    (call drop_path g tt i)
    (call drop_path g p j)
    (call join_path g a bb)
    (call join_ends a bb)
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat a (drop bb 1)))
    (assert (== (cut_of p i j) r))
    (assert (== (loop_of p i j) c))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) s))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) x))
    (assert (walk g s x r))
    (assert (< (len r) (len p)))
    (call eq_take p i j)
    (call join_weight g a c)
    (assert (== (path_weight g tt) (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g c))))
    (call eq_drop p j)
    (call join_weight g tt bb)
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g tt) (path_weight g bb))))
    (call join_weight g a bb)
    (assert (== (path_weight g r) (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g bb))))))
(lemma pigeon (params (p (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (> (len p) n)
    (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))) (and (<= 0 (idx p t)) (< (idx p t) n)))))
  (ensures (exists ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (and (< j (len p)) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 0)
      (block
        (assert (> (len p) 0))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) n))))
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (- (len p) 1))
        (ghost-let x int (idx p m))
        (assert (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
        (if (exists ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k m)) (== (idx p k) x)))
          (block
            (obtain ((k0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 k0) (< k0 m)) (== (idx p k0) x)))
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 k0) (< k0 m)) (and (< m (len p)) (== (idx p k0) (idx p m))))))
          (block
            (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build m (fn (h) (if (== (idx p h) (- n 1)) x (idx p h)))))
            (assert (== (len q) m))
            (assert (forall ((h2 int)) (=> (and (<= 0 h2) (< h2 m)) (== (idx q h2) (if (== (idx p h2) (- n 1)) x (idx p h2))))))
            (assert (forall ((h3 int)) (=> (and (<= 0 h3) (< h3 m)) (and (<= 0 (idx q h3)) (< (idx q h3) (- n 1))))))
            (call pigeon q (- n 1))
            (obtain ((i0 int) (j0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 j0)) (and (< j0 (len q)) (== (idx q i0) (idx q j0)))))
            (assert (== (idx p i0) (idx p j0)))
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 j0)) (and (< j0 (len p)) (== (idx p i0) (idx p j0)))))))))))
(lemma path_vertex (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (x int) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (walk g s x p) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))))

        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) (len g))))))))

  (ensures (closed_upto g d t cu ci))
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int)) (call closed_step_at g d s t v c cu ci u i))))
(lemma closed_extend_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 cu) (< cu (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 ci) (< ci (len (idx g cu))))
    (closed_upto g d s cu ci)
    (relaxes d s cu (idx (idx g cu) ci))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i (+ ci 1)))))
  (ensures (relaxes d s u (idx (idx g u) i)))
  (body
    (if (and (== u cu) (== i ci))
      (block)
      (assert (relaxes d s u (idx (idx g u) i))))))
(lemma closed_extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 cu) (< cu (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 ci) (< ci (len (idx g cu))))
    (closed_upto g d s cu ci)
    (relaxes d s cu (idx (idx g cu) ci)))
  (ensures (closed_upto g d s cu (+ ci 1)))
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int)) (call closed_extend_at g d s cu ci u i))))
(lemma row_done_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (u int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (closed_upto g d s u (len (idx g u)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx g x))))
    (or (< x (+ u 1)) (and (== x (+ u 1)) (< y 0))))
  (ensures (relaxes d s x (idx (idx g x) y)))
  (body (assert (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< y (len (idx g u))))))))
(lemma row_done (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (b int) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (rstate g d s b u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (rstate g d s b (+ u 1) 0))
  (body
    (assert (closed_upto g d s u (len (idx g u))))
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call row_done_at g d s u x y))
    (assert (closed_upto g d s (+ u 1) 0))))
(lemma row_skip_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (u int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (closed_upto g d s u 0)
    (not (is some (opt_at d u)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx g x))))
    (or (< x (+ u 1)) (and (== x (+ u 1)) (< y 0))))
  (ensures (relaxes d s x (idx (idx g x) y)))
  (body
    (if (== x u)
      (assert (not (is some (opt_at d x))))
      (assert (< x u)))))
(lemma row_skip (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (b int) (u int))
  (requires (rstate g d s b u 0) (not (is some (opt_at d u))))
  (ensures (rstate g d s b (+ u 1) 0))

    (assert (closed_upto g d s u 0))

    (assert (closed_upto g d s (+ u 1) 0))))
(lemma improved_new (params (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (t (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (mono d s) (updated s t v (some c)) (lowers s v c))
  (ensures (improved d t))
  (body
    (call updated_at s t v (some c) v)
    (assert (== (opt_at t v) (some c)))
    (assert (== (field (opt_at t v) value) c))
    (if (is some (opt_at d v))
      (block
        (assert (below (opt_at s v) (field (opt_at d v) value)))
        (assert (is some (opt_at s v)))
        (assert (< c (field (opt_at s v) value)))
        (assert (not (below (opt_at d v) c))))
      (assert (not (below (opt_at d v) c))))
    (assert (improved_at d t v))))
(lemma on_update (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (t (seq (option int))) (b int) (u int) (i int) (c int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (rstate g d s b u i)
    (updated s t (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (some c))
    (lowers s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) c)
    (is some (opt_at d u))
    (== c (+ (field (opt_at d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (and (<= (- 0 b) c) (<= c b)))
  (ensures (rstate g d t b u (+ i 1)) (improved d t))
  (body
    (ghost-let v int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (assert (mono d s))
    (assert (provenance g d s))
    (assert (closed_upto g d s u i))
    (assert (bounded s b))
    (call mono_step d s t v c)
    (call from_edge_intro g d u i)
    (assert (from_edge g d v c))
    (call prov_step g d s t v c)
    (call closed_step g d s t v c u i)
    (call updated_at s t v (some c) v)
    (assert (== (opt_at t v) (some c)))
    (assert (below (opt_at t v) c))
    (assert (relaxes d t u (idx (idx g u) i)))
    (call closed_extend g d t u i)
    (call bounded_step s t v c b)

(lemma on_skip (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (s (seq (option int))) (b int) (u int) (i int) (c int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))

    (not (lowers s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) c))

  (body
    (ghost-let v int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (assert (closed_upto g d s u i))
    (assert (is some (opt_at s v)))
    (assert (>= c (field (opt_at s v) value)))
    (assert (below (opt_at s v) c))
    (assert (relaxes d s u (idx (idx g u) i)))

    (assert (rstate g d s b u (+ i 1)))))
(lemma same_at (params (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (x int))
  (requires (copy_of d nx))
  (ensures (== (opt_at nx x) (opt_at d x)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len nx) (len d)))
    (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d)))
      (assert (== (idx nx x) (idx d x)))
      (block))))
(lemma init_mono_at (params (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (x int))
  (requires (copy_of d nx) (is some (opt_at d x)))
  (ensures (below (opt_at nx x) (field (opt_at d x) value)))
  (body (call same_at d nx x)))
(lemma init_prov_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (x int))
  (requires (copy_of d nx))
  (ensures (prov_at g d nx x))
  (body (call same_at d nx x)))
(lemma copy_bound_at (params (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (b int) (c int) (x int))
  (requires (copy_of d nx) (bounded d b) (>= c b) (is some (opt_at nx x)))
  (ensures (and (<= (- 0 c) (field (opt_at nx x) value)) (<= (field (opt_at nx x) value) c)))
  (body
    (call same_at d nx x)
    (assert (is some (opt_at d x)))
    (assert (and (<= (- 0 b) (field (opt_at d x) value)) (<= (field (opt_at d x) value) b)))
    (assert (== (field (opt_at nx x) value) (field (opt_at d x) value)))))
(lemma round_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (copy_of d nx) (bounded d b) (>= c b))
  (ensures (rstate g d nx c 0 0) (same d nx))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call init_mono_at d nx x))
    (forall ((x int)) (call init_prov_at g d nx x))
    (forall ((x int)) (call copy_bound_at d nx b c x))
    (forall ((x int)) (call same_at d nx x))
    (assert (mono d nx))
    (assert (provenance g d nx))
    (assert (closed_upto g d nx 0 0))
    (assert (bounded nx c))
    (assert (same d nx))))
(ghost-fn sound_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (k int) (x int)) bool
  (body (=> (is some (opt_at d x))
    (exists ((p (seq int))) (and (walk g s x p) (and (<= (len p) (+ k 1)) (== (path_weight g p) (field (opt_at d x) value))))))))
(ghost-fn sound ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (sound_at g s d k x))))
(ghost-fn complete ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (p (seq int)))
    (=> (and (walk g s x p) (<= (len p) (+ k 1))) (below (opt_at d x) (path_weight g p))))))
(lemma sound_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (k int) (x int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is some (opt_at d x)) (walk g s x p) (<= (len p) (+ k 1)) (== (path_weight g p) (field (opt_at d x) value)))
  (ensures (sound_at g s d k x))
  (body (assert (and (walk g s x p) (and (<= (len p) (+ k 1)) (== (path_weight g p) (field (opt_at d x) value)))))))
(lemma extend_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (u int) (q (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (walk g s u q) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (distinct_ok g))
  (ensures
    (walk g s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (concat q (seq-lit (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
    (== (len (concat q (seq-lit (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))) (+ (len q) 1))
    (== (path_weight g (concat q (seq-lit (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))) (+ (path_weight g q) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let v int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (ghost-let w int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (> (len q) 0))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) u))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) s))
    (call has_edge_intro g u i)
    (assert (has_edge g u v w))
    (assert (connected g u v))
    (call snoc_path g q v)
    (call weight_snoc g q v)
    (call edge_weight g u i)
    (call snoc_idx q v 0)
    (call law_len_concat q (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_idx_concat q (seq-lit v) (len q))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit v) 0) v))
    (assert (== (idx (concat q (seq-lit v)) (len q)) v))
    (assert (== (- (len (concat q (seq-lit v))) 1) (len q)))
    (assert (walk g s v (concat q (seq-lit v))))))
(lemma sound_next_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (k int) (x int))
  (requires (sound g s d k) (provenance g d nx) (distinct_ok g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (sound_at g s nx (+ k 1) x))
  (body
    (if (is some (opt_at nx x))
      (block
        (assert (prov_at g d nx x))
        (ghost-let y int (field (opt_at nx x) value))
        (if (== (opt_at nx x) (opt_at d x))
          (block
            (assert (sound_at g s d k x))
            (assert (is some (opt_at d x)))
            (assert (== (field (opt_at d x) value) y))
            (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (walk g s x p) (and (<= (len p) (+ k 1)) (== (path_weight g p) (field (opt_at d x) value)))))
            (call sound_intro g s nx (+ k 1) x p))
          (block
            (assert (from_edge g d x y))
            (obtain ((u int) (i int))
              (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                   (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x)
                        (and (is some (opt_at d u)) (== y (+ (field (opt_at d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))
            (assert (sound_at g s d k u))
            (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (walk g s u q) (and (<= (len q) (+ k 1)) (== (path_weight g q) (field (opt_at d u) value)))))
            (call extend_walk g s u q i)
            (ghost-let q2 (seq int) (concat q (seq-lit x)))
            (assert (walk g s x q2))
            (assert (== (len q2) (+ (len q) 1)))
            (assert (== (path_weight g q2) y))
            (call sound_intro g s nx (+ k 1) x q2))))
      (block))))
(lemma sound_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (sound g s d k) (provenance g d nx) (distinct_ok g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (sound g s nx (+ k 1)))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call sound_next_at g s d nx k x))))
(lemma mono_below (params (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (x int) (c int))
  (requires (mono d nx) (below (opt_at d x) c))
  (ensures (below (opt_at nx x) c))
  (body
    (assert (is some (opt_at d x)))
    (assert (below (opt_at nx x) (field (opt_at d x) value)))))
(lemma walk_prefix (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (x int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (walk g s x p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (== (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) (- (len p) 1))
    (walk g s (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (take p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) s))
    (call take_path g p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1) (- (len p) 2)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
    (assert (walk g s (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (take p (- (len p) 1))))))
(lemma step_below (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (>= (len p) 2)
    (distinct_ok g)
    (closed_upto g d nx (len g) 0)
    (below (opt_at d (idx p (- (len p) 2))) (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (below (opt_at nx (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (ghost-let x int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (call path_step g p (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (connected g u x))
    (call connected_idx g u x)
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u))))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) x)))
    (call edge_weight g u i0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u x) (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 1)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g r) (get_edge_weight g u x))))
    (assert (relaxes d nx u (idx (idx g u) i0)))
    (assert (is some (opt_at d u)))
    (assert (<= (field (opt_at d u) value) (path_weight g r)))
    (assert (below (opt_at nx x) (+ (field (opt_at d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 1))))))
(lemma complete_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (k int) (x int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (complete g s d k)
    (mono d nx)
    (closed_upto g d nx (len g) 0)
    (distinct_ok g)
    (>= k 0)
    (walk g s x p)
    (<= (len p) (+ (+ k 1) 1)))
  (ensures (below (opt_at nx x) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (block
        (assert (below (opt_at d x) (path_weight g p)))
        (call mono_below d nx x (path_weight g p)))
      (block
        (call walk_prefix g s x p)
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (assert (walk g s u r))
        (assert (<= (len r) (+ k 1)))
        (assert (below (opt_at d u) (path_weight g r)))
        (call step_below g d nx p)))))
(lemma complete_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (complete g s d k) (mono d nx) (closed_upto g d nx (len g) 0) (distinct_ok g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (complete g s nx (+ k 1)))
  (body (forall ((x int) (p (seq int))) (call complete_step g s d nx k x p))))
(lemma fixed_below (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (k int) (x int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (complete g s d k) (>= k 0) (distinct_ok g) (closed_upto g d nx (len g) 0) (same d nx) (walk g s x p))
  (ensures (below (opt_at d x) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (assert (below (opt_at d x) (path_weight g p)))
      (block
        (call walk_prefix g s x p)
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (assert (walk g s u r))
        (assert (< (len r) (len p)))
        (call fixed_below g s d nx k u r)
        (call step_below g d nx p)
        (assert (== (opt_at nx x) (opt_at d x)))))))
(lemma no_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (k int) (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (complete g s d k) (>= k 0) (distinct_ok g) (closed_upto g d nx (len g) 0) (same d nx) (not (is some (opt_at d v))))
  (ensures (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false))
  (body
    (if (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
      (block
        (assert (walk g s v p))
        (call fixed_below g s d nx k v p)
        (assert (below (opt_at d v) (path_weight g p)))
        (assert (is some (opt_at d v))))
      (block))))
(lemma all_ge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (k int) (v int) (y int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (complete g s d k) (>= k 0) (distinct_ok g) (closed_upto g d nx (len g) 0) (same d nx) (== (opt_at d v) (some y)))
  (ensures (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (>= (path_weight g p) y)))
  (body
    (if (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
      (block
        (assert (walk g s v p))
        (call fixed_below g s d nx k v p)
        (assert (below (opt_at d v) (path_weight g p)))
        (assert (== (field (opt_at d v) value) y)))
      (block))))
(lemma final_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (k int) (v int))
  (requires
    (sound g s d k)
    (complete g s d k)
    (>= k 0)
    (distinct_ok g)
    (closed_upto g d nx (len g) 0)
    (same d nx)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))))
  (ensures (match (idx d v)
    (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int))) (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
    (case (some y) (is_shortest_dist g s v y))))
  (body
    (assert (== (opt_at d v) (idx d v)))
    (match (idx d v)
      (case (none)
        (block
          (assert (not (is some (opt_at d v))))
          (forall ((p1 (seq int))) (call no_walk g s d nx k v p1))))
      (case (some y1)
        (block
          (assert (== (opt_at d v) (some y1)))
          (assert (sound_at g s d k v))
          (assert (== (field (opt_at d v) value) y1))
          (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (walk g s v q) (and (<= (len q) (+ k 1)) (== (path_weight g q) y1))))
          (assert (is_path g q))
          (assert (== (idx q 0) s))
          (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))
          (forall ((p2 (seq int))) (call all_ge g s d nx k v y1 p2))
          (assert (and (and (is_path g q) (and (== (idx q 0) s) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))) (== (path_weight g q) y1)))
          (assert (is_shortest_dist g s v y1)))))))
(lemma neg_from_improved (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires
    (targets_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
    (>= k 0)
    (== (+ k 1) (len g))
    (complete g s d k)
    (sound g s nx (+ k 1))
    (improved d nx))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (obtain ((x int)) (improved_at d nx x))
    (assert (is some (opt_at nx x)))
    (ghost-let y int (field (opt_at nx x) value))

        (call below_at s n l))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (swap_out s k) q) (idx s q)))
        (call nodup_ne s k q)
        (call below_at s n q)))))
(lemma pigeon (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (nodup s) (all_below s n))
  (ensures (<= (len s) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call below_at s n 0)
        (if (exists ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (== (idx s k) (- n 1))))
          (block
            (obtain ((k0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 k0) (< k0 (len s))) (== (idx s k0) (- n 1))))
            (ghost-let t (seq int) (swap_out s k0))
            (call swap_out_at s k0)
            (forall ((q int) (r int)) (call swap_out_ne_at s k0 q r))
            (forall ((q int)) (call swap_out_below_at s n k0 q))
            (assert (nodup t))
            (assert (all_below t (- n 1)))
            (call pigeon t (- n 1))
            (assert (== (len t) (- (len s) 1))))
          (block
            (assert (all_below s (- n 1)))
            (call pigeon s (- n 1))))))))
(lemma pigeon_dup (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (all_below s n) (> (len s) n))
  (ensures (exists ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len s))) (== (idx s i) (idx s j)))))
  (body
    (if (nodup s)
      (call pigeon s n)
      (block (assert (not (nodup s)))))))

(ghost-fn row_targets ((row (seq (tuple int int)))) (seq int)
  (body (seq-build (len row) (fn (q) (get (idx row q) 0)))))
(lemma row_targets_at (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len row))))
  (ensures (== (len (row_targets row)) (len row))
           (== (idx (row_targets row) q) (get (idx row q) 0)))
  (body))
(lemma row_target_below (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (u int) (q int))
  (requires (wf g) (== n (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx (row_targets (idx g u)) q)) (< (idx (row_targets (idx g u)) q) n)))
  (body
    (call row_targets_at (idx g u) q)
    (assert (wf g))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) q) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) q) 0) (len g))))))
(lemma row_target_ne (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (q int) (r int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q r)) (< r (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (!= (idx (row_targets (idx g u)) q) (idx (row_targets (idx g u)) r)))
  (body
    (call row_targets_at (idx g u) q)
    (call row_targets_at (idx g u) r)
    (assert (wf g))
    (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) q) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) r) 0)))))
(lemma row_len (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (u int))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (len (idx g u)) 100000))
  (body
    (assert (ctx g n s))
    (assert (wf g))
    (ghost-let t (seq int) (row_targets (idx g u)))
    (assert (== (len t) (len (idx g u))))
    (forall ((q int)) (call row_target_below g n u q))
    (forall ((q int) (r int)) (call row_target_ne g u q r))
    (assert (nodup t))
    (assert (all_below t n))
    (call pigeon t n)))

(lemma weight_from_at (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (i int) (a int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 a) (<= a i)) (< i (len row)) (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
            (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))) (!= j i)) (!= (get (idx row j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v a) (get (idx row i) 1)))
  (decreases (- (len row) a))
  (body
    (if (== a i)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v a) (get (idx row i) 1)))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row a) 0) v))
        (call weight_from_at row v i (+ a 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v a) (weight_from row v (+ a 1))))))))
(lemma edge_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
           (connected g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (assert (connected g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
(lemma edge_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (connected g u v))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (connected g u v))
    (assert (wf g))
    (obtain ((w0 int)) (has_edge g u v w0))
    (assert (has_edge g u v w0))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u)))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 1) w0))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) (len g))))))
(lemma edge_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (wf g))
    (call weight_from_at (idx g u) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) i 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                (weight_from (idx g u) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) 0)))))
(lemma connected_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (connected g u v))
  (ensures (exists ((i int))
    (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
         (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) (get_edge_weight g u v))))))
  (body
    (assert (connected g u v))
    (obtain ((w0 int)) (has_edge g u v w0))
    (assert (has_edge g u v w0))
    (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len (idx g u)))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 1) w0))))
    (call edge_weight g u i0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w0))))
(lemma edge_info (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) n))
           (and (<= -100000 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body
    (assert (ctx g n s))
    (assert (wf g))
    (assert (weights_and_size_bounded g))
    (call edge_has g u i)))

(lemma path_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx p t) (idx p (+ t 1))))
  (body (assert (is_path g p))))
(lemma path_take_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- k 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take p k) t) (idx (take p k) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (call path_step g p t)
    (assert (== (idx (take p k) t) (idx p t)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p k) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ t 1))))))
(lemma path_take (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures (is_path g (take p k)) (== (len (take p k)) k) (== (idx (take p k) 0) (idx p 0)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (take p k)) k))
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_take_step g p k t))
    (assert (== (idx (take p k) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (is_path g (take p k)))))
(lemma path_drop_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (- (len p) k) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (drop p k) t) (idx (drop p k) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (call path_step g p (+ t k))
    (assert (== (idx (drop p k) t) (idx p (+ t k))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop p k) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ (+ t k) 1))))))
(lemma path_drop (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (is_path g (drop p k)) (== (len (drop p k)) (- (len p) k)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (drop p k)) (- (len p) k)))
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_drop_step g p k t))
    (assert (is_path g (drop p k)))))
(lemma path_below_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p t)) (< (idx p t) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (< t (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call path_step g p t)
        (call edge_range g (idx p t) (idx p (+ t 1))))
      (block
        (call path_step g p (- t 1))
        (assert (== (idx p (+ (- t 1) 1)) (idx p t)))
        (call edge_range g (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p (+ (- t 1) 1)))))))
(lemma path_below (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures (all_below p (len g)))
  (body
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_below_step g p t))
    (assert (all_below p (len g)))))
(lemma extend_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) t) (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (if (< t (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call path_step g p t)
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) t) (idx p t)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ t 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) t) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ t 1)) v))))))
(lemma path_extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
           (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) v)
           (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
               (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (forall ((t int)) (call extend_step g p v t))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (== (idx q (len p)) v))
    (call law_seq_ext (take q (- (len q) 1)) p)
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q)
                (+ (path_weight g (take q (- (len q) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))))

(lemma split_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) (path_weight g (drop p m)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== m (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert (== (+ m 1) (len p)))
        (assert (== (take p (+ m 1)) p))
        (assert (== (len (drop p m)) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (drop p m)) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let pp (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let dm (seq int) (drop p m))
        (assert (== (len pp) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (len dm) (- (len p) m)))
        (call split_weight g pp m)
        (call law_take_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ m 1))
        (call law_seq_ext (take dm (- (len dm) 1)) (drop pp m))
        (assert (== (idx dm (- (len dm) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
        (assert (== (idx dm (- (len dm) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g dm)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take dm (- (len dm) 1)))
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx dm (- (len dm) 2)) (idx dm (- (len dm) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g pp)
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn cut ((p (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (body (seq-build (- (len p) (- j i)) (fn (t) (if (<= t i) (idx p t) (idx p (+ t (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_facts (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (ensures (== (len (cut p i j)) (- (len p) (- j i)))
           (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= 0 t) (<= t i)) (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p t))))
           (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (< i t) (< t (- (len p) (- j i))))
                                 (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p (+ t (- j i)))))))
  (body))
(lemma path_cut_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (if (< t i)
      (block
        (call path_step g p t)
        (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p t)))
        (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ t 1)))))
      (if (== t i)
        (block
          (call path_step g p j)
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
        (block
          (call path_step g p (+ t (- j i)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p (+ t (- j i)))))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ (+ t (- j i)) 1)))))))))
(lemma path_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (is_path g (cut p i j))
           (== (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_cut_step g p i j t))
    (assert (is_path g (cut p i j)))
    (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (if (== j (- (len p) 1))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) i) (idx p j)))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))
                  (idx p (+ (- (len (cut p i j)) 1) (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_drop_step (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- (len p) j))))
  (ensures (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ x i)) (idx p (+ x j))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (if (== x 0)
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) i) (idx p i)))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ x i)) (idx p (+ (+ x i) (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p)
               (+ (path_weight g (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i)) (path_weight g (cut p i j)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let tk (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (cut p i j))
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (assert (== (len tk) (+ j 1)))
    (call split_weight g p j)
    (call split_weight g tk i)
    (call law_take_take p (+ j 1) (+ i 1))
    (call split_weight g r i)
    (call law_seq_ext (take r (+ i 1)) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (forall ((x int)) (call cut_drop_step p i j x))
    (call law_seq_ext (drop r i) (drop p j))))
(lemma cycle_nonneg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (not (has_negative_cycle g)) (is_path g c) (> (len c) 1)
            (== (idx c 0) (idx c (- (len c) 1))))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g c) 0))
  (body (assert (not (has_negative_cycle g)))))

(ghost-fn short_path ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int)) bool
  (body (exists ((q (seq int)))
    (and (and (is_path g q) (<= (len q) (len g)))
         (and (and (== (idx q 0) s) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) e))
              (<= (path_weight g q) x))))))
(lemma reduce (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (> (len g) 0) (not (has_negative_cycle g)) (is_path g p))
  (ensures (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (assert (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
      (block
        (call path_below g p)
        (call pigeon_dup p (len g))
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (ghost-let c (seq int) (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i))
        (call path_take g p (+ j 1))
        (call path_drop g (take p (+ j 1)) i)
        (assert (== (len c) (+ (- j i) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx p i)))
        (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p j)))
        (call cycle_nonneg g c)
        (call cut_weight g p i j)
        (call path_cut g p i j)
        (call cut_facts p i j)
        (call reduce g (cut p i j))
        (assert (short_path g (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1)) (path_weight g (cut p i j))))
        (obtain ((q (seq int)))
          (and (and (is_path g q) (<= (len q) (len g)))
               (and (and (== (idx q 0) (idx (cut p i j) 0))
                         (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))))
                    (<= (path_weight g q) (path_weight g (cut p i j))))))
        (assert (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))))))

(ghost-fn walks ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int)) bool
  (body (exists ((p (seq int)))
    (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) e)))
         (== (path_weight g p) x)))))
(lemma walk_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) e) (== (path_weight g p) x))
  (ensures (walks g s e x))
  (body))
(lemma relax_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (u int) (i int) (du int))
  (requires (wf g) (walks g s u du) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (walks g s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let tv int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (ghost-let wt int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (assert (walks g s u du))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
           (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call edge_has g u i)
    (call edge_weight g u i)
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) tv))
    (call path_extend g p tv)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) tv) wt))
    (call walk_intro g s tv (+ du wt) (concat p (seq-lit tv)))))

(ghost-fn dist_le ((d (seq (option int))) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d)))
             (and (is some (idx d v)) (<= (field (idx d v) value) x)))))
(ghost-fn sound ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (walks g s v (field (idx d v) value))))))
(ghost-fn bounded ((d (seq (option int))) (b int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (and (<= (- 0 b) (field (idx d v) value)) (<= (field (idx d v) value) b))))))
(ghost-fn mono ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (dist_le nx v (field (idx d v) value))))))
(ghost-fn same_dist ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))

(ghost-fn lb ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((p (seq int)))
    (=> (and (and (is_path g p) (<= (len p) (+ k 1))) (== (idx p 0) s))
        (dist_le d (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p))))))
(ghost-fn all_relaxed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (and (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i ci)))

  (body (and (and (== (len d) (len g)) (sound g s d))

  (body (and (and (== (len nx) (len g)) (mono d nx))
             (and (and (sound g s nx) (bounded nx (* (+ k 1) 100000)))

(ghost-fn updated ((nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len nx2) (len nx)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len nx))))

  (body (forall ((v int))

(lemma le_mono (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (t int) (y int))

  (ensures (dist_le c v (field (idx a v) value)))

(lemma mono_trans (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))))
  (requires (mono a b) (mono b c))

(lemma dist_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (u int) (x int))

(lemma relaxed_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int) (u int) (i int))

(lemma round_begin (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))))
  (requires (>= k 0) (outer_inv g s k d) (== (len nx) (len d)) (same_dist d nx))

    (call bounded_update nx nx2 tv c (* (+ k 1) 100000))

(lemma round_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (n int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int) (du int) (tv int) (wt int) (c int))

(lemma round_row_done (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (ci int))

(lemma edge_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (== (len d) (len g)) (all_relaxed g d nx n 0) (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2)
            (dist_le d (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))

    (ghost-let u0 int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))

           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u0) i0) 0) v0) (== (get (idx (idx g u0) i0) 1) (get_edge_weight g u0 v0)))))
    (assert (dist_le d u0 (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (call relaxed_at g d nx n 0 u0 i0)

    (assert (dist_le nx v0 (path_weight g p)))))
(lemma lb_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (>= k 0) (outer_inv g s k d) (round_inv g s k d nx n 0)

(lemma round_finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))))

(lemma same_le (params (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (t int) (y int))

(lemma same_relaxed_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int) (u int) (i int))

(lemma same_relaxed (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int))

(lemma fixed_lower (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))

(lemma final_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (n int) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (v int))

      (block
