(lemma split_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) (path_weight g (drop p m)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== m (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call law_take_all p)
        (assert (== (+ m 1) (len p)))
        (assert (== (take p (+ m 1)) p))
        (assert (== (len (drop p m)) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (drop p m)) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let pp (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let dm (seq int) (drop p m))
        (assert (== (len pp) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (len dm) (- (len p) m)))
        (call split_weight g pp m)
        (call law_take_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ m 1))
        (call law_seq_ext (take dm (- (len dm) 1)) (drop pp m))
        (assert (== (idx dm (- (len dm) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
        (assert (== (idx dm (- (len dm) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g dm)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take dm (- (len dm) 1)))
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx dm (- (len dm) 2)) (idx dm (- (len dm) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g pp)
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn cut ((p (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (body (seq-build (- (len p) (- j i)) (fn (t) (if (<= t i) (idx p t) (idx p (+ t (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_facts (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (ensures (== (len (cut p i j)) (- (len p) (- j i)))
           (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= 0 t) (<= t i)) (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p t))))
           (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (< i t) (< t (- (len p) (- j i))))
                                 (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p (+ t (- j i)))))))
  (body))
(lemma path_cut_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (if (< t i)
      (block
        (call path_step g p t)
        (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p t)))
        (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ t 1)))))
      (if (== t i)
        (block
          (call path_step g p j)
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
        (block
          (call path_step g p (+ t (- j i)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) t) (idx p (+ t (- j i)))))
          (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ t 1)) (idx p (+ (+ t (- j i)) 1)))))))))
(lemma path_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (is_path g (cut p i j))
           (== (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (forall ((t int)) (call path_cut_step g p i j t))
    (assert (is_path g (cut p i j)))
    (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (if (== j (- (len p) 1))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) i) (idx p j)))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))
                  (idx p (+ (- (len (cut p i j)) 1) (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_drop_step (params (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- (len p) j))))
  (ensures (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ x i)) (idx p (+ x j))))
  (body
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (if (== x 0)
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) i) (idx p i)))
      (assert (== (idx (cut p i j) (+ x i)) (idx p (+ (+ x i) (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p)
               (+ (path_weight g (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i)) (path_weight g (cut p i j)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let tk (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (cut p i j))
    (call cut_facts p i j)
    (assert (== (len tk) (+ j 1)))
    (call split_weight g p j)
    (call split_weight g tk i)
    (call law_take_take p (+ j 1) (+ i 1))
    (call split_weight g r i)
    (call law_seq_ext (take r (+ i 1)) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (forall ((x int)) (call cut_drop_step p i j x))
    (call law_seq_ext (drop r i) (drop p j))))
(lemma cycle_nonneg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (not (has_negative_cycle g)) (is_path g c) (> (len c) 1)
            (== (idx c 0) (idx c (- (len c) 1))))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g c) 0))
  (body (assert (not (has_negative_cycle g)))))

(ghost-fn short_path ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int)) bool
  (body (exists ((q (seq int)))
    (and (and (is_path g q) (<= (len q) (len g)))
         (and (and (== (idx q 0) s) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) e))
              (<= (path_weight g q) x))))))
(lemma reduce (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (> (len g) 0) (not (has_negative_cycle g)) (is_path g p))
  (ensures (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (assert (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))
      (block
        (call path_below g p)
        (call pigeon_dup p (len g))
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (ghost-let c (seq int) (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i))
        (call path_take g p (+ j 1))
        (call path_drop g (take p (+ j 1)) i)
        (assert (== (len c) (+ (- j i) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx p i)))
        (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p j)))
        (call cycle_nonneg g c)
        (call cut_weight g p i j)
        (call path_cut g p i j)
        (call cut_facts p i j)
        (call reduce g (cut p i j))
        (assert (short_path g (idx (cut p i j) 0) (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1)) (path_weight g (cut p i j))))
        (obtain ((q (seq int)))
          (and (and (is_path g q) (<= (len q) (len g)))
               (and (and (== (idx q 0) (idx (cut p i j) 0))
                         (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx (cut p i j) (- (len (cut p i j)) 1))))
                    (<= (path_weight g q) (path_weight g (cut p i j))))))
        (assert (short_path g (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p)))))))

(ghost-fn walks ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int)) bool
  (body (exists ((p (seq int)))
    (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) e)))
         (== (path_weight g p) x)))))
(lemma walk_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (e int) (x int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) e) (== (path_weight g p) x))
  (ensures (walks g s e x))
  (body))
(lemma relax_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (u int) (i int) (du int))
  (requires (wf g) (walks g s u du) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (walks g s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let tv int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (ghost-let wt int (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (assert (walks g s u du))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
           (== (path_weight g p) du)))
    (call edge_has g u i)
    (call edge_weight g u i)
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) tv))
    (call path_extend g p tv)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) tv) wt))
    (call walk_intro g s tv (+ du wt) (concat p (seq-lit tv)))))

(ghost-fn dist_le ((d (seq (option int))) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d)))
             (and (is some (idx d v)) (<= (field (idx d v) value) x)))))
(ghost-fn sound ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (walks g s v (field (idx d v) value))))))
(ghost-fn bounded ((d (seq (option int))) (b int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (and (<= (- 0 b) (field (idx d v) value)) (<= (field (idx d v) value) b))))))
(ghost-fn mono ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
        (dist_le nx v (field (idx d v) value))))))
(ghost-fn same_dist ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (< v (len nx))) (== (idx nx v) (idx d v))))))
(ghost-fn lb ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((p (seq int)))
    (=> (and (and (is_path g p) (<= (len p) (+ k 1))) (== (idx p 0) s))
        (dist_le d (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p))))))
(ghost-fn all_relaxed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (and (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i ci)))
                  (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u)))))
        (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn outer_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len d) (len g)) (sound g s d))
             (and (bounded d (* k 100000)) (lb g s k d)))))
(ghost-fn round_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len nx) (len g)) (mono d nx))
             (and (and (sound g s nx) (bounded nx (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
                  (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci)))))
(ghost-fn updated ((nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len nx2) (len nx)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len nx))))
             (and (== (idx nx2 v) (some c))
                  (and (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len nx))) (!= x v)) (== (idx nx2 x) (idx nx x))))
                       (or (is none (idx nx v)) (< c (field (idx nx v) value))))))))
(ghost-fn improved ((d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (w int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 w) (and (< w (len nx)) (< w (len d))))
             (and (is some (idx nx w))
                  (or (is none (idx d w)) (< (field (idx nx w) value) (field (idx d w) value)))))))
(ghost-fn final_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (ds (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (< v (len ds)))
        (match (idx ds v)
          (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                         (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
          (case (some dv) (is_shortest_dist g s v dv)))))))

(lemma le_mono (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (t int) (y int))
  (requires (mono a b) (dist_le a t y))
  (ensures (dist_le b t y))
  (body (assert (dist_le b t (field (idx a t) value)))))
(lemma mono_refl (params (a (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (mono a a))
  (body (assert (mono a a))))
(lemma mono_trans_at (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (v int))
  (requires (mono a b) (mono b c) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len a))) (is some (idx a v))))
  (ensures (dist_le c v (field (idx a v) value)))
  (body
    (assert (dist_le b v (field (idx a v) value)))
    (call le_mono b c v (field (idx a v) value))))
(lemma mono_trans (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))))
  (requires (mono a b) (mono b c))
  (ensures (mono a c))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call mono_trans_at a b c v))
    (assert (mono a c))))
(lemma updated_mono (params (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (tv int) (c int))
  (requires (updated nx nx2 tv c))
  (ensures (mono nx nx2))
  (body
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (assert (mono nx nx2))))
(lemma sound_update (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (tv int) (c int))
  (requires (sound g s nx) (updated nx nx2 tv c) (walks g s tv c))
  (ensures (sound g s nx2))
  (body
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (assert (sound g s nx2))))
(lemma bounded_update (params (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (tv int) (c int) (b int))
  (requires (bounded nx b) (updated nx nx2 tv c) (and (<= (- 0 b) c) (<= c b)))
  (ensures (bounded nx2 b))
  (body
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (assert (bounded nx2 b))))
(lemma dist_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (u int) (x int))
  (requires (outer_inv g s k d) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d))) (== (idx d u) (some x)))
  (ensures (<= (- 0 (* k 100000)) x) (<= x (* k 100000)))
  (body
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (bounded d (* k 100000)))
    (assert (== (field (idx d u) value) x))))

(lemma relaxed_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (cu int) (ci int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i ci)))
            (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (body (assert (all_relaxed g d nx cu ci))))
(lemma relaxed_empty (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (all_relaxed g d nx 0 0))
  (body (assert (all_relaxed g d nx 0 0))))
(lemma relaxed_advance_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int) (u2 int) (i2 int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u i) (mono nx nx2)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u)))
            (dist_le nx2 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
            (and (<= 0 u2) (< u2 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u2))))
            (or (< u2 u) (and (== u2 u) (< i2 (+ i 1))))
            (and (< u2 (len d)) (is some (idx d u2))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx2 (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1))))
  (body
    (if (and (== u2 u) (== i2 i))
      (block)
      (block
        (call relaxed_at g d nx u i u2 i2)
        (call le_mono nx nx2 (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1)))))))
(lemma relaxed_advance (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u i) (mono nx nx2)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (and (< u (len d)) (is some (idx d u)))
            (dist_le nx2 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx d u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (all_relaxed g d nx2 u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((u2 int) (i2 int)) (call relaxed_advance_at g d nx nx2 u i u2 i2))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d nx2 u (+ i 1)))))
(lemma row_done_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (ci int) (u2 int) (i2 int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u ci) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (== ci (len (idx g u)))
            (and (<= 0 u2) (< u2 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u2))))
            (or (< u2 (+ u 1)) (and (== u2 (+ u 1)) (< i2 0)))
            (and (< u2 (len d)) (is some (idx d u2))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1))))
  (body (call relaxed_at g d nx u ci u2 i2)))
(lemma skip_none_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (u2 int) (i2 int))
  (requires (all_relaxed g d nx u 0) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len d))) (is none (idx d u))
            (and (<= 0 u2) (< u2 (len g))) (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 (len (idx g u2))))
            (or (< u2 (+ u 1)) (and (== u2 (+ u 1)) (< i2 0)))
            (and (< u2 (len d)) (is some (idx d u2))))
  (ensures (dist_le nx (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 0) (+ (field (idx d u2) value) (get (idx (idx g u2) i2) 1))))
  (body
    (assert (!= u2 u))
    (call relaxed_at g d nx u 0 u2 i2)))

(lemma round_begin (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))))
  (requires (>= k 0) (outer_inv g s k d) (== (len nx) (len d)) (same_dist d nx))
  (ensures (round_inv g s k d nx 0 0))
  (body
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (same_dist d nx))
    (assert (mono d nx))
    (assert (sound g s nx))
    (assert (bounded nx (* (+ k 1) 100000)))
    (call relaxed_empty g d nx)
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx 0 0))))
(lemma round_update (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (n int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (nx2 (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int) (du int) (tv int) (wt int) (c int))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (outer_inv g s k d) (round_inv g s k d nx u i)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (idx d u) (some du))
            (== tv (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (== wt (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (== c (+ du wt))
            (updated nx nx2 tv c))
  (ensures (round_inv g s k d nx2 u (+ i 1)) (improved d nx2 tv))
  (body
    (assert (ctx g n s))
    (assert (outer_inv g s k d))
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx u i))
    (assert (updated nx nx2 tv c))
    (call updated_mono nx nx2 tv c)
    (call mono_trans d nx nx2)
    (assert (walks g s u (field (idx d u) value)))
    (assert (== (field (idx d u) value) du))
    (call relax_walk g s u i du)
    (call sound_update g s nx nx2 tv c)
    (call dist_bound g s k d u du)
    (call edge_info g n s u i)
    (call bounded_update nx nx2 tv c (* (+ k 1) 100000))
    (assert (dist_le nx2 tv c))
    (call relaxed_advance g d nx nx2 u i)
    (assert (round_inv g s k d nx2 u (+ i 1)))
    (if (is some (idx d tv))
      (assert (dist_le nx tv (field (idx d tv) value)))
      (block))
    (assert (improved d nx2 tv))))
(lemma round_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (n int) (k int) (d (seq (option int))) (nx (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int) (du int) (tv int) (wt int) (c int))
  (requires (ctx g n s) (outer_inv g s k d) (round_inv g s k d nx u i)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (idx d u) (some du))
            (== tv (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (== wt (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (== c (+ du wt))
            (dist_le nx tv c))
  (ensures (round_inv g s k d nx u (+ i 1)))
  (body

    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))))

(lemma weight_from_found (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (y int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (and (<= i j) (< j (len row))))
    (== (get (idx row j) 0) y)
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= i k) (< k j)) (!= (get (idx row k) 0) y))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row y i) (get (idx row j) 1)))
  (decreases (- j i))
  (body
    (if (== i j)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) y))
        (call weight_from_found row y (+ i 1) j)
        (assert (== (weight_from row y i) (weight_from row y (+ i 1))))))))
(lemma edge_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (x int) (i int))
  (requires (targets_distinct g) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))
  (body
    (ghost-let y int (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0))
    (assert (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k i)) (!= (get (idx (idx g x) k) 0) y))))
    (call weight_from_found (idx g x) y 0 i)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g x y) (weight_from (idx g x) y 0)))))
(lemma connected_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (targets_distinct g) (connected g x y))
  (ensures (exists ((ix int))
    (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 ix) (< ix (len (idx g x)))))
         (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) ix) 0) y)
              (== (get (idx (idx g x) ix) 1) (get_edge_weight g x y))))))
  (body
    (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g x y w))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) w))))
    (call edge_weight g x i)
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) (get_edge_weight g x y)))))
(lemma edge_facts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (x int) (i int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (weights_non_negative g) (weights_and_size_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)) (<= (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body (assert (has_edge g x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))
(lemma reach_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (x int) (du int) (i int))
  (requires (targets_distinct g) (reaches g s x du)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
  (ensures (reaches g s (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) (+ du (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1))))
  (body
    (call edge_weight g x i)
    (assert (has_edge g x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))
    (assert (connected g x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)))
    (call reaches_step g s x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) du)))

(ghost-fn edge_relaxed ((d (seq (option int))) (du int) (e (tuple int int))) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len d)))
             (and (is some (idx d (get e 0)))
                  (<= (field (idx d (get e 0)) value) (+ du (get e 1)))))))
(ghost-fn row_relaxed ((d (seq (option int))) (du int) (row (seq (tuple int int))) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j m)) (< j (len row))) (edge_relaxed d du (idx row j))))))
(ghost-fn relaxed_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (and (< x (len g)) (and (< x (len d)) (< x (len vis))))) (idx vis x))
        (and (is some (idx d x))
             (row_relaxed d (field (idx d x) value) (idx g x) (len (idx g x))))))))
(ghost-fn reach_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d))) (is some (idx d y)))
        (reaches g s y (field (idx d y) value))))))
(ghost-fn bound_ok ((d (seq (option int))) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d))) (is some (idx d y)))
        (and (<= 0 (field (idx d y) value)) (<= (field (idx d y) value) lim))))))
(ghost-fn order_ok ((d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (top int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d))) (< y (len vis)))
        (and (=> (idx vis y) (and (is some (idx d y)) (<= (field (idx d y) value) top)))
             (=> (not (idx vis y)) (=> (is some (idx d y)) (>= (field (idx d y) value) top))))))))
(ghost-fn start_ok ((d (seq (option int))) (s int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len d)))
             (and (is some (idx d s)) (<= (field (idx d s) value) 0)))))
(ghost-fn closed ((d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d))) (< y (len vis))) (is some (idx d y)))
        (idx vis y)))))
(ghost-fn mono ((a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (and (== (len a) (len b))
    (forall ((y int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len a))) (is some (idx a y)))
          (and (is some (idx b y)) (<= (field (idx b y) value) (field (idx a y) value))))))))
(ghost-fn keeps ((a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len a))) (and (< y (len b)) (< y (len vis)))) (idx vis y))
        (== (idx b y) (idx a y))))))
(ghost-fn updated ((a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (t int) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len a) (len b))
    (and (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len a)))
      (and (== (idx b t) (some c))
        (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len a))) (!= y t)) (== (idx b y) (idx a y)))))))))
(ghost-fn is_min ((d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d))) (< y (len vis)))
             (and (not (idx vis y)) (is some (idx d y))))
        (<= m (field (idx d y) value))))))

(lemma mono_refl (params (a (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (mono a a))
  (body))
(lemma keeps_refl (params (a (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)))
  (ensures (keeps a a vis))
  (body))
(lemma bound_weaken (params (d (seq (option int))) (l1 int) (l2 int))
  (requires (bound_ok d l1) (<= l1 l2))
  (ensures (bound_ok d l2))
  (body))
(lemma start_mono (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (s int))
  (requires (start_ok a s) (mono a b))
  (ensures (start_ok b s))
  (body
    (assert (is some (idx b s)))
    (assert (<= (field (idx b s) value) (field (idx a s) value)))))
(lemma relaxed_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)))
  (requires (none_visited vis))
  (ensures (relaxed_ok g d vis))
  (body))
(lemma order_init (params (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)))
  (requires (none_visited vis) (bound_ok d 0))

  (body))
(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (== (len d) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len d)))
    (== (idx d s) (some 0))
    (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d))) (!= y s)) (is none (idx d y)))))
  (ensures (reach_ok g s d) (bound_ok d 0) (start_ok d s))
  (body (call reaches_start g s)))

(lemma step_mono_at (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (t int) (c int) (y int))
  (requires (mono d0 a) (updated a b t c)
            (or (is none (idx a t)) (< c (field (idx a t) value)))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d0))) (is some (idx d0 y)))
  (ensures (is some (idx b y)) (<= (field (idx b y) value) (field (idx d0 y) value)))
  (body
    (assert (is some (idx a y)))
    (assert (<= (field (idx a y) value) (field (idx d0 y) value)))
    (if (== y t)
      (assert (== (idx b y) (some c)))
      (assert (== (idx b y) (idx a y))))))
(lemma step_mono (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (t int) (c int))
  (requires (mono d0 a) (updated a b t c)
            (or (is none (idx a t)) (< c (field (idx a t) value))))
  (ensures (mono d0 b))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call step_mono_at d0 a b t c y))))
(lemma step_keeps_at (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (t int) (c int) (y int))
  (requires (keeps d0 a vis) (updated a b t c) (== (len vis) (len a)) (not (idx vis t))
            (and (<= 0 y) (and (< y (len d0)) (< y (len a)))) (idx vis y))
  (ensures (== (idx b y) (idx d0 y)))
  (body
    (assert (!= y t))
    (assert (== (idx a y) (idx d0 y)))
    (assert (== (idx b y) (idx a y)))))
(lemma step_keeps (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (t int) (c int))
  (requires (keeps d0 a vis) (updated a b t c) (== (len vis) (len a)) (not (idx vis t)))
  (ensures (keeps d0 b vis))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call step_keeps_at d0 a b vis t c y))))
(lemma step_reach_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (t int) (c int) (y int))
  (requires (reach_ok g s a) (updated a b t c) (reaches g s t c)
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len b))) (is some (idx b y)))
  (ensures (reaches g s y (field (idx b y) value)))
  (body
    (if (== y t)
      (assert (== (field (idx b y) value) c))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx b y) (idx a y)))
        (assert (is some (idx a y)))
        (assert (reaches g s y (field (idx a y) value)))))))
(lemma step_reach (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (t int) (c int))
  (requires (reach_ok g s a) (updated a b t c) (reaches g s t c))
  (ensures (reach_ok g s b))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call step_reach_at g s a b t c y))))
(lemma step_bound_at (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (lim int) (t int) (c int) (y int))
  (requires (bound_ok a lim) (updated a b t c) (and (<= 0 c) (<= c lim))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len b))) (is some (idx b y)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (field (idx b y) value)) (<= (field (idx b y) value) lim)))
  (body
    (if (== y t)
      (assert (== (idx b y) (some c)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx b y) (idx a y)))
        (assert (is some (idx a y)))
        (assert (<= (field (idx a y) value) lim))))))
(lemma step_bound (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (lim int) (t int) (c int))
  (requires (bound_ok a lim) (updated a b t c) (and (<= 0 c) (<= c lim)))
  (ensures (bound_ok b lim))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call step_bound_at a b lim t c y))))
(lemma step_order_at (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (du int) (t int) (c int) (y int))
  (requires (order_ok a vis du) (updated a b t c) (== (len vis) (len a)) (not (idx vis t)) (>= c du)
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len a))))
  (ensures (and (=> (idx vis y) (and (is some (idx b y)) (<= (field (idx b y) value) du)))
                (=> (not (idx vis y)) (=> (is some (idx b y)) (>= (field (idx b y) value) du)))))
  (body
    (if (== y t)
      (assert (== (idx b y) (some c)))
      (assert (== (idx b y) (idx a y))))))
(lemma step_order (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (du int) (t int) (c int))
  (requires (order_ok a vis du) (updated a b t c) (== (len vis) (len a)) (not (idx vis t)) (>= c du))
  (ensures (order_ok b vis du))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call step_order_at a b vis du t c y))))

(lemma edge_mono (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (du int) (e (tuple int int)))
  (requires (edge_relaxed a du e) (mono a b))
  (ensures (edge_relaxed b du e))
  (body
    (assert (is some (idx a (get e 0))))
    (assert (is some (idx b (get e 0))))
    (assert (<= (field (idx b (get e 0)) value) (field (idx a (get e 0)) value)))))
(lemma row_mono_at (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (du int) (row (seq (tuple int int))) (m int) (j int))
  (requires (row_relaxed a du row m) (mono a b) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j m)) (< j (len row))))
  (ensures (edge_relaxed b du (idx row j)))
  (body
    (assert (edge_relaxed a du (idx row j)))
    (call edge_mono a b du (idx row j))))
(lemma row_mono (params (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (du int) (row (seq (tuple int int))) (m int))
  (requires (row_relaxed a du row m) (mono a b))
  (ensures (row_relaxed b du row m))
  (body (forall ((j int)) (call row_mono_at a b du row m j))))
(lemma row_extend_at (params (d (seq (option int))) (du int) (row (seq (tuple int int))) (m int) (j int))
  (requires (row_relaxed d du row m) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len row))) (edge_relaxed d du (idx row m))
            (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (+ m 1))) (< j (len row))))
  (ensures (edge_relaxed d du (idx row j)))
  (body
    (if (== j m)
      (block)
      (assert (edge_relaxed d du (idx row j))))))
(lemma row_extend (params (d (seq (option int))) (du int) (row (seq (tuple int int))) (m int))
  (requires (row_relaxed d du row m) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len row))) (edge_relaxed d du (idx row m)))
  (ensures (row_relaxed d du row (+ m 1)))
  (body (forall ((j int)) (call row_extend_at d du row m j))))

(lemma relax_taken
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int)))
          (vis (seq bool)) (du int) (lim int) (row (seq (tuple int int))) (m int) (t int) (c int))
  (requires
    (updated a b t c) (mono d0 a) (keeps d0 a vis) (reach_ok g s a) (bound_ok a lim)
    (order_ok a vis du) (row_relaxed a du row m)
    (== (len vis) (len a)) (not (idx vis t))
    (or (is none (idx a t)) (< c (field (idx a t) value)))
    (reaches g s t c) (and (<= 0 c) (<= c lim)) (>= c du)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row m) 0) t)
    (== c (+ du (get (idx row m) 1))))
  (ensures (mono d0 b) (keeps d0 b vis) (reach_ok g s b) (bound_ok b lim)
           (order_ok b vis du) (row_relaxed b du row (+ m 1)))
  (body
    (call step_mono d0 a b t c)
    (call step_keeps d0 a b vis t c)
    (call step_reach g s a b t c)
    (call step_bound a b lim t c)
    (call step_order a b vis du t c)
    (call mono_refl a)
    (call step_mono a a b t c)
    (call row_mono a b du row m)
    (assert (== (idx b t) (some c)))
    (assert (edge_relaxed b du (idx row m)))
    (call row_extend b du row m)))
(lemma relax_skip
  (params (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (du int) (row (seq (tuple int int))) (m int) (t int) (w int))
  (requires
    (row_relaxed d du row m) (order_ok d vis du) (== (len vis) (len d))
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row m) 0) t) (== (get (idx row m) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len d))) (>= w 0)
    (or (idx vis t) (and (is some (idx d t)) (<= (field (idx d t) value) (+ du w)))))
  (ensures (row_relaxed d du row (+ m 1)))
  (body
    (if (idx vis t)
      (assert (and (is some (idx d t)) (<= (field (idx d t) value) du)))
      (block))
    (assert (edge_relaxed d du (idx row m)))
    (call row_extend d du row m)))

(lemma order_pick_at (params (d (seq (option int))) (v0 (seq bool)) (v1 (seq bool)) (top int) (u int) (du int) (y int))
  (requires (order_ok d v0 top) (flipped v0 v1 u) (== (len v0) (len d))
            (is some (idx d u)) (== (field (idx d u) value) du) (is_min d v0 du)
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d))))
  (ensures (and (=> (idx v1 y) (and (is some (idx d y)) (<= (field (idx d y) value) du)))
                (=> (not (idx v1 y)) (=> (is some (idx d y)) (>= (field (idx d y) value) du)))))
  (body
    (assert (not (idx v0 u)))
    (assert (>= du top))
    (if (== y u)
      (block)
      (assert (== (idx v1 y) (idx v0 y))))))
(lemma order_pick (params (d (seq (option int))) (v0 (seq bool)) (v1 (seq bool)) (top int) (u int) (du int))
  (requires (order_ok d v0 top) (flipped v0 v1 u) (== (len v0) (len d))
            (is some (idx d u)) (== (field (idx d u) value) du) (is_min d v0 du))
  (ensures (order_ok d v1 du))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call order_pick_at d v0 v1 top u du y))))
(lemma round_end_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d (seq (option int)))
          (v0 (seq bool)) (v1 (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires
    (relaxed_ok g d0 v0) (mono d0 d) (keeps d0 d v1) (flipped v0 v1 u)
    (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len v1) (len g))
    (is some (idx d u)) (== (field (idx d u) value) du)
    (row_relaxed d du (idx g u) (len (idx g u)))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (idx v1 x))
  (ensures (is some (idx d x))
           (row_relaxed d (field (idx d x) value) (idx g x) (len (idx g x))))
  (body
    (if (== x u)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (idx v0 x))
        (assert (is some (idx d0 x)))
        (assert (row_relaxed d0 (field (idx d0 x) value) (idx g x) (len (idx g x))))
        (assert (== (idx d x) (idx d0 x)))
        (call row_mono d0 d (field (idx d0 x) value) (idx g x) (len (idx g x)))))))
(lemma round_end
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d (seq (option int)))
          (v0 (seq bool)) (v1 (seq bool)) (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (relaxed_ok g d0 v0) (mono d0 d) (keeps d0 d v1) (flipped v0 v1 u)
    (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len v1) (len g))
    (is some (idx d u)) (== (field (idx d u) value) du)
    (row_relaxed d du (idx g u) (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (relaxed_ok g d v1))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call round_end_at g d0 d v0 v1 u du x))))

(lemma relaxed_use (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (x int) (i int))
  (requires (relaxed_ok g d vis)
            (and (<= 0 x) (and (< x (len g)) (and (< x (len d)) (< x (len vis)))))
            (idx vis x)
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
  (ensures (is some (idx d x)) (edge_relaxed d (field (idx d x) value) (idx (idx g x) i)))
  (body
    (assert (is some (idx d x)))
    (assert (row_relaxed d (field (idx d x) value) (idx g x) (len (idx g x))))
    (assert (edge_relaxed d (field (idx d x) value) (idx (idx g x) i)))))
(lemma path_bound
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (targets_distinct g) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len vis) (len g))
    (relaxed_ok g d vis) (closed d vis) (start_ok d s)
    (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len d)))
    (is some (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (<= (field (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (len p) 1))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) s))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q 0) s))
        (call path_bound g s d vis q)
        (ghost-let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let b int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) a))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (+ (- (len p) 2) 1))))
        (assert (connected g a b))
        (assert (idx vis a))
        (call connected_edge g a b)
        (obtain ((i int))
          (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
               (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b)
                    (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) (get_edge_weight g a b)))))
        (call relaxed_use g d vis a i)
        (assert (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))

        (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len a))) (!= y t)) (== (idx b y) (idx a y)))))))))

(lemma path_bound
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (targets_distinct g) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len vis) (len g))
    (relaxed_ok g d vis) (closed d vis) (start_ok d s)
    (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len d)))
    (is some (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (<= (field (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (len p) 1))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) s))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q 0) s))
        (call path_bound g s d vis q)
        (ghost-let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let b int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) a))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (+ (- (len p) 2) 1))))
        (assert (connected g a b))
        (assert (idx vis a))
        (call connected_edge g a b)
        (obtain ((i int))
          (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
               (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b)
                    (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) (get_edge_weight g a b)))))
        (call relaxed_use g d vis a i)
        (assert (== (path_weight g p)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                       (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
        (assert (<= (field (idx d b) value) (path_weight g p)))))))
(lemma finish_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)) (v int))
  (requires
    (targets_distinct g) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len vis) (len g))
    (reach_ok g s d) (relaxed_ok g d vis) (start_ok d s) (closed d vis)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx d v)
      (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                     (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
      (case (some e) (is_shortest_dist g s v e))))
  (body
    (forall ((r (seq int))) (call path_bound g s d vis r))
    (match (idx d v)
      (case (none) (block))
      (case (some e2)
        (block
          (assert (reaches g s v e2))
          (obtain ((w (seq int)))
            (and (and (is_path g w) (and (== (idx w 0) s) (== (idx w (- (len w) 1)) v))) (== (path_weight g w) e2)))
          (assert (is_shortest_dist g s v e2)))))))

  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d (seq (option int))) (vis (seq bool)))

            (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))

            (case (some e) (is_shortest_dist g s v e))))))
  (body (forall ((v2 int)) (call finish_at g s d vis v2))))

(spec pick_min
  (params (dist (ref (slice (option i64)))) (visited (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (found bool) (u i64))
  (requires (== (len dist) (len visited)))
  (ensures
    (=> found (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist))) (and (not (idx visited u)) (is some (idx dist u)))))
    (=> found (forall ((y int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))) (and (not (idx visited y)) (is some (idx dist y))))
          (<= (field (idx dist u) value) (field (idx dist y) value)))))
    (=> (not found) (forall ((z int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len dist))) (not (idx visited z))) (is none (idx dist z))))))
  (effects))
(def pick_min
  (body
    (let-mut best_found bool false)
    (let-mut best i64 0)
    (let-mut best_d i64 0)
    (let-mut x i64 0)
    (while (< x (len dist))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (len dist))))
      (invariant (=> best_found (and (and (<= 0 best) (< best x)) (and (not (idx visited best)) (is some (idx dist best))))))
      (invariant (=> best_found (== best_d (field (idx dist best) value))))
      (invariant (=> best_found (forall ((y int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y x)) (and (not (idx visited y)) (is some (idx dist y))))
            (<= best_d (field (idx dist y) value))))))
      (invariant (=> (not best_found) (forall ((z int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z x)) (not (idx visited z))) (is none (idx dist z))))))
      (decreases (- (len dist) x))
      (if (idx visited x)
        (block)
        (match (idx dist x)
          (case (none) (block))
          (case (some dx)
            (if (or (not best_found) (< dx best_d))
              (block
                (set best_found true)
                (set best x)
                (set best_d dx))
              (block)))))
      (set x (+ x 1)))
    (return best_found best)))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call well_formed_view graph)
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (assert (<= (len g) 100000))
    (assert (<= n 100000))
    (assert (and (<= 0 start) (< start n)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64)) (seq-build n (fn (a0) (if (== a0 start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (let-mut visited (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (b0) false)))
    (assert (== (len dist) n))
    (assert (== (len visited) n))
    (assert (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
    (assert (forall ((c0 int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 c0) (< c0 (len dist))) (!= c0 start)) (is none (idx dist c0)))))
    (call init_state g start dist)
    (assert (none_visited visited))
    (call relaxed_init g dist visited)
    (call order_init dist visited)
    (call fc_all_false visited n)
    (ghost-let-mut top int 0)
    (let-mut k i64 0)
    (while (< k n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len visited) n))
      (invariant (reach_ok g start dist))
      (invariant (bound_ok dist (* k 100000)))
      (invariant (relaxed_ok g dist visited))
      (invariant (order_ok dist visited top))
      (invariant (start_ok dist start))
      (invariant (== (false_count visited n) (- n k)))
      (decreases (- n k))
      (ghost-let vis0 (seq bool) visited)
      (ghost-let dist0 (seq (option int)) dist)
      (let ((found bool) (u i64)) (call pick_min (borrow dist) (borrow visited)))
      (if found
        (block
          (let du i64 (field (idx dist u) value))
          (assert (is some (idx dist0 u)))
          (assert (== (field (idx dist0 u) value) du))
          (assert (reaches g start u du))
          (assert (and (<= 0 du) (<= du (* k 100000))))
          (assert (is_min dist vis0 du))
          (set-idx visited u true)
          (assert (flipped vis0 visited u))
          (call fc_update vis0 visited u n)
          (call order_pick dist vis0 visited top u du)
          (ghost-let lim int (* (+ k 1) 100000))
          (call bound_weaken dist (* k 100000) lim)
          (call mono_refl dist0)
          (call keeps_refl dist0 visited)
          (let row_len i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
          (assert (== (len (idx g u)) row_len))
          (let-mut i i64 0)
          (while (< i row_len)
            (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i row_len)))
            (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (< k n)))
            (invariant (and (<= 0 du) (<= du (* k 100000))))
            (invariant (== (len dist) n))
            (invariant (== (len visited) n))
            (invariant (flipped vis0 visited u))
            (invariant (reaches g start u du))
            (invariant (mono dist0 dist))
            (invariant (keeps dist0 dist visited))
            (invariant (reach_ok g start dist))
            (invariant (bound_ok dist lim))

(ghost-fn select_inv ((d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (best int) (bv int) (i int)) bool
  (body (and (=> fnd (and (and (<= 0 best) (< best i)) (select_head d b best bv)))
             (forall ((y int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y i)) (and (known d y) (not (is_done b y))))
                   (and fnd (<= bv (dval d y))))))))
(lemma select_skip (params (d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (best int) (bv int) (i int))
  (requires (select_inv d b fnd best bv i) (<= 0 i)
            (or (not (known d i)) (or (is_done b i) (and fnd (<= bv (dval d i))))))
  (ensures (select_inv d b fnd best bv (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma select_take (params (d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (best int) (bv int) (i int))
  (requires (select_inv d b fnd best bv i) (<= 0 i) (known d i) (not (is_done b i))
            (or (not fnd) (< (dval d i) bv)))
  (ensures (select_inv d b true i (dval d i) (+ i 1)))
  (body (assert (select_head d b i (dval d i)))))
(lemma select_end (params (d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (best int) (bv int))
  (requires (select_inv d b fnd best bv (len d)))
  (ensures (=> fnd (select_facts d b best bv)) (=> (not fnd) (no_open d b)))
  (body (assert (=> fnd (select_head d b best bv)))))
(spec select_min
  (params (dist (ref (slice (option i64)))) (done (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (found bool) (u i64) (du i64))
  (requires (== (len dist) (len done)))
  (ensures (=> found (select_facts dist done u du))
           (=> (not found) (no_open dist done)))
  (effects))
(def select_min
  (body
    (let-mut fnd bool false)
    (let-mut best i64 0)
    (let-mut bv i64 0)
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (while (< i (len dist))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len dist))))
      (invariant (select_inv dist done fnd best bv i))
      (decreases (- (len dist) i))
      (if (idx done i)
        (block
          (assert (is_done done i))
          (call select_skip dist done fnd best bv i))
        (match (idx dist i)
          (case (none)
            (block
              (assert (not (known dist i)))
              (call select_skip dist done fnd best bv i)))
          (case (some c)
            (block
              (assert (known dist i))
              (assert (not (is_done done i)))
              (assert (== (dval dist i) c))
              (if (or (not fnd) (< c bv))
                (block
                  (call select_take dist done fnd best bv i)
                  (set fnd true)
                  (set best i)
                  (set bv c))
                (call select_skip dist done fnd best bv i))))))
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (assert (== i (len dist)))
    (call select_end dist done fnd best bv)
    (return fnd best bv)))

(ghost-fn done_le ((d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (du int) (x int)) bool
  (body (=> (is_done b x) (and (known d x) (<= (dval d x) du)))))
(ghost-fn all_done_le ((d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (du int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (done_le d b du x))))
(ghost-fn relax_frame_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (=> (is_done done x) (same_at c d0 x))
        (and (=> (known d0 x) (and (known c x) (<= (dval c x) (dval d0 x))))
             (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d0)))
                 (or (same_at c d0 x)
                     (and (connected g u x)
                          (and (known c x) (== (dval c x) (+ du (get_edge_weight g u x)))))))))))
(ghost-fn relax_frame ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len c) (len d0)) (forall ((x int)) (relax_frame_at g d0 c done u du x)))))
(ghost-fn relax_idx_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int) (j int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j i)) (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
            (and (known c (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
                 (<= (dval c (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn relax_idx ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((j int)) (relax_idx_at g c u du i j))))
(ghost-fn relax_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int)) bool
  (body (and (relax_frame g d0 c done u du) (relax_idx g c u du i))))
(ghost-fn relax_done_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (x int)) bool
  (body (=> (connected g u x)
            (and (known c x) (<= (dval c x) (+ du (get_edge_weight g u x)))))))
(ghost-fn updated ((c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (v int) (nv int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len c2) (len c))
        (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len c)))
        (and (== (idx c2 v) (some nv))
             (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (!= x v)) (== (idx c2 x) (idx c x)))))))))
(ghost-fn update_ctx ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (nv int)) bool
  (body (and (graph_ok g)
        (and (relax_inv g d0 c done u du i)
        (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
        (and (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
        (and (== nv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (and (not (is_done done v))
        (and (or (not (known c v)) (< nv (dval c v)))
             (updated c c2 v nv)))))))))))
(lemma relax_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int))
  (requires (== (len done) (len d0)))
  (ensures (relax_inv g d0 d0 done u du 0))
  (body
    (assert (forall ((x int)) (relax_frame_at g d0 d0 done u du x)))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d0 done u du))
    (assert (forall ((j int)) (relax_idx_at g d0 u du 0 j)))
    (assert (relax_idx g d0 u du 0))))
(lemma update_known (params (c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (v int) (nv int) (x int))
  (requires (updated c c2 v nv))
  (ensures (=> (== x v) (and (known c2 x) (== (dval c2 x) nv)))
           (=> (!= x v) (and (== (known c2 x) (known c x)) (== (dval c2 x) (dval c x)))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (!= x v))
      (assert (== (idx c2 x) (idx c x)))
      (block))))
(lemma relax_update_x (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (nv int) (x int))
  (requires (update_ctx g d0 c c2 done u du i v nv))
  (ensures (relax_frame_at g d0 c2 done u du x))
  (body
    (assert (relax_inv g d0 c done u du i))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 c done u du))
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 c done u du x))
    (assert (updated c c2 v nv))
    (call edge_fact g u i)
    (call update_known c c2 v nv x)
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (!= x v))
      (assert (== (idx c2 x) (idx c x)))
      (block))))
(lemma relax_update_j (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (nv int) (j int))
  (requires (update_ctx g d0 c c2 done u du i v nv))
  (ensures (relax_idx_at g c2 u du (+ i 1) j))
  (body
    (assert (relax_inv g d0 c done u du i))
    (assert (relax_idx g c u du i))
    (assert (relax_idx_at g c u du i j))
    (assert (updated c c2 v nv))
    (if (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))
      (call update_known c c2 v nv (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
      (block))))
(lemma relax_update (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (nv int))
  (requires (update_ctx g d0 c c2 done u du i v nv))
  (ensures (relax_inv g d0 c2 done u du (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (assert (relax_inv g d0 c done u du i))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 c done u du))
    (assert (updated c c2 v nv))
    (assert (== (len c2) (len d0)))
    (forall ((x int)) (call relax_update_x g d0 c c2 done u du i v nv x))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 c2 done u du))
    (forall ((j int)) (call relax_update_j g d0 c c2 done u du i v nv j))
    (assert (relax_idx g c2 u du (+ i 1)))))
(lemma relax_keep_j (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (relax_idx g c u du i)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (known c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (<= (dval c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (relax_idx_at g c u du (+ i 1) j))
  (body (assert (relax_idx_at g c u du i j))))
(lemma relax_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int))
  (requires (relax_inv g d0 c done u du i)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (known c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (<= (dval c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (relax_inv g d0 c done u du (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 c done u du))
    (assert (relax_idx g c u du i))
    (forall ((j int)) (call relax_keep_j g c u du i j))
    (assert (relax_idx g c u du (+ i 1)))))
(lemma done_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (v int))
  (requires (relax_frame g d0 c done u du) (all_done_le d0 done du) (is_done done v))
  (ensures (known c v) (<= (dval c v) du))
  (body
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 c done u du v))
    (assert (done_le d0 done du v))
    (call same_vals c d0 v)))
(lemma relax_finish_x (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (relax_idx g c u du (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (relax_done_at g c u du x))
  (body
    (if (connected g u x)
      (block
        (call edge_index g u x)
        (obtain ((i int)) (is_edge_index g u x i))
        (assert (is_edge_index g u x i))
        (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x))
        (call edge_fact g u i)
        (assert (relax_idx_at g c u du (len (idx g u)) i)))
      (block))))
(lemma relax_finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (relax_idx g c u du (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (forall ((x int)) (relax_done_at g c u du x)))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call relax_finish_x g c u du x))))
(spec relax_edges
  (params (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (dist (vec (option i64))) (done (ref (slice bool))) (u i64) (du i64))
  (returns (out (vec (option i64))))
  (requires (graph_ok rows) (== (len dist) (len rows)) (== (len done) (len rows))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len rows)))
            (and (<= 0 du) (<= du 10000000000))
            (all_done_le dist done du))
  (ensures (relax_frame rows dist out done u du)
           (forall ((x int)) (relax_done_at rows out u du x)))
  (effects))
(def relax_edges
  (body
    (call relax_init rows dist done u du)
    (let-mut c (vec (option i64)) dist)
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (let m i64 (len (idx rows u)))
    (while (< i m)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i m)))
      (invariant (relax_inv rows dist c done u du i))
      (decreases (- m i))
      (let v i64 (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 0))
      (let w i64 (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 1))
      (call edge_fact rows u i)
      (assert (relax_frame rows dist c done u du))
      (let nv i64 (+ du w))
      (if (idx done v)
        (block
          (assert (is_done done v))
          (call done_target rows dist c done u du v)
          (call relax_keep rows dist c done u du i))
        (match (idx c v)
          (case (none)
            (block
              (ghost-let c0 (seq (option int)) c)
              (assert (not (known c0 v)))
              (assert (not (is_done done v)))
              (set-idx c v (some nv))
              (assert (updated c0 c v nv))
              (call relax_update rows dist c0 c done u du i v nv)))
          (case (some dv)
            (block
              (assert (known c v))
              (assert (== (dval c v) dv))
              (if (< nv dv)
                (block
                  (ghost-let c1 (seq (option int)) c)
                  (assert (< nv (dval c1 v)))
                  (assert (not (is_done done v)))
                  (set-idx c v (some nv))
                  (assert (updated c1 c v nv))
                  (call relax_update rows dist c1 c done u du i v nv))
                (call relax_keep rows dist c done u du i))))))
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (assert (== i m))
    (assert (relax_idx rows c u du (len (idx rows u))))
    (call relax_finish rows c u du)
    (return c)))

(lemma pre_relax_x (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires (state g s d0 b0 k) (select_facts d0 b0 u du) (marked b0 b1 u))
  (ensures (done_le d0 b1 du x))
  (body
    (assert (== (is_done b1 x) (or (is_done b0 x) (== x u))))
    (assert (done_at g s d0 b0 x))
    (assert (mono_at d0 b0 x u))))
(lemma pre_relax (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (state g s d0 b0 k) (select_facts d0 b0 u du) (marked b0 b1 u)
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (all_done_le d0 b1 du) (lower_bound g s u du) (and (<= 0 du) (<= du 10000000000)))
  (body
    (assert (weights_and_size_bounded g))
    (assert (<= (len g) 100000))
    (assert (reach_at g s d0 k u))
    (assert (== (dval d0 u) du))
    (assert (start_ok d0 s))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d0 b0))
    (call selected_lower g s d0 b0 u)
    (forall ((x int)) (call pre_relax_x g s d0 b0 b1 k u du x))
    (assert (all_done_le d0 b1 du))))

(ghost-fn step_ctx ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int)) bool
  (body (and (graph_ok g)
        (and (state g s d0 b0 k)
        (and (select_facts d0 b0 u du)
        (and (marked b0 b1 u)
        (and (lower_bound g s u du)
        (and (all_done_le d0 b1 du)
        (and (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du)
             (forall ((x int)) (relax_done_at g d1 u du x)))))))))))
(lemma step_done_x (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (=> (is_done b1 x) (and (known d1 x) (and (== (dval d1 x) (dval d0 x)) (<= (dval d1 x) du)))))
  (body
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du))
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 d1 b1 u du x))
    (assert (all_done_le d0 b1 du))
    (assert (done_le d0 b1 du x))
    (if (is_done b1 x)
      (call same_vals d1 d0 x)
      (block))))
(lemma step_start (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (start_ok d1 s))
  (body
    (assert (state g s d0 b0 k))
    (assert (start_ok d0 s))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du))
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 d1 b1 u du s))))
(lemma step_relaxed_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int) (a int) (x int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (relaxed_at g d1 b1 a x))
  (body
    (assert (state g s d0 b0 k))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d0 b0))
    (assert (relaxed_at g d0 b0 a x))
    (assert (select_facts d0 b0 u du))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du))
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 d1 b1 u du x))
    (assert (relax_done_at g d1 u du x))
    (assert (marked b0 b1 u))
    (assert (== (is_done b1 a) (or (is_done b0 a) (== a u))))
    (call step_done_x g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du a)))
(lemma step_done_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (done_at g s d1 b1 x))
  (body
    (assert (state g s d0 b0 k))
    (assert (done_at g s d0 b0 x))
    (assert (select_facts d0 b0 u du))
    (assert (lower_bound g s u du))
    (assert (marked b0 b1 u))
    (assert (== (is_done b1 x) (or (is_done b0 x) (== x u))))
    (call step_done_x g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du x)))
(lemma step_reach_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (reach_at g s d1 (+ k 1) x))
  (body
    (assert (graph_ok g))
    (assert (state g s d0 b0 k))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du))
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 d1 b1 u du x))
    (if (known d1 x)
      (block
        (assert (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d0))))
        (if (same_at d1 d0 x)
          (block
            (call same_vals d1 d0 x)
            (assert (reach_at g s d0 k x)))
          (block
            (assert (connected g u x))
            (call connected_facts g u x)
            (assert (select_facts d0 b0 u du))
            (assert (reach_at g s d0 k u))
            (call attained_extend g s u x du))))
      (block))))
(lemma step_mono_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (mono_at d1 b1 x y))
  (body
    (assert (graph_ok g))
    (call step_done_x g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du x)
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du))
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 d1 b1 u du y))
    (assert (marked b0 b1 u))
    (assert (== (is_done b1 y) (or (is_done b0 y) (== y u))))
    (if (and (is_done b1 x) (and (known d1 y) (not (is_done b1 y))))
      (block
        (assert (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len d0))))
        (if (same_at d1 d0 y)
          (block
            (call same_vals d1 d0 y)
            (assert (select_facts d0 b0 u du))
            (assert (open_ge d0 b0 du))
            (assert (below_open d0 b0 du y)))
          (block
            (assert (connected g u y))
            (call connected_facts g u y))))
      (block))))
(lemma step_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (state g s d1 b1 (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (assert (state g s d0 b0 k))
    (assert (shape_ok g s d0 b0))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du))
    (assert (marked b0 b1 u))
    (assert (shape_ok g s d1 b1))
    (call step_start g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du)
    (forall ((a int) (x int)) (call step_relaxed_at g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du a x))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d1 b1))
    (forall ((x int)) (call step_done_at g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du x))
    (forall ((x int)) (call step_reach_at g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du x))
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call step_mono_at g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du x y))
    (assert (state g s d1 b1 (+ k 1)))))

(ghost-fn finish_ctx ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (res (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (k int)) bool
  (body (and (graph_ok g) (and (state g s res done k) (no_open res done)))))
