        (assert (== (dval dist x) 0))
        (call trivial_walk g s))
      (block))))
(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)))
  (requires (init_ctx g s dist done))
  (ensures (state g s dist done 0))
  (body
    (assert (shape_ok g s dist done))
    (assert (known dist s))
    (assert (== (dval dist s) 0))
    (assert (start_ok dist s))
    (forall ((x int)) (call init_no_done g s dist done x))
    (assert (forall ((a int) (x int)) (relaxed_at g dist done a x)))
    (assert (all_relaxed g dist done))
    (assert (forall ((x int)) (done_at g s dist done x)))
    (forall ((x int)) (call init_reach_at g s dist done x))
    (assert (forall ((x int) (y int)) (mono_at dist done x y)))))

(ghost-fn undone_in ((s (seq bool)) (i int)) int (requires (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len s)))) (decreases i)
  (body (if (== i 0) 0 (+ (undone_in s (- i 1)) (if (idx s (- i 1)) 0 1)))))
(ghost-fn marked ((b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len b1) (len b0))
             (forall ((x int)) (== (is_done b1 x) (or (is_done b0 x) (== x u)))))))
(lemma undone_range (params (s (seq bool)) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len s))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (undone_in s i)) (<= (undone_in s i) i)))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (undone_in s 0) 0))
      (block
        (call undone_range s (- i 1))
        (assert (== (undone_in s i) (+ (undone_in s (- i 1)) (if (idx s (- i 1)) 0 1))))))))
(lemma undone_all (params (s (seq bool)) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len s)))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s))) (not (idx s x)))))
  (ensures (== (undone_in s i) i))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (undone_in s 0) 0))
      (block
        (assert (not (idx s (- i 1))))
        (call undone_all s (- i 1))
        (assert (== (undone_in s i) (+ (undone_in s (- i 1)) (if (idx s (- i 1)) 0 1))))))))
(lemma undone_mark (params (s (seq bool)) (t (seq bool)) (j int) (i int))
  (requires (marked s t j) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s))) (not (idx s j)) (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len s))))
  (ensures (== (undone_in t i) (- (undone_in s i) (if (< j i) 1 0))))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (assert (== (len t) (len s)))
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (undone_in s 0) 0))
        (assert (== (undone_in t 0) 0)))
      (block
        (call undone_mark s t j (- i 1))
        (assert (== (is_done t (- i 1)) (or (is_done s (- i 1)) (== (- i 1) j))))
        (assert (== (undone_in s i) (+ (undone_in s (- i 1)) (if (idx s (- i 1)) 0 1))))
        (assert (== (undone_in t i) (+ (undone_in t (- i 1)) (if (idx t (- i 1)) 0 1))))))))

(ghost-fn select_facts ((d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (u int) (du int)) bool
  (body (and (not (is_done b u)) (and (known d u) (and (== (dval d u) du) (open_ge d b du))))))
(ghost-fn select_head ((d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (best int) (bv int)) bool
  (body (and (not (is_done b best)) (and (known d best) (== (dval d best) bv)))))
(ghost-fn select_inv ((d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (best int) (bv int) (i int)) bool
  (body (and (=> fnd (and (and (<= 0 best) (< best i)) (select_head d b best bv)))
             (forall ((y int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y i)) (and (known d y) (not (is_done b y))))
                   (and fnd (<= bv (dval d y))))))))
(lemma select_skip (params (d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (best int) (bv int) (i int))
  (requires (select_inv d b fnd best bv i) (<= 0 i)
            (or (not (known d i)) (or (is_done b i) (and fnd (<= bv (dval d i))))))
  (ensures (select_inv d b fnd best bv (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma select_take (params (d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (best int) (bv int) (i int))
  (requires (select_inv d b fnd best bv i) (<= 0 i) (known d i) (not (is_done b i))
            (or (not fnd) (< (dval d i) bv)))
  (ensures (select_inv d b true i (dval d i) (+ i 1)))
  (body (assert (select_head d b i (dval d i)))))
(lemma select_end (params (d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (fnd bool) (best int) (bv int))
  (requires (select_inv d b fnd best bv (len d)))
  (ensures (=> fnd (select_facts d b best bv)) (=> (not fnd) (no_open d b)))
  (body (assert (=> fnd (select_head d b best bv)))))
(spec select_min
  (params (dist (ref (slice (option i64)))) (done (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (found bool) (u i64) (du i64))
  (requires (== (len dist) (len done)))
  (ensures (=> found (select_facts dist done u du))
           (=> (not found) (no_open dist done)))
  (effects))
(def select_min
  (body
    (let-mut fnd bool false)
    (let-mut best i64 0)
    (let-mut bv i64 0)
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (while (< i (len dist))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len dist))))
      (invariant (select_inv dist done fnd best bv i))
      (decreases (- (len dist) i))
      (if (idx done i)
        (block
          (assert (is_done done i))
          (call select_skip dist done fnd best bv i))
        (match (idx dist i)
          (case (none)
            (block
              (assert (not (known dist i)))
              (call select_skip dist done fnd best bv i)))
          (case (some c)
            (block
              (assert (known dist i))
              (assert (not (is_done done i)))
              (assert (== (dval dist i) c))
              (if (or (not fnd) (< c bv))
                (block
                  (call select_take dist done fnd best bv i)
                  (set fnd true)
                  (set best i)
                  (set bv c))
                (call select_skip dist done fnd best bv i))))))
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (assert (== i (len dist)))
    (call select_end dist done fnd best bv)
    (return fnd best bv)))

(ghost-fn done_le ((d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (du int) (x int)) bool
  (body (=> (is_done b x) (and (known d x) (<= (dval d x) du)))))
(ghost-fn all_done_le ((d (seq (option int))) (b (seq bool)) (du int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (done_le d b du x))))
(ghost-fn relax_frame_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (=> (is_done done x) (same_at c d0 x))
        (and (=> (known d0 x) (and (known c x) (<= (dval c x) (dval d0 x))))
             (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d0)))
                 (or (same_at c d0 x)
                     (and (connected g u x)
                          (and (known c x) (== (dval c x) (+ du (get_edge_weight g u x)))))))))))
(ghost-fn relax_frame ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len c) (len d0)) (forall ((x int)) (relax_frame_at g d0 c done u du x)))))
(ghost-fn relax_idx_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int) (j int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j i)) (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
            (and (known c (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
                 (<= (dval c (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn relax_idx ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((j int)) (relax_idx_at g c u du i j))))
(ghost-fn relax_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int)) bool
  (body (and (relax_frame g d0 c done u du) (relax_idx g c u du i))))
(ghost-fn relax_done_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (x int)) bool
  (body (=> (connected g u x)
            (and (known c x) (<= (dval c x) (+ du (get_edge_weight g u x)))))))
(ghost-fn updated ((c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (v int) (nv int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len c2) (len c))
        (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len c)))
        (and (== (idx c2 v) (some nv))
             (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (!= x v)) (== (idx c2 x) (idx c x)))))))))
(ghost-fn update_ctx ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (nv int)) bool
  (body (and (graph_ok g)
        (and (relax_inv g d0 c done u du i)
        (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
        (and (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
        (and (== nv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (and (not (is_done done v))
        (and (or (not (known c v)) (< nv (dval c v)))
             (updated c c2 v nv)))))))))))
(lemma relax_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int))
  (requires (== (len done) (len d0)))
  (ensures (relax_inv g d0 d0 done u du 0))
  (body
    (assert (forall ((x int)) (relax_frame_at g d0 d0 done u du x)))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d0 done u du))
    (assert (forall ((j int)) (relax_idx_at g d0 u du 0 j)))
    (assert (relax_idx g d0 u du 0))))
(lemma update_known (params (c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (v int) (nv int) (x int))
  (requires (updated c c2 v nv))
  (ensures (=> (== x v) (and (known c2 x) (== (dval c2 x) nv)))
           (=> (!= x v) (and (== (known c2 x) (known c x)) (== (dval c2 x) (dval c x)))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (!= x v))
      (assert (== (idx c2 x) (idx c x)))
      (block))))
(lemma relax_update_x (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (nv int) (x int))
  (requires (update_ctx g d0 c c2 done u du i v nv))
  (ensures (relax_frame_at g d0 c2 done u du x))
  (body
    (assert (relax_inv g d0 c done u du i))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 c done u du))
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 c done u du x))
    (assert (updated c c2 v nv))
    (call edge_fact g u i)
    (call update_known c c2 v nv x)
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (!= x v))
      (assert (== (idx c2 x) (idx c x)))
      (block))))
(lemma relax_update_j (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (nv int) (j int))
  (requires (update_ctx g d0 c c2 done u du i v nv))
  (ensures (relax_idx_at g c2 u du (+ i 1) j))
  (body
    (assert (relax_inv g d0 c done u du i))
    (assert (relax_idx g c u du i))
    (assert (relax_idx_at g c u du i j))
    (assert (updated c c2 v nv))
    (if (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))
      (call update_known c c2 v nv (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
      (block))))
(lemma relax_update (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (c2 (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (nv int))
  (requires (update_ctx g d0 c c2 done u du i v nv))
  (ensures (relax_inv g d0 c2 done u du (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (assert (relax_inv g d0 c done u du i))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 c done u du))
    (assert (updated c c2 v nv))
    (assert (== (len c2) (len d0)))
    (forall ((x int)) (call relax_update_x g d0 c c2 done u du i v nv x))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 c2 done u du))
    (forall ((j int)) (call relax_update_j g d0 c c2 done u du i v nv j))
    (assert (relax_idx g c2 u du (+ i 1)))))
(lemma relax_keep_j (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (relax_idx g c u du i)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (known c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (<= (dval c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (relax_idx_at g c u du (+ i 1) j))
  (body (assert (relax_idx_at g c u du i j))))
(lemma relax_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int))
  (requires (relax_inv g d0 c done u du i)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (known c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (<= (dval c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (relax_inv g d0 c done u du (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 c done u du))
    (assert (relax_idx g c u du i))
    (forall ((j int)) (call relax_keep_j g c u du i j))
    (assert (relax_idx g c u du (+ i 1)))))
(lemma done_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (c (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (v int))
  (requires (relax_frame g d0 c done u du) (all_done_le d0 done du) (is_done done v))
  (ensures (known c v) (<= (dval c v) du))
  (body
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 c done u du v))
    (assert (done_le d0 done du v))
    (call same_vals c d0 v)))
(lemma relax_finish_x (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (relax_idx g c u du (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (relax_done_at g c u du x))
  (body
    (if (connected g u x)
      (block
        (call edge_index g u x)
        (obtain ((i int)) (is_edge_index g u x i))
        (assert (is_edge_index g u x i))
        (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x))
        (call edge_fact g u i)
        (assert (relax_idx_at g c u du (len (idx g u)) i)))
      (block))))
(lemma relax_finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (relax_idx g c u du (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (forall ((x int)) (relax_done_at g c u du x)))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call relax_finish_x g c u du x))))
(spec relax_edges
  (params (rows (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (dist (vec (option i64))) (done (ref (slice bool))) (u i64) (du i64))
  (returns (out (vec (option i64))))
  (requires (graph_ok rows) (== (len dist) (len rows)) (== (len done) (len rows))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len rows)))
            (and (<= 0 du) (<= du 10000000000))
            (all_done_le dist done du))
  (ensures (relax_frame rows dist out done u du)
           (forall ((x int)) (relax_done_at rows out u du x)))
  (effects))
(def relax_edges
  (body
    (call relax_init rows dist done u du)
    (let-mut c (vec (option i64)) dist)
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (let m i64 (len (idx rows u)))
    (while (< i m)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i m)))
      (invariant (relax_inv rows dist c done u du i))
      (decreases (- m i))
      (let v i64 (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 0))
      (let w i64 (get (idx (idx rows u) i) 1))
      (call edge_fact rows u i)
      (assert (relax_frame rows dist c done u du))
      (let nv i64 (+ du w))
      (if (idx done v)
        (block
          (assert (is_done done v))
          (call done_target rows dist c done u du v)
          (call relax_keep rows dist c done u du i))
        (match (idx c v)
          (case (none)
            (block
              (ghost-let c0 (seq (option int)) c)
              (assert (not (known c0 v)))
              (assert (not (is_done done v)))
              (set-idx c v (some nv))
              (assert (updated c0 c v nv))
              (call relax_update rows dist c0 c done u du i v nv)))
          (case (some dv)
            (block
              (assert (known c v))
              (assert (== (dval c v) dv))
              (if (< nv dv)
                (block
                  (ghost-let c1 (seq (option int)) c)
                  (assert (< nv (dval c1 v)))
                  (assert (not (is_done done v)))
                  (set-idx c v (some nv))
                  (assert (updated c1 c v nv))
                  (call relax_update rows dist c1 c done u du i v nv))
                (call relax_keep rows dist c done u du i))))))
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (assert (== i m))
    (assert (relax_idx rows c u du (len (idx rows u))))
    (call relax_finish rows c u du)
    (return c)))

(lemma pre_relax_x (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires (state g s d0 b0 k) (select_facts d0 b0 u du) (marked b0 b1 u))
  (ensures (done_le d0 b1 du x))
  (body
    (assert (== (is_done b1 x) (or (is_done b0 x) (== x u))))
    (assert (done_at g s d0 b0 x))
    (assert (mono_at d0 b0 x u))))
(lemma pre_relax (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int))
  (requires (graph_ok g) (state g s d0 b0 k) (select_facts d0 b0 u du) (marked b0 b1 u)
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (all_done_le d0 b1 du) (lower_bound g s u du) (and (<= 0 du) (<= du 10000000000)))
  (body
    (assert (weights_and_size_bounded g))
    (assert (<= (len g) 100000))
    (assert (reach_at g s d0 k u))
    (assert (== (dval d0 u) du))
    (assert (start_ok d0 s))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d0 b0))
    (call selected_lower g s d0 b0 u)
    (forall ((x int)) (call pre_relax_x g s d0 b0 b1 k u du x))
    (assert (all_done_le d0 b1 du))))

(ghost-fn step_ctx ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int)) bool
  (body (and (graph_ok g)
        (and (state g s d0 b0 k)
        (and (select_facts d0 b0 u du)
        (and (marked b0 b1 u)
        (and (lower_bound g s u du)
        (and (all_done_le d0 b1 du)
        (and (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du)
             (forall ((x int)) (relax_done_at g d1 u du x)))))))))))
(lemma step_done_x (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (=> (is_done b1 x) (and (known d1 x) (and (== (dval d1 x) (dval d0 x)) (<= (dval d1 x) du)))))
  (body
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du))
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 d1 b1 u du x))
    (assert (all_done_le d0 b1 du))
    (assert (done_le d0 b1 du x))
    (if (is_done b1 x)
      (call same_vals d1 d0 x)
      (block))))
(lemma step_start (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (start_ok d1 s))
  (body
    (assert (state g s d0 b0 k))
    (assert (start_ok d0 s))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du))
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 d1 b1 u du s))))
(lemma step_relaxed_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int) (a int) (x int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (relaxed_at g d1 b1 a x))
  (body
    (assert (state g s d0 b0 k))
    (assert (all_relaxed g d0 b0))
    (assert (relaxed_at g d0 b0 a x))
    (assert (select_facts d0 b0 u du))
    (assert (relax_frame g d0 d1 b1 u du))
    (assert (relax_frame_at g d0 d1 b1 u du x))
    (assert (relax_done_at g d1 u du x))
    (assert (marked b0 b1 u))
    (assert (== (is_done b1 a) (or (is_done b0 a) (== a u))))
    (call step_done_x g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du a)))
(lemma step_done_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (b0 (seq bool)) (b1 (seq bool)) (k int) (u int) (du int) (x int))
  (requires (step_ctx g s d0 d1 b0 b1 k u du))
  (ensures (done_at g s d1 b1 x))
  (body
    (assert (state g s d0 b0 k))
    (assert (done_at g s d0 b0 x))
    (assert (select_facts d0 b0 u du))
    (assert (lower_bound g s u du))
    (assert (marked b0 b1 u))
    (assert (== (is_done b1 x) (or (is_done b0 x) (== x u))))

      (=> (and
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (size wg)))
                 (and (<= 0 j)
                      (< j (len (idx (view wg) x)))))
            (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i))))
          (=> (is some (idx before x))
              (is some
                (idx now
                  (get (idx (idx (view wg) x) j) 0)))))))))

(ghost-fn relax_scan
  ((wg weighted_graph)
   (before (seq (option int)))
   (now (seq (option int)))
   (u int)
   (i int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (j int))
      (=> (and
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (size wg)))
                 (and (<= 0 j)
                      (< j (len (idx (view wg) x)))))
            (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i))))
          (match (idx before x)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some dx)
              (match
                (idx now (get (idx (idx (view wg) x) j) 0))
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some dy)
                  (<= dy
                      (+ dx
                         (get (idx (idx (view wg) x) j) 1)))))))))))

(ghost-fn extends_labels
  ((before (seq (option int))) (now (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len before) (len now))
      (forall ((i int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len before)))
            (match (idx before i)
              (case (none) true)
              (case (some d) (== (idx now i) (some d)))))))))

(ghost-fn improves_labels
  ((before (seq (option int))) (now (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len before) (len now))
      (forall ((i int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len before)))
            (match (idx before i)
              (case (none) (is none (idx now i)))
              (case (some d)
                (match (idx now i)
                  (case (none) false)
                  (case (some e) (<= e d))))))))))

(lemma label_update_facts
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e (option int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (label_update s i e)) (len s))
    (== (idx (label_update s i e) i) e)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
            (!= k i))
          (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (label_update s i e)) (len s)))
    (assert (== (idx (label_update s i e) i) e))
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
              (!= k i))
            (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))))

(lemma unknown_update
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (is none (idx s i)))
  (ensures
    (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
        (- (unknown_count s) 1)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some e))))
        (call unknown_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) e)
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1)))))))

(lemma sum_update_decrease
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (old int)
    (new int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (== (idx s i) (some old))
    (and (<= 0 new) (< new old)))
  (ensures
    (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
       (label_sum s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
             (label_sum s))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some new))))
        (call sum_update_decrease
          (drop s 1) (- i 1) old new)
        (assert
          (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
             (label_sum s)))))))

(lemma graph_row_unique
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg))))
  (ensures (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))
  (body
    (assert (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))))

(lemma weight_from_index
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row k) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i k)))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (== i k)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (< i k))
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call weight_from_index row v w k (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_correct
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 1) w))))
    (call graph_row_unique wg u)
    (call weight_from_index
      (idx (view wg) u) v w k 0)
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma append_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call append_connection (view wg) p u v w i))
    (call edge_weight_correct wg u v w)
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma sound_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_sound (view wg) start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (is none (idx s v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (labels_sound
      (view wg)
      start
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (labels_sound
        (view wg)
        start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma discover_step
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (discovery_ok wg start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (is none (idx s v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (discovery_ok
      wg start (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (extends_labels
      s (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (== (unknown_count
          (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
        (- (unknown_count s) 1))
    (in_i64 (+ du w)))
  (body
    (call sound_update wg start s u v w du)
    (call unknown_update s v (+ du w))
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert (>= w 0))
    (assert (<= w 100000))
    (assert (> (unknown_count s) 0))
    (assert (<= (len s) 100000))
    (assert (in_i64 (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (discovery_ok
        wg start (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (extends_labels
        s (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma discovery_finished
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (discovery_ok wg start s))
  (ensures (labels_ok wg start s))
  (body
    (assert (<= (len s) 100000))
    (assert (>= (unknown_count s) 0))
    (assert (labels_ok wg start s))))

(lemma relax_sound_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int)
    (dv int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (== (idx s v) (some dv))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (and (<= 0 (+ du w)) (< (+ du w) dv)))
  (ensures
    (labels_ok
      wg start
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (improves_labels
      s
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert (!= v start))
    (assert
      (labels_sound
        (view wg)
        start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (labels_ok
        wg start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (improves_labels
        s
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i)
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected g
        (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i)
        (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_connection g p i))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take
      p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
               (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))

(lemma path_reachable
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert
          (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call path_reachable
          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (assert
          (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))))

(lemma path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert
          (== (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
        (assert
          (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some d)
              (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call path_lower
          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call edge_weight_correct
          wg
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight (view wg) p)
              (+ (path_weight
                    (view wg)
                    (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                 w)))
        (assert
          (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some d)
              (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p)))))))))

(lemma none_has_no_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (is none (idx s v))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call path_reachable wg start s p)
    (assert false)))

(lemma some_is_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (== (idx s v) (some d)))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call path_lower wg start s p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx s v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and
                (is_path (view wg) p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))
  (body
    (if (is none (idx s v))
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call none_has_no_path wg start s v p))
      (block
        (call some_is_shortest
          wg start s v (field (idx s v) value))
        (assert
          (match (idx s v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path (view wg) p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))))))

(lemma final_labels
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (triangle_closed wg s))
  (ensures
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (match (idx s v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path (view wg) p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)))
      (call final_vertex wg start s v)))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let vertex_count i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut distances (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build vertex_count (fn (initial_index) (none))))
    (set-idx distances start (some 0))

    (let-mut discover_changed bool true)
    (while discover_changed
      (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
      (invariant
        (=> (not discover_changed)
            (reach_closed graph distances)))
      (decreases
        (+ (unknown_count distances)
           (if discover_changed 1 0)))

      (ghost-let discover_before (seq (option int)) distances)
      (set discover_changed false)
      (let-mut discover_u i64 0)

      (while (< discover_u vertex_count)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 discover_u)
               (<= discover_u vertex_count)))
        (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
        (invariant
          (extends_labels discover_before distances))
        (invariant
          (reach_scan
            graph discover_before distances discover_u 0))
        (invariant
          (=> (not discover_changed)
              (== distances discover_before)))
        (invariant
          (=> discover_changed
              (< (unknown_count distances)
                 (unknown_count discover_before))))
        (decreases (- vertex_count discover_u))

        (let-mut discover_i i64 0)
        (while
          (< discover_i
             (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u)))
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 discover_i)
              (<= discover_i
                  (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u)))))
          (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
          (invariant
            (extends_labels discover_before distances))
          (invariant
            (reach_scan
              graph discover_before distances
              discover_u discover_i))
          (invariant
            (=> (not discover_changed)
                (== distances discover_before)))
          (invariant
            (=> discover_changed
                (< (unknown_count distances)
                   (unknown_count discover_before))))
          (decreases
            (- (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u))
               discover_i))

          (let discover_edge (tuple i64 i64)
            (idx (idx (field graph adj) discover_u) discover_i))
          (let discover_v i64 (get discover_edge 0))
          (let discover_w i64 (get discover_edge 1))

          (if
            (and
              (is some (idx distances discover_u))
              (is none (idx distances discover_v)))
            (block
              (let discover_du i64
                (field (idx distances discover_u) value))
              (ghost-let discover_step_before
                (seq (option int)) distances)
              (call discover_step
                graph start discover_step_before
                discover_u discover_v discover_w discover_du)
              (set-idx distances discover_v
                (some (+ discover_du discover_w)))

      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
            (!= k i))
          (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))
  (body

    (assert

(lemma unknown_update
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (is none (idx s i)))
  (ensures
    (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
        (- (unknown_count s) 1)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some e))))
        (call unknown_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) e)

  (params

  (body

        (assert

      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some new))))
        (call sum_update_decrease

        (assert

  (params

  (decreases (- k i))

(lemma append_connection
  (params

      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))

  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_connection g p i))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)

  (params

  (requires

    (reach_closed wg s)

  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert

      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)

          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))

        (assert

    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e (option int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (label_update s i e)) (len s))
    (== (idx (label_update s i e) i) e)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
            (!= k i))
          (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (label_update s i e)) (len s)))
    (assert (== (idx (label_update s i e) i) e))
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
              (!= k i))
            (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))))

(lemma unknown_update
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (is none (idx s i)))
  (ensures
    (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
        (- (unknown_count s) 1)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some e))))
        (call unknown_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) e)
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1)))))))

(lemma sum_update_decrease
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (old int)
    (new int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (== (idx s i) (some old))
    (and (<= 0 new) (< new old)))
  (ensures
    (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
       (label_sum s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
             (label_sum s))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some new))))
        (call sum_update_decrease
          (drop s 1) (- i 1) old new)
        (assert
          (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
             (label_sum s)))))))

(lemma graph_row_unique
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg))))
  (ensures (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))
  (body
    (assert (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))))

(lemma weight_from_index
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row k) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i k)))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (== i k)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (< i k))
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call weight_from_index row v w k (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_correct
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 1) w))))
    (call graph_row_unique wg u)
    (call weight_from_index
      (idx (view wg) u) v w k 0)
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma append_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call append_connection (view wg) p u v w i))
    (call edge_weight_correct wg u v w)
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma sound_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_sound (view wg) start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (is none (idx s v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (labels_sound
      (view wg)
      start
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (labels_sound
        (view wg)
        start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma discover_step
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (discovery_ok wg start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (is none (idx s v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (discovery_ok
      wg start (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (extends_labels
      s (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (== (unknown_count
          (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
        (- (unknown_count s) 1))
    (in_i64 (+ du w)))
  (body
    (call sound_update wg start s u v w du)
    (call unknown_update s v (+ du w))
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert (>= w 0))
    (assert (<= w 100000))
    (assert (> (unknown_count s) 0))
    (assert (<= (len s) 100000))
    (assert (in_i64 (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (discovery_ok
        wg start (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (extends_labels
        s (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma discovery_finished
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (discovery_ok wg start s))
  (ensures (labels_ok wg start s))
  (body
    (assert (<= (len s) 100000))
    (assert (>= (unknown_count s) 0))
    (assert (labels_ok wg start s))))

(lemma relax_sound_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int)
    (dv int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (== (idx s v) (some dv))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (and (<= 0 (+ du w)) (< (+ du w) dv)))
  (ensures
    (labels_ok
      wg start
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (improves_labels
      s
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert (!= v start))
    (assert
      (labels_sound
        (view wg)
        start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (labels_ok
        wg start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (improves_labels
        s
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i)
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected g
        (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i)
        (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_connection g p i))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take
      p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
               (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))

(lemma path_reachable
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert
          (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call path_reachable
          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (assert
          (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))))

(lemma path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert
          (== (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
        (assert
          (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some d)
              (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call path_lower
          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call edge_weight_correct
          wg
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight (view wg) p)
              (+ (path_weight
                    (view wg)
                    (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                 w)))
        (assert
          (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some d)
              (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p)))))))))

(lemma none_has_no_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (is none (idx s v))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call path_reachable wg start s p)
    (assert false)))

(lemma some_is_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (== (idx s v) (some d)))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call path_lower wg start s p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx s v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and
                (is_path (view wg) p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))
  (body
    (if (is none (idx s v))
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call none_has_no_path wg start s v p))
      (block
        (call some_is_shortest
          wg start s v (field (idx s v) value))
        (assert
          (match (idx s v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path (view wg) p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))))))

(lemma final_labels
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (triangle_closed wg s))
  (ensures
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (match (idx s v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path (view wg) p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call final_vertex wg start s v))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let vertex_count i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut distances (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build vertex_count (fn (initial_index) (none))))
    (set-idx distances start (some 0))

    (let-mut discover_changed bool true)
    (while discover_changed
      (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
      (invariant
        (=> (not discover_changed)
            (reach_closed graph distances)))
      (decreases
        (+ (unknown_count distances)
           (if discover_changed 1 0)))

      (ghost-let discover_before (seq (option int)) distances)
      (set discover_changed false)
      (let-mut discover_u i64 0)

      (while (< discover_u vertex_count)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 discover_u)
               (<= discover_u vertex_count)))
        (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
        (invariant
          (extends_labels discover_before distances))
        (invariant
          (reach_scan
            graph discover_before distances discover_u 0))
        (invariant
          (=> (not discover_changed)
              (== distances discover_before)))
        (invariant
          (=> discover_changed
              (< (unknown_count distances)
                 (unknown_count discover_before))))
        (decreases (- vertex_count discover_u))

        (let-mut discover_i i64 0)
        (while
          (< discover_i
             (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u)))
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 discover_i)
              (<= discover_i
                  (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u)))))
          (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
          (invariant
            (extends_labels discover_before distances))
          (invariant
            (reach_scan
              graph discover_before distances
              discover_u discover_i))
          (invariant
            (=> (not discover_changed)
                (== distances discover_before)))
          (invariant
            (=> discover_changed
                (< (unknown_count distances)
                   (unknown_count discover_before))))
          (decreases
            (- (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u))
               discover_i))

          (let discover_edge (tuple i64 i64)
            (idx (idx (field graph adj) discover_u) discover_i))
          (let discover_v i64 (get discover_edge 0))
          (let discover_w i64 (get discover_edge 1))

          (if
            (and
              (is some (idx distances discover_u))
              (is none (idx distances discover_v)))
            (block
              (let discover_du i64
                (field (idx distances discover_u) value))
              (ghost-let discover_step_before
                (seq (option int)) distances)
              (call discover_step
                graph start discover_step_before
                discover_u discover_v discover_w discover_du)
              (set-idx distances discover_v
                (some (+ discover_du discover_w)))
              (assert
                (== distances
                    (label_update
                      discover_step_before
                      discover_v
                      (some (+ discover_du discover_w)))))
              (set discover_changed true))
            (block))
          (set discover_i (+ discover_i 1)))
        (set discover_u (+ discover_u 1)))

      (assert
        (=> (not discover_changed)
            (reach_closed graph distances))))

    (call discovery_finished graph start distances)

    (let-mut relax_changed bool true)
    (while relax_changed
      (invariant (labels_ok graph start distances))
      (invariant (reach_closed graph distances))
      (invariant
        (=> (not relax_changed)
            (triangle_closed graph distances)))
      (decreases
        (+ (label_sum distances)
           (if relax_changed 1 0)))

      (ghost-let relax_before (seq (option int)) distances)
      (set relax_changed false)
      (let-mut relax_u i64 0)

      (while (< relax_u vertex_count)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 relax_u)
               (<= relax_u vertex_count)))
        (invariant (labels_ok graph start distances))
        (invariant (reach_closed graph distances))
        (invariant
          (improves_labels relax_before distances))
        (invariant
          (relax_scan graph relax_before distances relax_u 0))
        (invariant
          (=> (not relax_changed)
              (== distances relax_before)))
        (invariant
          (=> relax_changed
              (< (label_sum distances)
                 (label_sum relax_before))))
        (decreases (- vertex_count relax_u))

        (let-mut relax_i i64 0)
        (while
          (< relax_i (len (idx (field graph adj) relax_u)))
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 relax_i)
              (<= relax_i
                  (len (idx (field graph adj) relax_u)))))
          (invariant (labels_ok graph start distances))
          (invariant (reach_closed graph distances))
          (invariant
            (improves_labels relax_before distances))
          (invariant
            (relax_scan
              graph relax_before distances relax_u relax_i))
          (invariant
            (=> (not relax_changed)
                (== distances relax_before)))
          (invariant
            (=> relax_changed
                (< (label_sum distances)
