    (forall ((x int) (j int))
      (=> (and
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (size wg)))
                 (and (<= 0 j)
                      (< j (len (idx (view wg) x)))))
            (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i))))
          (match (idx before x)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some dx)
              (match
                (idx now (get (idx (idx (view wg) x) j) 0))
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some dy)
                  (<= dy
                      (+ dx
                         (get (idx (idx (view wg) x) j) 1)))))))))))

(ghost-fn extends_labels
  ((before (seq (option int))) (now (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len before) (len now))
      (forall ((i int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len before)))
            (match (idx before i)
              (case (none) true)
              (case (some d) (== (idx now i) (some d)))))))))

(ghost-fn improves_labels
  ((before (seq (option int))) (now (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len before) (len now))
      (forall ((i int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len before)))
            (match (idx before i)
              (case (none) (is none (idx now i)))
              (case (some d)
                (match (idx now i)
                  (case (none) false)
                  (case (some e) (<= e d))))))))))

(lemma label_update_facts
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e (option int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (label_update s i e)) (len s))
    (== (idx (label_update s i e) i) e)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
            (!= k i))
          (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (label_update s i e)) (len s)))
    (assert (== (idx (label_update s i e) i) e))
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
              (!= k i))
            (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))))

(lemma unknown_update
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (is none (idx s i)))
  (ensures
    (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
        (- (unknown_count s) 1)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some e))))
        (call unknown_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) e)
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1)))))))

(lemma sum_update_decrease
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (old int)
    (new int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (== (idx s i) (some old))
    (and (<= 0 new) (< new old)))
  (ensures
    (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
       (label_sum s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
             (label_sum s))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some new))))
        (call sum_update_decrease
          (drop s 1) (- i 1) old new)
        (assert
          (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
             (label_sum s)))))))

(lemma graph_row_unique
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg))))
  (ensures (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))
  (body
    (assert (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))))

(lemma weight_from_index
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row k) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i k)))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (== i k)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (< i k))
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call weight_from_index row v w k (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_correct
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 1) w))))
    (call graph_row_unique wg u)
    (call weight_from_index
      (idx (view wg) u) v w k 0)
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma append_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call append_connection (view wg) p u v w i))
    (call edge_weight_correct wg u v w)
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma sound_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_sound (view wg) start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (is none (idx s v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (labels_sound
      (view wg)
      start
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (labels_sound
        (view wg)
        start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma discover_step
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (discovery_ok wg start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (is none (idx s v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (discovery_ok
      wg start (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (extends_labels
      s (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (== (unknown_count
          (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
        (- (unknown_count s) 1))
    (in_i64 (+ du w)))
  (body
    (call sound_update wg start s u v w du)
    (call unknown_update s v (+ du w))
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert (>= w 0))
    (assert (<= w 100000))
    (assert (> (unknown_count s) 0))
    (assert (<= (len s) 100000))
    (assert (in_i64 (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (discovery_ok
        wg start (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (extends_labels
        s (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma discovery_finished
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (discovery_ok wg start s))
  (ensures (labels_ok wg start s))
  (body
    (assert (<= (len s) 100000))
    (assert (>= (unknown_count s) 0))
    (assert (labels_ok wg start s))))

(lemma relax_sound_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int)
    (dv int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (== (idx s v) (some dv))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (and (<= 0 (+ du w)) (< (+ du w) dv)))
  (ensures
    (labels_ok
      wg start
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (improves_labels
      s
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert (!= v start))
    (assert
      (labels_sound
        (view wg)
        start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (labels_ok
        wg start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (improves_labels
        s
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i)
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected g
        (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i)
        (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_connection g p i))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take
      p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
               (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))

(lemma path_reachable
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert
          (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call path_reachable
          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (assert
          (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))))

(lemma path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert
          (== (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
        (assert
          (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some base_d)
              (<= base_d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call path_lower
          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call edge_weight_correct
          wg
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight (view wg) p)
              (+ (path_weight
                    (view wg)
                    (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                 w)))
        (assert
          (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some step_d)
              (<= step_d (path_weight (view wg) p)))))))))

(lemma none_has_no_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (is none (idx s v))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call path_reachable wg start s p)
    (assert false)))

(lemma some_is_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (== (idx s v) (some d)))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call path_lower wg start s p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx s v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and
                (is_path (view wg) p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))
  (body
    (if (is none (idx s v))
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call none_has_no_path wg start s v p))
      (block
        (call some_is_shortest
          wg start s v (field (idx s v) value))
        (assert
          (match (idx s v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path (view wg) p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some final_d)
              (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v final_d))))))))

(lemma final_labels
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (triangle_closed wg s))
  (ensures
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (match (idx s v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path (view wg) p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call final_vertex wg start s v))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let vertex_count i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut distances (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build vertex_count (fn (initial_index) (none))))
    (set-idx distances start (some 0))

    (let-mut discover_changed bool true)
    (while discover_changed
      (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
      (invariant
        (=> (not discover_changed)
            (reach_closed graph distances)))
      (decreases
        (+ (unknown_count distances)
           (if discover_changed 1 0)))

      (ghost-let discover_before (seq (option int)) distances)
      (set discover_changed false)
      (let-mut discover_u i64 0)

      (while (< discover_u vertex_count)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 discover_u)
               (<= discover_u vertex_count)))
        (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
        (invariant
          (extends_labels discover_before distances))
        (invariant
          (reach_scan
            graph discover_before distances discover_u 0))
        (invariant
          (=> (not discover_changed)
              (== distances discover_before)))
        (invariant
          (=> discover_changed
              (< (unknown_count distances)
                 (unknown_count discover_before))))
        (decreases (- vertex_count discover_u))

        (let-mut discover_i i64 0)
        (while
          (< discover_i
             (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u)))
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 discover_i)
              (<= discover_i
                  (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u)))))
          (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
          (invariant
            (extends_labels discover_before distances))
          (invariant
            (reach_scan
              graph discover_before distances
              discover_u discover_i))
          (invariant
            (=> (not discover_changed)
                (== distances discover_before)))
          (invariant
            (=> discover_changed
                (< (unknown_count distances)
                   (unknown_count discover_before))))
          (decreases
            (- (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u))
               discover_i))

          (let discover_edge (tuple i64 i64)
            (idx (idx (field graph adj) discover_u) discover_i))
          (let discover_v i64 (get discover_edge 0))
          (let discover_w i64 (get discover_edge 1))

          (if
            (and
              (is some (idx distances discover_u))
              (is none (idx distances discover_v)))
            (block
              (let discover_du i64
                (field (idx distances discover_u) value))
              (ghost-let discover_step_before
                (seq (option int)) distances)
              (call discover_step
                graph start discover_step_before
                discover_u discover_v discover_w discover_du)
              (set-idx distances discover_v
                (some (+ discover_du discover_w)))
              (assert
                (== distances
                    (label_update
                      discover_step_before
                      discover_v
                      (some (+ discover_du discover_w)))))
              (set discover_changed true))
            (block))
          (set discover_i (+ discover_i 1)))
        (set discover_u (+ discover_u 1)))

      (assert
        (=> (not discover_changed)
            (reach_closed graph distances))))

    (call discovery_finished graph start distances)

    (let-mut relax_changed bool true)
    (while relax_changed
      (invariant (labels_ok graph start distances))

    (obtain ((edge_index int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_index)
            (< edge_index (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (==
            (get
              (idx (idx (view wg) u) edge_index)
              0)
            v)
          (==
            (get
              (idx (idx (view wg) u) edge_index)
              1)
            w))))
    (call graph_row_unique wg u)
    (call weight_from_position
      (idx (view wg) u)
      edge_index
      0)
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma path_vertices_in_range_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p k))
      (< (idx p k) (size wg))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (assert
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p k))
          (< (idx p k) (size wg))))
      (block
        (call path_vertices_in_range_at
          wg p start (- k 1))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            edge_weight))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
                (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len (view wg))))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index
                  (len
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))))))
            (and
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  0)
                (idx p k))
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  1)
                edge_weight))))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (size wg))))))))

  (params

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (d int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) p) d)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (candidate_path wg start v (+ d w)))
  (body
    (call exact_edge_weight wg u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat
      p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p (seq-lit v) (len p))
    (assert
      (is_path
        (view wg)
        (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight
          (view wg)
          (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ d w)))
    (assert
      (candidate_path wg start v (+ d w)))))

(lemma path_weight_non_negative
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg)))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (assert
        (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
      (block
        (call path_prefix
          (view wg) p (- (len p) 2))
        (call path_weight_non_negative
          wg
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            edge_weight))
        (call exact_edge_weight
          wg
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          edge_weight)
        (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))))))

(lemma prefix_step_non_negative
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (path_weight (view wg) (take p k))
      (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (body
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p k)
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p (- k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (obtain ((edge_weight int))
      (has_edge
        (view wg)
        (idx p (- k 1))
        (idx p k)
        edge_weight))
    (call exact_edge_weight
      wg
      (idx p (- k 1))
      (idx p k)
      edge_weight)
    (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
    (assert
      (<=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p k))
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))))))

(lemma frontier_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p j))
          (< (idx p j) (size wg)))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (not (idx done (idx p k))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int) (d int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some d))
          (<= d
            (path_weight
              (view wg)
              (take p (+ k 1))))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p 0)
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p 1))
            0))
        (assert
          (exists ((v int) (d int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
                (not (idx done v)))
              (and
                (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                (<= d
                  (path_weight
                    (view wg)
                    (take p 1))))))))
      (if
        (not (idx done (idx p (- k 1))))
        (block
          (call frontier_at
            wg start dist done steps p (- k 1))
          (call prefix_step_non_negative wg p k)
          (assert
            (exists ((v int) (d int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
                  (not (idx done v)))
                (and
                  (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                  (<= d
                    (path_weight
                      (view wg)
                      (take p (+ k 1)))))))))
        (block
          (obtain ((edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              (view wg)
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              edge_weight))
          (call exact_edge_weight
            wg
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            edge_weight)
          (call path_prefix
            (view wg) p (- k 1))
          (match (idx dist (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none)
              (assert false))
            (case (some predecessor_distance)
              (block
                (assert
                  (is_shortest_dist
                    (view wg)
                    start
                    (idx p (- k 1))
                    predecessor_distance))
                (assert
                  (<=
                    predecessor_distance
                    (path_weight
                      (view wg)
                      (take p k))))
                (match (idx dist (idx p k))
                  (case (none)
                    (assert false))
                  (case (some current_distance)
                    (block
                      (assert
                        (<=
                          current_distance
                          (+ predecessor_distance edge_weight)))
                      (assert
                        (==
                          (path_weight
                            (view wg)
                            (take p (+ k 1)))
                          (+
                            (path_weight
                              (view wg)
                              (take p k))
                            edge_weight)))
                      (assert
                        (exists ((v int) (d int))
                          (and
                            (and
                              (and
                                (<= 0 v)
                                (< v (size wg)))
                              (not (idx done v)))
                            (and
                              (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                              (<= d
                                (path_weight
                                  (view wg)
                                  (take p (+ k 1))))))))))))))))))))

(lemma frontier
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size wg)))
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int) (d int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some d))
          (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_in_range wg p start)
    (call frontier_at
      wg start dist done steps p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_take_all p)
    (assert
      (exists ((v int) (d int))
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
            (not (idx done v)))
          (and
            (== (idx dist v) (some d))
            (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))))

(lemma choice_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (u int)
    (d int)
    (p (seq int)))

    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)

  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_in_range wg p start)
    (call frontier wg start dist done steps p)
    (obtain ((v int) (candidate_distance int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some candidate_distance))

(lemma choice_is_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (u int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) (some (tuple u d))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u d)
      (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (* steps 100000)))))
  (body
    (assert (candidate_path wg start u d))
    (obtain ((witness_path (seq int)))
      (and
        (is_path (view wg) witness_path)
        (and
          (and
            (== (idx witness_path 0) start)
            (== (idx witness_path
                  (- (len witness_path) 1))
                u))
          (==
            (path_weight (view wg) witness_path)
            d))))
    (call path_weight_non_negative wg witness_path)
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call choice_path_lower_bound
        wg start dist done steps u d p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u d))
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (* steps 100000))))))

(lemma label_update_facts
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e (option int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (label_update s i e)) (len s))
    (== (idx (label_update s i e) i) e)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
            (!= k i))
          (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (label_update s i e)) (len s)))
    (assert (== (idx (label_update s i e) i) e))
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
              (!= k i))
            (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))))

(lemma unknown_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (>= (unknown_count s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (assert (>= (unknown_count s) 0))
      (block
        (call law_len_drop s 1)
        (call unknown_nonnegative (drop s 1))
        (assert (>= (unknown_count s) 0))))))

(lemma unknown_positive_at
  (params (s (seq (option int))) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (is none (idx s i)))
  (ensures (> (unknown_count s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_drop s 1)
        (call unknown_nonnegative (drop s 1))
        (assert (> (unknown_count s) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (call law_len_drop s 1)
        (call law_idx_drop s 1 (- i 1))
        (call unknown_positive_at (drop s 1) (- i 1))
        (assert (> (unknown_count s) 0))))))

(lemma label_sum_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
          (match (idx s i)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some d) (>= d 0))))))
  (ensures (>= (label_sum s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (assert (>= (label_sum s) 0))
      (block
        (call law_len_drop s 1)
        (assert
          (forall ((i int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (drop s 1))))
                (match (idx (drop s 1) i)
                  (case (none) true)
                  (case (some d) (>= d 0))))))
        (call label_sum_nonnegative (drop s 1))
        (assert (>= (label_sum s) 0))))))

(lemma unknown_update
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (is none (idx s i)))
  (ensures
    (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
        (- (unknown_count s) 1)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some e))))
        (call unknown_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) e)
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1)))))))

(lemma sum_update_decrease
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (old int)
    (new int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (== (idx s i) (some old))
    (and (<= 0 new) (< new old)))
  (ensures
    (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
       (label_sum s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
             (label_sum s))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some new))))
        (call sum_update_decrease
          (drop s 1) (- i 1) old new)
        (assert
          (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
             (label_sum s)))))))

(lemma graph_row_unique
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg))))
  (ensures (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))
  (body
    (assert (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))))

(lemma weight_from_index
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row k) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i k)))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (== i k)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (< i k))
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call weight_from_index row v w k (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_correct
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 1) w))))
    (call graph_row_unique wg u)
    (call weight_from_index
      (idx (view wg) u) v w k 0)
    (assert

(lemma append_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)

      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call append_connection (view wg) p u v w i))
    (call edge_weight_correct wg u v w)
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma sound_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires

    (is none (idx s v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (labels_sound
      (view wg)

      (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (labels_sound
        (view wg)

        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma discover_step
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)

    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (discovery_ok wg start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))

    (call unknown_positive_at s v)
    (call unknown_update s v (+ du w))
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert (>= w 0))
    (assert (<= w 100000))
    (assert (<= (len s) 100000))
    (assert (in_i64 (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (discovery_ok
        wg start (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (extends_labels
        s (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

  (params

(lemma prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)

  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i)
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected g
        (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i)

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_connection g p i))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take
      p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
               (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))

(lemma path_reachable
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert
          (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call path_reachable
          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (assert
          (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))))

(lemma path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert
          (== (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
        (assert
          (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some base_d)
              (<= base_d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call path_lower
          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call edge_weight_correct
          wg
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight (view wg) p)
              (+ (path_weight
                    (view wg)
                    (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                 w)))
        (assert
          (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some step_d)
              (<= step_d (path_weight (view wg) p)))))))))

(lemma none_has_no_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
    (is none (idx s v))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call path_reachable wg start s p)
    (assert false)))

(lemma some_is_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
    (== (idx s v) (some d)))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call path_lower wg start s p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx s v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and
                (is_path (view wg) p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))
  (body
    (if (is none (idx s v))
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call none_has_no_path wg start s v p))
      (block
        (call some_is_shortest
          wg start s v (field (idx s v) value))
        (assert
          (match (idx s v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path (view wg) p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some final_d)
              (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v final_d))))))))

(lemma final_labels
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (triangle_closed wg s))
  (ensures
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (match (idx s v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path (view wg) p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call final_vertex wg start s v))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let vertex_count i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut distances (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build vertex_count (fn (initial_index) (none))))
    (set-idx distances start (some 0))

    (call unknown_nonnegative distances)
    (let-mut discover_changed bool true)
    (while discover_changed
      (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
      (invariant (>= (unknown_count distances) 0))
      (invariant
        (=> (not discover_changed)
            (reach_closed graph distances)))
      (decreases
        (+ (unknown_count distances)
           (if discover_changed 1 0)))

      (ghost-let discover_before (seq (option int)) distances)
      (set discover_changed false)
      (let-mut discover_u i64 0)

      (while (< discover_u vertex_count)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 discover_u)
               (<= discover_u vertex_count)))
        (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
        (invariant (>= (unknown_count distances) 0))
        (invariant
          (extends_labels discover_before distances))
        (invariant
          (reach_scan
            graph discover_before distances discover_u 0))
        (invariant
          (=> (not discover_changed)
              (== distances discover_before)))
        (invariant
          (=> discover_changed
              (< (unknown_count distances)
                 (unknown_count discover_before))))
        (decreases (- vertex_count discover_u))

        (let-mut discover_i i64 0)
        (while
          (< discover_i
             (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u)))
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 discover_i)
              (<= discover_i
                  (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u)))))
          (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
          (invariant (>= (unknown_count distances) 0))
          (invariant
            (extends_labels discover_before distances))
          (invariant
            (reach_scan
              graph discover_before distances
              discover_u discover_i))
          (invariant
            (=> (not discover_changed)
                (== distances discover_before)))
          (invariant
            (=> discover_changed
                (< (unknown_count distances)
                   (unknown_count discover_before))))
          (decreases
            (- (len (idx (field graph adj) discover_u))
               discover_i))

          (let discover_edge (tuple i64 i64)
            (idx (idx (field graph adj) discover_u) discover_i))
          (let discover_v i64 (get discover_edge 0))
          (let discover_w i64 (get discover_edge 1))

          (if

        (get (idx row edge_index) 0)
        position)
      (get (idx row edge_index) 1)))
  (decreases (- edge_index position))
  (body
    (if
      (== position edge_index)
      (assert
        (==
          (weight_from
            row
            (get (idx row edge_index) 0)
            position)
          (get (idx row edge_index) 1)))
      (block
        (assert
          (!=
            (get (idx row position) 0)
            (get (idx row edge_index) 0)))
        (call weight_from_position
          row edge_index (+ position 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (weight_from
              row
              (get (idx row edge_index) 0)
              position)
            (get (idx row edge_index) 1)))))))

(lemma exact_edge_weight
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((edge_index int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_index)
            (< edge_index (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (==
            (get
              (idx (idx (view wg) u) edge_index)
              0)
            v)
          (==
            (get
              (idx (idx (view wg) u) edge_index)
              1)
            w))))
    (call graph_row_unique wg u)
    (call weight_from_position
      (idx (view wg) u)
      edge_index
      0)
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma path_vertices_in_range_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p k))
      (< (idx p k) (size wg))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (assert
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p k))
          (< (idx p k) (size wg))))
      (block
        (call path_vertices_in_range_at
          wg p start (- k 1))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            edge_weight))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
                (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len (view wg))))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index
                  (len
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))))))
            (and
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  0)
                (idx p k))
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  1)
                edge_weight))))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (size wg))))))))

(lemma path_vertices_in_range
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg))))

    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p k))
          (< (idx p k) (size wg))))))

    (forall ((k int))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (d int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) p) d)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (candidate_path wg start v (+ d w)))
  (body
    (call exact_edge_weight wg u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat
      p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p (seq-lit v) (len p))
    (assert
      (is_path
        (view wg)
        (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight
          (view wg)
          (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ d w)))
    (assert
      (candidate_path wg start v (+ d w)))))

(lemma path_weight_non_negative
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg)))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (assert
        (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
      (block
        (call path_prefix
          (view wg) p (- (len p) 2))
        (call path_weight_non_negative
          wg
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            edge_weight))
        (call exact_edge_weight
          wg
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          edge_weight)
        (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))))))

(lemma prefix_step_non_negative
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (path_weight (view wg) (take p k))
      (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (body
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p k)
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p (- k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (obtain ((edge_weight int))
      (has_edge
        (view wg)
        (idx p (- k 1))
        (idx p k)
        edge_weight))
    (call exact_edge_weight
      wg
      (idx p (- k 1))
      (idx p k)
      edge_weight)
    (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
    (assert
      (<=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p k))
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))))))

(lemma frontier_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p j))
          (< (idx p j) (size wg)))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (not (idx done (idx p k))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int) (d int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some d))
          (<= d
            (path_weight
              (view wg)
              (take p (+ k 1))))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p 0)
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p 1))
            0))
        (assert
          (exists ((v int) (d int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
                (not (idx done v)))
              (and
                (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                (<= d
                  (path_weight
                    (view wg)
                    (take p 1))))))))
      (if
        (not (idx done (idx p (- k 1))))
        (block
          (call frontier_at
            wg start dist done steps p (- k 1))
          (call prefix_step_non_negative wg p k)
          (assert
            (exists ((v int) (d int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
                  (not (idx done v)))
                (and
                  (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                  (<= d
                    (path_weight
                      (view wg)
                      (take p (+ k 1)))))))))
        (block
          (obtain ((edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              (view wg)
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              edge_weight))
          (call exact_edge_weight
            wg
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            edge_weight)
          (call path_prefix
            (view wg) p (- k 1))
          (match (idx dist (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none)
              (assert false))
            (case (some predecessor_distance)
              (block
                (assert
                  (is_shortest_dist
                    (view wg)
                    start
                    (idx p (- k 1))
                    predecessor_distance))
                (assert
                  (<=
                    predecessor_distance
                    (path_weight
                      (view wg)
                      (take p k))))
                (match (idx dist (idx p k))
                  (case (none)
                    (assert false))
                  (case (some current_distance)
                    (block
                      (assert
                        (<=
                          current_distance
                          (+ predecessor_distance edge_weight)))
                      (assert
                        (==
                          (path_weight
                            (view wg)
                            (take p (+ k 1)))
                          (+
                            (path_weight
                              (view wg)
                              (take p k))
                            edge_weight)))
                      (assert
                        (exists ((v int) (d int))
                          (and
                            (and
                              (and
                                (<= 0 v)
                                (< v (size wg)))
                              (not (idx done v)))
                            (and
                              (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                              (<= d
                                (path_weight
                                  (view wg)
                                  (take p (+ k 1))))))))))))))))))))

(lemma frontier
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size wg)))
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int) (d int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some d))
          (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_in_range wg p start)
    (call frontier_at
      wg start dist done steps p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_take_all p)
    (assert
      (exists ((v int) (d int))
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
            (not (idx done v)))
          (and
            (== (idx dist v) (some d))
            (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))))

(lemma choice_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (u int)
    (d int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) (some (tuple u d)))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_in_range wg p start)
    (call frontier wg start dist done steps p)
    (obtain ((v int) (candidate_distance int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some candidate_distance))
          (<= candidate_distance
            (path_weight (view wg) p)))))
    (assert (<= d candidate_distance))
    (assert (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))

(lemma choice_is_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (u int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) (some (tuple u d))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u d)
      (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (* steps 100000)))))
  (body
    (assert (candidate_path wg start u d))
    (obtain ((witness_path (seq int)))
      (and
        (is_path (view wg) witness_path)
        (and
          (and
            (== (idx witness_path 0) start)
            (== (idx witness_path
                  (- (len witness_path) 1))
                u))
          (==
            (path_weight (view wg) witness_path)
            d))))
    (call path_weight_non_negative wg witness_path)
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call choice_path_lower_bound
        wg start dist done steps u d p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u d))
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (* steps 100000))))))

(lemma no_path_when_no_candidate
  (params

(lemma finish_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) (none))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path (view wg) p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some result_distance)
        (is_shortest_dist
          (view wg)
          start
          v
          result_distance))))
  (body
    (if
      (idx done v)
      (assert
        (match (idx dist v)
          (case (none) false)
          (case (some settled_distance)
            (is_shortest_dist
              (view wg)
              start
              v
              settled_distance))))
      (block
        (assert (is none (idx dist v)))
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call no_path_when_no_candidate
            wg start dist done steps v p))
        (assert
          (match (idx dist v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (is_path (view wg) p)
                    (and
                      (== (idx p 0) start)
                      (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))
            (case (some impossible_distance) false)))))))
