                      (case (some dy)
                        (<= dy
                            (+ dx
                               (get (idx (idx (view wg) x) j) 1))))))))))))))

(ghost-fn extends_labels
  ((before (seq (option int))) (now (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len before) (len now))
      (forall ((i int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len before)))
            (match (idx before i)
              (case (none) true)
              (case (some d) (== (idx now i) (some d)))))))))

(ghost-fn improves_labels
  ((before (seq (option int))) (now (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len before) (len now))
      (forall ((i int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len before)))
            (match (idx before i)
              (case (none) (is none (idx now i)))
              (case (some d)
                (match (idx now i)
                  (case (none) false)
                  (case (some e) (<= e d))))))))))

(lemma label_update_facts
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e (option int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (label_update s i e)) (len s))
    (== (idx (label_update s i e) i) e)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
            (!= k i))
          (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (label_update s i e)) (len s)))
    (assert (== (idx (label_update s i e) i) e))
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
              (!= k i))
            (== (idx (label_update s i e) k) (idx s k)))))))

(lemma unknown_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (>= (unknown_count s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (assert (>= (unknown_count s) 0))
      (block
        (call law_len_drop s 1)
        (call unknown_nonnegative (drop s 1))
        (assert (>= (unknown_count s) 0))))))

(lemma unknown_positive_at
  (params (s (seq (option int))) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (is none (idx s i)))
  (ensures (> (unknown_count s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (call law_len_drop s 1)
        (call unknown_nonnegative (drop s 1))
        (assert (> (unknown_count s) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (call law_len_drop s 1)
        (call law_idx_drop s 1 (- i 1))
        (call unknown_positive_at (drop s 1) (- i 1))
        (assert (> (unknown_count s) 0))))))

(lemma label_sum_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
          (match (idx s i)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some d) (>= d 0))))))
  (ensures (>= (label_sum s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (assert (>= (label_sum s) 0))
      (block
        (call law_len_drop s 1)
        (assert
          (forall ((i int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (drop s 1))))
                (match (idx (drop s 1) i)
                  (case (none) true)
                  (case (some d) (>= d 0))))))
        (call label_sum_nonnegative (drop s 1))
        (assert (>= (label_sum s) 0))))))

(lemma unknown_update
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (e int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (is none (idx s i)))
  (ensures
    (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
        (- (unknown_count s) 1)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some e)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some e))))
        (call unknown_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) e)
        (assert
          (== (unknown_count (label_update s i (some e)))
              (- (unknown_count s) 1)))))))

(lemma sum_update_decrease
  (params
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (i int)
    (old int)
    (new int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
    (== (idx s i) (some old))
    (and (<= 0 new) (< new old)))
  (ensures
    (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
       (label_sum s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== i 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (drop s 1)))
        (assert
          (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
             (label_sum s))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (== (drop (label_update s i (some new)) 1)
              (label_update (drop s 1) (- i 1) (some new))))
        (call sum_update_decrease
          (drop s 1) (- i 1) old new)
        (assert
          (< (label_sum (label_update s i (some new)))
             (label_sum s)))))))

(lemma graph_row_unique
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg))))
  (ensures (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))
  (body
    (assert (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))))

(lemma weight_from_index
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (row_unique row)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row k) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i k)))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (== i k)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (< i k))
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call weight_from_index row v w k (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_weight_correct
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 1) w))))
    (call graph_row_unique wg u)
    (call weight_from_index
      (idx (view wg) u) v w k 0)
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma append_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
      (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)
        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call append_connection (view wg) p u v w i))
    (call edge_weight_correct wg u v w)
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma sound_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_sound (view wg) start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (is none (idx s v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (labels_sound
      (view wg)
      start
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (labels_sound
        (view wg)
        start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma discover_step
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (discovery_ok wg start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (is none (idx s v))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (discovery_ok
      wg start (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (extends_labels
      s (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (== (unknown_count
          (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
        (- (unknown_count s) 1))
    (in_i64 (+ du w)))
  (body
    (call sound_update wg start s u v w du)
    (call unknown_positive_at s v)
    (call unknown_update s v (+ du w))
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert (>= w 0))
    (assert (<= w 100000))
    (assert (<= (len s) 100000))
    (assert (in_i64 (+ du w)))
    (assert
      (discovery_ok
        wg start (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (extends_labels
        s (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma discovery_finished
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (discovery_ok wg start s))
  (ensures (labels_ok wg start s))
  (body
    (assert (<= (len s) 100000))
    (call unknown_nonnegative s)
    (assert (labels_ok wg start s))))

(lemma relax_sound_update
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (du int)
    (dv int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s)))
    (== (idx s u) (some du))
    (== (idx s v) (some dv))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (and (<= 0 (+ du w)) (< (+ du w) dv)))
  (ensures
    (labels_ok
      wg start
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w))))
    (improves_labels
      s
      (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path (view wg) p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) du)))
    (call append_path wg p u v w)
    (call label_update_facts s v (some (+ du w)))
    (assert (!= v start))
    (assert
      (labels_sound
        (view wg)
        start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (labels_ok
        wg start
        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))
    (assert
      (improves_labels

        (label_update s v (some (+ du w)))))))

(lemma prefix_connection
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1)
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected g
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i)
      (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) i)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (+ i 1))
    (assert
      (connected g
        (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i)
        (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_connection g p i))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take
      p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert
      (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
               (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))))))

(lemma path_reachable
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert
          (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call path_reachable
          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (assert
          (is some (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))))

(lemma path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert
          (== (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
        (assert
          (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some base_d)
              (<= base_d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p)
        (call path_lower
          wg start s (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))
        (call edge_weight_correct
          wg
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          w)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight (view wg) p)
              (+ (path_weight
                    (view wg)
                    (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                 w)))
        (assert
          (match (idx s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some step_d)
              (<= step_d (path_weight (view wg) p)))))))))

(lemma none_has_no_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx s start) (some 0))
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
    (is none (idx s v))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call path_reachable wg start s p)
    (assert false)))

(lemma some_is_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
    (== (idx s v) (some d)))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call path_lower wg start s p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int)))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (triangle_closed wg s)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx s v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and
                (is_path (view wg) p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))
  (body
    (if (is none (idx s v))
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call none_has_no_path wg start s v p))
      (block
        (call some_is_shortest
          wg start s v (field (idx s v) value))
        (assert
          (match (idx s v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path (view wg) p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some final_d)
              (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v final_d))))))))

(lemma final_labels
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (s (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (labels_ok wg start s)
    (reach_closed wg s)
    (triangle_closed wg s))
  (ensures
    (== (len s) (size wg))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (match (idx s v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path (view wg) p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call final_vertex wg start s v))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let vertex_count i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut distances (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build vertex_count (fn (initial_index) (none))))
    (set-idx distances start (some 0))
    (call unknown_nonnegative distances)
    (let-mut discover_changed bool true)
    (while discover_changed
      (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
      (invariant (>= (unknown_count distances) 0))
      (invariant
        (=> (not discover_changed)
            (reach_closed graph distances)))
      (decreases
        (+ (unknown_count distances)
           (if discover_changed 1 0)))
      (ghost-let discover_before (seq (option int)) distances)
      (set discover_changed false)
      (let-mut discover_u i64 0)
      (while (< discover_u vertex_count)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 discover_u)
               (<= discover_u vertex_count)))
        (invariant (discovery_ok graph start distances))
        (invariant (>= (unknown_count distances) 0))
        (invariant
          (extends_labels discover_before distances))
        (invariant
          (reach_scan
            graph discover_before distances discover_u 0))
        (invariant
          (=> (not discover_changed)
              (== distances discover_before)))
        (invariant
          (=> discover_changed
              (< (unknown_count distances)
                 (unknown_count discover_before))))
        (decreases (- vertex_count discover_u))
        (let-mut discover_i i64 0)

        (scan_min dist done i best))
      (decreases (- (len dist) i))
      (if
        (and
          (not (idx done i))
          (is some (idx dist i)))
        (block
          (let current i64 (field (idx dist i) value))
          (if
            (is none best)
            (set best (some (tuple i current)))
            (if
              (< current (get (field best value) 1))
              (set best (some (tuple i current)))
              (block))))
        (block))
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (return best)))

(lemma graph_row_unique
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (unique_targets (idx (view wg) u)))
  (body
    (assert
      (unique_targets (idx (view wg) u)))))

(lemma weight_from_position
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (edge_index int)
    (position int))
  (requires
    (unique_targets row)
    (and (<= 0 edge_index) (< edge_index (len row)))
    (and (<= 0 position) (<= position edge_index)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (weight_from
        row
        (get (idx row edge_index) 0)
        position)
      (get (idx row edge_index) 1)))
  (decreases (- edge_index position))
  (body
    (if
      (== position edge_index)
      (assert
        (==
          (weight_from
            row
            (get (idx row edge_index) 0)
            position)
          (get (idx row edge_index) 1)))
      (block
        (assert
          (!=
            (get (idx row position) 0)
            (get (idx row edge_index) 0)))
        (call weight_from_position
          row edge_index (+ position 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (weight_from
              row
              (get (idx row edge_index) 0)
              position)
            (get (idx row edge_index) 1)))))))

(lemma exact_edge_weight
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((edge_index int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_index)
            (< edge_index (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and
          (==
            (get
              (idx (idx (view wg) u) edge_index)
              0)
            v)
          (==
            (get
              (idx (idx (view wg) u) edge_index)
              1)
            w))))
    (call graph_row_unique wg u)
    (call weight_from_position
      (idx (view wg) u)
      edge_index
      0)
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma path_vertices_in_range_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p k))
      (< (idx p k) (size wg))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (assert
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p k))
          (< (idx p k) (size wg))))
      (block
        (call path_vertices_in_range_at
          wg p start (- k 1))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            edge_weight))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
                (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len (view wg))))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index
                  (len
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))))))
            (and
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  0)
                (idx p k))
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  1)
                edge_weight))))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (size wg))))))))

(lemma path_vertices_in_range
  (params

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (d int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) p) d)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (candidate_path wg start v (+ d w)))
  (body
    (call exact_edge_weight wg u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat
      p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p (seq-lit v) (len p))
    (assert
      (is_path
        (view wg)
        (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight
          (view wg)
          (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ d w)))
    (assert
      (candidate_path wg start v (+ d w)))))

(lemma path_weight_non_negative
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg)))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (assert
        (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
      (block
        (call path_prefix
          (view wg) p (- (len p) 2))
        (call path_weight_non_negative
          wg
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            edge_weight))
        (call exact_edge_weight
          wg
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          edge_weight)
        (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))))))

(lemma prefix_step_non_negative
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (path_weight (view wg) (take p k))
      (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (body
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p k)
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p (- k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (obtain ((edge_weight int))
      (has_edge
        (view wg)
        (idx p (- k 1))
        (idx p k)
        edge_weight))
    (call exact_edge_weight
      wg
      (idx p (- k 1))
      (idx p k)
      edge_weight)
    (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
    (assert
      (<=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p k))
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))))))

(lemma frontier_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p j))
          (< (idx p j) (size wg)))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (not (idx done (idx p k))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int) (d int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some d))
          (<= d
            (path_weight
              (view wg)
              (take p (+ k 1))))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p 0)
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p 1))
            0))
        (assert
          (exists ((v int) (d int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
                (not (idx done v)))
              (and
                (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                (<= d
                  (path_weight
                    (view wg)
                    (take p 1))))))))
      (if
        (not (idx done (idx p (- k 1))))
        (block
          (call frontier_at
            wg start dist done steps p (- k 1))
          (call prefix_step_non_negative wg p k)
          (assert
            (exists ((v int) (d int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
                  (not (idx done v)))
                (and
                  (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                  (<= d
                    (path_weight
                      (view wg)
                      (take p (+ k 1)))))))))
        (block
          (obtain ((edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              (view wg)
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              edge_weight))
          (call exact_edge_weight
            wg
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            edge_weight)
          (call path_prefix
            (view wg) p (- k 1))
          (match (idx dist (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none)
              (assert false))
            (case (some predecessor_distance)
              (block
                (assert
                  (is_shortest_dist
                    (view wg)
                    start
                    (idx p (- k 1))
                    predecessor_distance))
                (assert
                  (<=
                    predecessor_distance
                    (path_weight
                      (view wg)
                      (take p k))))
                (match (idx dist (idx p k))
                  (case (none)
                    (assert false))
                  (case (some current_distance)
                    (block
                      (assert
                        (<=
                          current_distance
                          (+ predecessor_distance edge_weight)))
                      (assert
                        (==
                          (path_weight
                            (view wg)
                            (take p (+ k 1)))
                          (+
                            (path_weight
                              (view wg)
                              (take p k))
                            edge_weight)))
                      (assert
                        (exists ((v int) (d int))
                          (and
                            (and
                              (and
                                (<= 0 v)
                                (< v (size wg)))
                              (not (idx done v)))
                            (and
                              (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                              (<= d
                                (path_weight
                                  (view wg)
                                  (take p (+ k 1)))))))))))))))))))))

(lemma frontier
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size wg)))
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int) (d int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some d))
          (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_in_range wg p start)
    (call frontier_at
      wg start dist done steps p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_take_all p)
    (assert
      (exists ((v int) (d int))
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
            (not (idx done v)))
          (and
            (== (idx dist v) (some d))
            (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))))

(lemma choice_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (u int)
    (d int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) (some (tuple u d)))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_in_range wg p start)
    (call frontier wg start dist done steps p)
    (obtain ((v int) (candidate_distance int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some candidate_distance))
          (<= candidate_distance
            (path_weight (view wg) p)))))
    (assert (<= d candidate_distance))
    (assert (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))

(lemma choice_is_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (u int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) (some (tuple u d))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u d)
      (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (* steps 100000)))))
  (body
    (assert (candidate_path wg start u d))
    (obtain ((witness_path (seq int)))
      (and
        (is_path (view wg) witness_path)
        (and
          (and
            (== (idx witness_path 0) start)
            (== (idx witness_path
                  (- (len witness_path) 1))
                u))
          (==
            (path_weight (view wg) witness_path)
            d))))
    (call path_weight_non_negative wg witness_path)
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call choice_path_lower_bound
        wg start dist done steps u d p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u d))
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (* steps 100000))))))

(lemma relaxation_step
  (params

            (view wg)
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            edge_weight))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
                (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len (view wg))))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index
                  (len
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))))))
            (and
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  0)
                (idx p k))
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx
                      (view wg)
                      (idx p (- k 1)))
                    edge_index)
                  1)
                edge_weight))))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (size wg))))))))

(lemma path_vertices_in_range
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (start int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p k))
          (< (idx p k) (size wg))))))
  (body
    (forall ((k int))
      (call path_vertices_in_range_at wg p start k))))

(lemma path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ k 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k) (idx p k)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (assert (is_path g (take p (+ k 1))))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (start int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (d int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (== (path_weight (view wg) p) d)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (candidate_path wg start v (+ d w)))
  (body
    (call exact_edge_weight wg u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat
      p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p (seq-lit v) (len p))
    (assert
      (is_path
        (view wg)
        (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight
          (view wg)
          (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ d w)))
    (assert
      (candidate_path wg start v (+ d w)))))

(lemma path_weight_non_negative
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg)))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (assert
        (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))
      (block
        (call path_prefix
          (view wg) p (- (len p) 2))
        (call path_weight_non_negative
          wg
          (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view wg)
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            edge_weight))
        (call exact_edge_weight
          wg
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          edge_weight)
        (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
        (assert
          (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) 0))))))

(lemma prefix_step_non_negative
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (path_weight (view wg) (take p k))
      (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (body
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p k)
    (call path_prefix (view wg) p (- k 1))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 1) k)
    (obtain ((edge_weight int))
      (has_edge
        (view wg)
        (idx p (- k 1))
        (idx p k)
        edge_weight))
    (call exact_edge_weight
      wg
      (idx p (- k 1))
      (idx p k)
      edge_weight)
    (assert (>= edge_weight 0))
    (assert
      (<=
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p k))
        (path_weight (view wg) (take p (+ k 1)))))))

(lemma frontier_at
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p j))
          (< (idx p j) (size wg)))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (not (idx done (idx p k))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int) (d int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some d))
          (<= d
            (path_weight
              (view wg)
              (take p (+ k 1))))))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (== k 0)
      (block
        (call path_prefix (view wg) p 0)
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight (view wg) (take p 1))
            0))
        (assert
          (exists ((v int) (d int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
                (not (idx done v)))
              (and
                (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                (<= d
                  (path_weight
                    (view wg)
                    (take p 1))))))))
      (if
        (not (idx done (idx p (- k 1))))
        (block
          (call frontier_at
            wg start dist done steps p (- k 1))
          (call prefix_step_non_negative wg p k)
          (assert
            (exists ((v int) (d int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
                  (not (idx done v)))
                (and
                  (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                  (<= d
                    (path_weight
                      (view wg)
                      (take p (+ k 1)))))))))
        (block
          (obtain ((edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              (view wg)
              (idx p (- k 1))
              (idx p k)
              edge_weight))
          (call exact_edge_weight
            wg
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)
            edge_weight)
          (call path_prefix
            (view wg) p (- k 1))
          (match (idx dist (idx p (- k 1)))
            (case (none)
              (assert false))
            (case (some predecessor_distance)
              (block
                (assert
                  (is_shortest_dist
                    (view wg)
                    start
                    (idx p (- k 1))
                    predecessor_distance))
                (assert
                  (<=
                    predecessor_distance
                    (path_weight
                      (view wg)
                      (take p k))))
                (match (idx dist (idx p k))
                  (case (none)
                    (assert false))
                  (case (some current_distance)
                    (block
                      (assert
                        (<=
                          current_distance
                          (+ predecessor_distance edge_weight)))
                      (assert
                        (==
                          (path_weight
                            (view wg)
                            (take p (+ k 1)))
                          (+
                            (path_weight
                              (view wg)
                              (take p k))
                            edge_weight)))
                      (assert
                        (exists ((v int) (d int))
                          (and
                            (and
                              (and
                                (<= 0 v)
                                (< v (size wg)))
                              (not (idx done v)))
                            (and
                              (== (idx dist v) (some d))
                              (<= d
                                (path_weight
                                  (view wg)
                                  (take p (+ k 1))))))))))))))))))))

(lemma frontier
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size wg)))
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int) (d int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some d))
          (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_in_range wg p start)
    (call frontier_at
      wg start dist done steps p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_take_all p)
    (assert
      (exists ((v int) (d int))
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
            (not (idx done v)))
          (and
            (== (idx dist v) (some d))
            (<= d (path_weight (view wg) p))))))))

(lemma choice_path_lower_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (u int)
    (d int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) (some (tuple u d)))
    (is_path (view wg) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))
  (body
    (call path_vertices_in_range wg p start)
    (call frontier wg start dist done steps p)
    (obtain ((v int) (candidate_distance int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
          (not (idx done v)))
        (and
          (== (idx dist v) (some candidate_distance))
          (<= candidate_distance
            (path_weight (view wg) p)))))
    (assert (<= d candidate_distance))
    (assert (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))

(lemma choice_is_shortest
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (u int)
    (d int))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) (some (tuple u d))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u d)
      (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (* steps 100000)))))
  (body
    (assert (candidate_path wg start u d))
    (obtain ((witness_path (seq int)))
      (and
        (is_path (view wg) witness_path)
        (and
          (and
            (== (idx witness_path 0) start)
            (== (idx witness_path
                  (- (len witness_path) 1))
                u))
          (==
            (path_weight (view wg) witness_path)
            d))))
    (call path_weight_non_negative wg witness_path)
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call choice_path_lower_bound
        wg start dist done steps u d p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start u d))
    (assert
      (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (* steps 100000))))))

(lemma no_path_when_no_candidate
  (params

    (start int)

(lemma finish_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (steps int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (main_invariant wg start dist done steps)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) (none))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path (view wg) p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some result_distance)
        (is_shortest_dist
          (view wg)
          start
          v
          result_distance))))
  (body
    (if
      (idx done v)
      (assert
        (match (idx dist v)
          (case (none) false)
          (case (some settled_distance)
            (is_shortest_dist
              (view wg)
              start
              v
              settled_distance))))
      (block
        (assert (is none (idx dist v)))
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call no_path_when_no_candidate
            wg start dist done steps v p))
        (assert
          (match (idx dist v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (is_path (view wg) p)
                    (and
                      (== (idx p 0) start)
                      (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))
            (case (some impossible_distance) false)))))))

(lemma finish_all
  (params

  (requires

            (forall ((p (seq int)))

(lemma initialize_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (size wg)))
        (==
          (idx dist k)
          (if (== k start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none) true)
      (case (some d)
        (candidate_path wg start v d))))
  (body
    (if
      (== v start)
      (block
        (call law_len_unit start)
        (assert (is_path (view wg) (seq-lit start)))
        (assert
          (==
            (path_weight (view wg) (seq-lit start))
            0))
        (assert
          (candidate_path wg start start 0)))
      (assert (is none (idx dist v))))))

(lemma initialize_invariant
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
        (==
          (idx dist v)
          (if (== v start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
        (not (idx done v)))))
  (ensures
    (main_invariant wg start dist done 0))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call initialize_vertex wg start dist v))
    (assert
      (== (occurrences done true) 0))
    (assert
      (distances_sound wg start dist))
    (assert
      (distances_bounded dist 0))
    (assert
      (settled_correct wg start dist done))
    (assert
      (relaxed_edges wg dist done))
    (assert
      (main_invariant wg start dist done 0))))

  (params

(lemma relaxation_preserves_soundness
  (params

    (u int)

(lemma relaxation_step
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (before (seq (option int)))
    (after (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (old_done (seq bool))
    (steps int)

    (assert
      (row_prefix_relaxed
        wg after done u du (+ edge_index 1)))

  (params

(lemma no_candidate_when_full
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool))
    (best (option (tuple int int))))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len done))
    (== (occurrences done true) (len done))
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) best))

    (assert (is none best))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut res (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n
        (fn (result_index)
          (if
            (== result_index start)
            (some 0)
            (none)))))
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (done_index) false)))
    (let-mut steps i64 0)
    (call initialize_invariant graph start res done)
    (while (< steps n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 0 steps) (<= steps n)))
      (invariant
        (main_invariant graph start res done steps))
      (decreases (- n steps))
      (let ((choice (option (tuple i64 i64))))
        (call choose_min (borrow res) (borrow done)))
      (if
        (is none choice)
        (block
          (call finish_all graph start res done steps)
          (return res))
        (block
          (let selected i64
            (get (field choice value) 0))
          (let selected_distance i64
            (get (field choice value) 1))
          (call choice_is_shortest
            graph start res done steps
            selected selected_distance)
          (ghost-let done_before (seq bool) done)
          (set-idx done selected true)
          (assert
            (done_update done_before done selected))
          (assert
            (==
              (occurrences done true)
              (+ steps 1)))
          (call mark_selected
            graph start res done_before done
            steps selected selected_distance)
          (call begin_relaxation
            graph start res done done_before
            steps selected selected_distance)
          (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
          (while
            (< edge_index
              (len (idx (field graph adj) selected)))

    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
        (match (idx dist v)
          (case (none) true)
          (case (some d)
            (exists ((p (seq int)))
              (and
                (is_path g p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)
                    (== (path_weight g p) d)))))))))))

(ghost-fn settled_correct
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len done))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done))) (idx done v))
          (match (idx dist v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (is_path g p)
                    (and
                      (== (idx p 0) start)
                      (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))
            (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))))))

(ghost-fn frontier_correct
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len done))
      (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
        (=>
          (and
            (has_edge g u v w)
            (and
              (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len done))) (idx done u))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
                (not (idx done v)))))
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some du)
              (match (idx dist v)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some dv) (<= dv (+ du w)))))))))))

(ghost-fn tentative_bounded
  ((dist (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
        (match (idx dist v)
          (case (none) true)
          (case (some d) (and (<= 0 d) (<= d 10000000000))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_inv
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len g))
      (and
        (== (len done) (len g))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
          (and
            (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
            (and
              (tentative_witnesses g start dist)
              (and
                (tentative_bounded dist)
                (and
                  (settled_correct g start dist done)
                  (frontier_correct g dist done))))))))))

(ghost-fn no_open_tentative
  ((dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len done))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
            (not (idx done v)))
          (is none (idx dist v)))))))

(ghost-fn answer_ok
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx dist v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (is_path g p)
                    (and
                      (== (idx p 0) start)
                      (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))
            (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))))))

(ghost-fn scan_ok
  ((dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
   (scan int) (found bool) (best_v int) (best_d int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len done))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 scan) (<= scan (len done)))
        (and
          (=>
            found
            (and
              (and (<= 0 best_v) (< best_v scan))
              (and
                (not (idx done best_v))
                (== (idx dist best_v) (some best_d)))))
          (forall ((v int) (d int))
            (=>
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v scan))
                  (not (idx done v)))
                (== (idx dist v) (some d)))
              (and found (<= best_d d)))))))))

(ghost-fn relaxed_option
  ((old (option int)) (candidate int)) (option int)
  (body
    (match old
      (case (none) (some candidate))
      (case (some old_d)
        (if (< candidate old_d) (some candidate) (some old_d))))))

(ghost-fn relax_ok
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (du int)
   (old_dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
   (dist (seq (option int))) (processed int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len old_dist) (len dist))
      (and
        (== (len dist) (len done))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 processed) (<= processed (len (idx g u))))
          (and
            (forall ((v int))
              (=>
                (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
                (and
                  (=>
                    (idx done v)
                    (== (idx dist v) (idx old_dist v)))
                  (and
                    (match (idx dist v)
                      (case (none) (is none (idx old_dist v)))
                      (case (some nd)
                        (or
                          (== (idx old_dist v) (some nd))
                          (exists ((j int))
                            (and
                              (and (<= 0 j) (< j processed))
                              (and
                                (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
                                (== nd
                                  (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))))))
                    (match (idx old_dist v)
                      (case (none) true)
                      (case (some od)
                        (match (idx dist v)
                          (case (none) false)
                          (case (some nd2) (<= nd2 od)))))))))
            (and
              (forall ((j int))
                (=>
                  (and (<= 0 j) (< j processed))
                  (=>
                    (not (idx done (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))
                    (match
                      (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
                      (case (none) false)
                      (case (some rd)
                        (<= rd
                          (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))))))))
              (tentative_bounded dist))))))))

(lemma law_scan_skip
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (scan int) (found bool) (best_v int) (best_d int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok dist done scan found best_v best_d)
    (< scan (len done))
    (or (idx done scan) (is none (idx dist scan))))
  (ensures
    (scan_ok dist done (+ scan 1) found best_v best_d))
  (body
    (assert (scan_ok dist done (+ scan 1) found best_v best_d))))

(lemma law_scan_keep
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (scan int) (found bool) (best_v int) (best_d int) (scan_d int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok dist done scan found best_v best_d)
    (< scan (len done))
    (not (idx done scan))
    (== (idx dist scan) (some scan_d))
    found
    (<= best_d scan_d))
  (ensures
    (scan_ok dist done (+ scan 1) found best_v best_d))
  (body
    (assert (scan_ok dist done (+ scan 1) found best_v best_d))))

(lemma law_scan_choose
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (scan int) (found bool) (best_v int) (best_d int) (scan_d int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok dist done scan found best_v best_d)
    (< scan (len done))
    (not (idx done scan))
    (== (idx dist scan) (some scan_d))
    (or (not found) (< scan_d best_d)))
  (ensures
    (scan_ok dist done (+ scan 1) true scan scan_d))
  (body
    (assert (scan_ok dist done (+ scan 1) true scan scan_d))))

(lemma law_path_append
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)) (start int) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v)
    (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (assert (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
            (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma law_min_open_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int) (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dijkstra_inv g start dist done)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len done)))
    (not (idx done u))
    (== (idx dist u) (some du))
    (forall ((x int) (dx int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len done)))
            (not (idx done x)))
          (== (idx dist x) (some dx)))
        (<= du dx)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
    (not (idx done v))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures (<= du (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== v start))
        (assert (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
        (assert (<= du 0))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let pred int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (assert (is_path g prefix))
        (assert (== (idx prefix 0) start))
        (assert (== (idx prefix (- (len prefix) 1)) pred))
        (assert (connected g pred v))
        (obtain ((edge_w int)) (has_edge g pred v edge_w))
        (assert (>= edge_w 0))
        (assert
          (== (path_weight g p)
              (+ (path_weight g prefix) edge_w)))
        (if (idx done pred)
          (match (idx dist pred)
            (case (none)
              (block
                (assert
                  (forall ((bad_p (seq int)))
                    (=>
                      (and
                        (is_path g bad_p)
                        (and
                          (== (idx bad_p 0) start)
                          (== (idx bad_p (- (len bad_p) 1)) pred)))
                      false)))
                (assert false)))
            (case (some pred_d)
              (block
                (assert (is_shortest_dist g start pred pred_d))
                (assert (<= pred_d (path_weight g prefix)))
                (match (idx dist v)
                  (case (none) (assert false))
                  (case (some vd)
                    (block
                      (assert (<= vd (+ pred_d edge_w)))
                      (assert (<= du vd))
                      (assert (<= du (path_weight g p)))))))))
          (block
            (call law_min_open_path
              g start dist done u du pred prefix)
            (assert (<= du (path_weight g prefix)))
            (assert (<= du (path_weight g p)))))))))

(lemma law_selected_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dijkstra_inv g start dist done)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len done)))
    (not (idx done u))
    (== (idx dist u) (some du))
    (forall ((v int) (dv int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
            (not (idx done v)))
          (== (idx dist v) (some dv)))
        (<= du dv))))
  (ensures (is_shortest_dist g start u du))
  (body
    (assert (tentative_witnesses g start dist))
    (obtain ((witness (seq int)))
      (and
        (is_path g witness)
        (and
          (== (idx witness 0) start)
          (and
            (== (idx witness (- (len witness) 1)) u)
            (== (path_weight g witness) du)))))
    (forall ((candidate_path (seq int)))
      (call law_min_open_path
        g start dist done u du u candidate_path))
    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u du))))

(lemma law_open_path_has_tentative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start dist done)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
    (not (idx done v))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (exists ((x int) (d int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len done)))
          (not (idx done x)))
        (== (idx dist x) (some d)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== v start))
        (assert (== (idx dist v) (some 0))))
      (block
        (ghost-let prefix2 (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let pred2 int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (assert (is_path g prefix2))
        (assert (== (idx prefix2 0) start))
        (assert (== (idx prefix2 (- (len prefix2) 1)) pred2))
        (assert (connected g pred2 v))
        (obtain ((edge_w2 int)) (has_edge g pred2 v edge_w2))
        (if (idx done pred2)
          (match (idx dist pred2)
            (case (none) (assert false))
            (case (some pred_d2)
              (match (idx dist v)
                (case (none) (assert false))
                (case (some vd2) (assert (== (idx dist v) (some vd2)))))))
          (call law_open_path_has_tentative
            g start dist done pred2 prefix2))))))

(lemma law_finish_path_impossible
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start dist done)
    (no_open_tentative dist done)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
    (is none (idx dist v))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (if (idx done v)
      (block
        (assert (settled_correct g start dist done))
        (assert false))
      (block
        (call law_open_path_has_tentative
          g start dist done v p)
        (obtain ((open_v int) (open_d int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 open_v) (< open_v (len done)))
              (not (idx done open_v)))
            (== (idx dist open_v) (some open_d))))
        (assert (is none (idx dist open_v)))
        (assert false)))))

(lemma law_dijkstra_finish_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (v int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_inv g start dist done)
    (no_open_tentative dist done)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((path_v (seq int)))
          (call law_finish_path_impossible
            g start dist done v path_v)))
      (case (some dist_v)
        (block
          (assert (is none (idx dist v)))
          (assert false))))))

(lemma law_dijkstra_finish
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dijkstra_inv g start dist done)
    (no_open_tentative dist done))
  (ensures (answer_ok g start dist))
  (body
    (assert (== (len dist) (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call law_dijkstra_finish_at g start dist done v))
    (assert (answer_ok g start dist))))

(lemma law_dijkstra_initial
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len done) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (not (idx done v))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (if (== v start)
          (== (idx dist v) (some 0))
          (is none (idx dist v))))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_inv g start dist done))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (tentative_witnesses g start dist))
    (assert (tentative_bounded dist))
    (assert (settled_correct g start dist done))
    (assert (frontier_correct g dist done))
    (assert (dijkstra_inv g start dist done))))

(lemma law_relax_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (du int)
    (old_dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
    (processed int) (to int) (weight int) (candidate int))
  (requires
    (relax_ok g u du old_dist done before processed)
    (< processed (len (idx g u)))
    (== to (get (idx (idx g u) processed) 0))
    (== weight (get (idx (idx g u) processed) 1))
    (== candidate (+ du weight))
    (and (>= weight 0) (<= weight 100000))
    (and (<= 0 candidate) (<= candidate 10000000000))
    (== (len after) (len before))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
        (== (idx after v)
          (if
            (and (== v to) (not (idx done to)))
            (relaxed_option (idx before to) candidate)
            (idx before v))))))
  (ensures
    (relax_ok g u du old_dist done after (+ processed 1)))
  (body
    (assert
      (relax_ok g u du old_dist done after (+ processed 1)))))

(lemma law_relax_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (du int)
    (old_dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (dist (seq (option int))) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (relax_ok g u du old_dist done dist (len (idx g u)))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (not (idx done v)))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (<= d (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((edge_index int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_index)
            (< edge_index (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_index) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_index) 1) w))))
    (assert
      (match (idx dist v)
        (case (none) false)
        (case (some d) (<= d (+ du w)))))))

(lemma law_dijkstra_settle
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (old_dist (seq (option int))) (old_done (seq bool))
    (new_dist (seq (option int))) (new_done (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dijkstra_inv g start old_dist old_done)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len old_done)))
    (not (idx old_done u))
    (== (idx old_dist u) (some du))
    (forall ((v int) (dv int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old_done)))
            (not (idx old_done v)))
          (== (idx old_dist v) (some dv)))
        (<= du dv)))
    (== (len new_dist) (len old_dist))
    (== (len new_done) (len old_done))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old_done)))
        (== (idx new_done v)
          (if (== v u) true (idx old_done v)))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old_done)))
          (idx old_done v))
        (== (idx new_dist v) (idx old_dist v))))
    (== (idx new_dist u) (idx old_dist u))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old_dist)))
        (match (idx new_dist v)
          (case (none) (is none (idx old_dist v)))
          (case (some nd)
            (or
              (== (idx old_dist v) (some nd))
              (exists ((w int))
                (and
                  (has_edge g u v w)
                  (== nd (+ du w)))))))))
    (forall ((v int) (w int))
      (=>
        (and
          (has_edge g u v w)
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len new_dist)))
            (not (idx old_done v))))
        (match (idx new_dist v)
          (case (none) false)
          (case (some relaxed_d) (<= relaxed_d (+ du w))))))
    (forall ((v int) (od int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old_dist)))
          (== (idx old_dist v) (some od)))
        (match (idx new_dist v)
          (case (none) false)
          (case (some retained_d) (<= retained_d od)))))
    (tentative_bounded new_dist))
  (ensures (dijkstra_inv g start new_dist new_done))
  (body
    (call law_selected_shortest
      g start old_dist old_done u du)
    (assert (== (len new_dist) (len g)))
    (assert (== (len new_done) (len g)))
    (assert (== (idx new_dist start) (some 0)))
    (assert (tentative_witnesses g start new_dist))
    (assert (settled_correct g start new_dist new_done))
    (assert (frontier_correct g new_dist new_done))
    (assert (dijkstra_inv g start new_dist new_done))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n (fn (init_i) (none))))
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (done_i) false)))
    (set-idx dist start (some 0))
    (call law_dijkstra_initial (view graph) start dist done)
    (let-mut running bool true)
    (while running
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant (dijkstra_inv (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant
        (=>
          (not running)
          (no_open_tentative dist done)))
      (decreases
        (+ (occurrences done false) (if running 1 0)))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut best_v i64 0)
      (let-mut best_d i64 0)
      (let-mut scan i64 0)
      (while (< scan n)
        (invariant
          (scan_ok dist done scan found best_v best_d))
        (decreases (- n scan))
        (if (idx done scan)
          (call law_scan_skip
            dist done scan found best_v best_d)
          (match (idx dist scan)
            (case (none)
              (call law_scan_skip
                dist done scan found best_v best_d))
            (case (some scan_d)
              (if (or (not found) (< scan_d best_d))
                (block
