  (body (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx g y)))))
             (and (== (get (idx (idx g y) b) 0) x) (== (get (idx (idx g y) b) 1) (get_edge_weight g y x))))))
(lemma edge_facts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (y int) (x int))
  (requires (good_graph g) (connected g y x))
  (ensures (exists ((b int)) (edge_idx g y x b)))
  (body
    (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g y x w))
    (assert (has_edge g y x w))
    (obtain ((b int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx g y)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g y) b) 0) x) (== (get (idx (idx g y) b) 1) w))))
    (call edge_weight_at g y b)
    (assert (edge_idx g y x b))))
(lemma edge_bounds (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (y int) (x int))
  (requires (good_graph g) (connected g y x))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
                (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (>= (get_edge_weight g y x) 0))))
  (body
    (call edge_facts g y x)
    (obtain ((b int)) (edge_idx g y x b))
    (assert (edge_idx g y x b))
    (call edge_bound_at g y b)))
(lemma path_prefix_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (- (len p) 2))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) a) (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ a 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) a) (idx p a)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ a 1)) (idx p (+ a 1))))
    (assert (connected g (idx p a) (idx p (+ a 1))))))
(lemma path_prefix (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
           (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
  (body
    (forall ((a int)) (call path_prefix_at g p a))
    (assert (== (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
    (assert (== (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1) (- (len p) 2)))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))))
(lemma path_last_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a int (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (+ a 1) (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (connected g (idx p a) (idx p (+ a 1))))))
(lemma path_weight_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p)
               (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
                  (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body))
(ghost-fn extends ((p (seq int)) (x int) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1))
    (and (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len p))) (== (idx q a) (idx p a))))
         (== (idx q (len p)) x)))))
(lemma extend_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (x int) (q (seq int)) (a int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x) (extends p x q) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx q a) (idx q (+ a 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx q a) (idx p a)))
    (if (== a (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (+ a 1) (len p)))
        (assert (== (idx q (+ a 1)) x)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q (+ a 1)) (idx p (+ a 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p a) (idx p (+ a 1))))))))
(lemma extend_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (x int) (q (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x) (extends p x q))
  (ensures (is_path g q))
  (body
    (forall ((a int)) (call extend_at g p x q a))
    (assert (is_path g q))))
(ghost-fn reach ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (v int) (d int)) bool
  (body (exists ((p (seq int)))
    (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (== (path_weight g p) d)))))
(ghost-fn lower ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (v int) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((p (seq int)))
    (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (>= (path_weight g p) d)))))
(lemma reach_self (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int))
  (ensures (reach g s s 0))
  (body
    (ghost-let p0 (seq int) (seq-build 1 (fn (k) s)))
    (assert (== (len p0) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p0 0) s))
    (assert (== (- (len p0) 1) 0))
    (assert (== (idx p0 (- (len p0) 1)) s))
    (assert (is_path g p0))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p0) 0))
    (assert (reach g s s 0))))
(lemma reach_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (u int) (x int) (d int))
  (requires (reach g s u d) (connected g u x))
  (ensures (reach g s x (+ d (get_edge_weight g u x))))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))) (== (path_weight g p) d)))
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build (+ (len p) 1) (fn (k) (if (< k (len p)) (idx p k) x))))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len p))) (== (idx q a) (idx p a)))))
    (assert (== (idx q (len p)) x))
    (assert (extends p x q))
    (call extend_path g p x q)
    (call law_seq_ext (take q (len p)) p)
    (call path_weight_step g q)
    (assert (== (- (len q) 1) (len p)))
    (assert (== (- (len q) 2) (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) s))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len p) 1)) u))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 2)) u))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) x))
    (assert (== (take q (- (len q) 1)) p))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (+ d (get_edge_weight g u x))))
    (assert (reach g s x (+ d (get_edge_weight g u x))))))
(ghost-fn is_done ((done (seq bool)) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len done))) (idx done x))))
(ghost-fn not_done ((done (seq bool)) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len done))) (not (idx done x)))))
(ghost-fn holds ((dist (seq (option int))) (x int) (d int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist))) (and (is some (idx dist x)) (== (field (idx dist x) value) d)))))
(ghost-fn at_most ((dist (seq (option int))) (x int) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist))) (and (is some (idx dist x)) (<= (field (idx dist x) value) c)))))
(ghost-fn cand ((dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (y int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))) (and (not_done done y) (is some (idx dist y))))))
(ghost-fn relax_at ((dist (seq (option int))) (x int) (y int) (w int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist)))
             (and (is some (idx dist x)) (at_most dist y (+ (field (idx dist x) value) w))))))
(ghost-fn low_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (a int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len dist)))
             (and (is some (idx dist a)) (lower g s a (field (idx dist a) value))))))
(ghost-fn sound ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((a int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len dist))) (is some (idx dist a)))
        (reach g s a (field (idx dist a) value))))))
(ghost-fn settled ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((a int)) (=> (is_done done a) (low_at g s dist a)))))
(ghost-fn capped ((dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (c int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int)) (=> (is_done done a) (at_most dist a c)))))
(ghost-fn floor_to ((dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (bd int) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y k)) (cand dist done y))
        (<= bd (field (idx dist y) value))))))
(ghost-fn no_cand_to ((dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y k)) (not (cand dist done y))))))
(ghost-fn relaxed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (is_done done a) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))))
             (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx g a)))) (or (!= a u) (< b i))))
        (relax_at dist a (get (idx (idx g a) b) 0) (get (idx (idx g a) b) 1))))))
(ghost-fn dist_range ((dist (seq (option int))) (c int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len dist))) (is some (idx dist a)))
        (and (<= 0 (field (idx dist a) value)) (<= (field (idx dist a) value) c))))))
(ghost-fn outer_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (level int) (cap int)) bool
  (body (and (sound g s dist)
        (and (settled g s dist done)
        (and (capped dist done level)
        (and (floor_to dist done level (len dist))
        (and (relaxed g dist done -1 0)
        (and (dist_range dist cap)
             (holds dist s 0)))))))))
(ghost-fn inner_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (i int) (cap int)) bool
  (body (and (sound g s dist)
        (and (settled g s dist done)
        (and (capped dist done du)
        (and (floor_to dist done du (len dist))
        (and (relaxed g dist done u i)
        (and (dist_range dist cap)
        (and (holds dist s 0)
        (and (holds dist u du)
             (is_done done u)))))))))))
(ghost-fn writes ((d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (v int) (nd int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len d1) (len d0))
        (and (holds d1 v nd)
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len d0))) (!= k v)) (== (idx d1 k) (idx d0 k))))))))
(ghost-fn scan_ok ((dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (k int) (best int) (bd int)) bool
  (body (if (< best 0)
    (no_cand_to dist done k)
    (and (holds dist best bd) (and (not_done done best) (floor_to dist done bd k))))))
(lemma scan_skip (params (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (k int) (best int) (bd int))
  (requires (scan_ok dist done k best bd)
            (=> (cand dist done k) (and (>= best 0) (<= bd (field (idx dist k) value)))))
  (ensures (scan_ok dist done (+ k 1) best bd))
  (body
    (if (< best 0)
      (block
        (assert (no_cand_to dist done k))
        (assert (not (cand dist done k)))
        (assert (no_cand_to dist done (+ k 1))))
      (block
        (assert (floor_to dist done bd k))
        (assert (floor_to dist done bd (+ k 1)))))))
(lemma scan_take (params (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (k int) (best int) (bd int) (dk int))
  (requires (scan_ok dist done k best bd)
            (cand dist done k)
            (== dk (field (idx dist k) value))
            (or (< best 0) (< dk bd)))
  (ensures (scan_ok dist done (+ k 1) k dk))
  (body
    (assert (holds dist k dk))
    (assert (not_done done k))
    (if (< best 0)
      (block
        (assert (no_cand_to dist done k))
        (assert (floor_to dist done dk (+ k 1))))
      (block
        (assert (floor_to dist done bd k))
        (assert (floor_to dist done dk (+ k 1)))))))
(spec pick_min
  (params (dist (ref (slice (option i64)))) (done (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (best i64) (bd i64))
  (requires (== (len dist) (len done)))
  (ensures (scan_ok dist done (len dist) best bd))
  (effects))
(def pick_min
  (body
    (let-mut best i64 -1)
    (let-mut bd i64 0)
    (let-mut k i64 0)
    (while (< k (len dist))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len dist))))
      (invariant (scan_ok dist done k best bd))
      (decreases (- (len dist) k))
      (if (and (not (idx done k)) (is some (idx dist k)))
        (block
          (let dk i64 (field (idx dist k) value))
          (if (or (< best 0) (< dk bd))
            (block
              (call scan_take dist done k best bd dk)
              (set best k)
              (set bd dk))
            (call scan_skip dist done k best bd)))
        (call scan_skip dist done k best bd))
      (set k (+ k 1)))
    (assert (== k (len dist)))
    (return best bd)))
(lemma relaxed_use
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (y int) (x int))
  (requires (good_graph g) (connected g y x) (relaxed g dist done -1 0) (is_done done y))
  (ensures (relax_at dist y x (get_edge_weight g y x)))
  (body
    (call edge_facts g y x)
    (obtain ((b int)) (edge_idx g y x b))
    (assert (edge_idx g y x b))
    (assert (relax_at dist y (get (idx (idx g y) b) 0) (get (idx (idx g y) b) 1)))))
(lemma min_bound
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (du int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (good_graph g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len done) (len g))
            (settled g s dist done) (relaxed g dist done -1 0) (holds dist s 0)
            (floor_to dist done du (len dist))
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s) (not_done done (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (<= du (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (- (len p) 1) 0))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx p 0)))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))
        (assert (not_done done s))
        (assert (cand dist done s))
        (assert (<= du (field (idx dist s) value))))
      (block
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let y int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let x int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (call path_last_edge g p)
        (call path_weight_step g p)
        (call edge_bounds g y x)
        (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (is_path g q))
        (assert (== (idx q 0) s))
        (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g q) (get_edge_weight g y x))))
        (if (is_done done y)
          (block
            (call relaxed_use g dist done y x)
            (assert (low_at g s dist y))
            (assert (lower g s y (field (idx dist y) value)))
            (assert (>= (path_weight g q) (field (idx dist y) value)))
            (assert (at_most dist x (+ (field (idx dist y) value) (get_edge_weight g y x))))
            (assert (cand dist done x))
            (assert (<= du (field (idx dist x) value))))
          (block
            (assert (not_done done y))
            (call min_bound g s dist done du q)))))))
(lemma pick_lower
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (du int) (u int))
  (requires (good_graph g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len done) (len g))
            (settled g s dist done) (relaxed g dist done -1 0) (holds dist s 0)
            (floor_to dist done du (len dist))
            (not_done done u))
  (ensures (lower g s u du))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int))) (call min_bound g s dist done du p))
    (assert (lower g s u du))))
(lemma path_ends_done
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (good_graph g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len done) (len g))
            (relaxed g dist done -1 0) (holds dist s 0)
            (no_cand_to dist done (len dist))
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s))
  (ensures (is_done done (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (- (len p) 1) 0))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx p 0)))
        (assert (not (cand dist done s)))
        (assert (is_done done s)))
      (block
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let y int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let x int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_prefix g p)
        (call path_last_edge g p)
        (call edge_bounds g y x)
        (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (is_path g q))
        (assert (== (idx q 0) s))
        (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))
        (call path_ends_done g s dist done q)
        (assert (is_done done y))
        (call relaxed_use g dist done y x)
        (assert (at_most dist x (+ (field (idx dist y) value) (get_edge_weight g y x))))
        (assert (not (cand dist done x)))
        (assert (is_done done x))))))
(lemma final_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (v int))
  (requires (good_graph g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len done) (len g))
            (sound g s dist) (settled g s dist done) (relaxed g dist done -1 0) (holds dist s 0)
            (no_cand_to dist done (len dist))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (match (idx dist v)
    (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                   (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
    (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g s v d))))
  (body
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (block
          (forall ((p (seq int))) (call path_ends_done g s dist done p))
          (assert (not (is_done done v)))))
      (case (some dv)
        (block
          (assert (== (field (idx dist v) value) dv))
          (assert (not (cand dist done v)))
          (assert (is_done done v))
          (assert (low_at g s dist v))
          (assert (lower g s v dv))
          (assert (reach g s v dv))
          (assert (is_shortest_dist g s v dv)))))))
(lemma final_all
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (level int) (cap int))
  (requires (good_graph g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len done) (len g))
            (outer_inv g s dist done level cap)
            (no_cand_to dist done (len dist)))
  (ensures (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (match (idx dist v)
          (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                         (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
          (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g s v d))))))
  (body
    (assert (sound g s dist))
    (assert (settled g s dist done))
    (assert (relaxed g dist done -1 0))
    (assert (holds dist s 0))
    (forall ((v int)) (call final_at g s dist done v))))
(lemma init_outer
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len done) (len g))
            (holds dist s 0)
            (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len dist))) (!= a s)) (is none (idx dist a))))
            (forall ((a int)) (=> (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len done))) (not (idx done a)))))
  (ensures (outer_inv g s dist done 0 0))
  (body
    (call reach_self g s)
    (assert (sound g s dist))
    (assert (settled g s dist done))
    (assert (capped dist done 0))
    (assert (floor_to dist done 0 (len dist)))
    (assert (relaxed g dist done -1 0))
    (assert (dist_range dist 0))))
(lemma enter_settled_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (a int))
  (requires (settled g s dist done0) (flipped done0 done1 u) (holds dist u du) (lower g s u du) (is_done done1 a))
  (ensures (low_at g s dist a))
  (body
    (if (== a u)
      (assert (low_at g s dist u))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx done1 a) (idx done0 a)))
        (assert (is_done done0 a))))))
(lemma enter_capped_at
  (params (dist (seq (option int))) (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (level int) (u int) (du int) (a int))
  (requires (capped dist done0 level) (flipped done0 done1 u) (holds dist u du) (<= level du) (is_done done1 a))
  (ensures (at_most dist a du))
  (body
    (if (== a u)
      (assert (at_most dist u du))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx done1 a) (idx done0 a)))
        (assert (is_done done0 a))
        (assert (at_most dist a level))))))
(lemma enter_floor_at
  (params (dist (seq (option int))) (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (u int) (du int) (a int))
  (requires (floor_to dist done0 du (len dist)) (flipped done0 done1 u)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len dist))) (cand dist done1 a))
  (ensures (<= du (field (idx dist a) value)))
  (body
    (assert (not_done done1 a))
    (assert (!= a u))
    (assert (== (idx done1 a) (idx done0 a)))
    (assert (cand dist done0 a))))

(lemma weight_from_hit

(lemma scan_skip (params (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (k int) (best int) (bd int))

(lemma scan_take (params (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (k int) (best int) (bd int) (dk int))
  (requires (scan_ok dist done k best bd)

            (== dk (field (idx dist k) value))
            (or (< best 0) (< dk bd)))
  (ensures (scan_ok dist done (+ k 1) k dk))
  (body
    (assert (holds dist k dk))
    (assert (not_done done k))
    (if (< best 0)
      (block
        (assert (no_cand_to dist done k))
        (assert (floor_to dist done dk (+ k 1))))
      (block
        (assert (floor_to dist done bd k))
        (assert (floor_to dist done dk (+ k 1)))))))
(spec pick_min
  (params (dist (ref (slice (option i64)))) (done (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (best i64) (bd i64))
  (requires (== (len dist) (len done)))
  (ensures (scan_ok dist done (len dist) best bd))
  (effects))
(def pick_min
  (body
    (let-mut best i64 -1)
    (let-mut bd i64 0)
    (let-mut k i64 0)
    (while (< k (len dist))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len dist))))
      (invariant (scan_ok dist done k best bd))
      (decreases (- (len dist) k))
      (if (and (not (idx done k)) (is some (idx dist k)))
        (block
          (let dk i64 (field (idx dist k) value))
          (if (or (< best 0) (< dk bd))
            (block
              (call scan_take dist done k best bd dk)
              (set best k)
              (set bd dk))
            (call scan_skip dist done k best bd)))
        (call scan_skip dist done k best bd))
      (set k (+ k 1)))
    (assert (== k (len dist)))
    (return best bd)))
(lemma relaxed_use

  (ensures (relax_at dist y x (get_edge_weight g y x)))

    (call edge_facts g y x)
    (obtain ((b int)) (edge_idx g y x b))
    (assert (edge_idx g y x b))

(lemma min_bound
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (du int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (good_graph g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len done) (len g))
            (settled g s dist done) (relaxed g dist done -1 0) (holds dist s 0)
            (floor_to dist done du (len dist))
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s) (not_done done (idx p (- (len p) 1))))

  (decreases (len p))

    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (- (len p) 1) 0))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx p 0)))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))
        (assert (not_done done s))

        (call path_weight_step g p)

        (assert (== (idx q 0) s))

            (assert (not_done done y))

  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (du int) (u int))

            (no_cand_to dist done (len dist))

    (if (< (len p) 2)

(lemma final_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (v int))
  (requires (good_graph g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len done) (len g))
            (sound g s dist) (settled g s dist done) (relaxed g dist done -1 0) (holds dist s 0)
            (no_cand_to dist done (len dist))

    (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))

    (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g s v d))))

          (forall ((p (seq int))) (call path_ends_done g s dist done p))

          (assert (== (field (idx dist v) value) dv))

          (assert (is_done done v))

(lemma init_outer

(lemma enter_settled_at

    (set-idx pos s 0)

    (call uc_nonneg pos n)

      (invariant (tree_ok c f n s pos par))
      (invariant (q_ok n q pos))
      (invariant (closed_h c f n pos h))
      (decreases (- n h))

        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
        (invariant (tree_ok c f n s pos par))
        (invariant (q_ok n q pos))
        (invariant (closed_h c f n pos h))
        (invariant (row_done c f n pos u v))
        (invariant (== (idx q h) u))
        (invariant (== (idx pos u) h))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (if (and (< (idx pos v) 0)

            (ghost-let pos0 (seq int) pos)
            (ghost-let par0 (seq int) par)
            (set-idx par v u)
            (set-idx pos v (len q))

        (set v (+ v 1)))

      (set h (+ h 1)))

                          (and (side x (idx nx u)) (< (idx rk (idx nx u)) (idx rk u))))))))))))
(ghost-fn all_resid ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (nx (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (t int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len nx) n)
    (forall ((u int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (side x u) (!= u t)))
          (resid c f u (idx nx u)))))))
(ghost-fn walk_ok ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (nx (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (t int) (b int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len nx) n) (== (len rk) n))
    (forall ((u int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (side x u) (and (!= u t) (<= (idx rk u) b))))
          (resid c f u (idx nx u)))))))
(ghost-fn rk_bound ((x (seq bool)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (cnt int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len rk) n)
    (forall ((u int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (side x u)) (< (idx rk u) cnt))))))
(ghost-fn unl ((x (seq bool)) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (unl x (- k 1)) (if (side x (- k 1)) 0 1)))))
(ghost-fn lab_inv ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (nx (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (t int) (cnt int)) bool
  (body (and (labels_struct x nx rk n t)
    (and (all_resid c f x nx rk n t)
      (and (rk_bound x rk n cnt)
        (and (== (+ cnt (unl x n)) n)
          (and (<= cnt n) (>= cnt 1))))))))
(ghost-fn fix_upto ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a u)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
        (=> (and (not (side x a)) (side x b)) (not (resid c f a b)))))))
(ghost-fn fix_row ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (forall ((b int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 b) (< b v))
        (=> (and (not (side x u)) (side x b)) (not (resid c f u b)))))))
(ghost-fn walk_net ((h (seq (seq int))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (cur int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w n))
        (== (mnet h w n) (- (+ (mnet h0 w n) (if (== w s) 1 0)) (if (== w cur) 1 0)))))))
(ghost-fn row_good ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (r (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len r) n)
    (and
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (and (>= (idx r v) 0) (=> (> (idx r v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (idx r v))))))
      (forall ((v int) (ca int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (has_capacity g u v ca)) (== (idx r v) ca)))))))
(ghost-fn caps_part ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len c))) (row_good g u (idx c u) n)))))
(ghost-fn caps_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len c) n) (== (len g) n)) (caps_part g c n))))
(ghost-fn row_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (r (seq int)) (i int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len r) n)
    (and
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (and (>= (idx r v) 0) (=> (> (idx r v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (idx r v))))))
      (forall ((j int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j i)) (and (<= 0 (tgt g u j)) (< (tgt g u j) n)))
            (== (idx r (tgt g u j)) (capv g u j))))))))

(lemma col_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (col_sum h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) 0))
        (assert (== (col_sum h u k) 0)))
      (block
        (call col_eq g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) u))))
        (assert (== (col_sum h u k) (+ (col_sum h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) u))))))))
(lemma in_t_not (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (d int) (v int))
  (requires (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j d)) (!= (tgt g u j) v))))
  (ensures (not (in_t g u d v)))
  (decreases d)
  (body
    (if (<= d 0)
      (assert (not (in_t g u d v)))
      (block
        (assert (!= (tgt g u (- d 1)) v))
        (call in_t_not g u (- d 1) v)
        (assert (== (in_t g u d v) (or (== (tgt g u (- d 1)) v) (in_t g u (- d 1) v))))))))
(lemma in_t_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (d int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i d)))
  (ensures (in_t g u d (tgt g u i)))
  (decreases d)
  (body
    (if (== i (- d 1))
      (assert (in_t g u d (tgt g u i)))
      (block
        (call in_t_has g u (- d 1) i)
        (assert (in_t g u d (tgt g u i)))))))
(lemma pr_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (pr g h u 0 k) 0))
      (block
        (call pr_zero g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (not (in_t g u 0 (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (pr g h u 0 k) (+ (pr g h u 0 (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u 0 (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma pr_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (>= d 0) (not (in_t g u d (tgt g u d))))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u (+ d 1) k)
               (+ (pr g h u d k) (if (and (<= 0 (tgt g u d)) (< (tgt g u d) k)) (get_flow h u (tgt g u d)) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (pr g h u (+ d 1) k) 0))
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) 0)))
      (block
        (call pr_step g h u d (- k 1))
        (assert (== (pr g h u (+ d 1) k) (+ (pr g h u (+ d 1) (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u (+ d 1) (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) (+ (pr g h u d (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u d (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (in_t g u (+ d 1) (- k 1)) (or (== (tgt g u d) (- k 1)) (in_t g u d (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma out_pr (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int))
  (requires (gwf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u d) (pr g h u d (len g))))
  (decreases d)
  (body
    (if (== d 0)
      (block
        (call pr_zero g h u (len g))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u d) 0)))
      (block
        (call out_pr g h u (- d 1))
        (assert (== (tgt g u (- d 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- d 1)) 0)))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u d)
                    (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (- d 1)) (get_flow h u (tgt g u (- d 1))))))
        (call in_t_not g u (- d 1) (tgt g u (- d 1)))
        (call pr_step g h u (- d 1) (len g))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (tgt g u (- d 1))) (< (tgt g u (- d 1)) (len g))))))))
(lemma pr_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v k)) (or (in_t g u d v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u d k) (row_sum h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) 0))
        (assert (== (row_sum h u k) 0)))
      (block
        (call pr_row g h u d (- k 1))
        (assert (or (in_t g u d (- k 1)) (== (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0)))
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) (+ (pr g h u d (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u d (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (row_sum h u k) (+ (row_sum h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma has_cap_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (tgt g u i) (capv g u i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (tgt g u i)))
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) (capv g u i)))))
(lemma cap_in_t (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (ca int))
  (requires (has_capacity g u v ca) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (in_t g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) ca))))
    (assert (== (tgt g u i) v))
    (call in_t_has g u (len (idx g u)) i)))
(lemma wf_view (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (gwf (view cg)))
  (body (assert (== (view cg) (field cg adj)))))
(lemma caps_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow c u v) 0)
           (=> (> (get_flow c u v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
           (forall ((ca int)) (=> (has_capacity g u v ca) (== (get_flow c u v) ca))))
  (body
    (assert (row_good g u (idx c u) n))
    (assert (== (get_flow c u v) (idx (idx c u) v)))))
(lemma supp_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (or (in_t g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))
  (body
    (call caps_at g c n u v)
    (assert (>= (get_flow h u v) 0))
    (assert (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v)))
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (call cap_in_t g u v (get_flow c u v))
      (block))))
(lemma bridge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row_sum h u n)) (== (total_flow_in g h u) (col_sum h u n)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (forall ((v int)) (call supp_pt g c h n u v))
    (call pr_row g h u (len (idx g u)) n)
    (call out_pr g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h u) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (len (idx g u)))))
    (call col_eq g h u n)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))))
(lemma fv_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (mnet h s n)))
  (body
    (call bridge g c h n s)
    (assert (== (mnet h s n) (- (row_sum h s n) (col_sum h s n))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))))
(lemma qs_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (b int) (a int))
  (requires (<= a 0))
  (ensures (== (qs h x b a) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (assert (== (qs h x b a) 0))
      (block
        (call qs_zero h x (- b 1) a)
        (assert (== (col_sum h (- b 1) a) 0))
        (assert (== (qs h x b a) (+ (qs h x (- b 1) a) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- b 1) a)))))))))
(lemma exch_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (qs h x b (+ a 1)) (+ (qs h x b a) (rr h x a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (qs h x b (+ a 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (qs h x b a) 0))
        (assert (== (rr h x a b) 0)))
      (block
        (call exch_step h x a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (qs h x b (+ a 1)) (+ (qs h x (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- b 1) (+ a 1))))))
        (assert (== (qs h x b a) (+ (qs h x (- b 1) a) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- b 1) a)))))
        (assert (== (col_sum h (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (col_sum h (- b 1) a) (get_flow h a (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rr h x a b) (+ (rr h x a (- b 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (get_flow h a (- b 1))))))))))
(lemma exch (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (qs h x b a) (rs h x a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block
        (call qs_zero h x b a)
        (assert (== (rs h x a b) 0)))
      (block
        (call exch h x (- a 1) b)
        (call exch_step h x (- a 1) b)
        (assert (== (rs h x a b) (+ (rs h x (- a 1) b) (rr h x (- a 1) b))))))))
(lemma row_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= b n))
  (ensures (<= (- (if (side x u) 0 (row_sum h u b)) (rr h x u b)) (cr c x u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (row_sum h u b) 0))
        (assert (== (rr h x u b) 0))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) 0)))
      (block
        (call row_le h c x n u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (row_sum h u b) (+ (row_sum h u (- b 1)) (get_flow h u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rr h x u b) (+ (rr h x u (- b 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (get_flow h u (- b 1))))))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) (+ (cr c x u (- b 1)) (if (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (get_flow c u (- b 1)) 0))))
        (assert (and (>= (get_flow h u (- b 1)) 0) (<= (get_flow h u (- b 1)) (get_flow c u (- b 1)))))))))
(lemma all_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (dom_caps h c n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (<= (- (ps h x a n) (rs h x a n)) (cs c x a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (ps h x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (rs h x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) 0)))
      (block
        (call all_le h c x n (- a 1))
        (call row_le h c x n (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (ps h x a n) (+ (ps h x (- a 1) n) (if (side x (- a 1)) 0 (row_sum h (- a 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (rs h x a n) (+ (rs h x (- a 1) n) (rr h x (- a 1) n))))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) (+ (cs c x (- a 1) n) (cr c x (- a 1) n))))))))
(lemma row_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (tight f c x n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= b n))
  (ensures (== (- (if (side x u) 0 (row_sum f u b)) (rr f x u b)) (cr c x u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (row_sum f u b) 0))
        (assert (== (rr f x u b) 0))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) 0)))
      (block
        (call row_eq f c x n u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (row_sum f u b) (+ (row_sum f u (- b 1)) (get_flow f u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rr f x u b) (+ (rr f x u (- b 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (get_flow f u (- b 1))))))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) (+ (cr c x u (- b 1)) (if (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (get_flow c u (- b 1)) 0))))
        (assert (=> (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (== (get_flow f u (- b 1)) (get_flow c u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (=> (and (side x u) (not (side x (- b 1)))) (== (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0)))))))
(lemma all_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (tight f c x n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (== (- (ps f x a n) (rs f x a n)) (cs c x a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (ps f x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (rs f x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) 0)))
      (block
        (call all_eq f c x n (- a 1))
        (call row_eq f c x n (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (ps f x a n) (+ (ps f x (- a 1) n) (if (side x (- a 1)) 0 (row_sum f (- a 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (rs f x a n) (+ (rs f x (- a 1) n) (rr f x (- a 1) n))))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) (+ (cs c x (- a 1) n) (cr c x (- a 1) n))))))))
(lemma val_sum (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (cons_m h s t n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (<= k n))
  (ensures (== (- (ps h x k n) (qs h x k n)) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s k)) (mnet h s n) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (ps h x k n) 0))
        (assert (== (qs h x k n) 0)))
      (block
        (call val_sum h x s t n (- k 1))
        (assert (== (ps h x k n) (+ (ps h x (- k 1) n) (if (side x (- k 1)) 0 (row_sum h (- k 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (qs h x k n) (+ (qs h x (- k 1) n) (if (side x (- k 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- k 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (mnet h (- k 1) n) (- (row_sum h (- k 1) n) (col_sum h (- k 1) n))))
        (if (== (- k 1) s)
          (block)
          (if (== (- k 1) t)
            (block)
            (assert (== (mnet h (- k 1) n) 0))))))))
(lemma cut_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (dom_caps h c n) (cons_m h s t n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (<= (mnet h s n) (cs c x n n)))
  (body
    (call val_sum h x s t n n)
    (call exch h x n n)
    (call all_le h c x n n)))
(lemma cut_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (tight f c x n) (cons_m f s t n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (mnet f s n) (cs c x n n)))
  (body
    (call val_sum f x s t n n)
    (call exch f x n n)
    (call all_eq f c x n n)))
(lemma valid_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (and (>= (get_flow h u v) 0) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v))))
  (body
    (call caps_at g c n u v)
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx h u) v) 0))
        (if (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0)
          (block
            (obtain ((cb int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cb) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) cb)))
            (assert (== (get_flow c u v) cb)))
          (block)))
      (assert (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
(lemma valid_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (mnet h u n) 0))
  (body
    (call bridge g c h n u)
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (total_flow_out g h u)))

(lemma other_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (h (seq (seq int))))

(ghost-fn row_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (r (seq int)) (i int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len r) n)
    (and
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (and (>= (idx r v) 0) (=> (> (idx r v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (idx r v))))))
      (forall ((j int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j i)) (and (<= 0 (tgt g u j)) (< (tgt g u j) n)))
            (== (idx r (tgt g u j)) (capv g u j))))))))

(lemma col_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (col_sum h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) 0))
        (assert (== (col_sum h u k) 0)))
      (block
        (call col_eq g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) u))))
        (assert (== (col_sum h u k) (+ (col_sum h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) u))))))))
(lemma in_t_not (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (d int) (v int))
  (requires (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j d)) (!= (tgt g u j) v))))
  (ensures (not (in_t g u d v)))
  (decreases d)
  (body
    (if (<= d 0)
      (assert (not (in_t g u d v)))
      (block
        (assert (!= (tgt g u (- d 1)) v))
        (call in_t_not g u (- d 1) v)
        (assert (== (in_t g u d v) (or (== (tgt g u (- d 1)) v) (in_t g u (- d 1) v))))))))
(lemma in_t_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (d int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i d)))
  (ensures (in_t g u d (tgt g u i)))
  (decreases d)
  (body
    (if (== i (- d 1))
      (assert (in_t g u d (tgt g u i)))
      (block
        (call in_t_has g u (- d 1) i)
        (assert (in_t g u d (tgt g u i)))))))
(lemma pr_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (pr g h u 0 k) 0))
      (block
        (call pr_zero g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (not (in_t g u 0 (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (pr g h u 0 k) (+ (pr g h u 0 (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u 0 (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma pr_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (>= d 0) (not (in_t g u d (tgt g u d))))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u (+ d 1) k)
               (+ (pr g h u d k) (if (and (<= 0 (tgt g u d)) (< (tgt g u d) k)) (get_flow h u (tgt g u d)) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (pr g h u (+ d 1) k) 0))
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) 0)))
      (block
        (call pr_step g h u d (- k 1))
        (assert (== (pr g h u (+ d 1) k) (+ (pr g h u (+ d 1) (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u (+ d 1) (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) (+ (pr g h u d (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u d (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (in_t g u (+ d 1) (- k 1)) (or (== (tgt g u d) (- k 1)) (in_t g u d (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma out_pr (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int))
  (requires (gwf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u d) (pr g h u d (len g))))
  (decreases d)
  (body
    (if (== d 0)
      (block
        (call pr_zero g h u (len g))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u d) 0)))
      (block
        (call out_pr g h u (- d 1))
        (assert (== (tgt g u (- d 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- d 1)) 0)))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u d)
                    (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (- d 1)) (get_flow h u (tgt g u (- d 1))))))
        (call in_t_not g u (- d 1) (tgt g u (- d 1)))
        (call pr_step g h u (- d 1) (len g))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (tgt g u (- d 1))) (< (tgt g u (- d 1)) (len g))))))))
(lemma pr_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v k)) (or (in_t g u d v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u d k) (row_sum h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) 0))
        (assert (== (row_sum h u k) 0)))
      (block
        (call pr_row g h u d (- k 1))
        (assert (or (in_t g u d (- k 1)) (== (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0)))
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) (+ (pr g h u d (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u d (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (row_sum h u k) (+ (row_sum h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma has_cap_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (tgt g u i) (capv g u i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (tgt g u i)))
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) (capv g u i)))))
(lemma cap_in_t (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (ca int))
  (requires (has_capacity g u v ca) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (in_t g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) ca))))
    (assert (== (tgt g u i) v))
    (call in_t_has g u (len (idx g u)) i)))
(lemma wf_view (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (gwf (view cg)))
  (body (assert (== (view cg) (field cg adj)))))
(lemma caps_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow c u v) 0)
           (=> (> (get_flow c u v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
           (forall ((ca int)) (=> (has_capacity g u v ca) (== (get_flow c u v) ca))))
  (body
    (assert (row_good g u (idx c u) n))
    (assert (== (get_flow c u v) (idx (idx c u) v)))))
(lemma supp_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (or (in_t g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))
  (body
    (call caps_at g c n u v)
    (assert (>= (get_flow h u v) 0))
    (assert (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v)))
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (call cap_in_t g u v (get_flow c u v))
      (block))))
(lemma bridge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row_sum h u n)) (== (total_flow_in g h u) (col_sum h u n)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (forall ((v int)) (call supp_pt g c h n u v))
    (call pr_row g h u (len (idx g u)) n)
    (call out_pr g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h u) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (len (idx g u)))))
    (call col_eq g h u n)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))))
(lemma fv_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (mnet h s n)))
  (body
    (call bridge g c h n s)
    (assert (== (mnet h s n) (- (row_sum h s n) (col_sum h s n))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))))
(lemma qs_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (b int) (a int))
  (requires (<= a 0))
  (ensures (== (qs h x b a) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (assert (== (qs h x b a) 0))
      (block
        (call qs_zero h x (- b 1) a)
        (assert (== (col_sum h (- b 1) a) 0))
        (assert (== (qs h x b a) (+ (qs h x (- b 1) a) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- b 1) a)))))))))
(lemma exch_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (qs h x b (+ a 1)) (+ (qs h x b a) (rr h x a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (qs h x b (+ a 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (qs h x b a) 0))
        (assert (== (rr h x a b) 0)))
      (block
        (call exch_step h x a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (qs h x b (+ a 1)) (+ (qs h x (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- b 1) (+ a 1))))))
        (assert (== (qs h x b a) (+ (qs h x (- b 1) a) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- b 1) a)))))
        (assert (== (col_sum h (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (col_sum h (- b 1) a) (get_flow h a (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rr h x a b) (+ (rr h x a (- b 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (get_flow h a (- b 1))))))))))
(lemma exch (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (qs h x b a) (rs h x a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block
        (call qs_zero h x b a)
        (assert (== (rs h x a b) 0)))
      (block
        (call exch h x (- a 1) b)
        (call exch_step h x (- a 1) b)
        (assert (== (rs h x a b) (+ (rs h x (- a 1) b) (rr h x (- a 1) b))))))))
(lemma row_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= b n))
  (ensures (<= (- (if (side x u) 0 (row_sum h u b)) (rr h x u b)) (cr c x u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (row_sum h u b) 0))
        (assert (== (rr h x u b) 0))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) 0)))
      (block
        (call row_le h c x n u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (row_sum h u b) (+ (row_sum h u (- b 1)) (get_flow h u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rr h x u b) (+ (rr h x u (- b 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (get_flow h u (- b 1))))))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) (+ (cr c x u (- b 1)) (if (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (get_flow c u (- b 1)) 0))))
        (assert (and (>= (get_flow h u (- b 1)) 0) (<= (get_flow h u (- b 1)) (get_flow c u (- b 1)))))))))
(lemma all_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (dom_caps h c n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (<= (- (ps h x a n) (rs h x a n)) (cs c x a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (ps h x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (rs h x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) 0)))
      (block
        (call all_le h c x n (- a 1))
        (call row_le h c x n (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (ps h x a n) (+ (ps h x (- a 1) n) (if (side x (- a 1)) 0 (row_sum h (- a 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (rs h x a n) (+ (rs h x (- a 1) n) (rr h x (- a 1) n))))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) (+ (cs c x (- a 1) n) (cr c x (- a 1) n))))))))
(lemma row_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (tight f c x n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= b n))
  (ensures (== (- (if (side x u) 0 (row_sum f u b)) (rr f x u b)) (cr c x u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (row_sum f u b) 0))
        (assert (== (rr f x u b) 0))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) 0)))
      (block
        (call row_eq f c x n u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (row_sum f u b) (+ (row_sum f u (- b 1)) (get_flow f u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rr f x u b) (+ (rr f x u (- b 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (get_flow f u (- b 1))))))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) (+ (cr c x u (- b 1)) (if (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (get_flow c u (- b 1)) 0))))
        (assert (=> (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (== (get_flow f u (- b 1)) (get_flow c u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (=> (and (side x u) (not (side x (- b 1)))) (== (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0)))))))
(lemma all_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (tight f c x n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (== (- (ps f x a n) (rs f x a n)) (cs c x a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (ps f x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (rs f x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) 0)))
      (block
        (call all_eq f c x n (- a 1))
        (call row_eq f c x n (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (ps f x a n) (+ (ps f x (- a 1) n) (if (side x (- a 1)) 0 (row_sum f (- a 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (rs f x a n) (+ (rs f x (- a 1) n) (rr f x (- a 1) n))))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) (+ (cs c x (- a 1) n) (cr c x (- a 1) n))))))))
(lemma val_sum (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (cons_m h s t n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (<= k n))
  (ensures (== (- (ps h x k n) (qs h x k n)) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s k)) (mnet h s n) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (ps h x k n) 0))
        (assert (== (qs h x k n) 0)))
      (block
        (call val_sum h x s t n (- k 1))
        (assert (== (ps h x k n) (+ (ps h x (- k 1) n) (if (side x (- k 1)) 0 (row_sum h (- k 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (qs h x k n) (+ (qs h x (- k 1) n) (if (side x (- k 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- k 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (mnet h (- k 1) n) (- (row_sum h (- k 1) n) (col_sum h (- k 1) n))))
        (if (== (- k 1) s)
          (block)
          (if (== (- k 1) t)
            (block)
            (assert (== (mnet h (- k 1) n) 0))))))))
(lemma cut_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (dom_caps h c n) (cons_m h s t n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (<= (mnet h s n) (cs c x n n)))
  (body
    (call val_sum h x s t n n)
    (call exch h x n n)
    (call all_le h c x n n)))
(lemma cut_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (tight f c x n) (cons_m f s t n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (mnet f s n) (cs c x n n)))
  (body
    (call val_sum f x s t n n)
    (call exch f x n n)
    (call all_eq f c x n n)))
(lemma valid_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (and (>= (get_flow h u v) 0) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v))))
  (body
    (call caps_at g c n u v)
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx h u) v) 0))
        (if (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0)
          (block
            (obtain ((cb int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cb) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) cb)))
            (assert (== (get_flow c u v) cb)))
          (block)))
      (assert (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
(lemma valid_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (mnet h u n) 0))
  (body
    (call bridge g c h n u)
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (total_flow_out g h u)))
    (assert (== (mnet h u n) (- (row_sum h u n) (col_sum h u n))))))
(lemma other_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g h s) (cs c x n n)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call valid_pt g c h n s t u v))
    (assert (dom_caps h c n))
    (forall ((u int)) (call valid_cons g c h n s t u))
    (assert (cons_m h s t n))
    (call fv_eq g c h n s)
    (call cut_le h c x n s t)))
(lemma resp_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (mat_ok c f n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
               (exists ((ca int)) (and (has_capacity g u v ca) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) ca)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len f) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx f u)) n))
    (call caps_at g c n u v)
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))
    (if (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
      (assert (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow c u v))))
      (block))))
(lemma nn_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (mat_ok c f n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (len f) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx f u)) n))
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0))))
(lemma cons_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps f c n) (cons_m f s t n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u)))
  (body
    (call bridge g c f n u)
    (assert (== (mnet f u n) 0))
    (assert (== (mnet f u n) (- (row_sum f u n) (col_sum f u n))))))
(lemma valid_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (mat_ok c f n) (cons_m f s t n))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (assert (dom_caps f c n))
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_pt g c f n u v))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (forall ((u int)) (call cons_pt g c f n s t u))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_pt c f n u v))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))
(lemma tight_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (dom_caps f c n) (fix_upto c f x n n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (=> (and (not (side x u)) (side x v)) (== (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))
           (=> (and (side x u) (not (side x v))) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (== (resid c f u v) (or (> (get_flow f v u) 0) (< (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))))
    (assert (== (resid c f v u) (or (> (get_flow f u v) 0) (< (get_flow f v u) (get_flow c v u)))))
    (assert (=> (and (not (side x u)) (side x v)) (not (resid c f u v))))
    (assert (=> (and (not (side x v)) (side x u)) (not (resid c f v u))))
    (assert (and (>= (get_flow f u v) 0) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v))))
    (assert (and (>= (get_flow f v u) 0) (<= (get_flow f v u) (get_flow c v u))))))
(lemma conclude (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (amt int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (mat_ok c f n) (cons_m f s t n) (fix_upto c f x n n)
            (not (side x s)) (side x t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
            (== (mnet f s n) amt))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) amt))
  (body
    (assert (dom_caps f c n))
    (call valid_final g c f n s t)
    (call fv_eq g c f n s)
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call tight_pt c f x n a b))
    (assert (tight f c x n))
    (call cut_eq f c x n s t)
    (forall ((oth (seq (seq int)))) (call other_le g c x n s t oth))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))))
(lemma row_upd (params (h (seq (seq int))) (y (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (cell_upd h y a b d))
  (ensures (== (row_sum y w k) (+ (row_sum h w k) (if (and (== w a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b k))) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (row_sum y w k) 0))
        (assert (== (row_sum h w k) 0)))
      (block
        (call row_upd h y a b d w (- k 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow y w (- k 1)) (+ (get_flow h w (- k 1)) (if (and (== w a) (== (- k 1) b)) d 0))))
        (assert (== (row_sum y w k) (+ (row_sum y w (- k 1)) (get_flow y w (- k 1)))))
        (assert (== (row_sum h w k) (+ (row_sum h w (- k 1)) (get_flow h w (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma col_upd (params (h (seq (seq int))) (y (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (cell_upd h y a b d))
  (ensures (== (col_sum y w k) (+ (col_sum h w k) (if (and (== w b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a k))) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (col_sum y w k) 0))
        (assert (== (col_sum h w k) 0)))
      (block
        (call col_upd h y a b d w (- k 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow y (- k 1) w) (+ (get_flow h (- k 1) w) (if (and (== (- k 1) a) (== w b)) d 0))))
        (assert (== (col_sum y w k) (+ (col_sum y w (- k 1)) (get_flow y (- k 1) w))))
        (assert (== (col_sum h w k) (+ (col_sum h w (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) w))))))))
(lemma net_upd (params (h (seq (seq int))) (y (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (w int) (n int))
  (requires (cell_upd h y a b d) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (== (mnet y w n) (- (+ (mnet h w n) (if (== w a) d 0)) (if (== w b) d 0))))
  (body
    (call row_upd h y a b d w n)
    (call col_upd h y a b d w n)
    (assert (== (mnet y w n) (- (row_sum y w n) (col_sum y w n))))
    (assert (== (mnet h w n) (- (row_sum h w n) (col_sum h w n))))))
(lemma walk_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (nx (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (t int) (cur int) (w int))
  (requires (labels_struct x nx rk n t) (walk_ok c f x nx rk n t (idx rk cur))
            (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur n)) (side x cur) (!= cur t)
            (forall ((a int) (b int)) (=> (and (!= a cur) (!= b cur)) (== (get_flow r a b) (get_flow f a b))))
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (side x w) (!= w t) (<= (idx rk w) (idx rk (idx nx cur))))
  (ensures (resid c r w (idx nx w)))
  (body
    (assert (< (idx rk (idx nx cur)) (idx rk cur)))
    (assert (resid c f w (idx nx w)))
    (assert (< (idx rk (idx nx w)) (idx rk w)))
    (assert (!= w cur))
    (assert (!= (idx nx w) cur))
    (assert (== (get_flow r w (idx nx w)) (get_flow f w (idx nx w))))
    (assert (== (get_flow r (idx nx w) w) (get_flow f (idx nx w) w)))
    (assert (== (resid c f w (idx nx w)) (or (> (get_flow f (idx nx w) w) 0) (< (get_flow f w (idx nx w)) (get_flow c w (idx nx w))))))
    (assert (== (resid c r w (idx nx w)) (or (> (get_flow r (idx nx w) w) 0) (< (get_flow r w (idx nx w)) (get_flow c w (idx nx w))))))))
(lemma walk_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (nx (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (t int) (cur int))
  (requires (labels_struct x nx rk n t) (walk_ok c f x nx rk n t (idx rk cur))
            (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur n)) (side x cur) (!= cur t)
            (forall ((a int) (b int)) (=> (and (!= a cur) (!= b cur)) (== (get_flow r a b) (get_flow f a b)))))
  (ensures (walk_ok c r x nx rk n t (idx rk (idx nx cur))))
  (body
    (forall ((w int)) (call walk_pt c f r x nx rk n t cur w))))

            (forall ((w int)) (=> (!= w u) (== (side x1 w) (side x0 w)))))

  (decreases k)

        (assert (== (unl x1 k) 0))

(lemma init_labels (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x0 (seq bool)) (x (seq bool)) (nx (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (t int))
  (requires (== (len x0) n) (== (len x) n) (== (len nx) n) (== (len rk) n) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
            (forall ((w int)) (not (side x0 w)))

(lemma label_facts (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x0 (seq bool)) (nx0 (seq int)) (rk0 (seq int)) (x1 (seq bool)) (nx1 (seq int)) (rk1 (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (n int) (t int) (cnt int))
  (requires (lab_inv c f x0 nx0 rk0 n t cnt)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (not (side x0 u)) (side x0 v) (resid c f u v)
            (and (== (len x1) n) (and (== (len nx1) n) (== (len rk1) n)))
            (idx x1 u) (== (idx nx1 u) v) (== (idx rk1 u) cnt)
            (forall ((w int))
              (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (!= w u))
                  (and (== (idx x1 w) (idx x0 w))

  (ensures (lab_inv c f x1 nx1 rk1 n t (+ cnt 1)))
  (body
    (assert (labels_struct x0 nx0 rk0 n t))
    (assert (all_resid c f x0 nx0 rk0 n t))
    (assert (rk_bound x0 rk0 n cnt))
    (assert (forall ((w int)) (== (side x1 w) (or (== w u) (side x0 w)))))
    (call unl_flip x0 x1 u n)
    (call unl_nonneg x1 n)
    (assert (labels_struct x1 nx1 rk1 n t))
    (assert (all_resid c f x1 nx1 rk1 n t))

(lemma row_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (r0 (seq int)) (r1 (seq int)) (i int) (n int))

(lemma caps_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (r (seq int)) (n int))

(spec push_unit
  (params (c (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (f0 (vec (vec i64))) (u i64) (v i64) (n i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (mat_ok c f0 n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (!= u v) (resid c f0 u v))
  (ensures (mat_ok c r n)
           (forall ((w int))
             (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w n))
                 (== (mnet r w n) (- (+ (mnet f0 w n) (if (== w u) 1 0)) (if (== w v) 1 0)))))
           (forall ((a int) (b int))
             (=> (and (!= a u) (!= b u)) (== (get_flow r a b) (get_flow f0 a b)))))
  (effects))
(def push_unit
  (body
    (let-mut m (vec (vec i64)) f0)
    (assert (== (get_flow f0 v u) (idx (idx f0 v) u)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f0 u v) (idx (idx f0 u) v)))
    (assert (== (get_flow c u v) (idx (idx c u) v)))
    (assert (== (resid c f0 u v) (or (> (get_flow f0 v u) 0) (< (get_flow f0 u v) (get_flow c u v)))))
    (assert (dom_caps f0 c n))
    (if (> (idx (idx m v) u) 0)
      (block
        (set-idx (idx m v) u (- (idx (idx m v) u) 1))
        (assert (cell_upd f0 m v u -1))
        (assert (square m n))
        (assert (dom_caps m c n))
        (forall ((w int)) (call net_upd f0 m v u -1 w n))
        (return m))
      (block
        (set-idx (idx m u) v (+ (idx (idx m u) v) 1))
        (assert (cell_upd f0 m u v 1))
        (assert (square m n))
        (assert (dom_caps m c n))
        (forall ((w int)) (call net_upd f0 m u v 1 w n))
        (return m)))))

(spec augment
  (params (c (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (f0 (vec (vec i64))) (x (ref (slice bool))) (nx (ref (slice i64))) (rk (ref (slice i64))) (s i64) (t i64) (n i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (mat_ok c f0 n) (labels_struct x nx rk n t) (all_resid c f0 x nx rk n t)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (side x s))
  (ensures (mat_ok c r n) (walk_net r f0 s t n))
  (effects))
(def augment
  (body
    (let-mut fl (vec (vec i64)) f0)
    (let-mut cur i64 s)
    (while (!= cur t)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur n)))
      (invariant (side x cur))
      (invariant (mat_ok c fl n))
      (invariant (walk_ok c fl x nx rk n t (idx rk cur)))
      (invariant (walk_net fl f0 s cur n))
      (decreases (idx rk cur))
      (let nxt i64 (idx nx cur))
      (assert (< (idx rk nxt) (idx rk cur)))
      (assert (side x nxt))
      (assert (resid c fl cur nxt))
      (ghost-let before (seq (seq int)) fl)
      (let ((f2 (vec (vec i64)))) (call push_unit c fl cur nxt n))
      (call walk_step c before f2 x nx rk n t cur)
      (assert (walk_net f2 f0 s nxt n))
      (set fl f2)
      (set cur nxt))
    (return fl)))

(spec do_label

(spec find_labels

(def find_labels

          (q (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int))
          (q2 (seq int)) (pos2 (seq int)) (par2 (seq int)) (h int) (u int) (v int))

            (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len q))) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (== (idx q h) u) (== (idx pos u) h) (< (idx pos v) 0) (rpos c f u v)
            (and (== (len pos2) n) (== (len par2) n))
            (== (idx pos2 v) (len q)) (== (idx par2 v) u)
            (forall ((i int))
              (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i n)) (!= i v))
                  (and (== (idx pos2 i) (idx pos i)) (== (idx par2 i) (idx par i)))))
            (== q2 (concat q (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures (tree_ok c f n s pos2 par2) (q_ok n q2 pos2) (closed_h c f n pos2 h)

           (< h (len q2)) (== (idx q2 h) u) (== (idx pos2 u) h))
  (body
    (assert (!= v s))
    (assert (!= u v))
    (call uc_step pos pos2 v n)
    (call uc_nonneg pos2 n)
    (assert (== (len q2) (+ (len q) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx q2 (len q)) v))
    (assert (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q))) (== (idx q2 i) (idx q i)))))))
(lemma bfs_advance
  (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (q (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (h int) (u int))
  (requires (closed_h c f n pos h) (row_done c f n pos u n) (q_ok n q pos)
            (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len q))) (== (idx q h) u))
  (ensures (closed_h c f n pos (+ h 1)))
  (body))
(lemma bfs_finish
  (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (q (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (h int))
  (requires (closed_h c f n pos h) (q_ok n q pos) (== h (len q)))
  (ensures (closed c f n pos))

(spec bfs
  (params (n i64) (c (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (f (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (s i64))
  (returns (pos (vec i64)) (par (vec i64)))
  (requires (mat c n) (mat f n) (<= n 1000) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (tree_ok c f n s pos par) (closed c f n pos))
  (effects alloc))
(def bfs
  (body
    (let-mut pos (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (i) -1)))
    (let-mut par (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j) 0)))
    (let-mut q (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (ghost-let p0 (seq int) pos)
    (call uc_all p0 n)
    (set-idx pos s 0)
    (call uc_step p0 pos s n)
    (call uc_nonneg pos n)
    (push q s)
    (let-mut h i64 0)
    (while (< h (len q))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 h) (<= h (len q))))
      (invariant (tree_ok c f n s pos par))
      (invariant (q_ok n q pos))
      (invariant (closed_h c f n pos h))
      (decreases (- n h))
      (let u i64 (idx q h))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len q))))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
        (invariant (tree_ok c f n s pos par))
        (invariant (q_ok n q pos))
        (invariant (closed_h c f n pos h))
        (invariant (row_done c f n pos u v))
        (invariant (== (idx q h) u))
        (invariant (== (idx pos u) h))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (if (and (< (idx pos v) 0)
                 (or (< (idx (idx f u) v) (idx (idx c u) v)) (> (idx (idx f v) u) 0)))
          (block
            (ghost-let q0 (seq int) q)
            (ghost-let pos0 (seq int) pos)
            (ghost-let par0 (seq int) par)
            (set-idx par v u)
            (set-idx pos v (len q))
            (push q v)
            (call bfs_mark c f n s q0 pos0 par0 q pos par h u v))
          (block
            (assert (row_done c f n pos u (+ v 1)))))
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (call bfs_advance c f n q pos h u)
      (set h (+ h 1)))
    (call bfs_finish c f n q pos h)
    (return pos par)))
(ghost-fn frame ((m (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (pos (seq int)) (k int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len pos) n) (and (mat m n) (mat f0 n)))
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
          (=> (or (< (idx pos a) k) (< (idx pos b) k))
              (== (idx (idx m a) b) (idx (idx f0 a) b))))))))

                    (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (cur int)) bool
  (body (and (and (mat c n) (mat m n))
    (and (and (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur n)) (== (len pos) n))
      (and (>= (idx pos cur) 0)
        (and (forall ((u int) (v int))
               (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
                   (and (<= 0 (idx (idx m u) v)) (<= (idx (idx m u) v) (idx (idx c u) v)))))
          (and (forall ((w int))
                 (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (!= w s) (!= w t)))
                     (== (ex m w n) (if (== w cur) -1 0))))
            (and (== (ex m s n) (- (ex f0 s n) (if (== cur s) 1 0)))
                 (frame m f0 n pos (idx pos cur))))))))))
(ghost-fn one_diff ((x (seq (seq int))) (y (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool

      (forall ((u int) (v int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
            (== (idx (idx y u) v) (+ (idx (idx x u) v) (if (and (== u a) (== v b)) d 0)))))))))
(lemma rs_diff (params (x (seq (seq int))) (y (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (one_diff x y n a b d) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (rs y u k) (+ (rs x u k) (if (and (== u a) (< b k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call rs_diff x y n a b d u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (get_flow y u (- k 1))
                  (+ (get_flow x u (- k 1)) (if (and (== u a) (== (- k 1) b)) d 0)))))
    (block))))
(lemma cs_diff (params (x (seq (seq int))) (y (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (one_diff x y n a b d) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (cs y u k) (+ (cs x u k) (if (and (== u b) (< a k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call cs_diff x y n a b d u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (get_flow y (- k 1) u)

    (block))))
(lemma ex_diff (params (x (seq (seq int))) (y (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (w int))
  (requires (one_diff x y n a b d) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
  (ensures (== (ex y w n) (- (+ (ex x w n) (if (== w b) d 0)) (if (== w a) d 0))))
  (body

    (call cs_diff x y n a b d w n)))
(lemma walk_rpos
  (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (x (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int)
          (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (cur int))
  (requires (walk_inv c f0 x n s t pos par cur) (tree_ok c f0 n s pos par) (!= cur s))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx par cur)) (< (idx par cur) n))
           (>= (idx pos (idx par cur)) 0)
           (< (idx pos (idx par cur)) (idx pos cur))
           (or (< (idx (idx x (idx par cur)) cur) (idx (idx c (idx par cur)) cur))
               (> (idx (idx x cur) (idx par cur)) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (rpos c f0 (idx par cur) cur))))
(lemma walk_step
  (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (x (seq (seq int))) (y (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int)
          (pos (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (cur int) (p int) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (walk_inv c f0 x n s t pos par cur) (tree_ok c f0 n s pos par) (!= cur s)
            (== p (idx par cur)) (and (<= 0 p) (< p n))
            (>= (idx pos p) 0) (< (idx pos p) (idx pos cur))
            (one_diff x y n a b d)
            (or (and (== a p) (and (== b cur) (and (== d 1) (< (idx (idx x p) cur) (idx (idx c p) cur)))))
                (and (== a cur) (and (== b p) (and (== d -1) (> (idx (idx x cur) p) 0))))))
  (ensures (walk_inv c f0 y n s t pos par p))
  (body
    (forall ((w int)) (call ex_diff x y n a b d w))))
(spec augment
  (params (n i64) (c (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (f0 (vec (vec i64)))
          (pos (ref (slice i64))) (par (ref (slice i64))) (s i64) (t i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (flow_ok c f0 n s t) (tree_ok c f0 n s pos par)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
            (>= (idx pos t) 0))
  (ensures (flow_ok c r n s t) (== (ex r s n) (- (ex f0 s n) 1)))
  (effects))
(def augment
  (body
    (let-mut m (vec (vec i64)) f0)
    (let-mut cur i64 t)
    (while (!= cur s)
      (invariant (walk_inv c f0 m n s t pos par cur))
      (decreases (idx pos cur))
      (call walk_rpos c f0 m n s t pos par cur)
      (let p i64 (idx par cur))
      (ghost-let x0 (seq (seq int)) m)
      (if (< (idx (idx m p) cur) (idx (idx c p) cur))
        (block
          (set-idx (idx m p) cur (+ (idx (idx m p) cur) 1))
          (call walk_step c f0 x0 m n s t pos par cur p p cur 1))
        (block
          (set-idx (idx m cur) p (- (idx (idx m cur) p) 1))
          (call walk_step c f0 x0 m n s t pos par cur p cur p -1)))
      (set cur p))
    (return m)))

(lemma all_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))

        (assert (== (ps h x a n) (+ (ps h x (- a 1) n) (if (side x (- a 1)) 0 (row_sum h (- a 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (rs h x a n) (+ (rs h x (- a 1) n) (rr h x (- a 1) n))))

(lemma row_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
