        (assert (== (cr c x u b) (+ (cr c x u (- b 1)) (if (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (get_flow c u (- b 1)) 0))))
        (assert (=> (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (== (get_flow f u (- b 1)) (get_flow c u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (=> (and (side x u) (not (side x (- b 1)))) (== (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0)))))))
(lemma all_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))

(lemma val_sum (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (cons_m h s t n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (<= k n))
  (ensures (== (- (ps h x k n) (qs h x k n)) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s k)) (mnet h s n) 0)))
  (decreases k)

        (assert (== (ps h x k n) 0))
        (assert (== (qs h x k n) 0)))
      (block

        (assert (== (ps h x k n) (+ (ps h x (- k 1) n) (if (side x (- k 1)) 0 (row_sum h (- k 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (qs h x k n) (+ (qs h x (- k 1) n) (if (side x (- k 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- k 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (mnet h (- k 1) n) (- (row_sum h (- k 1) n) (col_sum h (- k 1) n))))
        (if (== (- k 1) s)

(lemma cut_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (s int) (t int))

(lemma valid_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (and (>= (get_flow h u v) 0) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v))))
  (body
    (call caps_at g c n u v)
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx h u) v) 0))

          (block
            (obtain ((cb int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cb) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) cb)))
            (assert (== (get_flow c u v) cb)))

      (assert (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
(lemma valid_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (mnet h u n) 0))

    (call bridge g c h n u)
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (total_flow_out g h u)))
    (assert (== (mnet h u n) (- (row_sum h u n) (col_sum h u n))))))
(lemma other_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g h s) (cs c x n n)))

    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call valid_pt g c h n s t u v))
    (assert (dom_caps h c n))
    (forall ((u int)) (call valid_cons g c h n s t u))
    (assert (cons_m h s t n))

(lemma resp_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (mat_ok c f n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
               (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow c u v)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len f) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx f u)) n))
    (call caps_at g c n u v)
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))
    (if (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
      (assert (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow c u v))))
      (block))))
(lemma resp_wit_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))

  (ensures (resp_wit g c f))
  (body

(lemma resp_of_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))

(lemma nn_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))

(lemma cons_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps f c n) (cons_m f s t n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u)))

    (assert (== (mnet f u n) (- (row_sum f u n) (col_sum f u n))))))
(lemma valid_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (mat_ok c f n) (cons_m f s t n))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (assert (dom_caps f c n))
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (call resp_wit_all g c f n)
    (call resp_of_wit g c f)
    (forall ((u int)) (call cons_pt g c f n s t u))

    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_pt c f n u v))

(lemma tight_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (dom_caps f c n) (fix_upto c f x n n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (=> (and (not (side x u)) (side x v)) (== (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))
           (=> (and (side x u) (not (side x v))) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (== (resid c f u v) (or (> (get_flow f v u) 0) (< (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))))
    (assert (== (resid c f v u) (or (> (get_flow f u v) 0) (< (get_flow f v u) (get_flow c v u)))))
    (assert (=> (and (not (side x u)) (side x v)) (not (resid c f u v))))
    (assert (=> (and (not (side x v)) (side x u)) (not (resid c f v u))))
    (assert (and (>= (get_flow f u v) 0) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v))))
    (assert (and (>= (get_flow f v u) 0) (<= (get_flow f v u) (get_flow c v u))))))
(lemma conclude (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (amt int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (mat_ok c f n) (cons_m f s t n) (fix_upto c f x n n)
            (not (side x s)) (side x t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
            (== (mnet f s n) amt))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) amt))
  (body
    (assert (dom_caps f c n))
    (call valid_final g c f n s t)
    (call fv_eq g c f n s)
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call tight_pt c f x n a b))
    (assert (tight f c x n))
    (call cut_eq f c x n s t)
    (forall ((oth (seq (seq int)))) (call other_le g c x n s t oth))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))))
(lemma row_upd (params (h (seq (seq int))) (y (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (w int) (k int))

        (assert (== (row_sum y w k) (+ (row_sum y w (- k 1)) (get_flow y w (- k 1)))))

(lemma net_upd (params (h (seq (seq int))) (y (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (w int) (n int))

(lemma walk_pt (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (nx (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (t int) (cur int) (w int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur n)) (labels_struct x nx rk n t) (walk_ok c f x nx rk n t (idx rk cur))
            (side x cur) (!= cur t)
            (forall ((a int) (b int)) (=> (and (!= a cur) (!= b cur)) (== (get_flow r a b) (get_flow f a b))))
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (side x w) (!= w t) (<= (idx rk w) (idx rk (idx nx cur))))

    (assert (resid c f w (idx nx w)))
    (assert (< (idx rk (idx nx w)) (idx rk w)))
    (assert (!= w cur))

    (assert (== (get_flow r (idx nx w) w) (get_flow f (idx nx w) w)))

  (body

  (body (and (== (len nx) n)
    (forall ((u int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (side x u) (!= u t)))
          (resid c f u (idx nx u)))))))
(ghost-fn walk_ok ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (nx (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (t int) (b int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len nx) n) (== (len rk) n))
    (forall ((u int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (side x u) (and (!= u t) (<= (idx rk u) b))))
          (resid c f u (idx nx u)))))))
(ghost-fn rk_bound ((x (seq bool)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (cnt int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len rk) n)
    (forall ((u int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (side x u)) (< (idx rk u) cnt))))))
(ghost-fn unl ((x (seq bool)) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (unl x (- k 1)) (if (side x (- k 1)) 0 1)))))
(ghost-fn lab_inv ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (nx (seq int)) (rk (seq int)) (n int) (t int) (cnt int)) bool
  (body (and (labels_struct x nx rk n t)
    (and (all_resid c f x nx rk n t)
      (and (rk_bound x rk n cnt)
        (and (== (+ cnt (unl x n)) n)
          (and (<= cnt n) (>= cnt 1))))))))
(ghost-fn fix_upto ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a u)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
        (=> (and (not (side x a)) (side x b)) (not (resid c f a b)))))))
(ghost-fn fix_row ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (forall ((b int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 b) (< b v))
        (=> (and (not (side x u)) (side x b)) (not (resid c f u b)))))))
(ghost-fn walk_net ((h (seq (seq int))) (h0 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (cur int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w n))
        (== (mnet h w n) (- (+ (mnet h0 w n) (if (== w s) 1 0)) (if (== w cur) 1 0)))))))
(ghost-fn row_good ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (r (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len r) n)
    (and
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (and (>= (idx r v) 0) (=> (> (idx r v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (idx r v))))))
      (forall ((v int) (ca int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (has_capacity g u v ca)) (== (idx r v) ca)))))))
(ghost-fn caps_part ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len c))) (row_good g u (idx c u) n)))))
(ghost-fn caps_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len c) n) (== (len g) n)) (caps_part g c n))))
(ghost-fn row_inv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (r (seq int)) (i int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len r) n)
    (and
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (and (>= (idx r v) 0) (=> (> (idx r v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (idx r v))))))
      (forall ((j int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j i)) (and (<= 0 (tgt g u j)) (< (tgt g u j) n)))
            (== (idx r (tgt g u j)) (capv g u j))))))))
(ghost-fn resp_wit ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
        (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
            (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow c u v))))))))

(lemma col_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (col_sum h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) 0))
        (assert (== (col_sum h u k) 0)))
      (block
        (call col_eq g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) u))))
        (assert (== (col_sum h u k) (+ (col_sum h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) u))))))))
(lemma in_t_not (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (d int) (v int))
  (requires (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j d)) (!= (tgt g u j) v))))
  (ensures (not (in_t g u d v)))
  (decreases d)
  (body
    (if (<= d 0)
      (assert (not (in_t g u d v)))
      (block
        (assert (!= (tgt g u (- d 1)) v))
        (call in_t_not g u (- d 1) v)
        (assert (== (in_t g u d v) (or (== (tgt g u (- d 1)) v) (in_t g u (- d 1) v))))))))
(lemma in_t_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (d int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i d)))
  (ensures (in_t g u d (tgt g u i)))
  (decreases d)
  (body
    (if (== i (- d 1))
      (assert (in_t g u d (tgt g u i)))
      (block
        (call in_t_has g u (- d 1) i)
        (assert (in_t g u d (tgt g u i)))))))
(lemma pr_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (assert (== (pr g h u 0 k) 0))
      (block
        (call pr_zero g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (not (in_t g u 0 (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (pr g h u 0 k) (+ (pr g h u 0 (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u 0 (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma pr_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (>= d 0) (not (in_t g u d (tgt g u d))))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u (+ d 1) k)
               (+ (pr g h u d k) (if (and (<= 0 (tgt g u d)) (< (tgt g u d) k)) (get_flow h u (tgt g u d)) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (pr g h u (+ d 1) k) 0))
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) 0)))
      (block
        (call pr_step g h u d (- k 1))
        (assert (== (pr g h u (+ d 1) k) (+ (pr g h u (+ d 1) (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u (+ d 1) (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) (+ (pr g h u d (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u d (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (in_t g u (+ d 1) (- k 1)) (or (== (tgt g u d) (- k 1)) (in_t g u d (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma out_pr (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int))
  (requires (gwf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 d) (<= d (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u d) (pr g h u d (len g))))
  (decreases d)
  (body
    (if (== d 0)
      (block
        (call pr_zero g h u (len g))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u d) 0)))
      (block
        (call out_pr g h u (- d 1))
        (assert (== (tgt g u (- d 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- d 1)) 0)))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u d)
                    (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (- d 1)) (get_flow h u (tgt g u (- d 1))))))
        (call in_t_not g u (- d 1) (tgt g u (- d 1)))
        (call pr_step g h u (- d 1) (len g))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (tgt g u (- d 1))) (< (tgt g u (- d 1)) (len g))))))))
(lemma pr_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v k)) (or (in_t g u d v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (pr g h u d k) (row_sum h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) 0))
        (assert (== (row_sum h u k) 0)))
      (block
        (call pr_row g h u d (- k 1))
        (assert (or (in_t g u d (- k 1)) (== (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0)))
        (assert (== (pr g h u d k) (+ (pr g h u d (- k 1)) (if (in_t g u d (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (row_sum h u k) (+ (row_sum h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma has_cap_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (tgt g u i) (capv g u i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (tgt g u i)))
    (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) (capv g u i)))))
(lemma cap_in_t (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (ca int))
  (requires (has_capacity g u v ca) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (in_t g u (len (idx g u)) v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) ca))))
    (assert (== (tgt g u i) v))
    (call in_t_has g u (len (idx g u)) i)))
(lemma wf_view (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (gwf (view cg)))
  (body (assert (== (view cg) (field cg adj)))))
(lemma caps_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow c u v) 0)
           (=> (> (get_flow c u v) 0) (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
           (forall ((ca int)) (=> (has_capacity g u v ca) (== (get_flow c u v) ca))))
  (body
    (assert (row_good g u (idx c u) n))
    (assert (== (get_flow c u v) (idx (idx c u) v)))))
(lemma supp_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (or (in_t g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))
  (body
    (call caps_at g c n u v)
    (assert (>= (get_flow h u v) 0))
    (assert (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v)))
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (call cap_in_t g u v (get_flow c u v))
      (block))))
(lemma bridge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row_sum h u n)) (== (total_flow_in g h u) (col_sum h u n)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (forall ((v int)) (call supp_pt g c h n u v))
    (call pr_row g h u (len (idx g u)) n)
    (call out_pr g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h u) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (len (idx g u)))))
    (call col_eq g h u n)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))))
(lemma fv_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (mnet h s n)))
  (body
    (call bridge g c h n s)
    (assert (== (mnet h s n) (- (row_sum h s n) (col_sum h s n))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))))
(lemma qs_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (b int) (a int))
  (requires (<= a 0))
  (ensures (== (qs h x b a) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (assert (== (qs h x b a) 0))
      (block
        (call qs_zero h x (- b 1) a)
        (assert (== (col_sum h (- b 1) a) 0))
        (assert (== (qs h x b a) (+ (qs h x (- b 1) a) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- b 1) a)))))))))
(lemma exch_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (qs h x b (+ a 1)) (+ (qs h x b a) (rr h x a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (qs h x b (+ a 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (qs h x b a) 0))
        (assert (== (rr h x a b) 0)))
      (block
        (call exch_step h x a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (qs h x b (+ a 1)) (+ (qs h x (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- b 1) (+ a 1))))))
        (assert (== (qs h x b a) (+ (qs h x (- b 1) a) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- b 1) a)))))
        (assert (== (col_sum h (- b 1) (+ a 1)) (+ (col_sum h (- b 1) a) (get_flow h a (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rr h x a b) (+ (rr h x a (- b 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (get_flow h a (- b 1))))))))))
(lemma exch (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (qs h x b a) (rs h x a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block
        (call qs_zero h x b a)
        (assert (== (rs h x a b) 0)))
      (block
        (call exch h x (- a 1) b)
        (call exch_step h x (- a 1) b)
        (assert (== (rs h x a b) (+ (rs h x (- a 1) b) (rr h x (- a 1) b))))))))
(lemma row_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (dom_caps h c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= b n))
  (ensures (<= (- (if (side x u) 0 (row_sum h u b)) (rr h x u b)) (cr c x u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (row_sum h u b) 0))
        (assert (== (rr h x u b) 0))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) 0)))
      (block
        (call row_le h c x n u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (row_sum h u b) (+ (row_sum h u (- b 1)) (get_flow h u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rr h x u b) (+ (rr h x u (- b 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (get_flow h u (- b 1))))))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) (+ (cr c x u (- b 1)) (if (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (get_flow c u (- b 1)) 0))))
        (assert (and (>= (get_flow h u (- b 1)) 0) (<= (get_flow h u (- b 1)) (get_flow c u (- b 1)))))))))
(lemma all_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (dom_caps h c n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (<= (- (ps h x a n) (rs h x a n)) (cs c x a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (ps h x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (rs h x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) 0)))
      (block
        (call all_le h c x n (- a 1))
        (call row_le h c x n (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (ps h x a n) (+ (ps h x (- a 1) n) (if (side x (- a 1)) 0 (row_sum h (- a 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (rs h x a n) (+ (rs h x (- a 1) n) (rr h x (- a 1) n))))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) (+ (cs c x (- a 1) n) (cr c x (- a 1) n))))))))
(lemma row_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (tight f c x n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (<= b n))
  (ensures (== (- (if (side x u) 0 (row_sum f u b)) (rr f x u b)) (cr c x u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (<= b 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (row_sum f u b) 0))
        (assert (== (rr f x u b) 0))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) 0)))
      (block
        (call row_eq f c x n u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (row_sum f u b) (+ (row_sum f u (- b 1)) (get_flow f u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rr f x u b) (+ (rr f x u (- b 1)) (if (side x (- b 1)) 0 (get_flow f u (- b 1))))))
        (assert (== (cr c x u b) (+ (cr c x u (- b 1)) (if (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (get_flow c u (- b 1)) 0))))
        (assert (=> (and (not (side x u)) (side x (- b 1))) (== (get_flow f u (- b 1)) (get_flow c u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (=> (and (side x u) (not (side x (- b 1)))) (== (get_flow f u (- b 1)) 0)))))))
(lemma all_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (tight f c x n) (<= a n))
  (ensures (== (- (ps f x a n) (rs f x a n)) (cs c x a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (<= a 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (ps f x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (rs f x a n) 0))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) 0)))
      (block
        (call all_eq f c x n (- a 1))
        (call row_eq f c x n (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (ps f x a n) (+ (ps f x (- a 1) n) (if (side x (- a 1)) 0 (row_sum f (- a 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (rs f x a n) (+ (rs f x (- a 1) n) (rr f x (- a 1) n))))
        (assert (== (cs c x a n) (+ (cs c x (- a 1) n) (cr c x (- a 1) n))))))))
(lemma val_sum (params (h (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (cons_m h s t n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (<= k n))
  (ensures (== (- (ps h x k n) (qs h x k n)) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s k)) (mnet h s n) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (ps h x k n) 0))
        (assert (== (qs h x k n) 0)))
      (block
        (call val_sum h x s t n (- k 1))
        (assert (== (ps h x k n) (+ (ps h x (- k 1) n) (if (side x (- k 1)) 0 (row_sum h (- k 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (qs h x k n) (+ (qs h x (- k 1) n) (if (side x (- k 1)) 0 (col_sum h (- k 1) n)))))
        (assert (== (mnet h (- k 1) n) (- (row_sum h (- k 1) n) (col_sum h (- k 1) n))))
        (if (== (- k 1) s)
          (block)
          (if (== (- k 1) t)
            (block)
            (assert (== (mnet h (- k 1) n) 0))))))))
(lemma cut_le (params (h (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (dom_caps h c n) (cons_m h s t n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (<= (mnet h s n) (cs c x n n)))
  (body
    (call val_sum h x s t n n)
    (call exch h x n n)
    (call all_le h c x n n)))
(lemma cut_eq (params (f (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x (seq bool)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (tight f c x n) (cons_m f s t n) (not (side x s)) (side x t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (mnet f s n) (cs c x n n)))
  (body
    (call val_sum f x s t n n)
    (call exch f x n n)
    (call all_eq f c x n n)))
(lemma valid_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (caps_ok g c n) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (and (>= (get_flow h u v) 0) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v))))
  (body
    (call caps_at g c n u v)
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx h u) v) 0))
        (if (> (idx (idx h u) v) 0)
          (block
            (obtain ((cb int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cb) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) cb)))
            (assert (== (get_flow c u v) cb)))
          (block)))
      (assert (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
(lemma valid_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (gwf g) (caps_ok g c n) (dom_caps h c n) (is_valid_flow g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (mnet h u n) 0))
  (body

            (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)) (ins p x) (not (ins p y)))
  (ensures (== (get_flow f x y) (get_flow cap x y)) (== (get_flow f y x) 0))
  (body
    (assert (<= (resid cap f x y) 0))
    (assert (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow cap x y)))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow f y x)))))
(lemma term_le_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (o (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_bounds cap o n) (closed cap f p n) (flow_bounds cap f n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (<= (tm o p u v) (tm f p u v)))
  (body
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow o u v)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow o u v) (get_flow cap u v)))
    (if (and (ins p u) (not (ins p v)))
      (call tight_fwd cap f p n u v)
      (if (and (not (ins p u)) (ins p v))
        (call tight_fwd cap f p n v u)
        (block)))))
(lemma term_le_all (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (n int) (o (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (flow_bounds cap o n) (closed cap f p n) (flow_bounds cap f n))
  (ensures (term_le o f p n))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call term_le_at cap f p n o x y))
    (assert (term_le o f p n))))

(lemma below_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (out_below g m u k 0) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call below_zero g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (=> (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))) (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma below_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (l int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (forall ((i int))
              (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                  (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- l 1)))))
  (ensures (== (out_below g m u k l) (out_below g m u k (- l 1))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call below_same g m u (- k 1) l)
        (assert (=> (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))
                    (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (- l 1))))))))
(lemma below_hit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (j int) (k int) (l int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (- l 1))
            (and (< j k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (out_below g m u k l) (+ (out_below g m u k (- l 1)) (get_flow m u (- l 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== (- k 1) j)
      (call below_same g m u (- k 1) l)
      (block
        (call below_hit g m u j (- k 1) l)
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (- l 1)))))))
(lemma rsum_is_below (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (l int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 l) (<= l (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rsum m u l) (out_below g m u (len (idx g u)) l)))
  (decreases l)
  (body
    (if (<= l 0)
      (call below_zero g m u (len (idx g u)))
      (block
        (call rsum_is_below g m u (- l 1))
        (if (has_target g u (- l 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((i int))
              (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                   (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- l 1))))
            (call below_hit g m u i (len (idx g u)) l))
          (block
            (call below_same g m u (len (idx g u)) l)
            (assert (== (get_flow m u (- l 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma out_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (out_below g m u k (len g)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call out_full g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g)))))))
(lemma in_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) (csum m u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (call in_eq g m u (- k 1)))))
(lemma net_total_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g m u) (total_flow_in g m u)) (net m u (len g))))
  (body
    (call rsum_is_below g m u (len g))
    (call out_full g m u (len (idx g u)))
    (call in_eq g m u (len g))))
(lemma cap_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (has_target g u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                 (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
(lemma cap_of_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap u v) c))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (cap_rows g cap (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma edge_fact (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
           (and (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body
    (assert (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))

(lemma f_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f x y) 0) (has_target g x y)))
  (body
    (if (!= (get_flow f x y) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x))))))
        (assert (and (< x (len g)) (< y (len g))))
        (assert (> (get_flow f x y) 0))
        (assert (> (get_flow cap x y) 0))
        (assert (cap_sound g cap (len g)))
        (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
        (call cap_target g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
      (block))))
(lemma f_cell_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f x) y) 0)
           (=> (> (idx (idx f x) y) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (idx (idx f x) y) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f x y) (idx (idx f x) y)))
    (assert (and (< x (len g)) (< y (len g))))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow cap x y)))
    (if (> (get_flow f x y) 0)
      (block
        (assert (cap_sound g cap (len g)))
        (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow cap x y))))
      (block))))
(lemma f_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g m) (conserved m (len g) s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g m u) (total_flow_out g m u)))
  (body
    (call net_total_at g m u)
    (assert (== (net m u (len g)) 0))))
(lemma f_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (conserved f (len g) s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call f_support_at g cap f x y))
    (assert (supported g f))
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call f_cell_at g cap f x y))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (forall ((z int)) (call f_cons_at g f s t z))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (call net_total_at g f s)
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))

(lemma other_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g o s t))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow o x y) 0) (has_target g x y)))
  (body
    (if (!= (get_flow o x y) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx o x))))))
        (assert (== (get_flow o x y) (idx (idx o x) y)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx o x) y) 0))
        (assert (> (idx (idx o x) y) 0))
        (assert (respects_capacity g o))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (idx (idx o x) y) c)))
        (call cap_target g x y c))
      (block))))
(lemma other_bound_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (is_valid_flow g o s t)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow o x y)) (<= (get_flow o x y) (get_flow cap x y))))
  (body
    (assert (cap_sound g cap (len g)))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow cap x y)))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx o x)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow o x y) (idx (idx o x) y)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx o x) y) 0))
        (if (> (idx (idx o x) y) 0)
          (block
            (assert (respects_capacity g o))
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (idx (idx o x) y) c)))
            (call cap_of_edge g cap x y c))
          (block)))
      (assert (== (get_flow o x y) 0)))))
(lemma other_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g o) (is_valid_flow g o s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (net o u (len g)) 0))
  (body
    (call net_total_at g o u)
    (assert (is_conserved g o s t))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g o u) (total_flow_out g o u)))))
(lemma other_facts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (is_valid_flow g o s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (flow_bounds cap o (len g)) (conserved o (len g) s t)
           (== (flow_val g o s) (net o s (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call other_support_at g o s t x y))
    (assert (supported g o))
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call other_bound_at g cap o s t x y))
    (assert (flow_bounds cap o (len g)))
    (forall ((z int)) (call other_cons_at g o s t z))
    (assert (conserved o (len g) s t))
    (call net_total_at g o s)))
(lemma other_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (o (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (conserved f (len g) s t) (closed cap f p (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins p s) (not (ins p t))
            (is_valid_flow g o s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g o s)))
  (body
    (call f_valid g cap f s t)
    (call other_facts g cap o s t)
    (call term_le_all cap f p (len g) o)
    (call flow_duality o f p (len g) s t)))
(lemma max_flow_thm (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (conserved f (len g) s t) (closed cap f p (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins p s) (not (ins p t)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s (len g))))
  (body
    (call f_valid g cap f s t)
    (forall ((o (seq (seq int)))) (call other_le g cap f p s t o))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))))

(lemma unseen_nonneg (params (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (ensures (>= (unseen p k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (call unseen_nonneg p (- k 1)))))
(lemma unseen_all (params (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len p))) (< (idx p w) 0)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures (== (unseen p k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call unseen_all p (- k 1))
        (assert (< (idx p (- k 1)) 0))))))
(lemma unseen_mark (params (p0 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (== (len p1) (len p0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len p0)))
            (< (idx p0 v) 0) (>= (idx p1 v) 0)
            (forall ((w int))
              (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len p0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx p1 w) (idx p0 w))))
            (<= k (len p0)))
  (ensures (== (unseen p1 k) (- (unseen p0 k) (if (< v k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call unseen_mark p0 p1 v (- k 1))
        (assert (=> (!= (- k 1) v) (== (idx p1 (- k 1)) (idx p0 (- k 1)))))))))

(spec zero_matrix
  (params (n i64))
  (returns (m (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 n) (<= n 1000)))
  (ensures (square m n) (all_zero m))
  (effects alloc))
(def zero_matrix
  (body
    (let-mut w (vec (vec i64)) (vec-new))
    (let-mut i i64 0)
    (while (< i n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i n)))
      (invariant (== (len w) i))
      (invariant (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x i)) (== (len (idx w x)) n))))
      (invariant (forall ((x int) (y int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x i)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (== (idx (idx w x) y) 0))))
      (decreases (- n i))
      (let row (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (k0) 0)))
      (push w row)
      (set i (+ i 1)))
    (return w)))

(spec set_cell
  (params (m (vec (vec i64))) (n i64) (a i64) (b i64) (e i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (square m n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (square r n) (cell_set m r a b e))
  (effects))
(def set_cell
  (body
    (let-mut w (vec (vec i64)) m)
    (set-idx (idx w a) b e)
    (return w)))

(spec push_flow
  (params (m (vec (vec i64))) (n i64) (a i64) (b i64) (d i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))) (y i64))
  (requires (square m n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (!= a b)
            (and (>= d 0) (<= d 1000000))
            (>= (get_flow m b a) 0) (<= (get_flow m a b) 100000))
  (ensures (square r n) (moved m r a b (- d y) y) (and (<= 0 y) (<= y d))
           (<= y (get_flow m b a)) (or (== y d) (== y (get_flow m b a))))
  (effects))
(def push_flow
  (body
    (let back i64 (idx (idx m b) a))
    (let fwd i64 (idx (idx m a) b))
    (assert (== back (get_flow m b a)))
    (assert (== fwd (get_flow m a b)))
    (let y0 i64 (if (< back d) back d))
    (let x0 i64 (- d y0))
    (let ((r1 (vec (vec i64)))) (call set_cell m n b a (- back y0)))
    (let ((r2 (vec (vec i64)))) (call set_cell r1 n a b (+ fwd x0)))
    (return r2 y0)))

(spec build_cap
  (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (returns (cap (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (wf_view (view cg)) (capacities_bounded (view cg)))
  (ensures (cap_ok (view cg) cap))
  (effects alloc))
(def build_cap
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field cg adj)))
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view cg))
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (assert (<= n 1000))
    (let ((c0 (vec (vec i64)))) (call zero_matrix n))
    (let-mut w (vec (vec i64)) c0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (square w n))
      (invariant (cap_sound g w n))
      (invariant (cap_rows g w u))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field cg adj) u)))
      (assert (== deg (len (idx g u))))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (square w n))
        (invariant (cap_sound g w n))
        (invariant (cap_rows g w u))
        (invariant (cap_row g w u i))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let tg i64 (get (idx (idx (field cg adj) u) i) 0))
        (let cv i64 (get (idx (idx (field cg adj) u) i) 1))
        (call edge_fact g u i)
        (assert (and (<= 0 tg) (< tg n)))
        (let ((w1 (vec (vec i64)))) (call set_cell w n u tg cv))
        (set w w1)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (return w)))

(spec residual
  (params (cap (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (fl (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (n i64) (u i64) (v i64))
  (returns (r i64))
  (requires (square cap n) (square fl n) (cap_bounds cap n) (flow_bounds cap fl n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (== r (resid cap fl u v)))
  (effects))
(def residual
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (idx cap u) v) (get_flow cap u v)))
    (assert (== (idx (idx fl u) v) (get_flow fl u v)))
    (assert (== (idx (idx fl v) u) (get_flow fl v u)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow cap u v) 100000))
    (assert (<= (get_flow cap v u) 100000))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow fl u v)) (<= (get_flow fl u v) (get_flow cap u v))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow fl v u)) (<= (get_flow fl v u) (get_flow cap v u))))
    (return (+ (- (idx (idx cap u) v) (idx (idx fl u) v)) (idx (idx fl v) u)))))

(spec bfs
  (params (cap (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (fl (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (n i64) (s i64))
  (returns (ps (vec i64)) (pr (vec i64)) (bt (vec i64)))
  (requires (square cap n) (square fl n) (cap_bounds cap n) (flow_bounds cap fl n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (chain_ok ps pr bt n s) (resid_all cap fl ps pr bt n s)
           (closed cap fl ps n) (== (idx ps s) 0))
  (effects alloc))
(def bfs
  (body
    (let-mut pos (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (k0) -1)))
    (let-mut pred (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (k0) 0)))
    (let-mut bn (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (k0) 0)))
    (let-mut queue (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (k0) 0)))
    (ghost-let pos_init (seq int) pos)
    (call unseen_all pos_init n)
    (set-idx pos s 0)
    (call unseen_mark pos_init pos s n)
    (set-idx bn s 1000000)
    (set-idx queue 0 s)
    (let-mut head i64 0)
    (let-mut tail i64 1)
    (while (< head tail)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (<= head tail)))
      (invariant (queue_ok pos queue n tail))
      (invariant (pos_ok pos n tail))
      (invariant (chain_ok pos pred bn n s))
      (invariant (resid_all cap fl pos pred bn n s))
      (invariant (closed_below cap fl pos n head))
      (invariant (== (+ (unseen pos n) tail) n))
      (invariant (== (idx pos s) 0))
      (invariant (>= (idx bn s) 1))
      (decreases (- n head))
      (let u i64 (idx queue head))
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))

(lemma net_total_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g m u) (total_flow_in g m u)) (net m u (len g))))
  (body
    (call rsum_is_below g m u (len g))
    (call out_full g m u (len (idx g u)))
    (call in_eq g m u (len g))))
(lemma cap_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (has_target g u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                 (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
(lemma cap_of_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap u v) c))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (cap_rows g cap (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma edge_fact (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
           (and (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body
    (assert (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))

(lemma f_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f x y) 0) (has_target g x y)))
  (body
    (if (!= (get_flow f x y) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x))))))
        (assert (and (< x (len g)) (< y (len g))))
        (assert (> (get_flow f x y) 0))
        (assert (> (get_flow cap x y) 0))
        (assert (cap_sound g cap (len g)))
        (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
        (call cap_target g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
      (block))))
(lemma f_support (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (supported g f))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call f_support_at g cap f x y))))
(lemma f_resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap (len g)) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f x) y) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (idx (idx f x) y) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f x y) (idx (idx f x) y)))
    (assert (and (< x (len g)) (< y (len g))))
    (assert (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow cap x y)))
    (if (> (get_flow f x y) 0)
      (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
      (block))))
(lemma f_respects (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap (len g)) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call f_resp_at g cap f x y))))
(lemma f_nn_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f x) y) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f x y) (idx (idx f x) y)))
    (assert (and (< x (len g)) (< y (len g))))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)))))
(lemma f_nonneg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call f_nn_at g cap f x y))))
(lemma f_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g m) (conserved m (len g) s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g m u) (total_flow_out g m u)))
  (body
    (call net_total_at g m u)
    (assert (== (net m u (len g)) 0))))
(lemma f_is_conserved (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g m) (conserved m (len g) s t))
  (ensures (is_conserved g m s t))
  (body
    (forall ((z int)) (call f_cons_at g m s t z))))
(lemma f_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (conserved f (len g) s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s (len g))))
  (body
    (call f_support g cap f)
    (call f_respects g cap f)
    (call f_nonneg g cap f)
    (call f_is_conserved g f s t)
    (call net_total_at g f s)
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))

(lemma other_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g o s t))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow o x y) 0) (has_target g x y)))
  (body
    (if (!= (get_flow o x y) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx o x))))))
        (assert (== (get_flow o x y) (idx (idx o x) y)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx o x) y) 0))
        (assert (> (idx (idx o x) y) 0))
        (assert (respects_capacity g o))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (idx (idx o x) y) c)))
        (call cap_target g x y c))
      (block))))
(lemma other_bound_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (is_valid_flow g o s t)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow o x y)) (<= (get_flow o x y) (get_flow cap x y))))
  (body
    (assert (cap_sound g cap (len g)))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow cap x y)))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx o x)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow o x y) (idx (idx o x) y)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx o x) y) 0))
        (if (> (idx (idx o x) y) 0)
          (block
            (assert (respects_capacity g o))
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (idx (idx o x) y) c)))
            (call cap_of_edge g cap x y c))
          (block)))
      (assert (== (get_flow o x y) 0)))))
(lemma other_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g o) (is_valid_flow g o s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (net o u (len g)) 0))
  (body
    (call net_total_at g o u)
    (assert (is_conserved g o s t))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g o u) (total_flow_out g o u)))))
(lemma other_facts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (is_valid_flow g o s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (flow_bounds cap o (len g)) (conserved o (len g) s t)
           (== (flow_val g o s) (net o s (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call other_support_at g o s t x y))
    (assert (supported g o))
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call other_bound_at g cap o s t x y))
    (assert (flow_bounds cap o (len g)))
    (forall ((z int)) (call other_cons_at g o s t z))
    (assert (conserved o (len g) s t))
    (call net_total_at g o s)))
(lemma other_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (o (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (conserved f (len g) s t) (closed cap f p (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins p s) (not (ins p t))
            (is_valid_flow g o s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g o s)))
  (body
    (call f_valid g cap f s t)
    (call other_facts g cap o s t)
    (call term_le_all cap f p (len g) o)
    (call flow_duality o f p (len g) s t)))
(lemma max_flow_thm (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (conserved f (len g) s t) (closed cap f p (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins p s) (not (ins p t)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s (len g))))
  (body
    (call f_valid g cap f s t)
    (forall ((o (seq (seq int)))) (call other_le g cap f p s t o))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))))

(lemma unseen_nonneg (params (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (ensures (>= (unseen p k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (call unseen_nonneg p (- k 1)))))
(lemma unseen_all (params (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len p))) (< (idx p w) 0)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures (== (unseen p k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call unseen_all p (- k 1))
        (assert (< (idx p (- k 1)) 0))))))
(lemma unseen_mark (params (p0 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (== (len p1) (len p0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len p0)))
            (< (idx p0 v) 0) (>= (idx p1 v) 0)
            (forall ((w int))
              (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len p0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx p1 w) (idx p0 w))))
            (<= k (len p0)))
  (ensures (== (unseen p1 k) (- (unseen p0 k) (if (< v k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call unseen_mark p0 p1 v (- k 1))
        (assert (=> (!= (- k 1) v) (== (idx p1 (- k 1)) (idx p0 (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma tail_room (params (pos (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (v int) (tail int) (n int))
  (requires (== (len pos) n) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (< (idx pos v) 0) (>= tail 0)
            (== (+ (unseen pos n) tail) n))
  (ensures (< tail n) (== (+ (unseen p1 n) (+ tail 1)) n))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx p1 v) tail))
    (call unseen_mark pos p1 v n)
    (call unseen_nonneg p1 n)))

(lemma queue_new (params (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int) (n int) (tail int) (i int))
  (requires (queue_ok pos queue n tail) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 queue q1 tail v)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (< (idx pos v) 0) (and (<= 0 tail) (< tail n))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ tail 1))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx q1 i)) (< (idx q1 i) n)) (== (idx p1 (idx q1 i)) i)))
  (body
    (if (== i tail)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q1 tail) v))
        (assert (== (idx p1 v) tail)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q1 i) (idx queue i)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx queue i)) (< (idx queue i) n)))
        (assert (== (idx pos (idx queue i)) i))
        (assert (!= (idx queue i) v))
        (assert (== (idx p1 (idx queue i)) (idx pos (idx queue i))))))))
(lemma queue_old (params (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int) (n int) (tail int) (w int))
  (requires (queue_ok pos queue n tail) (pos_ok pos n tail) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 queue q1 tail v)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 tail) (< tail n))
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (<= 0 (idx p1 w)) (< (idx p1 w) (+ tail 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx q1 (idx p1 w)) w))
  (body
    (if (== w v)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p1 v) tail))
        (assert (== (idx q1 tail) v)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p1 w) (idx pos w)))
        (assert (< (idx pos w) tail))
        (assert (== (idx queue (idx pos w)) w))
        (assert (== (idx q1 (idx pos w)) (idx queue (idx pos w))))))))
(lemma queue_step (params (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int) (n int) (tail int))
  (requires (queue_ok pos queue n tail) (pos_ok pos n tail) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 queue q1 tail v)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (< (idx pos v) 0) (and (<= 0 tail) (< tail n)))
  (ensures (queue_ok p1 q1 n (+ tail 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call queue_new pos queue p1 q1 v n tail i))
    (forall ((w int)) (call queue_old pos queue p1 q1 v n tail w))))
(lemma pos_step (params (pos (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (v int) (n int) (tail int))
  (requires (pos_ok pos n tail) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (pos_ok p1 n (+ tail 1)))
  (body))
(lemma chain_at (params (pos (seq int)) (pred (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (p3 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (v int) (u int) (tail int) (head int) (nb int) (w int))
  (requires (chain_ok pos pred bn n s) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 pred p2 v u) (upd1 bn p3 v nb)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (< (idx pos v) 0)
            (== (idx pos u) head) (and (<= 0 head) (< head tail))
            (and (<= 1 nb) (<= nb (idx bn u)))
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (!= w s) (>= (idx p1 w) 0))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx p2 w)) (< (idx p2 w) n))
                (and (and (<= 0 (idx p1 (idx p2 w))) (< (idx p1 (idx p2 w)) (idx p1 w)))
                     (and (<= 1 (idx p3 w)) (<= (idx p3 w) (idx p3 (idx p2 w)))))))
  (body
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (== (idx p1 u) head))
    (assert (== (idx p3 u) (idx bn u)))
    (if (== w v)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p1 v) tail))
        (assert (== (idx p2 v) u))
        (assert (== (idx p3 v) nb)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p1 w) (idx pos w)))
        (assert (== (idx p2 w) (idx pred w)))
        (assert (== (idx p3 w) (idx bn w)))
        (assert (>= (idx pos w) 0))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx pred w)) (< (idx pred w) n)))
        (assert (>= (idx pos (idx pred w)) 0))
        (assert (!= (idx pred w) v))
        (assert (== (idx p1 (idx pred w)) (idx pos (idx pred w))))
        (assert (== (idx p3 (idx pred w)) (idx bn (idx pred w))))))))
(lemma chain_step (params (pos (seq int)) (pred (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (p3 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (v int) (u int) (tail int) (head int) (nb int))
  (requires (chain_ok pos pred bn n s) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 pred p2 v u) (upd1 bn p3 v nb)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (< (idx pos v) 0)
            (== (idx pos u) head) (and (<= 0 head) (< head tail))
            (and (<= 1 nb) (<= nb (idx bn u))))
  (ensures (chain_ok p1 p2 p3 n s))
  (body
    (forall ((w int)) (call chain_at pos pred bn p1 p2 p3 n s v u tail head nb w))))
(lemma resid_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (pred (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (p3 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (v int) (u int) (tail int) (nb int) (w int))
  (requires (resid_all cap fl pos pred bn n s) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 pred p2 v u) (upd1 bn p3 v nb)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (>= (resid cap fl u v) nb)
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (!= w s) (>= (idx p1 w) 0))
  (ensures (>= (resid cap fl (idx p2 w) w) (idx p3 w)))
  (body
    (if (== w v)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p2 v) u))
        (assert (== (idx p3 v) nb)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p1 w) (idx pos w)))
        (assert (== (idx p2 w) (idx pred w)))
        (assert (== (idx p3 w) (idx bn w)))
        (assert (>= (resid cap fl (idx pred w) w) (idx bn w)))))))
(lemma resid_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (pred (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (p3 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (v int) (u int) (tail int) (nb int))
  (requires (resid_all cap fl pos pred bn n s) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 pred p2 v u) (upd1 bn p3 v nb)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (>= (resid cap fl u v) nb))
  (ensures (resid_all cap fl p1 p2 p3 n s))
  (body
    (forall ((w int)) (call resid_at cap fl pos pred bn p1 p2 p3 n s v u tail nb w))))
(lemma closed_new_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (n int) (v int) (tail int) (head int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (closed_below cap fl pos n head) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (<= head tail)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p1 a)) (< (idx p1 a) head)) (> (resid cap fl a b) 0))
  (ensures (>= (idx p1 b) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx p1 v) tail))
    (assert (!= a v))
    (assert (== (idx p1 a) (idx pos a)))
    (assert (>= (idx pos b) 0))))
(lemma closed_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (n int) (v int) (tail int) (head int))
  (requires (closed_below cap fl pos n head) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (<= head tail))
  (ensures (closed_below cap fl p1 n head))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call closed_new_at cap fl pos p1 n v tail head a b))))
(lemma scan_hit (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int) (tail int))
  (requires (scan_ok cap fl pos n u v) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (>= tail 0))
  (ensures (scan_ok cap fl p1 n u (+ v 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx p1 v) tail))))
(lemma scan_miss (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (scan_ok cap fl pos n u v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (=> (> (resid cap fl u v) 0) (>= (idx pos v) 0)))
  (ensures (scan_ok cap fl pos n u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma hit_ground (params (pos (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (p3 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (head int) (tail int) (u int) (v int) (nb int))
  (requires (== (len pos) n) (== (len bn) n) (== (len queue) n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (and (<= 0 head) (and (< head tail) (<= tail n)))
            (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 bn p3 v nb) (upd1 queue q1 tail v)
            (< (idx pos v) 0) (== (idx pos s) 0) (>= (idx bn s) 1)
            (== (idx queue head) u) (== (idx pos u) head) (>= (idx bn u) 1))
  (ensures (== (idx p1 s) 0) (>= (idx p3 s) 1) (== (idx q1 head) u) (== (idx p1 u) head) (>= (idx p3 u) 1))
  (body
    (assert (!= s v))
    (assert (!= u v))))
(lemma hit_state (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (pred (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (p3 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (head int) (tail int) (u int) (v int) (nb int))
