      (block
        (call below_same g m u (- k 1) l)
        (assert (=> (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))
                    (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (- l 1))))))))
(lemma below_hit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (j int) (k int) (l int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (- l 1))
            (and (< j k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (out_below g m u k l) (+ (out_below g m u k (- l 1)) (get_flow m u (- l 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== (- k 1) j)
      (call below_same g m u (- k 1) l)
      (block
        (call below_hit g m u j (- k 1) l)
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (- l 1)))))))
(lemma rsum_is_below (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (l int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 l) (<= l (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rsum m u l) (out_below g m u (len (idx g u)) l)))
  (decreases l)
  (body
    (if (<= l 0)
      (call below_zero g m u (len (idx g u)))
      (block
        (call rsum_is_below g m u (- l 1))
        (if (has_target g u (- l 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((i int))
              (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                   (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (- l 1))))
            (call below_hit g m u i (len (idx g u)) l))
          (block
            (call below_same g m u (len (idx g u)) l)
            (assert (== (get_flow m u (- l 1)) 0))))))))
(lemma out_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (out_below g m u k (len g)) (sum_flow_out_recursive g m u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call out_full g m u (- k 1))
        (assert (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g)))))))
(lemma in_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g m u k) (csum m u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (call in_eq g m u (- k 1)))))
(lemma net_total_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g m) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g m u) (total_flow_in g m u)) (net m u (len g))))
  (body
    (call rsum_is_below g m u (len g))
    (call out_full g m u (len (idx g u)))
    (call in_eq g m u (len g))))
(lemma cap_target (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (has_target g u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                 (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
(lemma cap_of_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (has_capacity g u v c))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap u v) c))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (cap_rows g cap (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma edge_fact (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
           (and (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body
    (assert (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))

(lemma f_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f x y) 0) (has_target g x y)))
  (body
    (if (!= (get_flow f x y) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x))))))
        (assert (and (< x (len g)) (< y (len g))))
        (assert (> (get_flow f x y) 0))
        (assert (> (get_flow cap x y) 0))
        (assert (cap_sound g cap (len g)))
        (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
        (call cap_target g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
      (block))))
(lemma f_support (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (supported g f))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call f_support_at g cap f x y))))
(lemma f_resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap (len g)) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f x) y) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (idx (idx f x) y) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f x y) (idx (idx f x) y)))
    (assert (and (< x (len g)) (< y (len g))))
    (assert (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow cap x y)))
    (if (> (get_flow f x y) 0)
      (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
      (block))))
(lemma f_respects (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap (len g)) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call f_resp_at g cap f x y))))
(lemma f_nn_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f x)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f x) y) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f x y) (idx (idx f x) y)))
    (assert (and (< x (len g)) (< y (len g))))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)))))
(lemma f_nonneg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g)))
  (ensures (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call f_nn_at g cap f x y))))
(lemma f_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g m) (conserved m (len g) s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g m u) (total_flow_out g m u)))
  (body
    (call net_total_at g m u)
    (assert (== (net m u (len g)) 0))))
(lemma f_is_conserved (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g m) (conserved m (len g) s t))
  (ensures (is_conserved g m s t))
  (body
    (forall ((z int)) (call f_cons_at g m s t z))))
(lemma f_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (conserved f (len g) s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s (len g))))
  (body
    (call f_support g cap f)
    (call f_respects g cap f)
    (call f_nonneg g cap f)
    (call f_is_conserved g f s t)
    (call net_total_at g f s)
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))

(lemma other_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g o s t))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow o x y) 0) (has_target g x y)))
  (body
    (if (!= (get_flow o x y) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx o x))))))
        (assert (== (get_flow o x y) (idx (idx o x) y)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx o x) y) 0))
        (assert (> (idx (idx o x) y) 0))
        (assert (respects_capacity g o))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (idx (idx o x) y) c)))
        (call cap_target g x y c))
      (block))))
(lemma other_bound_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_ok g cap) (is_valid_flow g o s t)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow o x y)) (<= (get_flow o x y) (get_flow cap x y))))
  (body
    (assert (cap_sound g cap (len g)))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow cap x y)))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx o x)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow o x y) (idx (idx o x) y)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx o x) y) 0))
        (if (> (idx (idx o x) y) 0)
          (block
            (assert (respects_capacity g o))
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (idx (idx o x) y) c)))
            (call cap_of_edge g cap x y c))
          (block)))
      (assert (== (get_flow o x y) 0)))))
(lemma other_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (supported g o) (is_valid_flow g o s t)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t))
  (ensures (== (net o u (len g)) 0))
  (body
    (call net_total_at g o u)
    (assert (is_conserved g o s t))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g o u) (total_flow_out g o u)))))
(lemma other_facts (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (o (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (is_valid_flow g o s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (flow_bounds cap o (len g)) (conserved o (len g) s t)
           (== (flow_val g o s) (net o s (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call other_support_at g o s t x y))
    (assert (supported g o))
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call other_bound_at g cap o s t x y))
    (assert (flow_bounds cap o (len g)))
    (forall ((z int)) (call other_cons_at g o s t z))
    (assert (conserved o (len g) s t))
    (call net_total_at g o s)))
(lemma other_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (o (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (conserved f (len g) s t) (closed cap f p (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins p s) (not (ins p t))
            (is_valid_flow g o s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g o s)))
  (body
    (call f_valid g cap f s t)
    (call other_facts g cap o s t)
    (call term_le_all cap f p (len g) o)
    (call flow_duality o f p (len g) s t)))
(lemma max_flow_thm (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_view g) (cap_ok g cap) (square f (len g)) (flow_bounds cap f (len g))
            (conserved f (len g) s t) (closed cap f p (len g))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (ins p s) (not (ins p t)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s (len g))))
  (body
    (call f_valid g cap f s t)
    (forall ((o (seq (seq int)))) (call other_le g cap f p s t o))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))))

(lemma unseen_nonneg (params (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (ensures (>= (unseen p k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (call unseen_nonneg p (- k 1)))))
(lemma unseen_all (params (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len p))) (< (idx p w) 0)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures (== (unseen p k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call unseen_all p (- k 1))
        (assert (< (idx p (- k 1)) 0))))))
(lemma unseen_mark (params (p0 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (== (len p1) (len p0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len p0)))
            (< (idx p0 v) 0) (>= (idx p1 v) 0)
            (forall ((w int))
              (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len p0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx p1 w) (idx p0 w))))
            (<= k (len p0)))
  (ensures (== (unseen p1 k) (- (unseen p0 k) (if (< v k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (<= k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call unseen_mark p0 p1 v (- k 1))
        (assert (=> (!= (- k 1) v) (== (idx p1 (- k 1)) (idx p0 (- k 1)))))))))
(lemma tail_room (params (pos (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (v int) (tail int) (n int))
  (requires (== (len pos) n) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (< (idx pos v) 0) (>= tail 0)
            (== (+ (unseen pos n) tail) n))
  (ensures (< tail n) (== (+ (unseen p1 n) (+ tail 1)) n))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx p1 v) tail))
    (call unseen_mark pos p1 v n)
    (call unseen_nonneg p1 n)))

(lemma queue_new (params (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int) (n int) (tail int) (i int))
  (requires (queue_ok pos queue n tail) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 queue q1 tail v)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (< (idx pos v) 0) (and (<= 0 tail) (< tail n))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ tail 1))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx q1 i)) (< (idx q1 i) n)) (== (idx p1 (idx q1 i)) i)))
  (body
    (if (== i tail)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q1 tail) v))
        (assert (== (idx p1 v) tail)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q1 i) (idx queue i)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx queue i)) (< (idx queue i) n)))
        (assert (== (idx pos (idx queue i)) i))
        (assert (!= (idx queue i) v))
        (assert (== (idx p1 (idx queue i)) (idx pos (idx queue i))))))))
(lemma queue_old (params (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int) (n int) (tail int) (w int))
  (requires (queue_ok pos queue n tail) (pos_ok pos n tail) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 queue q1 tail v)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 tail) (< tail n))
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (<= 0 (idx p1 w)) (< (idx p1 w) (+ tail 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx q1 (idx p1 w)) w))
  (body
    (if (== w v)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p1 v) tail))
        (assert (== (idx q1 tail) v)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p1 w) (idx pos w)))
        (assert (< (idx pos w) tail))
        (assert (== (idx queue (idx pos w)) w))
        (assert (== (idx q1 (idx pos w)) (idx queue (idx pos w))))))))
(lemma queue_step (params (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int) (n int) (tail int))
  (requires (queue_ok pos queue n tail) (pos_ok pos n tail) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 queue q1 tail v)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (< (idx pos v) 0) (and (<= 0 tail) (< tail n)))
  (ensures (queue_ok p1 q1 n (+ tail 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call queue_new pos queue p1 q1 v n tail i))
    (forall ((w int)) (call queue_old pos queue p1 q1 v n tail w))))
(lemma pos_step (params (pos (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (v int) (n int) (tail int))
  (requires (pos_ok pos n tail) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (pos_ok p1 n (+ tail 1)))
  (body))
(lemma chain_at (params (pos (seq int)) (pred (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (p3 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (v int) (u int) (tail int) (head int) (nb int) (w int))
  (requires (chain_ok pos pred bn n s) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 pred p2 v u) (upd1 bn p3 v nb)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (< (idx pos v) 0)
            (== (idx pos u) head) (and (<= 0 head) (< head tail))
            (and (<= 1 nb) (<= nb (idx bn u)))
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (!= w s) (>= (idx p1 w) 0))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx p2 w)) (< (idx p2 w) n))
                (and (and (<= 0 (idx p1 (idx p2 w))) (< (idx p1 (idx p2 w)) (idx p1 w)))
                     (and (<= 1 (idx p3 w)) (<= (idx p3 w) (idx p3 (idx p2 w)))))))
  (body
    (assert (!= u v))
    (assert (== (idx p1 u) head))
    (assert (== (idx p3 u) (idx bn u)))
    (if (== w v)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p1 v) tail))
        (assert (== (idx p2 v) u))
        (assert (== (idx p3 v) nb)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p1 w) (idx pos w)))
        (assert (== (idx p2 w) (idx pred w)))
        (assert (== (idx p3 w) (idx bn w)))
        (assert (>= (idx pos w) 0))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx pred w)) (< (idx pred w) n)))
        (assert (>= (idx pos (idx pred w)) 0))
        (assert (!= (idx pred w) v))
        (assert (== (idx p1 (idx pred w)) (idx pos (idx pred w))))
        (assert (== (idx p3 (idx pred w)) (idx bn (idx pred w))))))))
(lemma chain_step (params (pos (seq int)) (pred (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (p3 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (v int) (u int) (tail int) (head int) (nb int))
  (requires (chain_ok pos pred bn n s) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 pred p2 v u) (upd1 bn p3 v nb)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (< (idx pos v) 0)
            (== (idx pos u) head) (and (<= 0 head) (< head tail))
            (and (<= 1 nb) (<= nb (idx bn u))))
  (ensures (chain_ok p1 p2 p3 n s))
  (body
    (forall ((w int)) (call chain_at pos pred bn p1 p2 p3 n s v u tail head nb w))))
(lemma resid_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (pred (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (p3 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (v int) (u int) (tail int) (nb int) (w int))
  (requires (resid_all cap fl pos pred bn n s) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 pred p2 v u) (upd1 bn p3 v nb)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (>= (resid cap fl u v) nb)
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (!= w s) (>= (idx p1 w) 0))
  (ensures (>= (resid cap fl (idx p2 w) w) (idx p3 w)))
  (body
    (if (== w v)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p2 v) u))
        (assert (== (idx p3 v) nb)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p1 w) (idx pos w)))
        (assert (== (idx p2 w) (idx pred w)))
        (assert (== (idx p3 w) (idx bn w)))
        (assert (>= (resid cap fl (idx pred w) w) (idx bn w)))))))
(lemma resid_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (pred (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (p3 (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (v int) (u int) (tail int) (nb int))
  (requires (resid_all cap fl pos pred bn n s) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (upd1 pred p2 v u) (upd1 bn p3 v nb)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (>= (resid cap fl u v) nb))
  (ensures (resid_all cap fl p1 p2 p3 n s))
  (body
    (forall ((w int)) (call resid_at cap fl pos pred bn p1 p2 p3 n s v u tail nb w))))
(lemma closed_new_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (fl (seq (seq int))) (pos (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (n int) (v int) (tail int) (head int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (closed_below cap fl pos n head) (upd1 pos p1 v tail) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (<= head tail)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p1 a)) (< (idx p1 a) head)) (> (resid cap fl a b) 0))
  (ensures (>= (idx p1 b) 0))

  (body (concat (concat a (seq-lit t1)) (rem_at o i))))
(ghost-fn step_conn ((e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (edge_in_set e1 x y) (edges_connected e2 x y)))))
(ghost-fn is_prefix ((e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (<= (len e1) (len e2))
             (forall ((c int)) (=> (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len e1))) (== (idx e2 c) (idx e1 c)))))))
(ghost-fn outside_upto ((pos (seq int)) (k int) (p (seq int)) (t int)) bool
  (requires (< t (len p)))
  (body (forall ((l int)) (=> (and (<= 0 l) (<= l t)) (not (in_s pos k (idx p l)))))))
(ghost-fn good_step ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (j int) (t1 (tuple int int int))) bool
  (body (and (and (crossing pos j (get t1 0) (get t1 1))
                  (and (in_s pos (+ j 1) (get t1 0)) (in_s pos (+ j 1) (get t1 1))))
             (forall ((x int) (y int) (z int))
               (=> (and (has_edge g x y z) (crossing pos j x y)) (<= (get t1 2) z))))))
(ghost-fn steps_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len es))) (good_step g pos j (idx es j))))))
(ghost-fn vert_ok ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (x int)) bool
  (requires (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))))
  (body (and (and (>= (idx pos x) 0)
                  (or (<= (idx pos x) (len es)) (== (idx pos x) (len pos))))
             (and (=> (== (idx pos x) 0) (== x 0))
                  (=> (and (< 0 (idx pos x)) (<= (idx pos x) (len es)))
                      (or (== x (get (idx es (- (idx pos x) 1)) 0))
                          (== x (get (idx es (- (idx pos x) 1)) 1))))))))
(ghost-fn verts_ok ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (> (len pos) (len es)) (== (idx pos 0) 0))
             (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))) (vert_ok es pos x))))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((pos (seq int)) (k int) (m int)) int
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len pos))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) 0 (+ (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn prim_cert ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (are_valid_edges g es) (== (len pos) (len g)))
             (and (verts_ok es pos)
                  (and (steps_ok g es pos)
                       (== (cnt pos (len es) (len pos)) (+ (len es) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn is_min_cross ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (u int) (v int) (w int)) bool
  (body (and (and (has_edge g u v w) (crossing pos k u v))
             (forall ((x int) (y int) (z int))
               (=> (and (has_edge g x y z) (crossing pos k x y)) (<= w z))))))
(ghost-fn cross_exists_p ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (k int)) bool
  (body (exists ((x int) (y int) (z int)) (and (has_edge g x y z) (crossing pos k x y)))))
(ghost-fn scan_done ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (x int) (i int) (found bool) (bw int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx g a)))))
             (and (or (< a x) (and (== a x) (< b i)))
                  (crossing pos k a (get (idx (idx g a) b) 0))))
        (and found (<= bw (get (idx (idx g a) b) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn scan_best ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (k int) (found bool) (bu int) (bv int) (bw int)) bool
  (body (=> found (and (and (and (<= 0 bu) (< bu (len pos))) (and (<= 0 bv) (< bv (len pos))))
                       (and (has_edge g bu bv bw) (crossing pos k bu bv))))))
(ghost-fn same_upto ((pos (seq int)) (pos2 (seq int)) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((l int) (x int)) (=> (<= l k) (== (in_s pos2 l x) (in_s pos l x))))))
(ghost-fn pos_rel ((pos (seq int)) (pos2 (seq int)) (k int) (nv int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len pos2) (len pos)) (and (<= 0 nv) (< nv (len pos))))
             (and (== (idx pos2 nv) (+ k 1))
                  (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))) (!= x nv)) (== (idx pos2 x) (idx pos x))))))))
(lemma edge_from_entry
  (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (c int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len es))) (same_ends (idx es c) x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es x y))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len es)))
                 (or (and (== (get (idx es c) 0) x) (== (get (idx es c) 1) y))
                     (and (== (get (idx es c) 0) y) (== (get (idx es c) 1) x)))))))
(lemma edge_in_set_sym
  (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es a b))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es b a))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len es))) (same_ends (idx es c) a b)))
    (assert (same_ends (idx es c) b a))
    (call edge_from_entry es c b a)))
(lemma conn_intro
  (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b) (path_follows_edges es p))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a b))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges es p)))))
(lemma conn_refl
  (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x x))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (call conn_intro es p x x)))
(lemma conn_of_edge
  (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x y))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) y))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (call conn_intro es p x y)))
(lemma conn_sym_at
  (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (== (len q) (len p))
            (forall ((l int)) (=> (and (<= 0 l) (< l (len p))) (== (idx q l) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) l)))))
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (- (len q) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx q m) (idx q (+ m 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let r int (- (- (len p) 2) m))
    (assert (== (idx q m) (idx p (+ r 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (+ m 1)) (idx p r)))
    (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p r) (idx p (+ r 1))))
    (call edge_in_set_sym es (idx p r) (idx p (+ r 1)))))
(lemma conn_sym
  (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_connected es a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected es b a))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build (len p) (fn (l0) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) l0)))))
    (assert (== (len q) (len p)))
    (assert (forall ((l int)) (=> (and (<= 0 l) (< l (len p))) (== (idx q l) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) l))))))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) b))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) a))
    (forall ((m int)) (call conn_sym_at es p q m))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es q))
    (call conn_intro es q b a)))
(lemma conn_trans_at
  (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (r (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (> (len q) 0)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx q 0))
            (path_follows_edges es p) (path_follows_edges es q)
            (== r (concat p (drop q 1)))
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (- (len r) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx r m) (idx r (+ m 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)))
    (if (< (+ m 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx r m) (idx p m)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ m 1)) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let l int (- (+ m 1) (len p)))
        (assert (== (idx r m) (idx q l)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ m 1)) (idx q (+ l 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx q l) (idx q (+ l 1))))))))
(lemma conn_trans
  (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected es a b) (edges_connected es b c))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a c))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) b) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) c))) (path_follows_edges es q)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (drop q 1)))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) a))
    (if (== (len q) 1)
      (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
      (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) c))
    (forall ((m int)) (call conn_trans_at es p q r m))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es r))
    (call conn_intro es r a c)))
(lemma walk_lift
  (params (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges e1 p) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))) (step_conn e1 e2))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 (idx p 0) (idx p t)))
  (decreases t)
  (body
    (if (== t 0)
      (call conn_refl e2 (idx p 0))
      (block
        (call walk_lift e1 e2 p (- t 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set e1 (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t)))
        (assert (edges_connected e2 (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t)))
        (call conn_trans e2 (idx p 0) (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t))))))
(lemma conn_lift_at
  (params (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (step_conn e1 e2) (edges_connected e1 a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges e1 p)))
    (call walk_lift e1 e2 p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma span_lift_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g e1) (step_conn e1 e2) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected e1 u v))
    (call conn_lift_at e1 e2 u v)))
(lemma spanning_lift
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning g e1) (step_conn e1 e2))
  (ensures (is_spanning g e2))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_lift_at g e1 e2 u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g e2))))
(lemma edge_prefix_conn
  (params (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_prefix e1 e2) (edge_in_set e1 x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len e1))) (same_ends (idx e1 c) x y)))
    (assert (== (idx e2 c) (idx e1 c)))
    (call edge_from_entry e2 c x y)
    (call conn_of_edge e2 x y)))
(lemma conn_prefix
  (params (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_prefix e1 e2) (edges_connected e1 a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 a b))
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call edge_prefix_conn e1 e2 x y))
    (assert (step_conn e1 e2))
    (call conn_lift_at e1 e2 a b)))
(lemma first_cross_from
  (params (pos (seq int)) (k int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (outside_upto pos k p m) (in_s pos k (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (exists ((t int)) (and (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len p) 1)))
                                  (and (outside_upto pos k p t) (in_s pos k (idx p (+ t 1)))))))
  (decreases (- (len p) m))
  (body
    (assert (not (in_s pos k (idx p m))))
    (assert (!= m (- (len p) 1)))
    (if (in_s pos k (idx p (+ m 1)))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (- (len p) 1)))
                   (and (outside_upto pos k p m) (in_s pos k (idx p (+ m 1))))))
      (block
        (assert (outside_upto pos k p (+ m 1)))
        (call first_cross_from pos k p (+ m 1))))))
(lemma lift_edge
  (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))) (edge_in_set (concat a o) x y) (not (same_ends (idx o i) x y)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (h_new a t1 o i) x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat a o))
    (ghost-let hn (seq (tuple int int int)) (h_new a t1 o i))
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len h))) (same_ends (idx h c) x y)))
    (assert (== (len (rem_at o i)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (len hn) (+ (len a) (len o))))
    (if (< c (len a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx h c) (idx a c)))
        (assert (== (idx hn c) (idx a c)))
        (call edge_from_entry hn c x y))
      (block
        (ghost-let l int (- c (len a)))
        (assert (== (idx h c) (idx o l)))
        (assert (!= l i))
        (if (< l i)
          (block
            (assert (== (idx hn (+ (+ (len a) 1) l)) (idx o l)))
            (call edge_from_entry hn (+ (+ (len a) 1) l) x y))
          (block
            (assert (== (idx hn (+ (len a) l)) (idx o l)))
            (call edge_from_entry hn (+ (len a) l) x y)))))))
(lemma exch_edge
  (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (zz int) (yy int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))) (same_ends (idx o i) zz yy)
            (edges_connected (h_new a t1 o i) zz yy) (edge_in_set (concat a o) x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (h_new a t1 o i) x y))
  (body
    (if (same_ends (idx o i) x y)
      (if (and (== x zz) (== y yy))
        (block)
        (block
          (assert (and (== x yy) (== y zz)))
          (call conn_sym (h_new a t1 o i) zz yy)))
      (block
        (call lift_edge a t1 o i x y)
        (call conn_of_edge (h_new a t1 o i) x y)))))
(lemma prefix_lift
  (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int)
          (pos (seq int)) (k int) (zz int) (yy int) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))) (same_ends (idx o i) zz yy) (in_s pos k zz) (not (in_s pos k yy))
            (path_follows_edges (concat a o) p) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))) (outside_upto pos k p t))
  (ensures (edges_connected (h_new a t1 o i) (idx p 0) (idx p t)))
  (decreases t)
  (body
    (if (== t 0)
      (call conn_refl (h_new a t1 o i) (idx p 0))
      (block
        (assert (outside_upto pos k p (- t 1)))
        (call prefix_lift a t1 o i pos k zz yy p (- t 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set (concat a o) (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t)))
        (assert (not (in_s pos k (idx p (- t 1)))))
        (assert (not (in_s pos k (idx p t))))
        (assert (not (same_ends (idx o i) (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t))))
        (call lift_edge a t1 o i (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t))
        (call conn_of_edge (h_new a t1 o i) (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t))
        (call conn_trans (h_new a t1 o i) (idx p 0) (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t))))))
(lemma prefix_h_new
  (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))))
  (ensures (is_prefix a (h_new a t1 o i)) (== (len (h_new a t1 o i)) (+ (len a) (len o))) (== (idx (h_new a t1 o i) (len a)) t1))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (rem_at o i)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (len (h_new a t1 o i)) (+ (len a) (len o))))
    (assert (== (idx (h_new a t1 o i) (len a)) t1))
    (assert (is_prefix a (h_new a t1 o i)))))
(lemma tw_concat
  (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat s r)) (+ (total_weight s) (total_weight r))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat s r) r))
        (assert (== (total_weight s) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (concat s r)) (+ (len s) (len r))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat s r) 0) (idx s 0)))
        (assert (== (drop (concat s r) 1) (concat (drop s 1) r)))
        (call tw_concat (drop s 1) r)
        (assert (== (total_weight (concat s r)) (+ (get (idx (concat s r) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (concat s r) 1)))))
        (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))))))
(lemma tw_unit_cons
  (params (t1 (tuple int int int)) (d (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat (seq-lit t1) d)) (+ (get t1 2) (total_weight d))))
  (body
    (ghost-let x (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (seq-lit t1) d))
    (assert (== (len x) (+ 1 (len d))))
    (assert (== (idx x 0) t1))
    (assert (== (drop x 1) d))
    (assert (== (total_weight x) (+ (get (idx x 0) 2) (total_weight (drop x 1)))))))
(lemma tw_rem
  (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight o) (+ (get (idx o i) 2) (total_weight (rem_at o i)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let d (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop o (+ i 1)))
    (assert (== o (concat (take o i) (concat (seq-lit (idx o i)) d))))
    (call tw_concat (take o i) (concat (seq-lit (idx o i)) d))
    (call tw_unit_cons (idx o i) d)
    (call tw_concat (take o i) d)
    (assert (== (rem_at o i) (concat (take o i) d)))))
(lemma rem_valid_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (m int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len (rem_at o i)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (rem_at o i) m) 0) (get (idx (rem_at o i) m) 1) (get (idx (rem_at o i) m) 2)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (rem_at o i)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (if (< m i)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (rem_at o i) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o m) 0) (get (idx o m) 1) (get (idx o m) 2))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (rem_at o i) m) (idx o (+ m 1))))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o (+ m 1)) 0) (get (idx o (+ m 1)) 1) (get (idx o (+ m 1)) 2)))))))
(lemma rem_valid
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (rem_at o i)))
  (body
    (forall ((m int)) (call rem_valid_at g o i m))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g (rem_at o i)))))
(lemma cut_conn
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (verts_ok es pos) (steps_ok g es pos) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len es))) (in_s pos j x))
  (ensures (edges_connected (take es j) 0 x))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (assert (vert_ok es pos x))
    (if (== j 0)
      (block
        (assert (== x 0))
        (call conn_refl (take es 0) 0))
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (- j 1))
        (assert (== (len (take es j)) j))
        (assert (== (len (take es m)) m))
        (assert (is_prefix (take es m) (take es j)))
        (if (in_s pos m x)
          (block
            (call cut_conn g es pos m x)
            (call conn_prefix (take es m) (take es j) 0 x))
          (block
            (assert (== (idx pos x) j))
            (ghost-let t1 (tuple int int int) (idx es m))
            (assert (good_step g pos m t1))
            (assert (or (== x (get t1 0)) (== x (get t1 1))))
            (ghost-let w0 int (if (== x (get t1 0)) (get t1 1) (get t1 0)))
            (assert (in_s pos m w0))
            (assert (same_ends t1 w0 x))
            (call cut_conn g es pos m w0)

(lemma prefix_inside
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (j int) (c int))
  (requires (steps_ok g es pos) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len es))) (<= 0 c))
  (ensures (=> (< c j) (and (in_s pos j (get (idx es c) 0)) (in_s pos j (get (idx es c) 1)))))

    (if (< c j)

(lemma exch_exists
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (j int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (verts_ok es pos) (steps_ok g es pos) (== (len pos) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len es)))
            (are_valid_edges g o)
            (is_spanning g (concat (take es j) o)))
  (ensures (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o)))
                                  (and (<= (get (idx es j) 2) (get (idx o i) 2))
                                       (is_spanning g (h_new (take es j) (idx es j) o i))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (take es j))
    (ghost-let t1 (tuple int int int) (idx es j))
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat a0 o))
    (assert (== (len a0) j))
    (assert (good_step g pos j t1))
    (ghost-let ia int (if (in_s pos j (get t1 0)) (get t1 0) (get t1 1)))
    (ghost-let ib int (if (in_s pos j (get t1 0)) (get t1 1) (get t1 0)))
    (assert (in_s pos j ia))
    (assert (not (in_s pos j ib)))
    (assert (same_ends t1 ia ib))
    (assert (in_s pos (+ j 1) ib))
    (assert (in_s pos (+ j 1) ia))
    (assert (and (<= 0 ib) (< ib (len g))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 ia) (< ia (len g))))
    (assert (edges_connected h ib ia))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) ib) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) ia))) (path_follows_edges h p)))
    (assert (outside_upto pos j p 0))
    (assert (in_s pos j (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (call first_cross_from pos j p 0)
    (obtain ((t int)) (and (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len p) 1)))
                           (and (outside_upto pos j p t) (in_s pos j (idx p (+ t 1))))))
    (ghost-let yo int (idx p t))
    (ghost-let zo int (idx p (+ t 1)))
    (assert (not (in_s pos j yo)))
    (assert (in_s pos j zo))
    (assert (edge_in_set h yo zo))
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len h))) (same_ends (idx h c) yo zo)))
    (call prefix_inside g es pos j c)
    (assert (=> (< c j) (== (idx h c) (idx es c))))
    (assert (>= c j))
    (ghost-let i0 int (- c j))
    (assert (== (idx h c) (idx o i0)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len o))))
    (assert (same_ends (idx o i0) yo zo))
    (assert (same_ends (idx o i0) zo yo))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o i0) 0) (get (idx o i0) 1) (get (idx o i0) 2)))
    (assert (crossing pos j (get (idx o i0) 0) (get (idx o i0) 1)))
    (assert (<= (get t1 2) (get (idx o i0) 2)))
    (ghost-let hn (seq (tuple int int int)) (h_new a0 t1 o i0))
    (call prefix_lift a0 t1 o i0 pos j zo yo p t)
    (assert (edges_connected hn ib yo))
    (call prefix_h_new a0 t1 o i0)
    (call cut_conn g es pos j zo)
    (call cut_conn g es pos j ia)
    (call conn_prefix a0 hn 0 zo)
    (call conn_prefix a0 hn 0 ia)
    (call conn_sym hn 0 zo)
    (call conn_trans hn zo 0 ia)
    (assert (== (idx hn j) t1))
    (call edge_from_entry hn j ia ib)
    (call conn_of_edge hn ia ib)
    (call conn_trans hn zo ia ib)
    (call conn_trans hn zo ib yo)
    (forall ((x1 int) (y1 int)) (call exch_edge a0 t1 o i0 zo yo x1 y1))
    (assert (step_conn h hn))
    (call spanning_lift g h hn)
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len o)))
                 (and (<= (get (idx es j) 2) (get (idx o i0) 2))
                      (is_spanning g (h_new (take es j) (idx es j) o i0)))))))
(lemma opt_ind
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (j int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (verts_ok es pos) (steps_ok g es pos) (== (len pos) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len es)))
            (== (len o) (- (len es) j))
            (are_valid_edges g o)
            (is_spanning g (concat (take es j) o)))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight (drop es j)) (total_weight o)))
  (decreases (- (len es) j))
  (body
    (if (== j (len es))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (drop es j)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop es j)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight o) 0)))
      (block
        (call exch_exists g es pos j o)
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o)))
                               (and (<= (get (idx es j) 2) (get (idx o i) 2))
                                    (is_spanning g (h_new (take es j) (idx es j) o i)))))
        (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rem_at o i))
        (assert (== (take es (+ j 1)) (concat (take es j) (seq-lit (idx es j)))))
        (assert (== (h_new (take es j) (idx es j) o i) (concat (take es (+ j 1)) r)))
        (assert (is_spanning g (concat (take es (+ j 1)) r)))
        (assert (== (len r) (- (len o) 1)))
        (call rem_valid g o i)
        (call opt_ind g es pos (+ j 1) r)
        (call tw_rem o i)
        (assert (== (len (drop es j)) (- (len es) j)))
        (assert (== (idx (drop es j) 0) (idx es j)))
        (assert (== (drop (drop es j) 1) (drop es (+ j 1))))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop es j)) (+ (get (idx (drop es j) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (drop es j) 1)))))))))
(lemma mst_other
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (verts_ok es pos) (steps_ok g es pos) (== (len pos) (len g)) (== (len es) (- (len g) 1)) (is_spanning_tree g other))

    (assert (== (concat (take es 0) other) other))
    (assert (== (drop es 0) es))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g other))
    (assert (is_spanning g other))
    (assert (is_spanning g (concat (take es 0) other)))
    (assert (== (len other) (- (len es) 0)))
    (call opt_ind g es pos 0 other)))
(lemma cnt_le
  (params (pos (seq int)) (k int) (m int))

  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (assert (== (cnt pos k 0) 0))
      (block
        (call cnt_le pos k (- m 1))
        (assert (== (cnt pos k m) (+ (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k) 1 0))))))))
(lemma cnt_full
  (params (pos (seq int)) (k int) (m int) (x int))

  (ensures (<= (idx pos x) k))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (== (cnt pos k m) (+ (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k) 1 0))))
    (call cnt_le pos k (- m 1))
    (assert (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k))
    (assert (== (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (- m 1)))
    (if (== x (- m 1))
      (block)
      (call cnt_full pos k (- m 1) x))))
(lemma cnt_gap
  (params (pos (seq int)) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len pos))) (< (cnt pos k m) m))
  (ensures (exists ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)) (> (idx pos x) k))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (> m 0))
    (assert (== (cnt pos k m) (+ (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k) 1 0))))
    (if (> (idx pos (- m 1)) k)
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- m 1)) (< (- m 1) m)) (> (idx pos (- m 1)) k)))
      (call cnt_gap pos k (- m 1)))))
(lemma cnt_step
  (params (pos (seq int)) (pos2 (seq int)) (k int) (nv int) (m int))
  (requires (== (len pos2) (len pos))
            (and (<= 0 nv) (< nv (len pos)))
            (> (idx pos nv) k) (== (idx pos2 nv) (+ k 1))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))) (!= x nv))
                                  (== (<= (idx pos2 x) (+ k 1)) (<= (idx pos x) k))))
            (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len pos))))
  (ensures (== (cnt pos2 (+ k 1) m) (+ (cnt pos k m) (if (< nv m) 1 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (cnt pos2 (+ k 1) 0) 0))
        (assert (== (cnt pos k 0) 0)))
      (block
        (call cnt_step pos pos2 k nv (- m 1))
        (assert (== (cnt pos2 (+ k 1) m) (+ (cnt pos2 (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos2 (- m 1)) (+ k 1)) 1 0))))
        (assert (== (cnt pos k m) (+ (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k) 1 0))))))))
(lemma cnt_init
  (params (pos (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (> (len pos) 0)
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))) (== (<= (idx pos x) 0) (== x 0))))
            (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len pos))))
  (ensures (== (cnt pos 0 m) (if (== m 0) 0 1)))
  (decreases m)

      (assert (== (cnt pos 0 0) 0))

        (call cnt_init pos (- m 1))

        (assert (== (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) 0) (== (- m 1) 0)))))))
(lemma tree_spans_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (verts_ok es pos) (steps_ok g es pos) (== (len pos) (len g))
            (== (cnt pos (len es) (len pos)) (len pos))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u v))
  (body
    (call cnt_full pos (len es) (len pos) u)
    (call cnt_full pos (len es) (len pos) v)
    (assert (in_s pos (len es) u))
    (assert (in_s pos (len es) v))

    (call cut_conn g es pos (len es) v)

    (assert (edges_connected es 0 v))

  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)))

  (ensures (is_mst g es))

    (assert (is_spanning g es))

(lemma cross_exists_lemma
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (pos (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (== (len pos) (len g)) (> (len pos) 0) (<= (idx pos 0) k)

  (ensures (cross_exists_p g pos k))

    (call cnt_gap pos k (len pos))
    (obtain ((x0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 x0) (< x0 (len pos))) (> (idx pos x0) k)))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g x0 0))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) 0))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert (not (in_s pos k x0)))

    (assert (cross_exists_p g pos k))))

    (call walk_lift e1 e2 p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma span_lift_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g e1) (step_conn e1 e2) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected e1 u v))
    (call conn_lift_at e1 e2 u v)))
(lemma spanning_lift
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning g e1) (step_conn e1 e2))
  (ensures (is_spanning g e2))

    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_lift_at g e1 e2 u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g e2))))
(lemma edge_prefix_conn
  (params (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_prefix e1 e2) (edge_in_set e1 x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len e1))) (same_ends (idx e1 c) x y)))
    (assert (== (idx e2 c) (idx e1 c)))
    (call edge_from_entry e2 c x y)
    (call conn_of_edge e2 x y)))
(lemma conn_prefix
  (params (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_prefix e1 e2) (edges_connected e1 a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 a b))

    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call edge_prefix_conn e1 e2 x y))

    (call conn_lift_at e1 e2 a b)))
(lemma first_cross_from
  (params (pos (seq int)) (k int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (outside_upto pos k p m) (in_s pos k (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (exists ((t int)) (and (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len p) 1)))
                                  (and (outside_upto pos k p t) (in_s pos k (idx p (+ t 1)))))))
  (decreases (- (len p) m))
  (body
    (assert (not (in_s pos k (idx p m))))
    (assert (!= m (- (len p) 1)))
    (if (in_s pos k (idx p (+ m 1)))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 m) (< m (- (len p) 1)))
                   (and (outside_upto pos k p m) (in_s pos k (idx p (+ m 1))))))
      (block
        (assert (outside_upto pos k p (+ m 1)))
        (call first_cross_from pos k p (+ m 1))))))
(lemma lift_edge
  (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))) (edge_in_set (concat a o) x y) (not (same_ends (idx o i) x y)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (h_new a t1 o i) x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat a o))
    (ghost-let hn (seq (tuple int int int)) (h_new a t1 o i))
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len h))) (same_ends (idx h c) x y)))
    (assert (== (len (rem_at o i)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (len hn) (+ (len a) (len o))))
    (if (< c (len a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx h c) (idx a c)))
        (assert (== (idx hn c) (idx a c)))
        (call edge_from_entry hn c x y))
      (block
        (ghost-let l int (- c (len a)))
        (assert (== (idx h c) (idx o l)))
        (assert (!= l i))
        (if (< l i)
          (block
            (assert (== (idx hn (+ (+ (len a) 1) l)) (idx o l)))
            (call edge_from_entry hn (+ (+ (len a) 1) l) x y))
          (block
            (assert (== (idx hn (+ (len a) l)) (idx o l)))
            (call edge_from_entry hn (+ (len a) l) x y)))))))
(lemma exch_edge
  (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (zz int) (yy int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))) (same_ends (idx o i) zz yy)
            (edges_connected (h_new a t1 o i) zz yy) (edge_in_set (concat a o) x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (h_new a t1 o i) x y))
  (body
    (if (same_ends (idx o i) x y)
      (if (and (== x zz) (== y yy))
        (block)
        (block
          (assert (and (== x yy) (== y zz)))
          (call conn_sym (h_new a t1 o i) zz yy)))
      (block
        (call lift_edge a t1 o i x y)
        (call conn_of_edge (h_new a t1 o i) x y)))))
(lemma prefix_lift
  (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int)
          (pos (seq int)) (k int) (zz int) (yy int) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))) (same_ends (idx o i) zz yy) (in_s pos k zz) (not (in_s pos k yy))
            (path_follows_edges (concat a o) p) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))) (outside_upto pos k p t))
  (ensures (edges_connected (h_new a t1 o i) (idx p 0) (idx p t)))
  (decreases t)
  (body
    (if (== t 0)
      (call conn_refl (h_new a t1 o i) (idx p 0))
      (block
        (assert (outside_upto pos k p (- t 1)))
        (call prefix_lift a t1 o i pos k zz yy p (- t 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set (concat a o) (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t)))
        (assert (not (in_s pos k (idx p (- t 1)))))
        (assert (not (in_s pos k (idx p t))))
        (assert (not (same_ends (idx o i) (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t))))
        (call lift_edge a t1 o i (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t))
        (call conn_of_edge (h_new a t1 o i) (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t))
        (call conn_trans (h_new a t1 o i) (idx p 0) (idx p (- t 1)) (idx p t))))))
(lemma prefix_h_new
  (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))))
  (ensures (is_prefix a (h_new a t1 o i)) (== (len (h_new a t1 o i)) (+ (len a) (len o))) (== (idx (h_new a t1 o i) (len a)) t1))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (rem_at o i)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (len (h_new a t1 o i)) (+ (len a) (len o))))
    (assert (== (idx (h_new a t1 o i) (len a)) t1))
    (assert (is_prefix a (h_new a t1 o i)))))
(lemma tw_concat
  (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat s r)) (+ (total_weight s) (total_weight r))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat s r) r))
        (assert (== (total_weight s) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (concat s r)) (+ (len s) (len r))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat s r) 0) (idx s 0)))
        (assert (== (drop (concat s r) 1) (concat (drop s 1) r)))
        (call tw_concat (drop s 1) r)
        (assert (== (total_weight (concat s r)) (+ (get (idx (concat s r) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (concat s r) 1)))))
        (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))))))
(lemma tw_unit_cons
  (params (t1 (tuple int int int)) (d (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat (seq-lit t1) d)) (+ (get t1 2) (total_weight d))))
  (body
    (ghost-let x (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (seq-lit t1) d))
    (assert (== (len x) (+ 1 (len d))))
    (assert (== (idx x 0) t1))
    (assert (== (drop x 1) d))
    (assert (== (total_weight x) (+ (get (idx x 0) 2) (total_weight (drop x 1)))))))
(lemma tw_rem
  (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight o) (+ (get (idx o i) 2) (total_weight (rem_at o i)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let d (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop o (+ i 1)))
    (assert (== o (concat (take o i) (concat (seq-lit (idx o i)) d))))
    (call tw_concat (take o i) (concat (seq-lit (idx o i)) d))
    (call tw_unit_cons (idx o i) d)
    (call tw_concat (take o i) d)
    (assert (== (rem_at o i) (concat (take o i) d)))))
(lemma rem_valid_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (m int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len (rem_at o i)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (rem_at o i) m) 0) (get (idx (rem_at o i) m) 1) (get (idx (rem_at o i) m) 2)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (rem_at o i)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (if (< m i)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (rem_at o i) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o m) 0) (get (idx o m) 1) (get (idx o m) 2))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (rem_at o i) m) (idx o (+ m 1))))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o (+ m 1)) 0) (get (idx o (+ m 1)) 1) (get (idx o (+ m 1)) 2)))))))
(lemma rem_valid
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (rem_at o i)))
  (body
    (forall ((m int)) (call rem_valid_at g o i m))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g (rem_at o i)))))
(lemma cut_conn
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (verts_ok es pos) (steps_ok g es pos) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len es))) (in_s pos j x))
  (ensures (edges_connected (take es j) 0 x))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (assert (vert_ok es pos x))
    (if (== j 0)
      (block
        (assert (== x 0))
        (call conn_refl (take es 0) 0))
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (- j 1))
        (assert (== (len (take es j)) j))
        (assert (== (len (take es m)) m))
        (assert (is_prefix (take es m) (take es j)))
        (if (in_s pos m x)
          (block
            (call cut_conn g es pos m x)
            (call conn_prefix (take es m) (take es j) 0 x))
          (block
            (assert (== (idx pos x) j))
            (ghost-let t1 (tuple int int int) (idx es m))
            (assert (good_step g pos m t1))
            (assert (or (== x (get t1 0)) (== x (get t1 1))))
            (ghost-let w0 int (if (== x (get t1 0)) (get t1 1) (get t1 0)))
            (assert (in_s pos m w0))
            (assert (same_ends t1 w0 x))
            (call cut_conn g es pos m w0)
            (call conn_prefix (take es m) (take es j) 0 w0)
            (assert (== (idx (take es j) m) t1))
            (call edge_from_entry (take es j) m w0 x)
            (call conn_of_edge (take es j) w0 x)
            (call conn_trans (take es j) 0 w0 x)))))))
(lemma prefix_inside
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (j int) (c int))
  (requires (steps_ok g es pos) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len es))) (<= 0 c))
  (ensures (=> (< c j) (and (in_s pos j (get (idx es c) 0)) (in_s pos j (get (idx es c) 1)))))
  (body
    (if (< c j)
      (block
        (assert (good_step g pos c (idx es c)))
        (assert (in_s pos (+ c 1) (get (idx es c) 0)))
        (assert (in_s pos (+ c 1) (get (idx es c) 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma exch_exists
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (j int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (verts_ok es pos) (steps_ok g es pos) (== (len pos) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len es)))
            (are_valid_edges g o)
            (is_spanning g (concat (take es j) o)))
  (ensures (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o)))
                                  (and (<= (get (idx es j) 2) (get (idx o i) 2))
                                       (is_spanning g (h_new (take es j) (idx es j) o i))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (take es j))
    (ghost-let t1 (tuple int int int) (idx es j))
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat a0 o))
    (assert (== (len a0) j))
    (assert (good_step g pos j t1))
    (ghost-let ia int (if (in_s pos j (get t1 0)) (get t1 0) (get t1 1)))
    (ghost-let ib int (if (in_s pos j (get t1 0)) (get t1 1) (get t1 0)))
    (assert (in_s pos j ia))
    (assert (not (in_s pos j ib)))
    (assert (same_ends t1 ia ib))
    (assert (in_s pos (+ j 1) ib))
    (assert (in_s pos (+ j 1) ia))
    (assert (and (<= 0 ib) (< ib (len g))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 ia) (< ia (len g))))
    (assert (edges_connected h ib ia))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) ib) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) ia))) (path_follows_edges h p)))
    (assert (outside_upto pos j p 0))
    (assert (in_s pos j (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (call first_cross_from pos j p 0)
    (obtain ((t int)) (and (and (<= 0 t) (< t (- (len p) 1)))
                           (and (outside_upto pos j p t) (in_s pos j (idx p (+ t 1))))))
    (ghost-let yo int (idx p t))
    (ghost-let zo int (idx p (+ t 1)))
    (assert (not (in_s pos j yo)))
    (assert (in_s pos j zo))
    (assert (edge_in_set h yo zo))
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len h))) (same_ends (idx h c) yo zo)))
    (call prefix_inside g es pos j c)
    (assert (=> (< c j) (== (idx h c) (idx es c))))
    (assert (>= c j))
    (ghost-let i0 int (- c j))
    (assert (== (idx h c) (idx o i0)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len o))))
    (assert (same_ends (idx o i0) yo zo))
    (assert (same_ends (idx o i0) zo yo))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o i0) 0) (get (idx o i0) 1) (get (idx o i0) 2)))
    (assert (crossing pos j (get (idx o i0) 0) (get (idx o i0) 1)))
    (assert (<= (get t1 2) (get (idx o i0) 2)))
    (ghost-let hn (seq (tuple int int int)) (h_new a0 t1 o i0))
    (call prefix_lift a0 t1 o i0 pos j zo yo p t)
    (assert (edges_connected hn ib yo))
    (call prefix_h_new a0 t1 o i0)
    (call cut_conn g es pos j zo)
    (call cut_conn g es pos j ia)
    (call conn_prefix a0 hn 0 zo)
    (call conn_prefix a0 hn 0 ia)
    (call conn_sym hn 0 zo)
    (call conn_trans hn zo 0 ia)
    (assert (== (idx hn j) t1))
    (call edge_from_entry hn j ia ib)
    (call conn_of_edge hn ia ib)
    (call conn_trans hn zo ia ib)
    (call conn_trans hn zo ib yo)
    (forall ((x1 int) (y1 int)) (call exch_edge a0 t1 o i0 zo yo x1 y1))
    (assert (step_conn h hn))
    (call spanning_lift g h hn)
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len o)))
                 (and (<= (get (idx es j) 2) (get (idx o i0) 2))
                      (is_spanning g (h_new (take es j) (idx es j) o i0)))))))
(lemma opt_ind
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (j int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (verts_ok es pos) (steps_ok g es pos) (== (len pos) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len es)))
            (== (len o) (- (len es) j))
            (are_valid_edges g o)
            (is_spanning g (concat (take es j) o)))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight (drop es j)) (total_weight o)))
  (decreases (- (len es) j))
  (body
    (if (== j (len es))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (drop es j)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop es j)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight o) 0)))
      (block
        (call exch_exists g es pos j o)
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o)))
                               (and (<= (get (idx es j) 2) (get (idx o i) 2))
                                    (is_spanning g (h_new (take es j) (idx es j) o i)))))
        (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (rem_at o i))
        (assert (== (take es (+ j 1)) (concat (take es j) (seq-lit (idx es j)))))
        (assert (== (h_new (take es j) (idx es j) o i) (concat (take es (+ j 1)) r)))
        (assert (is_spanning g (concat (take es (+ j 1)) r)))
        (assert (== (len r) (- (len o) 1)))
        (call rem_valid g o i)
        (call opt_ind g es pos (+ j 1) r)
        (call tw_rem o i)
        (assert (== (len (drop es j)) (- (len es) j)))
        (assert (== (idx (drop es j) 0) (idx es j)))
        (assert (== (drop (drop es j) 1) (drop es (+ j 1))))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop es j)) (+ (get (idx (drop es j) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (drop es j) 1)))))))))
(lemma mst_other
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (verts_ok es pos) (steps_ok g es pos) (== (len pos) (len g)) (== (len es) (- (len g) 1)) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight es) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (take es 0)) 0))
    (assert (== (concat (take es 0) other) other))
    (assert (== (drop es 0) es))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g other))
    (assert (is_spanning g other))
    (assert (is_spanning g (concat (take es 0) other)))
    (assert (== (len other) (- (len es) 0)))
    (call opt_ind g es pos 0 other)))
(lemma cnt_le
  (params (pos (seq int)) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len pos))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (cnt pos k m)) (<= (cnt pos k m) m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (assert (== (cnt pos k 0) 0))
      (block
        (call cnt_le pos k (- m 1))
        (assert (== (cnt pos k m) (+ (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k) 1 0))))))))
(lemma cnt_full
  (params (pos (seq int)) (k int) (m int) (x int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len pos))) (== (cnt pos k m) m) (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)))
  (ensures (<= (idx pos x) k))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (== (cnt pos k m) (+ (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k) 1 0))))
    (call cnt_le pos k (- m 1))
    (assert (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k))
    (assert (== (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (- m 1)))
    (if (== x (- m 1))
      (block)
      (call cnt_full pos k (- m 1) x))))
(lemma cnt_gap
  (params (pos (seq int)) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len pos))) (< (cnt pos k m) m))
  (ensures (exists ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)) (> (idx pos x) k))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (assert (> m 0))
    (assert (== (cnt pos k m) (+ (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k) 1 0))))
    (if (> (idx pos (- m 1)) k)
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- m 1)) (< (- m 1) m)) (> (idx pos (- m 1)) k)))
      (call cnt_gap pos k (- m 1)))))
(lemma cnt_step
  (params (pos (seq int)) (pos2 (seq int)) (k int) (nv int) (m int))
  (requires (== (len pos2) (len pos))
            (and (<= 0 nv) (< nv (len pos)))
            (> (idx pos nv) k) (== (idx pos2 nv) (+ k 1))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))) (!= x nv))
                                  (== (<= (idx pos2 x) (+ k 1)) (<= (idx pos x) k))))
            (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len pos))))
  (ensures (== (cnt pos2 (+ k 1) m) (+ (cnt pos k m) (if (< nv m) 1 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (cnt pos2 (+ k 1) 0) 0))
        (assert (== (cnt pos k 0) 0)))
      (block
        (call cnt_step pos pos2 k nv (- m 1))
        (assert (== (cnt pos2 (+ k 1) m) (+ (cnt pos2 (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos2 (- m 1)) (+ k 1)) 1 0))))
        (assert (== (cnt pos k m) (+ (cnt pos k (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) k) 1 0))))))))
(lemma cnt_init
  (params (pos (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (> (len pos) 0)
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len pos))) (== (<= (idx pos x) 0) (== x 0))))
            (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len pos))))
  (ensures (== (cnt pos 0 m) (if (== m 0) 0 1)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (assert (== (cnt pos 0 0) 0))
      (block
        (call cnt_init pos (- m 1))
        (assert (== (cnt pos 0 m) (+ (cnt pos 0 (- m 1)) (if (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) 0) 1 0))))
        (assert (== (<= (idx pos (- m 1)) 0) (== (- m 1) 0)))))))
(lemma tree_spans_at
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (pos (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (verts_ok es pos) (steps_ok g es pos) (== (len pos) (len g))
            (== (cnt pos (len es) (len pos)) (len pos))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u v))
  (body
    (call cnt_full pos (len es) (len pos) u)
    (call cnt_full pos (len es) (len pos) v)
    (assert (in_s pos (len es) u))
    (assert (in_s pos (len es) v))
    (assert (== (take es (len es)) es))
    (call cut_conn g es pos (len es) u)

(spec scan_arcs
  (params (nbrs (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (t (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (found bool) (bu i64) (bv i64) (bw i64))
  (requires (targets_ok nbrs) (== (len t) (len nbrs)))
  (ensures (scan_post nbrs t found bu bv bw))
  (effects))
(def scan_arcs
  (body
    (let-mut found bool false)
    (let-mut bu i64 0)
    (let-mut bv i64 0)
    (let-mut bw i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u (len nbrs))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u (len nbrs))))
      (invariant (scanned nbrs t u 0 found bw))
      (invariant (=> found (and (has_edge nbrs bu bv bw) (cross_arc t bu bv))))
      (decreases (- (len nbrs) u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx nbrs u)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len nbrs))))
        (invariant (== deg (len (idx nbrs u))))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (scanned nbrs t u i found bw))
        (invariant (=> found (and (has_edge nbrs bu bv bw) (cross_arc t bu bv))))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx nbrs u) i) 0))
        (let w i64 (get (idx (idx nbrs u) i) 1))
        (assert (targets_ok nbrs))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len nbrs))))
        (assert (== (cross_arc t u v) (!= (idx t u) (idx t v))))
        (if (and (!= (idx t u) (idx t v)) (or (not found) (< w bw)))
          (block
            (call arc_has_edge nbrs u i)
            (call scan_next nbrs t u i found bw true w)
            (set found true)
            (set bu u)
            (set bv v)
            (set bw w))
          (call scan_next nbrs t u i found bw found bw))
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call scan_row nbrs t u found bw)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (return found bu bv bw)))
(def prim_mst

    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call wf_targets graph)
    (assert (graph_is_connected g))
    (assert (> (size graph) 0))
    (match graph
      (case (weighted_graph nbrs)
        (block
          (assert (== g nbrs))
          (assert (> (len nbrs) 0))
          (assert (targets_ok nbrs))
          (let n i64 (len nbrs))
          (let-mut t (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (q) (== q 0))))
          (let-mut edges (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
          (assert (root_only t))
          (call init_state g t edges)
          (while (< (len edges) (- n 1))
            (invariant (and (== g nbrs) (targets_ok nbrs)))
            (invariant (graph_is_connected g))
            (invariant (and (> n 0) (== n (len g))))
            (invariant (== (len t) n))
            (invariant (<= (len edges) (- n 1)))
            (invariant (tree_state g t edges))
            (decreases (- (- n 1) (len edges)))
            (let ((found bool) (bu i64) (bv i64) (bw i64)) (call scan_arcs (borrow nbrs) (borrow t)))
            (ghost-let t0 (seq bool) t)
            (ghost-let tr0 (seq (tuple int int int)) edges)
            (assert (scan_post g t0 found bu bv bw))
            (assert (< (len tr0) (- (len g) 1)))
            (call scan_found g t0 tr0 found bu bv bw)

        (assert (== (get (idx o j) 1) y))

        (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (edge_idx (upd o j e) m x y))

(lemma refines_upd (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))

(lemma valid_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))

(lemma tree_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))

            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))

    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (call valid_upd g o j e)
    (call refines_upd o j e)

(lemma tw_drop_zero_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (> (len o) 0) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len o) 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx (drop (upd o 0 e) 1) i) (idx (drop o 1) i)))

    (assert (== (len (upd o 0 e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (idx (drop (upd o 0 e) 1) i) (idx (upd o 0 e) (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (upd o 0 e) (+ i 1)) (idx o (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop o 1) i) (idx o (+ i 1))))))
(lemma tw_drop_succ_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)) (i int))

  (ensures (== (idx (drop (upd o j e) 1) i) (idx (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e) i)))

    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (len (drop o 1)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (len (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (drop (upd o j e) 1) i) (idx (upd o j e) (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop o 1) i) (idx o (+ i 1))))
    (if (== i (- j 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) (+ i 1)) e))
        (assert (== (idx (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e) i) e)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) (+ i 1)) (idx o (+ i 1))))

(lemma tw_upd (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (upd o j e)) (+ (- (total_weight o) (get (idx o j) 2)) (get e 2))))
  (decreases (len o))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (total_weight o) (+ (get (idx o 0) 2) (total_weight (drop o 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight (upd o j e)) (+ (get (idx (upd o j e) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (upd o j e) 1)))))
    (assert (== (len (drop o 1)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (len (drop (upd o j e) 1)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (if (== j 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) 0) e))
        (forall ((i int)) (call tw_drop_zero_at o e i))
        (assert (== (drop (upd o 0 e) 1) (drop o 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) 0) (idx o 0)))
        (forall ((i int)) (call tw_drop_succ_at o j e i))
        (assert (== (len (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)) (- (len o) 1)))
        (assert (== (drop (upd o j e) 1) (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)))
        (call tw_upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)
        (assert (== (idx (drop o 1) (- j 1)) (idx o j)))))))
(ghost-fn swap_at ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int)) (seq (tuple int int int))

  (body (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))))
(lemma swap_len (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))

    (assert (== (len (upd o x (idx o y))) (len o)))
    (assert (== (swap_at o x y) (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))))

(lemma swap_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))))
  (ensures (== (idx (swap_at o x y) i) (if (== i y) (idx o x) (if (== i x) (idx o y) (idx o i)))))

    (call swap_len o x y)
    (assert (== (len (upd o x (idx o y))) (len o)))
    (assert (== (swap_at o x y) (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))))
    (assert (== (idx (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x)) i) (if (== i y) (idx o x) (idx (upd o x (idx o y)) i))))
    (assert (== (idx (upd o x (idx o y)) i) (if (== i x) (idx o y) (idx o i))))))
(lemma swap_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o)
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (swap_at o x y) k) 0) (get (idx (swap_at o x y) k) 1) (get (idx (swap_at o x y) k) 2)))

    (call swap_facts o x y k)
    (if (== k y)
      (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o x) 0) (get (idx o x) 1) (get (idx o x) 2)))
      (if (== k x)
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o y) 0) (get (idx o y) 1) (get (idx o y) 2)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))))))
(lemma swap_refine_one (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))

    (call edge_elim o a b)

        (call swap_facts o x y y)

          (call swap_facts o x y x)

          (assert (edge_idx (swap_at o x y) x a b))
          (call edge_intro (swap_at o x y) x a b))
        (block
          (call swap_facts o x y m)
          (assert (== (idx (swap_at o x y) m) (idx o m)))
          (assert (edge_idx (swap_at o x y) m a b))
          (call edge_intro (swap_at o x y) m a b))))
    (call conn_step (swap_at o x y) a b)))
(lemma swap_refines (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o)))))
  (ensures (refines o (swap_at o x y)))

(lemma tree_swap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))

    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (call swap_len o x y)
    (forall ((k int)) (call swap_valid_at g o x y k))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g (swap_at o x y)))

(lemma tw_swap (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o)))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (swap_at o x y)) (total_weight o)))

    (call tw_upd o x (idx o y))

    (call tw_upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))

    (assert (== (swap_at o x y) (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))))))
(ghost-fn has_prefix ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool

(ghost-fn min_cross ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (w int)) bool

(ghost-fn better_ext ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (w int)) bool

(lemma prefix_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int) (i int))
  (requires (has_prefix o tr)
            (and (<= (len tr) j) (< j (len o)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len tr))))
  (ensures (== (idx (swap_at (upd o j e) (len tr) j) i) (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i)))

    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (call swap_facts (upd o j e) (len tr) j i)
    (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) j) e))
    (if (< i (len tr))
      (block
        (assert (has_prefix o tr))
        (assert (== (idx o i) (idx tr i)))
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) i) (idx o i)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) (idx tr i))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (len tr)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) e))))))
(lemma prefix_after (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires (has_prefix o tr) (and (<= (len tr) j) (< j (len o))))

    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (call swap_len (upd o j e) (len tr) j)
    (assert (== (len (concat tr (seq-lit e))) (+ (len tr) 1)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_at o tr e j i))))
(lemma exchange (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g o)
            (has_prefix o tr)
            (< (len tr) (len o))
            (ends_in tr t)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (edge_ends e a b)
            (intree t a)
            (not (intree t b))
            (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
            (min_cross g t (get e 2)))
