    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (edges_connected o a b))
    (call find_good o e t a b)
    (obtain ((j int)) (good_idx o e t j))
    (assert (good_idx o e t j))
    (assert (has_prefix o tr))
    (assert (ends_in tr t))
    (assert (cross_arc t (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
    (if (< j (len tr))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx o j) (idx tr j)))
        (assert (intree t (get (idx tr j) 0)))
        (assert (intree t (get (idx tr j) 1)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (assert (>= j (len tr)))
    (call tree_upd g o j e)
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1) (get (idx o j) 2)))
    (assert (min_cross g t (get e 2)))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get (idx o j) 2)))
    (call tw_upd o j e)
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (call tree_swap g (upd o j e) (len tr) j)
    (call tw_swap (upd o j e) (len tr) j)
    (call prefix_after o tr e j)
    (assert (better_ext g (swap_at (upd o j e) (len tr) j) (concat tr (seq-lit e)) (total_weight o)))))
(ghost-fn all_ext ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool

    (=> (is_spanning_tree g other)

(lemma ext_step_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (all_ext g tr)
            (is_spanning_tree g other)
            (< (len tr) (- (len g) 1))
            (ends_in tr t)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (edge_ends e a b)
            (intree t a)
            (not (intree t b))
            (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
            (min_cross g t (get e 2)))
  (ensures (exists ((ow (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better_ext g ow (concat tr (seq-lit e)) (total_weight other))))
  (body
    (assert (all_ext g tr))
    (assert (exists ((oa (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better_ext g oa tr (total_weight other))))
    (obtain ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better_ext g o tr (total_weight other)))
    (assert (better_ext g o tr (total_weight other)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (== (len o) (- (len g) 1)))

    (assert (better_ext g o3 (concat tr (seq-lit e)) (total_weight other)))))

  (requires (all_ext g tr)
            (< (len tr) (- (len g) 1))
            (ends_in tr t)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (edge_ends e a b)
            (intree t a)
            (not (intree t b))
            (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
            (min_cross g t (get e 2)))

  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_step_one g tr t e a b other))))

  (requires (all_ext g tr) (is_spanning_tree g tr) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight tr) (total_weight other)))

    (assert (all_ext g tr))
    (assert (exists ((oa (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better_ext g oa tr (total_weight other))))
    (obtain ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (better_ext g o tr (total_weight other)))
    (assert (better_ext g o tr (total_weight other)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g tr))

    (assert (has_prefix o tr))
    (assert (== o tr))

  (requires (all_ext g tr) (is_spanning_tree g tr))
  (ensures (is_mst g tr))

    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call final_one g tr other))

  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (decreases k)

  (ensures (<= (cnt s k) k))
  (decreases k)

    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (cnt s 0) 0))
      (block
        (call cnt_le s (- k 1))
        (assert (== (cnt s k) (+ (cnt s (- k 1)) (if (idx s (- k 1)) 1 0))))))))

  (ensures (< (cnt s k) k))
  (decreases k)

    (assert (== (cnt s k) (+ (cnt s (- k 1)) (if (idx s (- k 1)) 1 0))))
    (if (== x (- k 1))
      (call cnt_le s (- k 1))
      (call cnt_miss s (- k 1) x))))

  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))) (< (cnt s k) k))
  (ensures (exists ((xw int)) (and (and (<= 0 xw) (< xw (len s))) (not (idx s xw)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (> k 0))
    (assert (== (cnt s k) (+ (cnt s (- k 1)) (if (idx s (- k 1)) 1 0))))
    (if (idx s (- k 1))
      (call cnt_gap s (- k 1))
      (assert (not (idx s (- k 1)))))))

(lemma cnt_added (params (t (seq bool)) (t1 (seq bool)) (v int) (k int))

            (assert (not (idx t v))))
          (assert (== (idx t1 (- k 1)) (idx t (- k 1)))))))))
(ghost-fn root_only ((s (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s))) (== (idx s x) (== x 0))))))
(lemma cnt_root (params (s (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires (root_only s) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (== (cnt s k) (if (> k 0) 1 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (root_only s))
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (cnt s 0) 0))
      (block
        (call cnt_root s (- k 1))
        (assert (== (cnt s k) (+ (cnt s (- k 1)) (if (idx s (- k 1)) 1 0))))
        (assert (== (idx s (- k 1)) (== (- k 1) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn conn_in ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool))) bool

(lemma conn_init_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (root_only t) (intree t a) (intree t b))

  (body
    (assert (root_only t))
    (assert (== (idx t a) (== a 0)))
    (assert (== (idx t b) (== b 0)))
    (assert (== a 0))
    (assert (== b 0))
    (call conn_refl es 0)))
(lemma conn_init (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq bool)))
  (requires (root_only t))
  (ensures (conn_in es t))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call conn_init_one es t a b))))
(lemma edge_push (params (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set tr x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat tr (seq-lit e)) x y))
  (body
    (call edge_elim tr x y)
    (obtain ((m int)) (edge_idx tr m x y))
    (assert (edge_idx tr m x y))
    (assert (== (len (concat tr (seq-lit e))) (+ (len tr) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) m) (idx tr m)))
    (assert (edge_idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) m x y))
    (call edge_intro (concat tr (seq-lit e)) m x y)))
(lemma refine_push_one (params (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set tr x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat tr (seq-lit e)) x y))
  (body
    (call edge_push tr e x y)
    (call conn_step (concat tr (seq-lit e)) x y)))
(lemma refine_push (params (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (refines tr (concat tr (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call refine_push_one tr e x y))))
(lemma conn_add_one (params (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t (seq bool)) (t1 (seq bool)) (a int) (b int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (conn_in tr t) (added t t1 b) (edge_ends e a b) (intree t a) (not (intree t b))
            (intree t1 x) (intree t1 y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat tr (seq-lit e)) x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let tr1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat tr (seq-lit e)))
    (call refine_push tr e)
    (call intree_added t t1 b x)
    (call intree_added t t1 b y)
    (assert (conn_in tr t))
    (assert (== (len tr1) (+ (len tr) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx tr1 (len tr)) e))
    (assert (edge_ends e a b))
    (assert (edge_idx tr1 (len tr) a b))
    (call edge_intro tr1 (len tr) a b)
    (call conn_step tr1 a b)
    (call conn_sym tr1 a b)
    (if (== x b)
      (if (== y b)
        (call conn_refl tr1 b)
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected tr a y))
          (call conn_mono tr tr1 a y)
          (call conn_trans tr1 b a y)))
      (if (== y b)
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected tr x a))
          (call conn_mono tr tr1 x a)
          (call conn_trans tr1 x a b))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected tr x y))
          (call conn_mono tr tr1 x y))))))
(lemma conn_add (params (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t (seq bool)) (t1 (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (conn_in tr t) (added t t1 b) (edge_ends e a b) (intree t a) (not (intree t b)))
  (ensures (conn_in (concat tr (seq-lit e)) t1))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call conn_add_one tr e t t1 a b x y))))
(lemma ends_push_at (params (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t (seq bool)) (t1 (seq bool)) (a int) (b int) (i int))
  (requires (ends_in tr t) (added t t1 b) (edge_ends e a b) (intree t a)
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ (len tr) 1))))
  (ensures (and (intree t1 (get (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) 0))
                (intree t1 (get (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) 1))))
  (body
    (call intree_added t t1 b a)
    (call intree_added t t1 b b)
    (assert (edge_ends e a b))
    (assert (== (len (concat tr (seq-lit e))) (+ (len tr) 1)))
    (if (< i (len tr))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) (idx tr i)))
        (assert (ends_in tr t))
        (assert (intree t (get (idx tr i) 0)))
        (assert (intree t (get (idx tr i) 1)))
        (call intree_added t t1 b (get (idx tr i) 0))
        (call intree_added t t1 b (get (idx tr i) 1)))
      (assert (== (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) e)))))
(lemma ends_push (params (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t (seq bool)) (t1 (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (ends_in tr t) (added t t1 b) (edge_ends e a b) (intree t a))
  (ensures (ends_in (concat tr (seq-lit e)) t1))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat tr (seq-lit e))) (+ (len tr) 1)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call ends_push_at tr e t t1 a b i))))
(lemma valid_push_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g tr)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (+ (len tr) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g
             (get (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) 0)
             (get (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) 1)
             (get (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) 2)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat tr (seq-lit e))) (+ (len tr) 1)))
    (if (< i (len tr))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) (idx tr i)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx tr i) 0) (get (idx tr i) 1) (get (idx tr i) 2))))
      (assert (== (idx (concat tr (seq-lit e)) i) e)))))
(lemma valid_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g tr) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat tr (seq-lit e))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat tr (seq-lit e))) (+ (len tr) 1)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call valid_push_at g tr e i))))
(ghost-fn tree_state ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (tr (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (and (and (== (len t) (len g)) (intree t 0))
                  (and (are_valid_edges g tr) (ends_in tr t)))
             (and (and (conn_in tr t) (== (cnt t (len t)) (+ (len tr) 1)))
                  (all_ext g tr)))))
(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (root_only t) (== (len t) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (== (len es) 0))
  (ensures (tree_state g t es))
  (body
    (assert (root_only t))
    (assert (== (idx t 0) true))
    (assert (intree t 0))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g es))
    (assert (ends_in es t))
    (call conn_init es t)
    (call cnt_root t (len t))
    (assert (== (cnt t (len t)) (+ (len es) 1)))
    (call ext_init g es)))
(lemma tree_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (t1 (seq bool)) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (tree_state g t tr)
            (< (len tr) (- (len g) 1))
            (added t t1 b)
            (edge_ends e a b)
            (intree t a)
            (not (intree t b))
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (min_cross g t (get e 2))
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))))
  (ensures (tree_state g t1 (concat tr (seq-lit e))))
  (body
    (assert (tree_state g t tr))
    (assert (added t t1 b))
    (call intree_added t t1 b 0)
    (assert (intree t 0))
    (assert (intree t1 0))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g tr))
    (assert (ends_in tr t))
    (assert (conn_in tr t))
    (assert (all_ext g tr))
    (call valid_push g tr e)
    (call ends_push tr e t t1 a b)
    (call conn_add tr e t t1 a b)
    (call cnt_added t t1 b (len t))
    (assert (== (len (concat tr (seq-lit e))) (+ (len tr) 1)))
    (assert (== (cnt t1 (len t1)) (+ (len (concat tr (seq-lit e))) 1)))
    (call ext_step g tr t e a b)))
(lemma full_mem (params (t (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires (== (cnt t (len t)) (len t)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len t))))
  (ensures (intree t u))
  (body
    (if (idx t u)
      (block)
      (call cnt_miss t (len t) u))))
(lemma span_full_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (tree_state g t tr)
            (== (len tr) (- (len g) 1))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected tr u v))
  (body
    (assert (tree_state g t tr))
    (assert (conn_in tr t))
    (assert (== (cnt t (len t)) (len t)))
    (call full_mem t u)
    (call full_mem t v)
    (assert (edges_connected tr u v))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (tree_state g t tr) (== (len tr) (- (len g) 1)))
  (ensures (is_mst g tr))
  (body
    (assert (tree_state g t tr))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g tr))
    (assert (all_ext g tr))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_full_one g t tr u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g tr))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g tr))
    (call final g tr)))
(ghost-fn targets_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))))
(lemma wf_targets (params (wg weighted_graph))

  (body
    (assert (well_formed wg))
    (assert (== (len (view wg)) (len (field wg adj))))

(ghost-fn scanned ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (u int) (i int) (found bool) (bw int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx g x)))))
             (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< y i))))
        (=> (cross_arc t x (get (idx (idx g x) y) 0))
            (and found (<= bw (get (idx (idx g x) y) 1))))))))
(ghost-fn scan_post ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (found bool) (bu int) (bv int) (bw int)) bool
  (body (and (scanned g t (len g) 0 found bw)
             (=> found (and (has_edge g bu bv bw) (cross_arc t bu bv))))))
(lemma arc_has_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body (assert (== (idx (idx g u) i) (idx (idx g u) i)))))
(lemma scan_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (u int) (i int) (found bool) (bw int) (found1 bool) (bw1 int))
  (requires (scanned g t u i found bw)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (=> found (and found1 (<= bw1 bw)))
            (=> (cross_arc t u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                (and found1 (<= bw1 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
  (ensures (scanned g t u (+ i 1) found1 bw1))
  (body (assert (scanned g t u i found bw))))
(lemma scan_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (u int) (found bool) (bw int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (scanned g t u (len (idx g u)) found bw))
  (ensures (scanned g t (+ u 1) 0 found bw))
  (body (assert (scanned g t u (len (idx g u)) found bw))))
(lemma no_cross_of_scan_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (bw int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (scanned g t (len g) 0 false bw)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))))
  (ensures (not (cross_arc t u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (body (assert (scanned g t (len g) 0 false bw))))
(ghost-fn no_cross ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (not (cross_arc t u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))))
(lemma no_cross_of_scan (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (bw int))
  (requires (scanned g t (len g) 0 false bw))
  (ensures (no_cross g t))
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int)) (call no_cross_of_scan_at g t bw u i))))
(lemma gap_cross (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (x int))
  (requires (no_cross g t)
            (graph_is_connected g)
            (> (len g) 0)
            (intree t 0)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (not (intree t x)))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (assert (graph_is_connected g))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x)))
           (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert (path_follows_graph g p))
    (call cross_from t p 0)
    (obtain ((k int)) (cross_at t p k))
    (assert (cross_at t p k))
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p k))))))
           (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p k)) i) 0) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
    (assert (no_cross g t))
    (assert (not (cross_arc t (idx p k) (get (idx (idx g (idx p k)) i) 0))))
    (assert (not (cross_arc t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
    (assert (cross_arc t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))))
(lemma scan_found (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (found bool) (bu int) (bv int) (bw int))
  (requires (tree_state g t tr)
            (< (len tr) (- (len g) 1))
            (graph_is_connected g)
            (scan_post g t found bu bv bw))
  (ensures found)
  (body
    (assert (tree_state g t tr))
    (assert (intree t 0))
    (assert (== (cnt t (len t)) (+ (len tr) 1)))
    (call cnt_gap t (len t))
    (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len t))) (not (idx t x))))
    (assert (not (intree t x)))
    (if found
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (scan_post g t found bu bv bw))
        (assert (scanned g t (len g) 0 false bw))
        (call no_cross_of_scan g t bw)
        (call gap_cross g t x)))))
(lemma scan_min_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (found bool) (bw int) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (scanned g t (len g) 0 found bw) (has_edge g x y z) (cross_arc t x y))
  (ensures (<= bw z))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g x y z))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) z))))
    (assert (scanned g t (len g) 0 found bw))
    (assert (cross_arc t x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)))
    (assert (<= bw (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))
(lemma scan_min (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq bool)) (found bool) (bw int))
  (requires (scanned g t (len g) 0 found bw))
  (ensures (min_cross g t bw))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int) (z int)) (call scan_min_one g t found bw x y z))))
(lemma pick_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (bu int) (bv int) (bw int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (has_edge g bu bv bw))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 bu) (< bu (len g))) (and (<= 0 bv) (< bv (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g bu bv bw))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 bu) (< bu (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g bu)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g bu) i) 0) bv) (== (get (idx (idx g bu) i) 1) bw))))
    (assert (targets_ok g))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g bu) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g bu) i) 0) (len g))))))
(spec scan_arcs
  (params (nbrs (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (t (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (found bool) (bu i64) (bv i64) (bw i64))
  (requires (targets_ok nbrs) (== (len t) (len nbrs)))
  (ensures (scan_post nbrs t found bu bv bw))
  (effects))
(def scan_arcs
  (body
    (let-mut found bool false)
    (let-mut bu i64 0)
    (let-mut bv i64 0)
    (let-mut bw i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u (len nbrs))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u (len nbrs))))
      (invariant (scanned nbrs t u 0 found bw))
      (invariant (=> found (and (has_edge nbrs bu bv bw) (cross_arc t bu bv))))
      (decreases (- (len nbrs) u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx nbrs u)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len nbrs))))
        (invariant (== deg (len (idx nbrs u))))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (scanned nbrs t u i found bw))
        (invariant (=> found (and (has_edge nbrs bu bv bw) (cross_arc t bu bv))))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx nbrs u) i) 0))
        (let w i64 (get (idx (idx nbrs u) i) 1))
        (assert (targets_ok nbrs))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len nbrs))))
        (assert (== (cross_arc t u v) (!= (idx t u) (idx t v))))
        (if (and (!= (idx t u) (idx t v)) (or (not found) (< w bw)))
          (block
            (call arc_has_edge nbrs u i)
            (call scan_next nbrs t u i found bw true w)
            (set found true)
            (set bu u)
            (set bv v)
            (set bw w))
          (call scan_next nbrs t u i found bw found bw))
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call scan_row nbrs t u found bw)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (return found bu bv bw)))
(def prim_mst
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call wf_targets graph)
    (assert (graph_is_connected g))
    (assert (> (size graph) 0))
    (match graph
      (case (weighted_graph nbrs)
        (block
          (assert (== g nbrs))
          (assert (> (len nbrs) 0))
          (assert (targets_ok nbrs))
          (let n i64 (len nbrs))
          (let-mut t (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (q) (== q 0))))
          (let-mut edges (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
          (assert (root_only t))
          (call init_state g t edges)
          (while (< (len edges) (- n 1))
            (invariant (and (== g nbrs) (targets_ok nbrs)))
            (invariant (graph_is_connected g))
            (invariant (and (> n 0) (== n (len g))))
            (invariant (== (len t) n))
            (invariant (<= (len edges) (- n 1)))
            (invariant (tree_state g t edges))
            (decreases (- (- n 1) (len edges)))
            (let ((found bool) (bu i64) (bv i64) (bw i64)) (call scan_arcs (borrow nbrs) (borrow t)))
            (ghost-let t0 (seq bool) t)
            (ghost-let tr0 (seq (tuple int int int)) edges)
            (assert (scan_post g t0 found bu bv bw))
            (assert (< (len tr0) (- (len g) 1)))
            (call scan_found g t0 tr0 found bu bv bw)
            (assert (scanned g t0 (len g) 0 found bw))
            (assert (and (has_edge g bu bv bw) (cross_arc t0 bu bv)))
            (call scan_min g t0 found bw)
            (assert (targets_ok g))
            (call pick_range g bu bv bw)
            (assert (== (cross_arc t0 bu bv) (!= (idx t bu) (idx t bv))))
            (let b i64 (if (idx t bu) bv bu))
            (ghost-let a int (if (idx t bu) bu bv))
            (ghost-let e (tuple int int int) (tuple bu bv bw))
            (assert (edge_ends e a b))
            (assert (intree t0 a))
            (assert (not (intree t0 b)))
            (assert (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
            (assert (min_cross g t0 (get e 2)))
            (set-idx t b true)
            (push edges (tuple bu bv bw))
            (ghost-let t1 (seq bool) t)
            (ghost-let tr1 (seq (tuple int int int)) edges)
            (assert (added t0 t1 b))
            (assert (== tr1 (concat tr0 (seq-lit e))))
            (call tree_step g t0 t1 tr0 e a b)
            (assert (tree_state g t1 tr1)))

    (assert (is_path es r v u))
    (call conn_intro es r v u)))
(ghost-fn refines ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (fs (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (edge_in_set es x y) (edges_connected fs x y)))))
(lemma mono_prefix (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (fs (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (refines es fs) (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected fs (idx p 0) (idx p k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (call conn_refl fs (idx p 0))
      (block
        (call mono_prefix es fs p (- k 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (assert (refines es fs))
        (assert (edges_connected fs (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (call conn_trans fs (idx p 0) (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k))))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (fs (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (refines es fs) (edges_connected es u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected fs u v))
  (body
    (call conn_elim es u v)
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (is_path es p u v))
    (assert (is_path es p u v))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (call mono_prefix es fs p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma span_mono_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (fs (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g es) (refines es fs) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected fs u v))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning g es))
    (assert (edges_connected es u v))
    (call conn_mono es fs u v)))
(lemma span_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (fs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning g es) (refines es fs))
  (ensures (is_spanning g fs))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_mono_one g es fs u v))))
(ghost-fn intree ((t (seq bool)) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len t))) (idx t x))))
(ghost-fn cross_arc ((t (seq bool)) (x int) (y int)) bool
  (body (!= (intree t x) (intree t y))))
(ghost-fn cross_at ((t (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (k int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len p)))
             (and (intree t (idx p k)) (not (intree t (idx p (+ k 1))))))))
(lemma cross_from (params (t (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))) (intree t (idx p i)) (not (intree t (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (exists ((kw int)) (cross_at t p kw)))
  (decreases (- (len p) i))
  (body
    (assert (< (+ i 1) (len p)))
    (if (intree t (idx p (+ i 1)))
      (call cross_from t p (+ i 1))
      (assert (cross_at t p i)))))
(ghost-fn simple_path ((p (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (!= (idx p i) (idx p j))))))
(lemma simple_inj (params (q (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (simple_path q) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len q))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len q))) (== (idx q x) (idx q y)))
  (ensures (== x y))
  (body
    (assert (simple_path q))
    (if (< x y)
      (assert (!= (idx q x) (idx q y)))
      (if (< y x)
        (assert (!= (idx q y) (idx q x)))
        (block)))))
(ghost-fn cut_path ((p (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (body (seq-build (- (len p) (- j i))
    (fn (m) (if (<= m i) (idx p m) (idx p (+ m (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p)
            (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p)))
            (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len (cut_path p i j)) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (cut_path p i j) k) (idx (cut_path p i j) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (cut_path p i j)) (- (len p) (- j i))))
    (if (< k i)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== k i)
        (block
          (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) k) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ j 1))))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) k) (idx p (+ k (- j i)))))
          (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ (+ k 1) (- j i)))))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (+ k (- j i))) (idx p (+ (+ k 1) (- j i))))))))))
(lemma simplify (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_path es p u v))
  (ensures (exists ((sw (seq int))) (and (is_path es sw u v) (simple_path sw))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (simple_path p)
      (assert (and (is_path es p u v) (simple_path p)))
      (block
        (assert (not (simple_path p)))
        (obtain ((i int) (j int))
          (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (assert (is_path es p u v))
        (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
        (ghost-let c (seq int) (cut_path p i j))
        (assert (== (len c) (- (len p) (- j i))))
        (forall ((k int)) (call cut_step es p i j k))
        (assert (path_follows_edges es c))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx p 0)))
        (if (== j (- (len p) 1))
          (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p i)))
          (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
        (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) v))
        (assert (is_path es c u v))
        (call simplify es c u v)))))
(ghost-fn edge_ends ((e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int)) bool
  (body (or (and (== (get e 0) a) (== (get e 1) b))
            (and (== (get e 0) b) (== (get e 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn upd ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int))) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (body (seq-build (len o) (fn (i) (if (== i j) e (idx o i))))))
(lemma simple_step_kept (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges o q) (simple_path q)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len q)))
            (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
            (and (and (<= 0 i) (< (+ i 1) (len q))) (!= i k)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (upd o j e) (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
    (call edge_elim o (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1)))
    (obtain ((m int)) (edge_idx o m (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
    (assert (edge_idx o m (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
    (assert (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (if (== m j)
      (if (== (idx q i) (idx q k))
        (call simple_inj q i k)
        (block
          (assert (== (idx q i) (idx q (+ k 1))))
          (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) (idx q k)))
          (call simple_inj q i (+ k 1))
          (call simple_inj q (+ i 1) k)))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (edge_idx (upd o j e) m (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
        (call edge_intro (upd o j e) m (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1)))))))
(lemma seg_conn (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int) (k int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges o q) (simple_path q)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len q)))
            (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (<= x y)) (< y (len q)))
            (or (<= y k) (> x k)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (upd o j e) (idx q x) (idx q y)))
  (decreases (- y x))
  (body
    (if (== x y)
      (call conn_refl (upd o j e) (idx q x))
      (block
        (call seg_conn o e q j k x (- y 1))
        (call simple_step_kept o e q j k (- y 1))
        (call conn_step (upd o j e) (idx q (- y 1)) (idx q y))
        (call conn_trans (upd o j e) (idx q x) (idx q (- y 1)) (idx q y))))))
(lemma bridge (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (q (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (edge_ends e a b)
            (is_path o q a b)
            (simple_path q)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len q)))
            (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (upd o j e) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (is_path o q a b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (assert (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) j) e))
    (assert (edge_ends e a b))
    (assert (edge_idx (upd o j e) j a b))
    (call edge_intro (upd o j e) j a b)
    (call conn_step (upd o j e) a b)
    (call seg_conn o e q j k 0 k)
    (call seg_conn o e q j k (+ k 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (call conn_sym (upd o j e) (idx q 0) (idx q k))
    (call conn_sym (upd o j e) (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))
    (call conn_trans (upd o j e) (idx q k) a b)
    (call conn_trans (upd o j e) (idx q k) b (idx q (+ k 1)))))
(ghost-fn good_idx ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t (seq bool)) (j int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
             (and (cross_arc t (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1))
                  (edges_connected (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1))))))
(lemma find_good (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_ends e a b) (edges_connected o a b) (intree t a) (not (intree t b)))
  (ensures (exists ((jw int)) (good_idx o e t jw)))
  (body
    (call conn_elim o a b)
    (obtain ((p0 (seq int))) (is_path o p0 a b))
    (call simplify o p0 a b)
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (is_path o q a b) (simple_path q)))
    (assert (is_path o q a b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (assert (intree t (idx q 0)))
    (assert (not (intree t (idx q (- (len q) 1)))))
    (call cross_from t q 0)
    (obtain ((k int)) (cross_at t q k))
    (assert (cross_at t q k))
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_elim o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
    (obtain ((j int)) (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (call bridge o e a b q j k)
    (assert (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (if (== (get (idx o j) 0) (idx q k))
      (assert (== (get (idx o j) 1) (idx q (+ k 1))))
      (call conn_sym (upd o j e) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (assert (cross_arc t (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
    (assert (edges_connected (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
    (assert (good_idx o e t j))))
(lemma refine_one (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
            (edges_connected (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1))
            (edge_in_set o x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (upd o j e) x y))
  (body
    (call edge_elim o x y)
    (obtain ((m int)) (edge_idx o m x y))
    (assert (edge_idx o m x y))
    (if (== m j)
      (if (== (get (idx o j) 0) x)
        (assert (== (get (idx o j) 1) y))
        (call conn_sym (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (edge_idx (upd o j e) m x y))
        (call edge_intro (upd o j e) m x y)
        (call conn_step (upd o j e) x y)))))
(lemma refines_upd (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
            (edges_connected (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
  (ensures (refines o (upd o j e)))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call refine_one o j e x y))))
(lemma valid_upd_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (upd o j e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd o j e) k) 1) (get (idx (upd o j e) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== k j)
      (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) k) e))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) k) (idx o k)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))))))
(lemma valid_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (upd o j e)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_upd_at g o j e k))))
(lemma tree_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g o)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (edges_connected (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
  (ensures (is_spanning_tree g (upd o j e)))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (call valid_upd g o j e)
    (call refines_upd o j e)
    (call span_mono g o (upd o j e))
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))))
(lemma tw_drop_zero_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (> (len o) 0) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len o) 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx (drop (upd o 0 e) 1) i) (idx (drop o 1) i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o 0 e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (idx (drop (upd o 0 e) 1) i) (idx (upd o 0 e) (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (upd o 0 e) (+ i 1)) (idx o (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop o 1) i) (idx o (+ i 1))))))
(lemma tw_drop_succ_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 1 j) (< j (len o))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len o) 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx (drop (upd o j e) 1) i) (idx (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e) i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (len (drop o 1)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (len (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (drop (upd o j e) 1) i) (idx (upd o j e) (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop o 1) i) (idx o (+ i 1))))
    (if (== i (- j 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) (+ i 1)) e))
        (assert (== (idx (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e) i) e)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) (+ i 1)) (idx o (+ i 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e) i) (idx (drop o 1) i)))))))
(lemma tw_upd (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (upd o j e)) (+ (- (total_weight o) (get (idx o j) 2)) (get e 2))))
  (decreases (len o))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (total_weight o) (+ (get (idx o 0) 2) (total_weight (drop o 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight (upd o j e)) (+ (get (idx (upd o j e) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (upd o j e) 1)))))
    (assert (== (len (drop o 1)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (len (drop (upd o j e) 1)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (if (== j 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) 0) e))
        (forall ((i int)) (call tw_drop_zero_at o e i))
        (assert (== (drop (upd o 0 e) 1) (drop o 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) 0) (idx o 0)))
        (forall ((i int)) (call tw_drop_succ_at o j e i))
        (assert (== (len (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)) (- (len o) 1)))
        (assert (== (drop (upd o j e) 1) (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)))
        (call tw_upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)
        (assert (== (idx (drop o 1) (- j 1)) (idx o j)))))))
(ghost-fn swap_at ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int)) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o)))))
  (body (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))))
(lemma swap_len (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o)))))
  (ensures (== (len (swap_at o x y)) (len o)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o x (idx o y))) (len o)))
    (assert (== (swap_at o x y) (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))))
    (assert (== (len (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))) (len (upd o x (idx o y)))))))
(lemma swap_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))))
  (ensures (== (idx (swap_at o x y) i) (if (== i y) (idx o x) (if (== i x) (idx o y) (idx o i)))))
  (body
    (call swap_len o x y)
    (assert (== (len (upd o x (idx o y))) (len o)))
    (assert (== (swap_at o x y) (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))))
    (assert (== (idx (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x)) i) (if (== i y) (idx o x) (idx (upd o x (idx o y)) i))))
    (assert (== (idx (upd o x (idx o y)) i) (if (== i x) (idx o y) (idx o i))))))
(lemma swap_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o)
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (swap_at o x y) k) 0) (get (idx (swap_at o x y) k) 1) (get (idx (swap_at o x y) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call swap_facts o x y k)
    (if (== k y)
      (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o x) 0) (get (idx o x) 1) (get (idx o x) 2)))
      (if (== k x)
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o y) 0) (get (idx o y) 1) (get (idx o y) 2)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))))))
(lemma swap_refine_one (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))
            (edge_in_set o a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swap_at o x y) a b))
  (body
    (call swap_len o x y)
    (call edge_elim o a b)
    (obtain ((m int)) (edge_idx o m a b))
    (assert (edge_idx o m a b))
    (if (== m x)
      (block
        (call swap_facts o x y y)
        (assert (== (idx (swap_at o x y) y) (idx o m)))
        (assert (edge_idx (swap_at o x y) y a b))
        (call edge_intro (swap_at o x y) y a b))
      (if (== m y)
        (block
          (call swap_facts o x y x)
          (assert (== (idx (swap_at o x y) x) (idx o m)))
          (assert (edge_idx (swap_at o x y) x a b))
          (call edge_intro (swap_at o x y) x a b))
        (block
          (call swap_facts o x y m)
          (assert (== (idx (swap_at o x y) m) (idx o m)))
          (assert (edge_idx (swap_at o x y) m a b))
          (call edge_intro (swap_at o x y) m a b))))
    (call conn_step (swap_at o x y) a b)))
(lemma swap_refines (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o)))))
  (ensures (refines o (swap_at o x y)))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call swap_refine_one o x y a b))))
(lemma tree_swap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g o)

    (if (== k 0)

  (ensures (edges_connected fs u v))
  (body
    (call conn_elim es u v)
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (is_path es p u v))
    (assert (is_path es p u v))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (call mono_prefix es fs p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma span_mono_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (fs (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g es) (refines es fs) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected fs u v))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning g es))
    (assert (edges_connected es u v))
    (call conn_mono es fs u v)))
(lemma span_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (fs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning g es) (refines es fs))
  (ensures (is_spanning g fs))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_mono_one g es fs u v))))
(ghost-fn intree ((t (seq bool)) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len t))) (idx t x))))
(ghost-fn cross_arc ((t (seq bool)) (x int) (y int)) bool
  (body (!= (intree t x) (intree t y))))
(ghost-fn cross_at ((t (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (k int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len p)))
             (and (intree t (idx p k)) (not (intree t (idx p (+ k 1))))))))
(lemma cross_from (params (t (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))) (intree t (idx p i)) (not (intree t (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (exists ((kw int)) (cross_at t p kw)))
  (decreases (- (len p) i))
  (body
    (assert (< (+ i 1) (len p)))
    (if (intree t (idx p (+ i 1)))
      (call cross_from t p (+ i 1))
      (assert (cross_at t p i)))))
(ghost-fn simple_path ((p (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (!= (idx p i) (idx p j))))))
(lemma simple_inj (params (q (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (simple_path q) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len q))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len q))) (== (idx q x) (idx q y)))
  (ensures (== x y))
  (body
    (assert (simple_path q))
    (if (< x y)
      (assert (!= (idx q x) (idx q y)))
      (if (< y x)
        (assert (!= (idx q y) (idx q x)))
        (block)))))
(ghost-fn cut_path ((p (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))))
  (body (seq-build (- (len p) (- j i))
    (fn (m) (if (<= m i) (idx p m) (idx p (+ m (- j i))))))))
(lemma cut_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p)
            (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p)))
            (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len (cut_path p i j)) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (cut_path p i j) k) (idx (cut_path p i j) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (cut_path p i j)) (- (len p) (- j i))))
    (if (< k i)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== k i)
        (block
          (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) k) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ j 1))))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) k) (idx p (+ k (- j i)))))
          (assert (== (idx (cut_path p i j) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ (+ k 1) (- j i)))))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (+ k (- j i))) (idx p (+ (+ k 1) (- j i))))))))))
(lemma simplify (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_path es p u v))
  (ensures (exists ((sw (seq int))) (and (is_path es sw u v) (simple_path sw))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (simple_path p)
      (assert (and (is_path es p u v) (simple_path p)))
      (block
        (assert (not (simple_path p)))
        (obtain ((i int) (j int))
          (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
        (assert (is_path es p u v))
        (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
        (ghost-let c (seq int) (cut_path p i j))
        (assert (== (len c) (- (len p) (- j i))))
        (forall ((k int)) (call cut_step es p i j k))
        (assert (path_follows_edges es c))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx p 0)))
        (if (== j (- (len p) 1))
          (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p i)))
          (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
        (assert (== (idx c (- (len c) 1)) v))
        (assert (is_path es c u v))
        (call simplify es c u v)))))
(ghost-fn edge_ends ((e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int)) bool
  (body (or (and (== (get e 0) a) (== (get e 1) b))
            (and (== (get e 0) b) (== (get e 1) a)))))
(ghost-fn upd ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int))) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (body (seq-build (len o) (fn (i) (if (== i j) e (idx o i))))))
(lemma simple_step_kept (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges o q) (simple_path q)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len q)))
            (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
            (and (and (<= 0 i) (< (+ i 1) (len q))) (!= i k)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (upd o j e) (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
    (call edge_elim o (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1)))
    (obtain ((m int)) (edge_idx o m (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
    (assert (edge_idx o m (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
    (assert (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (if (== m j)
      (if (== (idx q i) (idx q k))
        (call simple_inj q i k)
        (block
          (assert (== (idx q i) (idx q (+ k 1))))
          (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) (idx q k)))
          (call simple_inj q i (+ k 1))
          (call simple_inj q (+ i 1) k)))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (edge_idx (upd o j e) m (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1))))
        (call edge_intro (upd o j e) m (idx q i) (idx q (+ i 1)))))))
(lemma seg_conn (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int) (k int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges o q) (simple_path q)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len q)))
            (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (<= x y)) (< y (len q)))
            (or (<= y k) (> x k)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (upd o j e) (idx q x) (idx q y)))
  (decreases (- y x))
  (body
    (if (== x y)
      (call conn_refl (upd o j e) (idx q x))
      (block
        (call seg_conn o e q j k x (- y 1))
        (call simple_step_kept o e q j k (- y 1))
        (call conn_step (upd o j e) (idx q (- y 1)) (idx q y))
        (call conn_trans (upd o j e) (idx q x) (idx q (- y 1)) (idx q y))))))
(lemma bridge (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (q (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (edge_ends e a b)
            (is_path o q a b)
            (simple_path q)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len q)))
            (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (upd o j e) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (is_path o q a b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (assert (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) j) e))
    (assert (edge_ends e a b))
    (assert (edge_idx (upd o j e) j a b))
    (call edge_intro (upd o j e) j a b)
    (call conn_step (upd o j e) a b)
    (call seg_conn o e q j k 0 k)
    (call seg_conn o e q j k (+ k 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (call conn_sym (upd o j e) (idx q 0) (idx q k))
    (call conn_sym (upd o j e) (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))
    (call conn_trans (upd o j e) (idx q k) a b)
    (call conn_trans (upd o j e) (idx q k) b (idx q (+ k 1)))))
(ghost-fn good_idx ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t (seq bool)) (j int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
             (and (cross_arc t (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1))
                  (edges_connected (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1))))))
(lemma find_good (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_ends e a b) (edges_connected o a b) (intree t a) (not (intree t b)))
  (ensures (exists ((jw int)) (good_idx o e t jw)))
  (body
    (call conn_elim o a b)
    (obtain ((p0 (seq int))) (is_path o p0 a b))
    (call simplify o p0 a b)
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (is_path o q a b) (simple_path q)))
    (assert (is_path o q a b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o q))
    (assert (intree t (idx q 0)))
    (assert (not (intree t (idx q (- (len q) 1)))))
    (call cross_from t q 0)
    (obtain ((k int)) (cross_at t q k))
    (assert (cross_at t q k))
    (assert (edge_in_set o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_elim o (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
    (obtain ((j int)) (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (call bridge o e a b q j k)
    (assert (edge_idx o j (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (if (== (get (idx o j) 0) (idx q k))
      (assert (== (get (idx o j) 1) (idx q (+ k 1))))
      (call conn_sym (upd o j e) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (assert (cross_arc t (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
    (assert (edges_connected (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
    (assert (good_idx o e t j))))
(lemma refine_one (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
            (edges_connected (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1))
            (edge_in_set o x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (upd o j e) x y))
  (body
    (call edge_elim o x y)
    (obtain ((m int)) (edge_idx o m x y))
    (assert (edge_idx o m x y))
    (if (== m j)
      (if (== (get (idx o j) 0) x)
        (assert (== (get (idx o j) 1) y))
        (call conn_sym (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) m) (idx o m)))
        (assert (edge_idx (upd o j e) m x y))
        (call edge_intro (upd o j e) m x y)
        (call conn_step (upd o j e) x y)))))
(lemma refines_upd (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
            (edges_connected (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
  (ensures (refines o (upd o j e)))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call refine_one o j e x y))))
(lemma valid_upd_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (upd o j e) k) 0) (get (idx (upd o j e) k) 1) (get (idx (upd o j e) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== k j)
      (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) k) e))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) k) (idx o k)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))))))
(lemma valid_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (upd o j e)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_upd_at g o j e k))))
(lemma tree_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g o)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o)))
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
            (edges_connected (upd o j e) (get (idx o j) 0) (get (idx o j) 1)))
  (ensures (is_spanning_tree g (upd o j e)))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (call valid_upd g o j e)
    (call refines_upd o j e)
    (call span_mono g o (upd o j e))
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))))
(lemma tw_drop_zero_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (> (len o) 0) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len o) 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx (drop (upd o 0 e) 1) i) (idx (drop o 1) i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o 0 e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (idx (drop (upd o 0 e) 1) i) (idx (upd o 0 e) (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (upd o 0 e) (+ i 1)) (idx o (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop o 1) i) (idx o (+ i 1))))))
(lemma tw_drop_succ_at (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 1 j) (< j (len o))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len o) 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx (drop (upd o j e) 1) i) (idx (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e) i)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (len (drop o 1)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (len (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (drop (upd o j e) 1) i) (idx (upd o j e) (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop o 1) i) (idx o (+ i 1))))
    (if (== i (- j 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) (+ i 1)) e))
        (assert (== (idx (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e) i) e)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) (+ i 1)) (idx o (+ i 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e) i) (idx (drop o 1) i)))))))
(lemma tw_upd (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len o))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (upd o j e)) (+ (- (total_weight o) (get (idx o j) 2)) (get e 2))))
  (decreases (len o))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o j e)) (len o)))
    (assert (== (total_weight o) (+ (get (idx o 0) 2) (total_weight (drop o 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight (upd o j e)) (+ (get (idx (upd o j e) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (upd o j e) 1)))))
    (assert (== (len (drop o 1)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (assert (== (len (drop (upd o j e) 1)) (- (len o) 1)))
    (if (== j 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) 0) e))
        (forall ((i int)) (call tw_drop_zero_at o e i))
        (assert (== (drop (upd o 0 e) 1) (drop o 1))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (upd o j e) 0) (idx o 0)))
        (forall ((i int)) (call tw_drop_succ_at o j e i))
        (assert (== (len (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)) (- (len o) 1)))
        (assert (== (drop (upd o j e) 1) (upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)))
        (call tw_upd (drop o 1) (- j 1) e)
        (assert (== (idx (drop o 1) (- j 1)) (idx o j)))))))
(ghost-fn swap_at ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int)) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o)))))
  (body (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))))
(lemma swap_len (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o)))))
  (ensures (== (len (swap_at o x y)) (len o)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (upd o x (idx o y))) (len o)))
    (assert (== (swap_at o x y) (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))))
    (assert (== (len (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))) (len (upd o x (idx o y)))))))
(lemma swap_facts (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len o))))
  (ensures (== (idx (swap_at o x y) i) (if (== i y) (idx o x) (if (== i x) (idx o y) (idx o i)))))
  (body
    (call swap_len o x y)
    (assert (== (len (upd o x (idx o y))) (len o)))
    (assert (== (swap_at o x y) (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))))
    (assert (== (idx (upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x)) i) (if (== i y) (idx o x) (idx (upd o x (idx o y)) i))))
    (assert (== (idx (upd o x (idx o y)) i) (if (== i x) (idx o y) (idx o i))))))
(lemma swap_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g o)
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (swap_at o x y) k) 0) (get (idx (swap_at o x y) k) 1) (get (idx (swap_at o x y) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call swap_facts o x y k)
    (if (== k y)
      (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o x) 0) (get (idx o x) 1) (get (idx o x) 2)))
      (if (== k x)
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o y) 0) (get (idx o y) 1) (get (idx o y) 2)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))))))
(lemma swap_refine_one (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))
            (edge_in_set o a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swap_at o x y) a b))
  (body
    (call swap_len o x y)
    (call edge_elim o a b)
    (obtain ((m int)) (edge_idx o m a b))
    (assert (edge_idx o m a b))
    (if (== m x)
      (block
        (call swap_facts o x y y)
        (assert (== (idx (swap_at o x y) y) (idx o m)))
        (assert (edge_idx (swap_at o x y) y a b))
        (call edge_intro (swap_at o x y) y a b))
      (if (== m y)
        (block
          (call swap_facts o x y x)
          (assert (== (idx (swap_at o x y) x) (idx o m)))
          (assert (edge_idx (swap_at o x y) x a b))
          (call edge_intro (swap_at o x y) x a b))
        (block
          (call swap_facts o x y m)
          (assert (== (idx (swap_at o x y) m) (idx o m)))
          (assert (edge_idx (swap_at o x y) m a b))
          (call edge_intro (swap_at o x y) m a b))))
    (call conn_step (swap_at o x y) a b)))
(lemma swap_refines (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o)))))
  (ensures (refines o (swap_at o x y)))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call swap_refine_one o x y a b))))
(lemma tree_swap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g o)
            (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o)))))
  (ensures (is_spanning_tree g (swap_at o x y)))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (call swap_len o x y)
    (forall ((k int)) (call swap_valid_at g o x y k))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g (swap_at o x y)))
    (call swap_refines o x y)
    (call span_mono g o (swap_at o x y))))
(lemma tw_swap (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o)))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (swap_at o x y)) (total_weight o)))
  (body
    (call tw_upd o x (idx o y))
    (assert (== (len (upd o x (idx o y))) (len o)))
    (call tw_upd (upd o x (idx o y)) y (idx o x))
