    (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o1))) (and (>= (at o1 w) 0) (!= w s)))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (at p1 w)) (< (at p1 w) (len o1)))
                (and (>= (at o1 (at p1 w)) 0) (< (at o1 (at p1 w)) (at o1 w)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len o1) (len o0)))
    (if (== w v)
      (block
        (assert (== (at p1 w) u))
        (assert (!= u v))
        (assert (== (at o1 u) (at o0 u)))
        (assert (== (at o1 w) tail)))
      (block
        (assert (== (at p1 w) (at p0 w)))
        (assert (== (at o1 w) (at o0 w)))
        (assert (>= (at o0 w) 0))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 (at p0 w)) (< (at p0 w) (len o0)))
                     (and (>= (at o0 (at p0 w)) 0) (< (at o0 (at p0 w)) (at o0 w)))))
        (assert (!= (at p0 w) v))
        (assert (== (at o1 (at p0 w)) (at o0 (at p0 w))))))))
(lemma shape_step (params (o0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (s int) (u int) (v int) (tail int))
  (requires (tree_shape o0 p0 s) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (parent_step p0 p1 v u) (root_ok o0 u tail))
  (ensures (tree_shape o1 p1 s))
  (body
    (assert (== (at o0 s) 0))
    (assert (!= s v))
    (assert (== (at o1 s) (at o0 s)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call shape_at o0 p0 o1 p1 s u v tail w))))
(lemma res_at (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (s int) (u int) (v int) (tail int) (w int))
  (requires (tree_res c f o0 p0 s) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (parent_step p0 p1 v u) (residual c f u v)
    (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o1))) (and (>= (at o1 w) 0) (!= w s)))
  (ensures (residual c f (at p1 w) w))
  (body
    (assert (== (len o1) (len o0)))
    (if (== w v)
      (assert (== (at p1 w) u))
      (block
        (assert (== (at p1 w) (at p0 w)))
        (assert (== (at o1 w) (at o0 w)))
        (assert (residual c f (at p0 w) w))))))
(lemma res_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (s int) (u int) (v int) (tail int))
  (requires (tree_res c f o0 p0 s) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (parent_step p0 p1 v u) (residual c f u v))
  (ensures (tree_res c f o1 p1 s))
  (body (forall ((w int)) (call res_at c f o0 p0 o1 p1 s u v tail w))))
(lemma closed_at (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (v int) (h int) (tail int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (closed_below c f o0 h) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (>= tail h) (>= tail 0)
    (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o1))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o1))))
    (and (and (>= (at o1 x) 0) (< (at o1 x) h)) (< (at o1 y) 0)))
  (ensures (not (residual c f x y)))
  (body
    (assert (!= x v))
    (assert (!= y v))
    (assert (== (at o1 x) (at o0 x)))
    (assert (== (at o1 y) (at o0 y)))
    (assert (and (and (>= (at o0 x) 0) (< (at o0 x) h)) (< (at o0 y) 0)))
    (assert (== (len o1) (len o0)))))
(lemma closed_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (v int) (h int) (tail int))
  (requires (closed_below c f o0 h) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (>= tail h) (>= tail 0))
  (ensures (closed_below c f o1 h))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call closed_at c f o0 o1 v h tail x y))))

(lemma rsum_change (params (m (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (single_change m r a b d) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (rsum r u k) (+ (rsum m u k) (if (and (== u a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b k))) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call rsum_change m r a b d u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (rsum r u k) (+ (rsum r u (- k 1)) (get_flow r u (- k 1)))))
      (assert (== (rsum m u k) (+ (rsum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1))))))
    (block (assert (== (rsum r u k) 0)) (assert (== (rsum m u k) 0))))))
(lemma csum_change (params (m (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (single_change m r a b d) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (csum r v k) (+ (csum m v k) (if (and (== v b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a k))) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call csum_change m r a b d v (- k 1))
      (assert (== (csum r v k) (+ (csum r v (- k 1)) (get_flow r (- k 1) v))))
      (assert (== (csum m v k) (+ (csum m v (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) v)))))
    (block (assert (== (csum r v k) 0)) (assert (== (csum m v k) 0))))))
(lemma net_change (params (m (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (single_change m r a b d) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))))
  (ensures (== (net r u n) (- (+ (net m u n) (if (== u a) d 0)) (if (== u b) d 0))))
  (body
    (call rsum_change m r a b d u n)
    (call csum_change m r a b d u n)
    (assert (== (net r u n) (- (rsum r u n) (csum r u n))))
    (assert (== (net m u n) (- (rsum m u n) (csum m u n))))))
(lemma rsum_zero (params (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (all_zero m) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (rsum m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call rsum_zero m u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (rsum m u k) (+ (rsum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1))))))
    (assert (== (rsum m u k) 0)))))
(lemma csum_zero (params (m (seq (seq int))) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (all_zero m) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (csum m v k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call csum_zero m v (- k 1))
      (assert (== (csum m v k) (+ (csum m v (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) v)))))
    (assert (== (csum m v k) 0)))))
(lemma zero_net (params (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (all_zero m) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (net m u n) 0))
  (body
    (call rsum_zero m u n)
    (call csum_zero m u n)
    (assert (== (net m u n) (- (rsum m u n) (csum m u n))))))
(lemma rsum_le (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c f n) (cap_small c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (rsum f u k) (* 100000 k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call rsum_le c f n u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (rsum f u k) (+ (rsum f u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (- k 1)))))
      (assert (<= (get_flow f u (- k 1)) (get_flow c u (- k 1))))
      (assert (<= (get_flow c u (- k 1)) 100000)))
    (assert (== (rsum f u k) 0)))))
(lemma csum_ge (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c f n) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (>= (csum f v k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call csum_ge c f n v (- k 1))
      (assert (== (csum f v k) (+ (csum f v (- k 1)) (get_flow f (- k 1) v))))
      (assert (<= 0 (get_flow f (- k 1) v))))
    (assert (== (csum f v k) 0)))))
(lemma net_bound (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c f n) (cap_small c n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (<= (net f s n) (* 100000 n)))
  (body
    (call rsum_le c f n s n)
    (call csum_ge c f n s n)
    (assert (== (net f s n) (- (rsum f s n) (csum f s n))))))

(lemma wf_view (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (dests_ok (view cg)))
  (body (assert (== (len (view cg)) (len (field cg adj))))))
(lemma has_cap_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
(lemma cap_of_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int) (cc int))
  (requires (cap_exact g c) (has_capacity g x y cc))
  (ensures (== (get_flow c x y) cc))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) cc))))
    (assert (== (get_flow c x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))
(lemma flow_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (cap_exact g c) (cap_good g c n) (square c n) (== (len g) n)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow h x y)) (<= (get_flow h x y) (get_flow c x y))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow c x y)))
    (if (> (get_flow h x y) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g x y cc) (<= (get_flow h x y) cc)))
        (call cap_of_has g c x y cc))
      (block))))
(lemma flow_bnd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (cap_exact g c) (cap_good g c n) (square c n) (== (len g) n))
  (ensures (flow_bounds c h n))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call flow_at g c h s t n x y))))

(lemma seen_index (params (r (seq (tuple int int))) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len r)))
  (ensures (seen r k (get (idx r i) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== i (- k 1))
      (block)
      (call seen_index r i (- k 1)))
    (assert (== (seen r k (get (idx r i) 0))
                (or (== (get (idx r (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx r i) 0)) (seen r (- k 1) (get (idx r i) 0)))))))
(lemma seen_distinct (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j i)))
  (ensures (not (seen (idx g u) j (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0)
    (block
      (call seen_distinct g u i (- j 1))
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (assert (== (seen (idx g u) j (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                  (or (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                      (seen (idx g u) (- j 1) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))))
    (assert (not (seen (idx g u) j (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))))
(lemma msk_none (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (r (seq (tuple int int))) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (msk h u r 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call msk_none h u r (- m 1))
      (assert (not (seen r 0 (- m 1))))
      (assert (== (msk h u r 0 m) (+ (msk h u r 0 (- m 1)) (if (seen r 0 (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
    (assert (== (msk h u r 0 m) 0)))))
(lemma msk_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (r (seq (tuple int int))) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))) (not (seen r k (get (idx r k) 0))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (msk h u r (+ k 1) m)
               (+ (msk h u r k m)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 0)) (< (get (idx r k) 0) m)) (get_flow h u (get (idx r k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call msk_step h u r k (- m 1))
      (assert (== (seen r (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (or (== (get (idx r k) 0) (- m 1)) (seen r k (- m 1)))))
      (assert (== (msk h u r (+ k 1) m)
                  (+ (msk h u r (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (if (seen r (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (msk h u r k m)
                  (+ (msk h u r k (- m 1)) (if (seen r k (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
    (block
      (assert (== (msk h u r (+ k 1) m) 0))
      (assert (== (msk h u r k m) 0))))))
(lemma msk_full (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (r (seq (tuple int int))) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (<= k (len r)) (>= m 0)
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)) (or (seen r k v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (msk h u r k m) (rsum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call msk_full h u r k (- m 1))
      (assert (or (seen r k (- m 1)) (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))
      (assert (== (msk h u r k m) (+ (msk h u r k (- m 1)) (if (seen r k (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (rsum h u m) (+ (rsum h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))
    (block
      (assert (== (msk h u r k m) 0))
      (assert (== (rsum h u m) 0))))))
(lemma adj_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (== (len g) n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (msk h u (idx g u) k n)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call adj_eq g h u n (- k 1))
      (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) n)))
      (call seen_distinct g u (- k 1) (- k 1))
      (call msk_step h u (idx g u) (- k 1) n)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k)
                  (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
    (block
      (call msk_none h u (idx g u) n)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) 0))))))
(lemma seen_or_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c h n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (or (seen (idx g u) (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow h u v)) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v))))
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (> (get_flow c u v) 0))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
        (obtain ((i int))
          (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))
        (call seen_index (idx g u) i (len (idx g u))))
      (block))))
(lemma in_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (csum h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call in_eq g h u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) u))))
      (assert (== (csum h u k) (+ (csum h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) u)))))
    (block
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) 0))
      (assert (== (csum h u k) 0))))))
(lemma flow_sums (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c h n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rsum h u n)) (== (total_flow_in g h u) (csum h u n)))
  (body
    (call adj_eq g h u n (len (idx g u)))
    (forall ((v int)) (call seen_or_zero g c h n u v))
    (call msk_full h u (idx g u) (len (idx g u)) n)
    (call in_eq g h u n)
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h u) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (len (idx g u)))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))))
(lemma flow_val_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c h n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (net h s n)))
  (body
    (call flow_sums g c h n s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
    (assert (== (net h s n) (- (rsum h s n) (csum h s n))))))

(lemma hsum_zero (params (m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (hsum m o a 0) 0))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call hsum_zero m o (- a 1))
      (assert (== (rsel m o (- a 1) 0) 0))
      (assert (== (hsum m o a 0) (+ (hsum m o (- a 1) 0) (rsel m o (- a 1) 0)))))
    (assert (== (hsum m o a 0) 0)))))
(lemma hsum_step (params (m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 1))
  (ensures (== (hsum m o a b)
               (+ (hsum m o a (- b 1)) (if (>= (at o (- b 1)) 0) (csum m (- b 1) a) 0))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call hsum_step m o (- a 1) b)
      (assert (== (hsum m o a b) (+ (hsum m o (- a 1) b) (rsel m o (- a 1) b))))
      (assert (== (hsum m o a (- b 1)) (+ (hsum m o (- a 1) (- b 1)) (rsel m o (- a 1) (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (rsel m o (- a 1) b)
                  (+ (rsel m o (- a 1) (- b 1)) (if (>= (at o (- b 1)) 0) (get_flow m (- a 1) (- b 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (csum m (- b 1) a) (+ (csum m (- b 1) (- a 1)) (get_flow m (- a 1) (- b 1))))))
    (block
      (assert (== (hsum m o a b) 0))
      (assert (== (hsum m o a (- b 1)) 0))
      (assert (== (csum m (- b 1) a) 0))))))
(lemma fubini (params (m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (gsum m o b a) (hsum m o a b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call fubini m o a (- b 1))
      (call hsum_step m o a b)
      (assert (== (gsum m o b a)
                  (+ (gsum m o (- b 1) a) (if (>= (at o (- b 1)) 0) (csum m (- b 1) a) 0)))))
    (block
      (call hsum_zero m o a)
      (assert (== (gsum m o b a) 0))))))
(lemma net_sum (params (m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (a int))
  (requires (cons_on m o n s) (>= (at o s) 0) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (== (- (psum m o a n) (gsum m o a n)) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s a)) (net m s n) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call net_sum m o n s (- a 1))
      (assert (== (psum m o a n)
                  (+ (psum m o (- a 1) n) (if (>= (at o (- a 1)) 0) (rsum m (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (gsum m o a n)
                  (+ (gsum m o (- a 1) n) (if (>= (at o (- a 1)) 0) (csum m (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (net m (- a 1) n) (- (rsum m (- a 1) n) (csum m (- a 1) n)))))
    (block
      (assert (== (psum m o a n) 0))
      (assert (== (gsum m o a n) 0))))))
(lemma rdiff_le (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c h n) (flow_bounds c f n) (closed_cut c f o) (== (len o) n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))

    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (<= (get_flow c x y) 100000)))))
(ghost-fn dests_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
          (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))
    (forall ((u int) (i int) (j int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
               (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))) (!= i j)))
          (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn cap_part ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (u int) (e int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
             (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j e))))
        (== (get_flow c x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))))
(ghost-fn cap_exact ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
        (== (get_flow c x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))))
(ghost-fn cap_good ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (get_flow c x y)) (<= (get_flow c x y) 100000))
             (=> (> (get_flow c x y) 0) (has_capacity g x y (get_flow c x y))))))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((o (seq int)) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0 (+ (cnt o (- k 1)) (if (>= (at o (- k 1)) 0) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn tree_shape ((o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (and (== (at o s) 0)
    (forall ((w int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o))) (and (>= (at o w) 0) (!= w s)))
          (and (and (<= 0 (at p w)) (< (at p w) (len o)))
               (and (>= (at o (at p w)) 0) (< (at o (at p w)) (at o w)))))))))
(ghost-fn tree_res ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o))) (and (>= (at o w) 0) (!= w s)))
        (residual c f (at p w) w)))))
(ghost-fn walk_ok ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (s int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o))) (and (and (>= (at o w) 0) (<= (at o w) lim)) (!= w s)))
        (residual c f (at p w) w)))))
(ghost-fn walk_net ((m (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (cur int)) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((u int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (!= u s) (and (!= u t) (!= u cur)))) (== (net m u n) 0)))
    (=> (and (!= cur t) (!= cur s)) (== (net m cur n) 1)))))
(ghost-fn queue_ok ((o (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (tail int)) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((a int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 a) (< a tail))
          (and (and (<= 0 (at q a)) (< (at q a) (len o))) (== (at o (at q a)) a))))
    (forall ((w int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o))) (>= (at o w) 0))
          (and (< (at o w) tail) (== (at q (at o w)) w)))))))
(ghost-fn closed_below ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (h int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))
             (and (and (>= (at o x) 0) (< (at o x) h)) (< (at o y) 0)))
        (not (residual c f x y))))))
(ghost-fn closed_cut ((c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o))))
             (and (>= (at o x) 0) (< (at o y) 0)))
        (not (residual c f x y))))))
(ghost-fn cons_on ((m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (n int) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (>= (at o u) 0) (!= u s))) (== (net m u n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn rsel ((m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0
    (+ (rsel m o u (- k 1)) (if (>= (at o (- k 1)) 0) (get_flow m u (- k 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn gsum ((m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (b int) (a int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0
    (+ (gsum m o (- b 1) a) (if (>= (at o (- b 1)) 0) (csum m (- b 1) a) 0)))))
(ghost-fn hsum ((m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (hsum m o (- a 1) b) (rsel m o (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn psum ((m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0
    (+ (psum m o (- a 1) n) (if (>= (at o (- a 1)) 0) (rsum m (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn rdiff ((m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) int
  (body (- (if (>= (at o u) 0) (rsum m u k) 0) (rsel m o u k))))
(ghost-fn seen ((r (seq (tuple int int))) (k int) (v int)) bool
  (requires (<= k (len r)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) false (or (== (get (idx r (- k 1)) 0) v) (seen r (- k 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn msk ((h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (r (seq (tuple int int))) (k int) (m int)) int
  (requires (<= k (len r)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
    (+ (msk h u r k (- m 1)) (if (seen r k (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cert ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (== (len g) n) (square c n)) (and (dests_ok g) (cap_exact g c)))
    (and (and (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c f n))
      (and (and (square f n) (conserved f n s t))
        (and (and (closed_cut c f o) (== (len o) n))
          (and (and (>= (at o s) 0) (< (at o t) 0))
            (and (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t))))))))))
(ghost-fn disc_step ((o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (v int) (tail int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len o1) (len o0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len o0))))
    (and (and (< (at o0 v) 0) (== (at o1 v) tail))
      (forall ((w int)) (=> (!= w v) (== (at o1 w) (at o0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn parent_step ((p0 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (v int) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (== (at p1 v) u)
    (forall ((z int)) (=> (!= z v) (== (at p1 z) (at p0 z)))))))
(ghost-fn root_ok ((o0 (seq int)) (u int) (tail int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len o0))) (and (>= (at o0 u) 0) (< (at o0 u) tail)))))

(lemma cnt_bound (params (o (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (cnt o k)) (<= (cnt o k) k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call cnt_bound o (- k 1))
      (assert (== (cnt o k) (+ (cnt o (- k 1)) (if (>= (at o (- k 1)) 0) 1 0)))))
    (assert (== (cnt o k) 0)))))
(lemma cnt_none (params (o (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (forall ((w int)) (< (at o w) 0)))
  (ensures (== (cnt o k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call cnt_none o (- k 1))
      (assert (< (at o (- k 1)) 0))
      (assert (== (cnt o k) (+ (cnt o (- k 1)) (if (>= (at o (- k 1)) 0) 1 0)))))
    (assert (== (cnt o k) 0)))))
(lemma cnt_change (params (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (< (at o0 v) 0) (>= (at o1 v) 0)
    (forall ((w int)) (=> (!= w v) (== (at o1 w) (at o0 w)))))
  (ensures (== (cnt o1 k) (+ (cnt o0 k) (if (and (<= 0 v) (< v k)) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call cnt_change o0 o1 v (- k 1))
      (assert (== (cnt o1 k) (+ (cnt o1 (- k 1)) (if (>= (at o1 (- k 1)) 0) 1 0))))
      (assert (== (cnt o0 k) (+ (cnt o0 (- k 1)) (if (>= (at o0 (- k 1)) 0) 1 0)))))
    (block (assert (== (cnt o1 k) 0)) (assert (== (cnt o0 k) 0))))))

(lemma at_push (params (q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int) (a int))
  (requires (== q1 (concat q0 (seq-lit v))) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a (len q0))))
  (ensures (== (at q1 a) (if (< a (len q0)) (at q0 a) v)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat q0 (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat q0 (seq-lit v) a)
    (assert (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)))
    (assert (== (at q1 a) (idx q1 a)))
    (if (< a (len q0))
      (assert (== (at q0 a) (idx q0 a)))
      (block
        (assert (== a (len q0)))
        (assert (== (idx (seq-lit v) (- a (len q0))) v))))))
(lemma queue_a (params (o0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (tail int) (v int) (a int))
  (requires (queue_ok o0 q0 tail) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (== q1 (concat q0 (seq-lit v))) (== (len q0) tail)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (+ tail 1))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (at q1 a)) (< (at q1 a) (len o1))) (== (at o1 (at q1 a)) a)))
  (body
    (call at_push q0 q1 v a)
    (assert (== (len o1) (len o0)))
    (if (== a tail)
      (block
        (assert (== (at q1 a) v))
        (assert (== (at o1 v) tail)))
      (block
        (assert (== (at q1 a) (at q0 a)))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 (at q0 a)) (< (at q0 a) (len o0))) (== (at o0 (at q0 a)) a)))
        (assert (!= (at q0 a) v))
        (assert (== (at o1 (at q0 a)) (at o0 (at q0 a))))))))
(lemma queue_b (params (o0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (tail int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (queue_ok o0 q0 tail) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (== q1 (concat q0 (seq-lit v))) (== (len q0) tail) (>= tail 0)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o1))) (>= (at o1 x) 0))
  (ensures (and (< (at o1 x) (+ tail 1)) (== (at q1 (at o1 x)) x)))
  (body
    (if (== x v)
      (block
        (call at_push q0 q1 v tail)
        (assert (== (at o1 x) tail))
        (assert (== (at q1 tail) v)))
      (block
        (assert (== (at o1 x) (at o0 x)))
        (assert (== (len o1) (len o0)))
        (assert (>= (at o0 x) 0))
        (assert (and (< (at o0 x) tail) (== (at q0 (at o0 x)) x)))
        (call at_push q0 q1 v (at o0 x))
        (assert (== (at q1 (at o0 x)) (at q0 (at o0 x))))))))
(lemma queue_step (params (o0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (tail int) (v int))
  (requires (queue_ok o0 q0 tail) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (== q1 (concat q0 (seq-lit v))) (== (len q0) tail) (>= tail 0))
  (ensures (queue_ok o1 q1 (+ tail 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((a int)) (call queue_a o0 q0 o1 q1 tail v a))
    (forall ((x int)) (call queue_b o0 q0 o1 q1 tail v x))))
(lemma shape_at (params (o0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (s int) (u int) (v int) (tail int) (w int))
  (requires (tree_shape o0 p0 s) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (parent_step p0 p1 v u) (root_ok o0 u tail)
    (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o1))) (and (>= (at o1 w) 0) (!= w s)))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (at p1 w)) (< (at p1 w) (len o1)))
                (and (>= (at o1 (at p1 w)) 0) (< (at o1 (at p1 w)) (at o1 w)))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len o1) (len o0)))
    (if (== w v)
      (block
        (assert (== (at p1 w) u))
        (assert (!= u v))
        (assert (== (at o1 u) (at o0 u)))
        (assert (== (at o1 w) tail)))
      (block
        (assert (== (at p1 w) (at p0 w)))
        (assert (== (at o1 w) (at o0 w)))
        (assert (>= (at o0 w) 0))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 (at p0 w)) (< (at p0 w) (len o0)))
                     (and (>= (at o0 (at p0 w)) 0) (< (at o0 (at p0 w)) (at o0 w)))))
        (assert (!= (at p0 w) v))
        (assert (== (at o1 (at p0 w)) (at o0 (at p0 w))))))))
(lemma shape_step (params (o0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (s int) (u int) (v int) (tail int))
  (requires (tree_shape o0 p0 s) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (parent_step p0 p1 v u) (root_ok o0 u tail))
  (ensures (tree_shape o1 p1 s))
  (body
    (assert (== (at o0 s) 0))
    (assert (!= s v))
    (assert (== (at o1 s) (at o0 s)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call shape_at o0 p0 o1 p1 s u v tail w))))
(lemma res_at (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (s int) (u int) (v int) (tail int) (w int))
  (requires (tree_res c f o0 p0 s) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (parent_step p0 p1 v u) (residual c f u v)
    (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o1))) (and (>= (at o1 w) 0) (!= w s)))
  (ensures (residual c f (at p1 w) w))
  (body
    (assert (== (len o1) (len o0)))
    (if (== w v)
      (assert (== (at p1 w) u))
      (block
        (assert (== (at p1 w) (at p0 w)))
        (assert (== (at o1 w) (at o0 w)))
        (assert (residual c f (at p0 w) w))))))
(lemma res_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (s int) (u int) (v int) (tail int))
  (requires (tree_res c f o0 p0 s) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (parent_step p0 p1 v u) (residual c f u v))
  (ensures (tree_res c f o1 p1 s))
  (body (forall ((w int)) (call res_at c f o0 p0 o1 p1 s u v tail w))))
(lemma closed_at (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (v int) (h int) (tail int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (closed_below c f o0 h) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (>= tail h) (>= tail 0)
    (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len o1))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o1))))
    (and (and (>= (at o1 x) 0) (< (at o1 x) h)) (< (at o1 y) 0)))
  (ensures (not (residual c f x y)))
  (body
    (assert (!= x v))
    (assert (!= y v))
    (assert (== (at o1 x) (at o0 x)))
    (assert (== (at o1 y) (at o0 y)))
    (assert (and (and (>= (at o0 x) 0) (< (at o0 x) h)) (< (at o0 y) 0)))
    (assert (== (len o1) (len o0)))))
(lemma closed_step (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (v int) (h int) (tail int))
  (requires (closed_below c f o0 h) (disc_step o0 o1 v tail) (>= tail h) (>= tail 0))
  (ensures (closed_below c f o1 h))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call closed_at c f o0 o1 v h tail x y))))

(lemma rsum_change (params (m (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (single_change m r a b d) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (rsum r u k) (+ (rsum m u k) (if (and (== u a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b k))) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call rsum_change m r a b d u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (rsum r u k) (+ (rsum r u (- k 1)) (get_flow r u (- k 1)))))
      (assert (== (rsum m u k) (+ (rsum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1))))))
    (block (assert (== (rsum r u k) 0)) (assert (== (rsum m u k) 0))))))
(lemma csum_change (params (m (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (single_change m r a b d) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (csum r v k) (+ (csum m v k) (if (and (== v b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a k))) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call csum_change m r a b d v (- k 1))
      (assert (== (csum r v k) (+ (csum r v (- k 1)) (get_flow r (- k 1) v))))
      (assert (== (csum m v k) (+ (csum m v (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) v)))))
    (block (assert (== (csum r v k) 0)) (assert (== (csum m v k) 0))))))
(lemma net_change (params (m (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (single_change m r a b d) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))))
  (ensures (== (net r u n) (- (+ (net m u n) (if (== u a) d 0)) (if (== u b) d 0))))
  (body
    (call rsum_change m r a b d u n)
    (call csum_change m r a b d u n)
    (assert (== (net r u n) (- (rsum r u n) (csum r u n))))
    (assert (== (net m u n) (- (rsum m u n) (csum m u n))))))
(lemma rsum_zero (params (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (all_zero m) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (rsum m u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call rsum_zero m u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (rsum m u k) (+ (rsum m u (- k 1)) (get_flow m u (- k 1))))))
    (assert (== (rsum m u k) 0)))))
(lemma csum_zero (params (m (seq (seq int))) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (all_zero m) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (csum m v k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call csum_zero m v (- k 1))
      (assert (== (csum m v k) (+ (csum m v (- k 1)) (get_flow m (- k 1) v)))))
    (assert (== (csum m v k) 0)))))
(lemma zero_net (params (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (all_zero m) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (net m u n) 0))
  (body
    (call rsum_zero m u n)
    (call csum_zero m u n)
    (assert (== (net m u n) (- (rsum m u n) (csum m u n))))))
(lemma rsum_le (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c f n) (cap_small c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (rsum f u k) (* 100000 k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call rsum_le c f n u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (rsum f u k) (+ (rsum f u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (- k 1)))))
      (assert (<= (get_flow f u (- k 1)) (get_flow c u (- k 1))))
      (assert (<= (get_flow c u (- k 1)) 100000)))
    (assert (== (rsum f u k) 0)))))
(lemma csum_ge (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c f n) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (>= (csum f v k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call csum_ge c f n v (- k 1))
      (assert (== (csum f v k) (+ (csum f v (- k 1)) (get_flow f (- k 1) v))))
      (assert (<= 0 (get_flow f (- k 1) v))))
    (assert (== (csum f v k) 0)))))
(lemma net_bound (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c f n) (cap_small c n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (<= (net f s n) (* 100000 n)))
  (body
    (call rsum_le c f n s n)
    (call csum_ge c f n s n)
    (assert (== (net f s n) (- (rsum f s n) (csum f s n))))))

(lemma wf_view (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (dests_ok (view cg)))
  (body (assert (== (len (view cg)) (len (field cg adj))))))
(lemma has_cap_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
(lemma cap_of_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (x int) (y int) (cc int))
  (requires (cap_exact g c) (has_capacity g x y cc))
  (ensures (== (get_flow c x y) cc))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) cc))))
    (assert (== (get_flow c x (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1)))))
(lemma flow_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (cap_exact g c) (cap_good g c n) (square c n) (== (len g) n)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get_flow h x y)) (<= (get_flow h x y) (get_flow c x y))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow c x y)))
    (if (> (get_flow h x y) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g x y cc) (<= (get_flow h x y) cc)))
        (call cap_of_has g c x y cc))
      (block))))
(lemma flow_bnd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (cap_exact g c) (cap_good g c n) (square c n) (== (len g) n))
  (ensures (flow_bounds c h n))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call flow_at g c h s t n x y))))

(lemma seen_index (params (r (seq (tuple int int))) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len r)))
  (ensures (seen r k (get (idx r i) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== i (- k 1))
      (block)
      (call seen_index r i (- k 1)))
    (assert (== (seen r k (get (idx r i) 0))
                (or (== (get (idx r (- k 1)) 0) (get (idx r i) 0)) (seen r (- k 1) (get (idx r i) 0)))))))
(lemma seen_distinct (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j i)))
  (ensures (not (seen (idx g u) j (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0)
    (block
      (call seen_distinct g u i (- j 1))
      (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (assert (== (seen (idx g u) j (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                  (or (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                      (seen (idx g u) (- j 1) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))))
    (assert (not (seen (idx g u) j (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))))
(lemma msk_none (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (r (seq (tuple int int))) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (msk h u r 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call msk_none h u r (- m 1))
      (assert (not (seen r 0 (- m 1))))
      (assert (== (msk h u r 0 m) (+ (msk h u r 0 (- m 1)) (if (seen r 0 (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
    (assert (== (msk h u r 0 m) 0)))))
(lemma msk_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (r (seq (tuple int int))) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))) (not (seen r k (get (idx r k) 0))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (msk h u r (+ k 1) m)
               (+ (msk h u r k m)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 0)) (< (get (idx r k) 0) m)) (get_flow h u (get (idx r k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call msk_step h u r k (- m 1))
      (assert (== (seen r (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (or (== (get (idx r k) 0) (- m 1)) (seen r k (- m 1)))))
      (assert (== (msk h u r (+ k 1) m)
                  (+ (msk h u r (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (if (seen r (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (msk h u r k m)
                  (+ (msk h u r k (- m 1)) (if (seen r k (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
    (block
      (assert (== (msk h u r (+ k 1) m) 0))
      (assert (== (msk h u r k m) 0))))))
(lemma msk_full (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (r (seq (tuple int int))) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (<= k (len r)) (>= m 0)
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)) (or (seen r k v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (msk h u r k m) (rsum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call msk_full h u r k (- m 1))
      (assert (or (seen r k (- m 1)) (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))
      (assert (== (msk h u r k m) (+ (msk h u r k (- m 1)) (if (seen r k (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (rsum h u m) (+ (rsum h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))
    (block
      (assert (== (msk h u r k m) 0))
      (assert (== (rsum h u m) 0))))))
(lemma adj_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (== (len g) n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (msk h u (idx g u) k n)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call adj_eq g h u n (- k 1))
      (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) n)))
      (call seen_distinct g u (- k 1) (- k 1))
      (call msk_step h u (idx g u) (- k 1) n)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k)
                  (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
    (block
      (call msk_none h u (idx g u) n)
      (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) 0))))))
(lemma seen_or_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c h n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (or (seen (idx g u) (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow h u v)) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow c u v))))
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (> (get_flow c u v) 0))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))
        (obtain ((i int))
          (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))
        (call seen_index (idx g u) i (len (idx g u))))
      (block))))
(lemma in_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (csum h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call in_eq g h u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) u))))
      (assert (== (csum h u k) (+ (csum h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h (- k 1) u)))))
    (block
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) 0))
      (assert (== (csum h u k) 0))))))
(lemma flow_sums (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c h n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rsum h u n)) (== (total_flow_in g h u) (csum h u n)))
  (body
    (call adj_eq g h u n (len (idx g u)))
    (forall ((v int)) (call seen_or_zero g c h n u v))
    (call msk_full h u (idx g u) (len (idx g u)) n)
    (call in_eq g h u n)
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h u) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (len (idx g u)))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))))
(lemma flow_val_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c h n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (net h s n)))
  (body
    (call flow_sums g c h n s)
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
    (assert (== (net h s n) (- (rsum h s n) (csum h s n))))))

(lemma hsum_zero (params (m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int))
  (requires (>= a 0))
  (ensures (== (hsum m o a 0) 0))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call hsum_zero m o (- a 1))
      (assert (== (rsel m o (- a 1) 0) 0))
      (assert (== (hsum m o a 0) (+ (hsum m o (- a 1) 0) (rsel m o (- a 1) 0)))))
    (assert (== (hsum m o a 0) 0)))))
(lemma hsum_step (params (m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 1))
  (ensures (== (hsum m o a b)
               (+ (hsum m o a (- b 1)) (if (>= (at o (- b 1)) 0) (csum m (- b 1) a) 0))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call hsum_step m o (- a 1) b)
      (assert (== (hsum m o a b) (+ (hsum m o (- a 1) b) (rsel m o (- a 1) b))))
      (assert (== (hsum m o a (- b 1)) (+ (hsum m o (- a 1) (- b 1)) (rsel m o (- a 1) (- b 1)))))
      (assert (== (rsel m o (- a 1) b)
                  (+ (rsel m o (- a 1) (- b 1)) (if (>= (at o (- b 1)) 0) (get_flow m (- a 1) (- b 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (csum m (- b 1) a) (+ (csum m (- b 1) (- a 1)) (get_flow m (- a 1) (- b 1))))))
    (block
      (assert (== (hsum m o a b) 0))
      (assert (== (hsum m o a (- b 1)) 0))
      (assert (== (csum m (- b 1) a) 0))))))
(lemma fubini (params (m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (gsum m o b a) (hsum m o a b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0)
    (block
      (call fubini m o a (- b 1))
      (call hsum_step m o a b)
      (assert (== (gsum m o b a)
                  (+ (gsum m o (- b 1) a) (if (>= (at o (- b 1)) 0) (csum m (- b 1) a) 0)))))
    (block
      (call hsum_zero m o a)
      (assert (== (gsum m o b a) 0))))))
(lemma net_sum (params (m (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (a int))
  (requires (cons_on m o n s) (>= (at o s) 0) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (== (- (psum m o a n) (gsum m o a n)) (if (and (<= 0 s) (< s a)) (net m s n) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call net_sum m o n s (- a 1))
      (assert (== (psum m o a n)
                  (+ (psum m o (- a 1) n) (if (>= (at o (- a 1)) 0) (rsum m (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (gsum m o a n)
                  (+ (gsum m o (- a 1) n) (if (>= (at o (- a 1)) 0) (csum m (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (net m (- a 1) n) (- (rsum m (- a 1) n) (csum m (- a 1) n)))))
    (block
      (assert (== (psum m o a n) 0))
      (assert (== (gsum m o a n) 0))))))
(lemma rdiff_le (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c h n) (flow_bounds c f n) (closed_cut c f o) (== (len o) n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (rdiff h o u k) (rdiff f o u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call rdiff_le c f h o n u (- k 1))
      (assert (== (rsum h u k) (+ (rsum h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)))))
      (assert (== (rsum f u k) (+ (rsum f u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (- k 1)))))
      (assert (== (rsel h o u k) (+ (rsel h o u (- k 1)) (if (>= (at o (- k 1)) 0) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0))))
      (assert (== (rsel f o u k) (+ (rsel f o u (- k 1)) (if (>= (at o (- k 1)) 0) (get_flow f u (- k 1)) 0))))
      (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow h u (- k 1))) (<= (get_flow h u (- k 1)) (get_flow c u (- k 1)))))
      (assert (=> (and (>= (at o u) 0) (< (at o (- k 1)) 0)) (not (residual c f u (- k 1)))))
      (assert (=> (and (< (at o u) 0) (>= (at o (- k 1)) 0)) (not (residual c f (- k 1) u)))))
    (block
      (assert (== (rsum h u k) 0))
      (assert (== (rsum f u k) 0))
      (assert (== (rsel h o u k) 0))
      (assert (== (rsel f o u k) 0))))))
(lemma psum_hsum_le (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c h n) (flow_bounds c f n) (closed_cut c f o) (== (len o) n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (<= (- (psum h o a n) (hsum h o a n)) (- (psum f o a n) (hsum f o a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0)
    (block
      (call psum_hsum_le c f h o n (- a 1))
      (call rdiff_le c f h o n (- a 1) n)
      (assert (== (psum h o a n) (+ (psum h o (- a 1) n) (if (>= (at o (- a 1)) 0) (rsum h (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (psum f o a n) (+ (psum f o (- a 1) n) (if (>= (at o (- a 1)) 0) (rsum f (- a 1) n) 0))))
      (assert (== (hsum h o a n) (+ (hsum h o (- a 1) n) (rsel h o (- a 1) n))))
      (assert (== (hsum f o a n) (+ (hsum f o (- a 1) n) (rsel f o (- a 1) n))))
      (assert (== (rdiff h o (- a 1) n) (- (if (>= (at o (- a 1)) 0) (rsum h (- a 1) n) 0) (rsel h o (- a 1) n))))
      (assert (== (rdiff f o (- a 1) n) (- (if (>= (at o (- a 1)) 0) (rsum f (- a 1) n) 0) (rsel f o (- a 1) n)))))
    (block
      (assert (== (psum h o a n) 0))
      (assert (== (psum f o a n) 0))
      (assert (== (hsum h o a n) 0))
      (assert (== (hsum f o a n) 0))))))
(lemma value_le (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (n int) (s int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c h n) (flow_bounds c f n) (closed_cut c f o) (== (len o) n)
    (cons_on h o n s) (cons_on f o n s) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (>= (at o s) 0))
  (ensures (<= (net h s n) (net f s n)))
  (body
    (call net_sum h o n s n)
    (call net_sum f o n s n)
    (call fubini h o n n)
    (call fubini f o n n)
    (call psum_hsum_le c f h o n n)))

(lemma other_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t) (flow_bounds c h n) (dests_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g c n)
    (< (at o t) 0) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (>= (at o u) 0) (!= u s)))
  (ensures (== (net h u n) 0))
  (body
    (assert (!= u t))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (call flow_sums g c h n u)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (total_flow_out g h u)))
    (assert (== (net h u n) (- (rsum h u n) (csum h u n))))))
(lemma other_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (cert g c f o s t n) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (call flow_bnd g c h s t n)
    (call flow_val_eq g c h n s)
    (call flow_val_eq g c f n s)
    (forall ((u int)) (call other_cons_at g c h o s t n u))
    (assert (cons_on h o n s))
    (assert (cons_on f o n s))
    (call value_le c f h o n s)))
(lemma resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c f n) (square f n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))) (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g u v cc) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) cc))))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow c u v)))
    (assert (> (get_flow c u v) 0))
    (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow c u v)))))
(lemma nonneg_at (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c f n) (square f n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
    (assert (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)))))
(lemma cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c f n) (conserved f n s t)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u)))
  (body
    (call flow_sums g c f n u)
    (assert (== (net f u n) 0))
    (assert (== (net f u n) (- (rsum f u n) (csum f u n))))))
(lemma f_resp (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c f n) (square f n))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_at g c f n u v))))
(lemma f_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c f n) (conserved f n s t))
  (ensures (is_conserved g f s t))
  (body (forall ((u int)) (call cons_at g c f n s t u))))
(lemma f_nonneg (params (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (flow_bounds c f n) (square f n))
  (ensures (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nonneg_at c f n u v))))
(lemma f_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (dests_ok g) (== (len g) n) (cap_good g c n) (flow_bounds c f n) (square f n) (conserved f n s t))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call f_resp g c f n)
    (call f_cons g c f s t n)
    (call f_nonneg c f n)))
(lemma is_max (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (cert g c f o s t n))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (net f s n)))
  (body
    (call f_valid g c f s t n)
    (call flow_val_eq g c f n s)
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call other_le g c f o s t n h))))

(spec bump
  (params (m (vec (vec i64))) (n i64) (a i64) (b i64) (d i64))
  (returns (r (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (square m n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (in_i64 (+ (get_flow m a b) d)))
  (ensures (square r n) (single_change m r a b d))
  (effects))
(def bump
  (body
    (let-mut w (vec (vec i64)) m)
    (assert (== (idx (idx w a) b) (get_flow m a b)))
    (let e i64 (+ (idx (idx w a) b) d))
    (set-idx (idx w a) b e)
    (return w)))

(spec build_caps
  (params (graph capacity_graph) (n i64))
  (returns (cm (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (== n (len (view graph))) (dests_ok (view graph)) (capacities_bounded (view graph)))
  (ensures (square cm n) (cap_good (view graph) cm n) (cap_exact (view graph) cm))
  (effects alloc))
(def build_caps
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (assert (== (len (field graph adj)) n))
    (assert (capacities_bounded g))
    (assert (dests_ok g))
    (let-mut cm (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (zi) (seq-build n (fn (zj) 0)))))

(lemma step_nn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int))

    (and (== (len pe) (len ord))
      (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len ord)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) (len ord)))

(ghost-fn q_ok ((ord (seq int)) (q (seq int))) bool

  (body (and (and (== (len ord) (len g)) (and (== (len par) (len g)) (== (len pe) (len g))))
    (and (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
      (and (and (<= 0 head) (and (<= head (len q)) (<= (len q) (len g))))

(ghost-fn upd1 ((a0 (seq int)) (a1 (seq int)) (w int) (x int)) bool

      (assert (== (idx p1 v) (idx p0 v)))
      (assert (== (idx e1 v) (idx e0 v)))
      (assert (tree_ok g h o0 p0 e0 v))
      (assert (!= (idx p0 v) w))
      (assert (== (idx o1 (idx p0 v)) (idx o0 (idx p0 v))))

                          (head int) (u int) (w int) (e int))

    (assert (and (== (len h2) (len g)) (== (len (idx h2 p)) (len g))))
    (assert (== (len (idx h p)) (len g)))
    (assert (== (get_flow h2 p q) (idx (idx h2 p) q)))
    (assert (== (get_flow h p q) (idx (idx h p) q)))
    (assert (== (get_flow h2 p q) (+ (get_flow h p q) (if (and (== p a) (== q b)) e 0))))
    (assert (>= (idx (idx h p) q) 0))))
(lemma step_nn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int))
  (requires (square h (len g)) (square h2 (len g)) (nonneg h) (differs h h2 a b e)
            (>= (+ (get_flow h a b) e) 0))
  (ensures (nonneg h2))
  (body
    (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call nn_step g h h2 a b e p q))
    (assert (nonneg h2))))
(lemma up_resp (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (i int))
  (requires (square h (len g)) (square h2 (len g)) (differs h h2 a b 1) (respects_capacity g h)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b)
            (< (get_flow h a b) (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1)))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g h2))
  (body
    (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call resp_up g h h2 a b i p q))
    (assert (respects_capacity g h2))))
(lemma down_resp (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (square h (len g)) (square h2 (len g)) (differs h h2 a b -1) (respects_capacity g h))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g h2))
  (body
    (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call resp_down g h h2 a b p q))
    (assert (respects_capacity g h2))))
(lemma up_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (i int))
  (requires (square h (len g)) (square h2 (len g)) (nonneg h) (differs h h2 a b 1) (respects_capacity g h)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b)
            (< (get_flow h a b) (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1)))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g h2) (nonneg h2))
  (body
    (call up_resp g h h2 a b i)
    (call gf_nonneg h a b)
    (call step_nn g h h2 a b 1)))
(lemma down_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (square h (len g)) (square h2 (len g)) (nonneg h) (differs h h2 a b -1) (respects_capacity g h)
            (> (get_flow h a b) 0))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g h2) (nonneg h2))
  (body
    (call down_resp g h h2 a b)
    (call step_nn g h h2 a b -1)))
(ghost-fn vis ((ord (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len ord))) (>= (idx ord v) 0))))
(ghost-fn edge_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int)) bool
  (body (if (>= e 0)
    (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
         (and (< e (len (idx g a)))
              (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0) b)
                   (< (get_flow h a b) (get (idx (idx g a) e) 1)))))
    (> (get_flow h b a) 0))))
(ghost-fn tree_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len par) (len ord))
    (and (== (len pe) (len ord))
      (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len ord)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx par v)) (< (idx par v) (len ord)))
          (and (>= (idx ord (idx par v)) 0)
            (and (< (idx ord (idx par v)) (idx ord v))
                 (edge_ok g h (idx par v) v (idx pe v))))))))))
(ghost-fn tree_all ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len ord))) (and (!= v s) (>= (idx ord v) 0)))
        (tree_ok g h ord par pe v)))))
(ghost-fn fwd_upto ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j m)) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
        (=> (< (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))
            (vis ord (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn rev_upto ((h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((j int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j m)) (> (get_flow h j u) 0)) (vis ord j)))))
(ghost-fn closed_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (fwd_upto g h ord u (len (idx g u))) (rev_upto h ord u (len ord))))))
(ghost-fn closed_all ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int)) (=> (vis ord u) (closed_at g h ord u)))))
(ghost-fn closed_below ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len ord))) (and (<= 0 (idx ord v)) (< (idx ord v) head)))
        (closed_at g h ord v)))))
(ghost-fn search_done ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (ord (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len ord) (len g)) (and (== (len par) (len g)) (== (len pe) (len g))))
    (and (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
      (and (>= (idx ord s) 0)
        (and (tree_all g h ord par pe s) (closed_all g h ord)))))))
(ghost-fn unvis ((ord (seq int)) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (or (<= m 0) (> m (len ord))) 0
    (+ (unvis ord (- m 1)) (if (< (idx ord (- m 1)) 0) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn q_ok ((ord (seq int)) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q)))
          (and (and (<= 0 (idx q k)) (< (idx q k) (len ord))) (== (idx ord (idx q k)) k))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len ord))) (>= (idx ord v) 0))
          (and (< (idx ord v) (len q)) (== (idx q (idx ord v)) v)))))))
(ghost-fn bstate ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (ord (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len ord) (len g)) (and (== (len par) (len g)) (== (len pe) (len g))))
    (and (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
      (and (and (<= 0 head) (and (<= head (len q)) (<= (len q) (len g))))
        (and (>= (idx ord s) 0)
          (and (== (+ (len q) (unvis ord (len ord))) (len ord))
            (and (q_ok ord q)
              (and (tree_all g h ord par pe s) (closed_below g h ord head))))))))))
(ghost-fn upd1 ((a0 (seq int)) (a1 (seq int)) (w int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len a1) (len a0))
    (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len a0)))
      (and (== (idx a1 w) x)
        (forall ((y int))
          (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len a0))) (!= y w)) (== (idx a1 y) (idx a0 y)))))))))
(ghost-fn push1 ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (w int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1))
    (and (== (idx q1 (len q0)) w)
      (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k))))))))
(ghost-fn mono ((o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (vis o0 y) (vis o1 y)))))
(lemma unvis_nonneg (params (ord (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len ord))))
  (ensures (>= (unvis ord m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call unvis_nonneg ord (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma unvis_all (params (o0 (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o0))) (< (idx o0 y) 0)))
            (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len o0))))
  (ensures (== (unvis o0 m) m))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call unvis_all o0 (- m 1))
      (assert (< (idx o0 (- m 1)) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma unvis_set (params (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (w int) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (upd1 o0 o1 w x) (>= x 0) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o0))) (< (idx o0 w) 0)
            (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len o0))))
  (ensures (== (unvis o1 m) (- (unvis o0 m) (if (< w m) 1 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block
      (call unvis_set o0 o1 w x (- m 1))
      (if (== (- m 1) w)
        (assert (== (idx o1 (- m 1)) x))
        (assert (== (idx o1 (- m 1)) (idx o0 (- m 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma mono_one (params (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (w int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (upd1 o0 o1 w x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (=> (vis o0 y) (vis o1 y)))
  (body (if (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o0))) (!= y w))
    (assert (== (idx o1 y) (idx o0 y)))
    (block))))
(lemma fwd_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (u int) (m int) (j int))
  (requires (fwd_upto g h o0 u m) (mono o0 o1) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j m)) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (=> (< (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))
               (vis o1 (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))))
  (body (assert (=> (< (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))
                    (vis o0 (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))))))
(lemma fwd_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (fwd_upto g h o0 u m) (mono o0 o1) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (fwd_upto g h o1 u m))
  (body
    (forall ((j int)) (call fwd_one g h o0 o1 u m j))
    (assert (fwd_upto g h o1 u m))))
(lemma rev_one (params (h (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (u int) (m int) (j int))
  (requires (rev_upto h o0 u m) (mono o0 o1) (and (<= 0 j) (< j m)))
  (ensures (=> (> (get_flow h j u) 0) (vis o1 j)))
  (body (assert (=> (> (get_flow h j u) 0) (vis o0 j)))))
(lemma rev_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (rev_upto h o0 u m) (mono o0 o1))
  (ensures (rev_upto h o1 u m))
  (body
    (forall ((j int)) (call rev_one h o0 o1 u m j))
    (assert (rev_upto h o1 u m))))
(lemma closed_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (closed_at g h o0 v) (mono o0 o1) (== (len o1) (len o0)))
  (ensures (closed_at g h o1 v))
  (body
    (call fwd_mono g h o0 o1 v (len (idx g v)))
    (call rev_mono h o0 o1 v (len o0))
    (assert (closed_at g h o1 v))))
(lemma fwd_ext_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (fwd_upto g h ord u i)
            (=> (< (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
                (vis ord (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
            (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (+ i 1))) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (=> (< (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))
               (vis ord (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))))
  (body (if (< j i)
    (assert (=> (< (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1))
                (vis ord (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))))
    (assert (== j i)))))
(lemma fwd_extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (fwd_upto g h ord u i)
            (=> (< (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
                (vis ord (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))
  (ensures (fwd_upto g h ord u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((j int)) (call fwd_ext_one g h ord u i j))
    (assert (fwd_upto g h ord u (+ i 1)))))
(lemma rev_ext_one (params (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (x int) (j int))
  (requires (>= x 0) (rev_upto h ord u x) (=> (> (get_flow h x u) 0) (vis ord x))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (+ x 1))))
  (ensures (=> (> (get_flow h j u) 0) (vis ord j)))
  (body (if (< j x)
    (assert (=> (> (get_flow h j u) 0) (vis ord j)))
    (assert (== j x)))))
(lemma rev_extend (params (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (x int))
  (requires (>= x 0) (rev_upto h ord u x) (=> (> (get_flow h x u) 0) (vis ord x)))
  (ensures (rev_upto h ord u (+ x 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((j int)) (call rev_ext_one h ord u x j))
    (assert (rev_upto h ord u (+ x 1)))))
(lemma q_one (params (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o0))) (q_ok o0 q0) (upd1 o0 o1 w (len q0)) (push1 q0 q1 w)
            (< (idx o0 w) 0) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q1))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx q1 k)) (< (idx q1 k) (len o1))) (== (idx o1 (idx q1 k)) k)))
  (body (if (< k (len q0))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 (idx q0 k)) (< (idx q0 k) (len o0))) (== (idx o0 (idx q0 k)) k)))
      (assert (!= (idx q0 k) w))
      (assert (== (idx o1 (idx q0 k)) (idx o0 (idx q0 k)))))
    (block
      (assert (== k (len q0)))
      (assert (== (idx q1 k) w))))))
(lemma q_two (params (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (w int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o0))) (q_ok o0 q0) (upd1 o0 o1 w (len q0)) (push1 q0 q1 w)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len o1))) (>= (idx o1 v) 0))
  (ensures (and (< (idx o1 v) (len q1)) (== (idx q1 (idx o1 v)) v)))
  (body (if (== v w)
    (assert (== (idx o1 v) (len q0)))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx o1 v) (idx o0 v)))
      (assert (and (< (idx o0 v) (len q0)) (== (idx q0 (idx o0 v)) v)))
      (assert (== (idx q1 (idx o0 v)) (idx q0 (idx o0 v))))))))
(lemma tree_new (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                        (o0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (e0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int))
                        (o1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (e1 (seq int))
                        (head int) (u int) (w int) (e int) (v int))
  (requires (tree_all g h o0 p0 e0 s) (== (len p0) (len o0)) (== (len e0) (len o0))
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o0)))
            (upd1 o0 o1 w (len q0)) (upd1 p0 p1 w u) (upd1 e0 e1 w e)
            (< (idx o0 w) 0)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q0)))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len o0))) (== (idx o0 u) head)
            (edge_ok g h u w e)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len o1))) (!= v s) (>= (idx o1 v) 0))
  (ensures (tree_ok g h o1 p1 e1 v))
  (body (if (== v w)
    (block
      (assert (!= u w))
      (assert (== (idx o1 u) (idx o0 u)))
      (assert (== (idx p1 v) u))
      (assert (== (idx e1 v) e))
      (assert (== (idx o1 v) (len q0)))
      (assert (edge_ok g h (idx p1 v) v (idx e1 v)))
      (assert (tree_ok g h o1 p1 e1 v)))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx o1 v) (idx o0 v)))
      (assert (== (idx p1 v) (idx p0 v)))
      (assert (== (idx e1 v) (idx e0 v)))
      (assert (tree_ok g h o0 p0 e0 v))
      (assert (!= (idx p0 v) w))
      (assert (== (idx o1 (idx p0 v)) (idx o0 (idx p0 v))))
      (assert (edge_ok g h (idx p1 v) v (idx e1 v)))
      (assert (tree_ok g h o1 p1 e1 v))))))
(lemma closed_new (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (w int) (head int) (v int))
  (requires (closed_below g h o0 head) (mono o0 o1) (upd1 o0 o1 w (len q0)) (<= head (len q0))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len o1))) (and (<= 0 (idx o1 v)) (< (idx o1 v) head)))
  (ensures (closed_at g h o1 v))
  (body
    (assert (!= v w))
    (assert (== (idx o1 v) (idx o0 v)))
    (assert (closed_at g h o0 v))
    (call closed_mono g h o0 o1 v)))
(lemma visit_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                          (o0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (e0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int))
                          (o1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (e1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int))
                          (head int) (u int) (w int) (e int))
  (requires (bstate g h s o0 p0 e0 q0 head)
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len o0)))
            (upd1 o0 o1 w (len q0)) (upd1 p0 p1 w u) (upd1 e0 e1 w e) (push1 q0 q1 w)
            (< (idx o0 w) 0)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q0))) (== (idx q0 head) u)
            (edge_ok g h u w e))
  (ensures (bstate g h s o1 p1 e1 q1 head)
           (mono o0 o1)
           (and (< head (len q1)) (== (idx q1 head) u)))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 (idx q0 head)) (< (idx q0 head) (len o0))) (== (idx o0 (idx q0 head)) head)))
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len o0))) (== (idx o0 u) head)))
    (assert (== (idx q1 head) (idx q0 head)))
    (assert (!= s w))
    (assert (== (idx o1 s) (idx o0 s)))
    (call unvis_set o0 o1 w (len q0) (len o0))
    (call unvis_nonneg o1 (len o1))
    (forall ((y int)) (call mono_one o0 o1 w (len q0) y))
    (assert (mono o0 o1))
    (forall ((k int)) (call q_one o0 o1 q0 q1 w k))
    (forall ((y int)) (call q_two o0 o1 q0 q1 w y))
    (assert (q_ok o1 q1))
    (forall ((y int)) (call tree_new g h s o0 p0 e0 q0 o1 p1 e1 head u w e y))
    (assert (tree_all g h o1 p1 e1 s))
    (forall ((y int)) (call closed_new g h o0 o1 q0 w head y))
    (assert (closed_below g h o1 head))
    (assert (bstate g h s o1 p1 e1 q1 head))))
(lemma start_one (params (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (s int) (y int))
  (requires (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len o0))) (< (idx o0 z) 0)))
            (upd1 o0 o1 s 0) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len o0))))
  (ensures (=> (>= (idx o1 y) 0) (== y s)))
  (body (if (!= y s)
    (block
      (assert (== (idx o1 y) (idx o0 y)))
      (assert (< (idx o0 y) 0)))
    (block))))
(lemma bfs_start (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int)
                         (o0 (seq int)) (o1 (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int)) (q (seq int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (== (len o0) (len g)) (== (len par) (len g)) (== (len pe) (len g))
            (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len o0))) (< (idx o0 z) 0)))
            (upd1 o0 o1 s 0) (== (len q) 1) (== (idx q 0) s))
  (ensures (bstate g h s o1 par pe q 0))
  (body
    (call unvis_all o0 (len o0))
    (assert (< (idx o0 s) 0))
    (call unvis_set o0 o1 s 0 (len o0))
    (forall ((y int)) (call start_one o0 o1 s y))
    (assert (q_ok o1 q))
    (assert (tree_all g h o1 par pe s))
    (assert (closed_below g h o1 0))
    (assert (bstate g h s o1 par pe q 0))))
(lemma adv_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (q_ok ord q) (closed_below g h ord head) (closed_at g h ord u)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q))) (== (idx q head) u)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len ord))) (and (<= 0 (idx ord v)) (< (idx ord v) (+ head 1))))
  (ensures (closed_at g h ord v))
  (body (if (== (idx ord v) head)
    (block
      (assert (== (idx q (idx ord v)) v))
